Assombrado pela culpa pelos assassinatos em massa em Shibuya e desconfiado do interesse de Sukuna em Fushiguro, Itadori escolhe não voltar para Jujutsu High. Em vez disso, ele se junta a Choso para exorcizar os inúmeros espíritos amaldiçoados desencadeados por Noritoshi Kamo.
Em meio a esse caos, a Sede Jujutsu revoga a sentença de morte suspensa de Yuji Itadori e nomeia o feiticeiro de grau especial Yuta Okkotsu como seu carrasco.

Feiticeiros modernos recém-despertados e antigos ressuscitados, agora lutando como jogadores no jogo Culling, colidem com motivos conflitantes, dirigindo o mundo mais uma vez para uma era governada por jujutsu.

Minato's only source of strength is Ben-chan, a goddess in the form of a young girl that appeared in Benten Island. The time he spends with her are the only times where he feels like himself. But when he is about to be separated from Ben-chan due to being sent to a children's home, Minato prays to a Shiranuhi, a mysterious light floating above the sea, to grant him one wish. His wish, filled with hatred towards his father, eventually becomes a curse.

(Source: Anime News Network)

en.synopsisFull:
The Obinata Fireworks Shop factory is getting prepared for an administrative action for confiscation tomorrow. It has been six years since Keitaro has been holed up in a closed-down factory creating fireworks by himself, chasing after an illusion of his father who vanished. It is a story about three young people who overcome the extreme weather conditions, disasters and environmental problems imposed on them and establish their own identities.

(Source: Marché du Film Festival de Cannes)

*The film was selected for the 77th Cannes Film Festival’s 2024 Annecy Animation Showcase.

*Note: Initially slated for a 2025 release, on May 20th of the same year the movie was delayed to 2026.

en.synopsisFull:
Long, long ago, there lived a mermaid princess named Lara. She was raised with love by her father, the king of the sea kingdom, and her older sisters.

 One day, Lara fell in love with a human prince who lived on land. It was a forbidden love, one that was not allowed in the world of mermaids. Still, Lara journeyed to the surface. With a potion, given to her from the witch Grace, she became human. But the potion came at a cost: fail to find true love, she would turn into foam. Though she was a princess of the sea, Lara chose love. Yet, her wish went unfulfilled and perished into the sea.

 Two hundred years later, Lara awakens once more in Lake Biwa to finally search for her true love.

 All because of "love".
en.synopsisShort: Long, long ago, there lived a mermaid princess named Lara. She was raised with love by her father, the king of the sea kingdom, and her older sisters.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Há muito, muito tempo, vivia uma princesa sereia chamada Lara. Ela foi criada com amor por seu pai, o rei do reino do mar, e suas irmãs mais velhas.

Um dia, Lara se apaixonou por um príncipe humano que vivia em terra. Era um amor proibido, que não era permitido no mundo das sereias. Ainda assim, Lara viajou para a superfície. Com uma poção, dada a ela pela bruxa Grace, ela se tornou humana. Mas a poção chegou a um custo: não encontrar o verdadeiro amor, ela se transformaria em espuma. Embora ela fosse uma princesa do mar, Lara escolheu o amor. No entanto, seu desejo não foi realizado e pereceu no mar.

Duzentos anos depois, Lara desperta mais uma vez no Lago Biwa para finalmente procurar seu verdadeiro amor.

Tudo por causa do "amor".

Doscientos años después, Lara despierta una vez más en el lago Biwa para buscar finalmente su verdadero amor.

Todo por amor.

en.synopsisFull:
The year is 2029. In near-future Japan, where the world has become highly information-intensive, with a vast corporate network covering the planet, electrons and light pulsing through it. But the nation-state and ethnic groups still survive.

 Motoko Kusanagi, a full-body cyborg, leads an elite combat unit, including Batou. While commanding her team, Kusanagi envisions the creation of a specialized task force to preemptively strike against emerging threats. Meanwhile, Daisuke Aramaki of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, who had been planning to establish a similar unit, recruited Kusanagi and her team. Together, they begin operations as Public Security Section 9—an offensive tactical unit known as “Shell Squad.” As they confront complex cybercrimes and international conspiracies, the existence of a mysterious, unidentified hacker known as The “Puppet Master” emerges on the horizon of their investigation.

 What fate awaits Kusanagi? And what is the Puppet Master’s true objective? A new era of cyberpunk action begins.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
O ano é 2029. No futuro próximo do Japão, onde o mundo se tornou altamente intensivo em informação, com uma vasta rede corporativa cobrindo o planeta, elétrons e luz pulsando através dele. Mas o Estado-nação e grupos étnicos ainda sobrevivem.

Motoko Kusanagi, um ciborgue de corpo inteiro, lidera uma unidade de combate de elite, incluindo Batou. Enquanto comanda sua equipe, Kusanagi prevê a criação de uma força-tarefa especializada para atacar preventivamente contra ameaças emergentes. Enquanto isso, Daisuke Aramaki do Ministério de Assuntos Internos, que planejava estabelecer uma unidade semelhante, recrutou Kusanagi e sua equipe. Juntos, eles começam as operações como a Seção de Segurança Pública 9 - uma unidade tática ofensiva conhecida como "Shell Squad". Enquanto enfrentam crimes cibernéticos complexos e conspirações internacionais, a existência de um hacker misterioso e não identificado conhecido como o "Mestre dos Marionetas" emerge no horizonte de sua investigação.

Que destino espera Kusanagi? E qual é o verdadeiro objetivo do Mestre de Marionetes? Uma nova era de ação cyberpunk começa.

es.synopsisFull:
El año es 2029. En Japón cercano al futuro, donde el mundo se ha convertido en altamente intensivo de información, con una vasta red corporativa que cubre el planeta, electrones y luz que atraviesa. Pero los grupos nacionales y étnicos siguen sobreviviendo.

Motoko Kusanagi, un cyborg de cuerpo completo, conduce una unidad de combate de élite, incluyendo Batou. Al mando de su equipo, Kusanagi prevé la creación de un equipo de tareas especializado para atacar de forma preventiva contra las amenazas emergentes. Mientras tanto, Daisuke Aramaki del Ministerio del Interior, que había estado planeando establecer una unidad similar, contrató a Kusanagi y a su equipo. Juntos, comienzan las operaciones como Sección 9 de Seguridad Pública, una unidad táctica ofensiva conocida como “Escuadrón de Shell”. Al enfrentarse a complejos cibercrimens y conspiraciones internacionales, surge en el horizonte de su investigación la existencia de un misterioso hacker no identificado conocido como el “Maestro del títere”.

¿Qué destino espera Kusanagi? ¿Y cuál es el verdadero objetivo del maestro de títeres? Empieza una nueva era de acción ciberpunk.

en.synopsisFull:
Anthology movie consisting of three original animation segments:

Q1 - ÆLIENS (エリィアンズ)

Earth has entered an era of intergalatic exchange.

Amidst swirling prejudice and fear of aliens, Elie, an alien girl, arrives as a space goodwill ambassador. She loves Earth's culture and its often absurd daily life, and has teamed up with a civil servant working at the space agency to search for "friends".

Q2 - Yoroshiku★Shoujo (夜露死駆★少女)

GALs TOKYO, a city where morning never comes.

Night after night, girls who have lost their place in reality, known as "Gal P", gather here. Their goal is to become the winner, the "Queen" in a game called "Queen of Butterfly" or "QoB" for short.

Q3 - Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni (ノクターン～このグロテスクな夜に～)

A world after humanity has perished.

Traveling in a van are Ayame, a pure-blooded vampire, and three girls who survived by being bitten and "infected" by her. There, they find a sky full of stars that illuminate the night as brightly as day, and fields of glittering golden grass—even a desolate world looks so beautiful through the eyes of a vampire.

They enjoy a simple everyday life in this world left behind.

(Souce: Official Website, translated)
en.synopsisShort: Anthology movie consisting of three original animation segments:

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Filme de antologia composto por três segmentos de animação originais:

Q1 - LIENS

A Terra entrou em uma era de intercâmbio intergalático.

Em meio ao preconceito e ao medo de alienígenas, Elie, uma garota alienígena, chega como embaixadora da boa vontade espacial. Ela ama a cultura da Terra e sua vida diária, muitas vezes absurda, e se uniu a um funcionário público trabalhando na agência espacial para procurar "amigos".

Q2 - Yoroshiku-Shoujo

GALs Tokyo, uma cidade onde a manhã nunca chega.

Noite após noite, garotas que perderam seu lugar na realidade, conhecidas como "Gal P", se reúnem aqui. Seu objetivo é se tornar o vencedor, a "Rainha" em um jogo chamado "Rainha da Borboleta" ou "QoB".

Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni

Um mundo após a humanidade ter perecido.

Viajando em uma van estão Ayame, uma vampira de sangue puro, e três garotas que sobreviveram sendo mordidas e "infectadas" por ela. Lá, eles encontram um céu cheio de estrelas que iluminam a noite tão brilhantemente quanto o dia, e campos de grama dourada brilhante - mesmo um mundo desolado parece tão bonito através dos olhos de um vampiro.

Eles desfrutam de uma vida cotidiana simples neste mundo deixado para trás.

(Souce: Site oficial, traduzido)

es.synopsisFull:
Película de antología compuesta por tres segmentos de animación originales:

Q1 - ÈLIENS (corredores detrás de la pared)

La Tierra ha entrado en una era de intercambio intergalático.

En medio de los prejuicios y el miedo de los extranjeros, Elie, una chica alienígena, llega como embajador de buena voluntad espacial. Ama la cultura de la Tierra y su vida cotidiana a menudo absurda, y se ha unido con un funcionario que trabaja en la agencia espacial para buscar "amigos".

Q2 - Yoroshiku★Shoujo (corrección de moda)

GALs TOKYO, una ciudad donde nunca llega la mañana.

Buenas noches, chicas que han perdido su lugar en realidad, conocidas como "Gal P", se reúnen aquí. Su objetivo es convertirse en el ganador, el "Queen" en un juego llamado "Queen of Butterfly" o "QoB" para abreviar.

Q3 - Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni ( Seguir leyendo

Un mundo después de la humanidad ha muerto.

Viajar en una furgoneta son Ayame, un vampiro de sangre pura, y tres niñas que sobrevivieron siendo mordidas y "infectadas" por ella. Allí, encuentran un cielo lleno de estrellas que iluminan la noche tan brillante como el día, y campos de hierba dorada brillante, incluso un mundo desolado se ve tan hermoso a través de los ojos de un vampiro.

Disfrutan de una vida cotidiana simple en este mundo que queda atrás.

Meanwhile, Fern continues to cherish the gifts she has been blessed with throughout her life, each a reminder of those she holds dear.

Frieren—still honoring her vow to understand humanity—revisits memories of her journey with the Hero's party and her fleeting encounter with a legendary figure. As she reflects on the passage of time, the elven mage quietly questions whether she has truly changed, yet in the small, almost subtle choices that she makes, there are signs that she might have become more human than she realizes.

en.synopsisFull:
Taiyou Asano has settled into his career, having married into the Yozakura spy family. While he still struggles to control the powers granted to him by his wife, Mutsumi Yozakura, Taiyou works hard to complete missions alongside his new siblings. After taking down the organization Tanpopo, Taiyou and the Yozakuras agree to look after six-year-old Ai, one of Tanpopo's test subjects.

However, Taiyou's health soon begins to decline due to the Yozakura blood within his body. He dreams that the first head of the family, Tsubomi Yozakura, gives him a new mission: to kill her. To that end, he will have to learn more about his new family, become a silver-ranked spy, and push himself even more to succeed and continue protecting his family.

en.synopsisFull:
It is common knowledge that nobles will do anything for power; lying, manipulation, and extortion are the usual tactics. However, one family is exempt from this generalization: House Grail, whose main tenets are truth and integrity. The youngest daughter, Constance Grail, is just as moral as the rest of her family, believing in always doing the right thing and helping those in need.

However, these ideals do not help her when her fiancé cheats on her with another woman. Framed by his lover in the hope of her downfall, Constance has no one to hear her pleas for justice. Everyone turns a blind eye, save for one—the spirit of the infamous Scarlett Castiel—who possesses Constance and turns the tables on her accuser. However, this aid does not come without a price.

Ten years ago, Scarlett was executed for the attempted murder of Princess Cecilia. But this was actually a setup; as blunt and harsh as Scarlett could be, she would never stoop so low as to use poison. She has no idea who orchestrated her incrimination, but Scarlett demands that Constance—as the only one who can see her—help her exact revenge on all those who wronged her!
en.synopsisShort: It is common knowledge that nobles will do anything for power; lying, manipulation, and extortion are the usual tactics. However, one family is exempt from this generalization: House Grail, whose main tenets are truth and integrity. The youngest daughter, Constance Grail, is just as moral as the rest of her family, believing in always doing the right thing and helping those in need.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
É do conhecimento comum que os nobres farão qualquer coisa pelo poder; mentir, manipulação e extorsão são as táticas usuais. No entanto, uma família está isenta dessa generalização: a Casa Grail, cujos princípios principais são verdade e integridade. A filha mais nova, Constance Grail, é tão moral quanto o resto de sua família, acreditando em sempre fazer a coisa certa e ajudar os necessitados.

No entanto, esses ideais não a ajudam quando seu noivo a trai com outra mulher. Enquadrado por seu amante na esperança de sua queda, Constance não tem ninguém para ouvir seus apelos por justiça. Todos fecham os olhos, exceto um, o espírito da infame Scarlett Castiel, que possui Constance e vira as mesas em seu acusador. No entanto, esta ajuda não vem sem um preço.

Há dez anos, Scarlett foi executada pela tentativa de assassinato de Princess Cecilia. Mas isso era realmente uma armadilha, por mais contundente e dura que Scarlett pudesse ser, ela nunca se rebaixaria tão baixo a ponto de usar veneno. Ela não tem idéia de quem orquestrou sua incriminação, mas Scarlett exige que Constance - como o único que pode vê-la - ajude sua vingança exata sobre todos aqueles que a ofenderam!

en.synopsisFull:
Seiichirou Kondou, a salaryman approaching his 30s, gets caught up in a holy maiden summoning ritual and is transported to a parallel world called Romany Kingdom. Having worked day and night, he developed the mindset of a corporate slave and even demanded work in this new world, which landed him an accounting job at the Royal Accounting Department.

During his hectic days rebuilding the accounting department, Seiichirou came across a nutritional tonic that wiped away any fatigue. Thanks to the tonic, Seiichirou's chronic ailments and exhaustion completely disappeared, leaving him overjoyed. But because he had no resistance to the world's magic, the side effects put his life in danger!

The only way to survive was to have someone with magic help accustom his body to magical energy, so with no other choice Seiichirou entrusts himself to Aresh, captain of the Third Royal Order, known as the Ice Prince.

Seiichirou Kondou, um assalariado que se aproxima dos 30 anos, é pego em um ritual sagrado de convocação de donzela e é transportado para um mundo paralelo chamado Reino Romano. Tendo trabalhado dia e noite, ele desenvolveu a mentalidade de um escravo corporativo e até exigiu trabalho neste novo mundo, o que lhe rendeu um emprego de contabilidade no Departamento Real de Contabilidade.

Durante seus dias agitados reconstruindo o departamento de contabilidade, Seiichirou encontrou um tônico nutricional que eliminou qualquer fadiga. Graças ao tônico, as doenças crônicas de Seiichirou e a exaustão desapareceram completamente, deixando-o muito feliz. Mas porque ele não tinha resistência à magia do mundo, os efeitos colaterais colocaram sua vida em perigo!

A única maneira de sobreviver era ter alguém com ajuda mágica acostumando seu corpo a energia mágica, então sem outra escolha Seiichirou confia-se a Aresh, capitão da Terceira Ordem Real, conhecido como o Ice Prince.

en.synopsisFull:
Arne Neuntöte is a vampire detective who manipulates supernatural powers. Lynn Reinweiß is a nobleman’s daughter who loves vampires. Their worlds should never have crossed, but they join hands to solve a bloody mystery.

In the darkest of nights, Lynn finds herself in desperate need of help. Then she wanders into the mysterious city of "Lügenberg", where non-humans live. Lynn's world changes drastically when she encounters "Arne", a vampire who is called "the worst" in the city. And tonight, a new "murder case" has occurred. What is the truth behind the bizarre incidents that take place in a world where humanity and the bizarre intersect?

"Come on, human. You may dance merrily under the crimson moon.”

Na noite mais escura, Lynn encontra-se em necessidade desesperada de ajuda. Então ela vagueia pela misteriosa cidade de L genberg, onde não-humanos vivem. en.synopsisFull:
Round 3 of the MFG competition is heating up on the final race day at the Peninsula Manazuru track. Despite starting at the very front of the pack, MFG rookie Kanata Katagiri has difficulty getting the most out of his Toyota 86 GT due to an injury unknown to his competitors. Falling further behind, Kanata finds himself in a desperate situation that only stirs up unwanted memories.

At the head of the race, a vicious battle takes place between the two top drivers in the competition—Michael Beckenbauer and Kouki Sawatari—for the first spot on the podium. Given their aggressive and absurd driving, anyone daring to surpass either of them will have to match their level of pride until the very end. But when all hope seems lost for Kanata, a legendary competitive spirit awakens within him, and it may just push him to overcome his physical limitations and climb back to the top.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: Each episode streams 3 days early on Prime Video. The original TV broadcast started on January 4, 2026.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
A terceira rodada da competição MFG está esquentando no último dia de corrida na pista de Manazuru Peninsula. Apesar de começar na frente da matilha, o novato da MFG Kanata Katagiri tem dificuldade em tirar o máximo proveito de seu Toyota 86 GT devido a uma lesão desconhecida de seus concorrentes. Caindo mais para trás, Kanata encontra-se em uma situação desesperada que só desperta memórias indesejadas.

À frente da corrida, uma batalha cruel acontece entre os dois principais pilotos da competição - Michael Beckenbauer e Kouki Sawatari - para o primeiro lugar no pódio. Dada a sua condução agressiva e absurda, qualquer um que ouse superar qualquer um deles terá que igualar seu nível de orgulho até o fim. Mas quando toda a esperança parece perdida para Kanata, um lendário espírito competitivo desperta dentro dele, e pode apenas empurrá-lo para superar suas limitações físicas e subir de volta ao topo.

(Fonte: MAL Reescrever)

Nota: Cada episódio é transmitido 3 dias antes no Prime Video. A transmissão original da TV começou em 4 de janeiro de 2026.

(Fuente: MAL Rewrite)

Batalhas ferozes irrompem em todo o Wahr Welt entre os Treze esquadrões da Guarda e a Guarda Real. Ichigo aprende sobre as verdadeiras intenções de Uryuu e renova sua determinação de proteger o mundo juntos, como amigos que confiam uns nos outros. Yhwach superou até mesmo sua própria habilidade, The Almighty...

A feroz batalha pela sobrevivência dos Três Mundos se aproxima de seu fim. Além do caos da calamidade, o que está na espera? Desespero ou esperança?

es.synopsisFull:
La destrucción se desploma al final de la Guerra de la Sangre Mil Años entre los Reapers del Alma y Quincies... mientras la muerte de los Soul King refleja el colapso de los Tres Mundos, las distorsiones y los presagios de destrucción comienzan a aparecer en todos los reinos.

Quince batallas eruptieron a lo largo de la Wahr Welt entre los 13 Escuadrones de la Guardia de la Corte y la Guardia Real. Ichigo aprende sobre las verdaderas intenciones de Uryuu y renueva su determinación de proteger el mundo juntos, como amigos que confían entre sí. Yhwach ha superado incluso su propia habilidad, The Almighty...

La feroz batalla por la supervivencia de los Tres Mundos se acerca a su fin. Más allá del caos de la calamidad, ¿qué hay en la espera, el amor o la esperanza?

en.synopsisFull:
Thirty years ago, the world was nearly destroyed by the sudden appearance of unknown "invasive alien species."

Humans and these “invasive species” continue to vie for living space, and while humanity’s safety is currently barely secured, the world could be destroyed at any moment. Living in fear of death and destruction, people go about their daily lives as if trying to avert their eyes from danger and disaster.

In this world, the United Nations Hazardous Species Investigation Agency, "EXCEEDS," has begun operations to ward off crises and disasters caused by invasive species.

The story begins on the island nation of "Mizuho" in the Far East. Shina Hisase is a young invasive species extermination hunter living on a remote island. What incident will befall Shina, who wishes only to live quietly with her younger sister Setsuna, her sole remaining family member?

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~48 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.
en.synopsisShort: Thirty years ago, the world was nearly destroyed by the sudden appearance of unknown "invasive alien species."

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Trinta anos atrás, o mundo foi quase destruído pelo súbito aparecimento de "espécies alienígenas invasivas" desconhecidas.

Os humanos e essas "espécies invasivas" continuam a disputar o espaço vital, e enquanto a segurança da humanidade está atualmente mal assegurada, o mundo pode ser destruído a qualquer momento. Vivendo com medo da morte e da destruição, as pessoas vivem suas vidas diárias como se tentassem evitar o perigo e o desastre.

Neste mundo, a Agência de Investigação de Espécies Perigosas das Nações Unidas, "EXCEEDS", iniciou operações para afastar crises e desastres causados por espécies invasoras.

A história começa na nação insular de "Mizuho" no Extremo Oriente. Shina Hisase é uma jovem caçadora de extermínio de espécies invasoras vivendo em uma ilha remota. Que incidente acontecerá com Shina, que só deseja viver tranquilamente com sua irmã mais nova Setsuna, seu único membro da família?

Nota: O primeiro episódio foi ao ar com um tempo de execução de 48 minutos em oposição ao episódio padrão de 24 minutos.

pt-BR.source: Tradução automática local (OPUS-MT en→pt-BR)

es.synopsisFull:
Hace treinta años, el mundo estaba casi destruido por la repentina aparición de especies desconocidas de alienígenas.

Los humanos y estas “especies invasoras” continúan vieando para el espacio vivo, y mientras la seguridad de la humanidad está actualmente apenas asegurada, el mundo podría ser destruido en cualquier momento. Viviendo con miedo a la muerte y la destrucción, la gente va por su vida cotidiana como si tratara de evitar sus ojos del peligro y el desastre.

En este mundo, la Agencia de Investigación de Especies Peligrosas de las Naciones Unidas, "EXCEEDS", ha comenzado a operar para evitar crisis y desastres causados por especies invasoras.

La historia comienza en la nación isleña de "Mizuho" en el Lejano Oriente. Shina Hisase es un joven cazador de exterminio de especies invasivas que vive en una remota isla. ¿Qué incidente ocurrirá con Shina, que sólo quiere vivir tranquilamente con su hermana menor Setsuna, su único miembro de la familia restante?

Nota: El primer episodio se transmitió con una duración de ~48 minutos en lugar del episodio estándar de 24 minutos.

en.synopsisFull: In the Age of Catastrophe, five heroes saved the world from a primordial evil. One of the heroes, now reborn as Leo Plove, is excited to revisit his glorious past—only to find his name erased from history. Determined to uncover the truth, he joins Lumerne, a hero military academy, unaware he's about to discover dark secrets surrounding his reincarnation. Why are his past records hidden, and who wants to keep them that way? Will Leo be able to set things right and reclaim the credit he deserves?

en.synopsisFull: Noah, the world’s strongest six-year-old, has been privileged enough to be reborn as the emperor’s 13th child. What’s more, he’s been overpowered with an infinite level cap and a cheat that stacks the powers of anyone who serves him. But even privilege has its problems—the glittering facade of high society hides a world of conspiracies, schemes, and power struggles.

A fantasy about a young man, a blind genius, who opens up the world through curiosity in the pursuit for magic is about to begin.

en.synopsisFull:
Socially inept, Higawa Koyuki maintains a wall between herself and other people. She spends her time in high school alone, until she meets Amamiya Minato, a boy who keeps trying to close the distance between them for some reason?!

The loner Koyuki, the popular Miki, the boundary-less Minato, and the kind basketball player Youta. This is the story about four complicated and confused young people and their mixed up lives!

en.synopsisFull:
This is a story of four girls living in the "Dark Side" of Academy City.

In Academy City where "ESP" has been recognized as a general science. Behind the peace, there is a Dark Side organization that undertakes missions that cannot be made public.

"ITEM" is an elite unit consisting of four girls. Takitsubo Rikou is able to read and track the AIM fields emitted by those with abilities. Frenda Seivelun, who excels in combat using explosives and traps.

Kinuhata Saiai, who can manipulate nitrogen at will and plays a defensive role. And one of the 7 Espers that Academy City is proud of: Mugino Shizuri. They live freely in the darkness of the Academy City, and quietly set their sights on their target...!

This is a story of encounter, friendship, and darkness that eventually leads to a terrible incident!
en.synopsisShort: This is a story of four girls living in the "Dark Side" of Academy City.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Esta é a história de quatro garotas vivendo no "lado escuro" de Academy City.

Em Academy City, onde "ESP" foi reconhecido como uma ciência geral. Por trás da paz, há uma organização do Lado Negro que realiza missões que não podem ser tornadas públicas.

"ITEM" é uma unidade de elite composta por quatro garotas. Takitsubo Rikou é capaz de ler e rastrear os campos AIM emitidos por pessoas com habilidades. Frenda Seivelun, que se destaca em combate usando explosivos e armadilhas.

Kinuhata Saiai, que pode manipular nitrogênio à vontade e desempenha um papel defensivo. E um dos 7 Esperadores de que Academy City se orgulha: Mugino Shizuri. Eles vivem livremente na escuridão da cidade da Academia, e calmamente fixam seus olhos em seu alvo...!

Esta é uma história de encontro, amizade e escuridão que eventualmente leva a um terrível incidente!

En la Ciudad de la Academia donde el "ESP" ha sido reconocido como una ciencia general. Detrás de la paz, hay una organización del lado oscuro que realiza misiones que no pueden hacerse públicas.

en.synopsisFull: When she doesn’t feel well, when there’s a test, when she doesn’t want to go to school... I take her place. I’m her replica. I’m not meant for anything else. But that changed when I fell in love. I wear my hair up so the boy I fell for knows it’s me. We skip school and promise to meet again tomorrow, and every day after. I’m her replica. Everything about me is borrowed and empty, but my heart is mine.

en.synopsisFull:
The fire extinguishing samurai who stopped the great fire was called "The fire-eating bird". Matsunaga Gengo, once known as the "Fire-eating Bird", was the best fire-fighting samurai in Edo. He had resigned from the fire brigade for a reason but suddenly received an invitation to serve in the Shinjo clan.

The Shinjo clan's fire-fighting team had no money and no personnel and was looked down upon by those around them. With the encouragement of his wife, Miyuki, Gengo decides to rebuild the collapsed fire-fighting clan as its chairman. Gengo and his friends, all of whom have their own peculiarities, struggle to "save any life", despite being ridiculed as "ragged steeplejacks"(= the 'Boro-Tobi-Gumi'.), In Edo, a mysterious series of suspicious fires called "foxfires" continue.

An entertaining action drama opens, with the firefighters scrambling to save lives in the face of the approaching disaster!

A equipe de combate a incêndios do clã Shinjo não tinha dinheiro nem pessoal e foi desprezada por aqueles ao seu redor. Com o incentivo de sua esposa, Miyuki, Gengo decide reconstruir o clã de combate a incêndios em colapso como seu presidente. Um drama de ação se abre, com os bombeiros lutando para salvar vidas diante do desastre que se aproxima!

en.synopsisFull: At the mysterious orphanage where Sheena lives, death is nothing new to its residents—girls who no longer have families of their own, who are raised as weapons of war, taught to kill and take the lives of others without batting an eye. Everyone, that is, except Sheena, who wishes for nothing more than the growing conflict around her to end. On the night of her roommate's death, Sheena meets a strange girl covered in blood, who smiles despite the turmoil surrounding them. The next day, the girl appears as a new student in Sheena's class and introduces herself as Mimi. Initially thought to be a school myth, there are now whispers in the orphanage's halls that Mimi is their secret weapon—an immortal who cannot die. When Mimi is later assigned as Sheena's new roommate, Sheena's world grows even more complicated when she begins living with someone who loves and welcomes death, when all Sheena wants to do is stop it…

en.synopsisFull:
Two young boys... the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom - a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region.

The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return.

Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war.

The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

Os dois olharam para o mesmo céu estrelado, dormiram na mesma tenda e acreditaram no mesmo futuro. Uma vez que a luta acabou, e a noite terminou, suas vidas diárias com certeza voltariam.

Ao contrário de suas esperanças, os dois garotos são arrastados pelo redemoinho do destino, guiados pelas chamas da guerra.

Os garotos impotentes buscaram, e agarraram imenso poder. À medida que as 108 estrelas brilham intensamente no horizonte escuro, os meninos avançam, cada um com suas próprias crenças para uma pergunta sem resposta.

en.synopsisFull:
Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she’s the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: The series streamed a week in advance on ABEMA, Prime Video, and Crunchyroll starting with episode 2 released alongside episode 1.

en.synopsisFull:
After an unidentified plant from outer space invasion, Rita finds herself trapped in a time loop, forced to relive the same day over and over again. With each loop, she learns. She fights. Her memories and experiences sharpen her skills, turning her into a formidable warrior. Yet, the endless cycle of death and solitude begins to wear her down. Then, she meets Keiji. "I've been repeating this day too," he says. Two lost souls, trapped in an endless war. Could their meeting change fate?

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime)

Note: The film received an early premiere at the 2025 Annecy International Animation Film Festival on June 9, 2025.

en.synopsisFull: Always ready for a fight! Destruction for destruction’s sake! The online streamer Aoringo is a troll, making the worst of the worst of boundary-pushing flamebait content and raking in the revenue from the hate-watchers. You may think he’s nothing more than a bottom feeder and a drain on society, but in reality, he’s high school dropout Souji Enishiro, a caring older brother with a sweet tooth who loves nothing more than his little sister. His viral videos? Just a way to pay his sister’s medical bills. And even if all of humanity hates him, he doesn’t care, so long as his little sister gets better. But then, something very strange begins to happen...

en.synopsisFull: When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by “Apollo.” However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation. Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler. He makes it his mission to search for Apollo, as there is something he wants to tell her. He doesn’t know what she looks like, or even what her real name is, but he manages to get some leads on her in his school’s broadcasting club. That’s where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices! Just who is Apollo, and how will those four’s dreams pan out?

The supernatural story of a scumbag master and his self-proclaimed apprentice begins!

en.synopsisFull:
As maidens from the Five Clans battle for the Crown Prince’s heart, jealous Keigetsu uses forbidden magic to swap bodies with the beloved Reirin. Switching places does not guarantee happiness for Keigetsu with her new body's ill health leaving her hanging on the verge of death. Meanwhile, Reirin, now wearing the face of a scorned outcast, must answer for Keigetsu’s crimes in a dangerous trial.

The unlikely pair become increasingly entangled in each other’s lives and they will need to work together to survive after discovering the dark conspiracies brewing beneath the palace's genial surface. To confront the deadly threats lurking in the shadows, Reirin must embrace her new identity and defy their expectations of the court's inept villainess.

As seasons have passed, Mizuho Nishino's adolescence has been full of ups and downs. With Christmas approaching, she intends to celebrate the special event with all of her four childhood friends: Kizuki Hazawa, Shin Kashiwagi, Airu Izumi, and Shuugo Hoshikawa. However, Kizuki makes the first move when he declares that he wants to spend the time alone with Mizuho. Although hesitant at first, Mizuho ends up confiding in him and declares Kizuki to be her boyfriend!

The news about Mizuho and Kizuki spreads quickly and brings forth Shin and Airu, who have had a difficult time accepting their feelings for the one they love. With the friend group faced with a delicate situation they have never confronted before, only time will tell if the new romance and old friendships can survive.

en.synopsisFull:
Ever since the novice coach Tsukasa Akeuraji took Inori Yuitsuka under his mentorship, she has improved her figure skating at a fast pace. After passing a qualifying badge test, she earns a spot to compete in the upcoming Chubu Block Tournament, where only five of the 15 competitors can move forward to the next stage—the prestigious All-Japan Novice Tournament. However, earning a slot will not be easy for Inori: most of her rivals have already experienced trying their luck in the competition.

The stakes are high as the competition begins, and one by one, each of the competitors strive to perform their very best in front of the big crowd. Moreover, the current figure skating generation's prodigy, Hikaru Kamisaki, is not competing in this block, which raises everyone's determination to qualify. That includes Inori, who must beat the odds if she wants to keep her promise to reach Hikaru and represent Japan in the Olympics with Tsukasa.

As a prefect, he's supposed to be a role model to other students, but unfortunately he's not perfect. en.synopsisFull:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards.
However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!
en.synopsisShort: This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Esta é a Academia Fujinasu, uma escola particular com alunos de alto nível localizados nos arredores da cidade.

High School 1o ano Ume Mizunoe tem excelentes notas na aula de língua japonesa e recebeu vários prêmios literários.
No entanto, suas terríveis notas nas ciências estão afetando sua capacidade de subir uma nota. Para evitar repetir um ano, ele se torna membro do conselho estudantil para melhorar sua posição acadêmica.

No entanto, no conselho estudantil, ele conhece o carismático e mal-humorado presidente do conselho estudantil Kotobuki Hisako, e o tesoureiro assustador, mas gentil e refinado, Arisu Terui. Outros membros incluem um garoto atrevido e fofo, Tan Otori, e Komaro Michinoku, o administrador que é como um pequeno gato abandonado. Este é o começo de um pastelão, de coração, rom-com sobre um conselho estudantil ocupado cheio de estudantes fofos, incompatíveis e peculiares!

es.synopsisFull:
Esta es la Academia Fujinasu, una escuela secundaria privada con estudiantes de primer nivel ubicados en las afueras de la ciudad.

High School 1er año Ume Mizunoe tiene excelentes calificaciones en la clase de idioma japonés y ha recibido múltiples premios literarios.
Sin embargo, sus terribles grados en las ciencias están afectando su capacidad de avanzar en un grado. Para evitar repetir un año, se convierte en miembro del consejo estudiantil para mejorar su posición académica.

Sin embargo, en el consejo estudiantil, se encuentra con el carismático y suplementario presidente del consejo estudiantil Kotobuki Hisako, y el tesorero aterrador pero amable, Arisu Terui. Otros miembros incluyen un chico mejilla y lindo, Tan Otori y Komaro Michinoku, el administrador que es como un gato abandonado pequeño. Este es el comienzo de un palillo, lleno de corazón, rom-com acerca de un concejo estudiantil ocupado lleno de estudiantes lindos, desajustados y peculiares!

en.synopsisFull: Flum has been chosen by God to be in the hero's party despite having stats of zero across the board. All she has is the "Reversal" ability that she still doesn't fully understand. Predictably, she proves useless in battle, but she refuses to give up and continues to do all she can for the party. Her partymate Jean, a genius and renowned sage, picks on her at every opportunity and eventually sells her off into slavery. Even as a slave, she's treated as incompetent and persecuted, and ultimately thrown to monsters as bait for her master's entertainment. Flum is left with two options: take up the cursed sword that inevitably brings death to its wielder, or be eaten by monsters. The moment she chooses to fight back is when the "Reversal" of her life begins...

Flum se deja con dos opciones: tomar la espada maldecida que inevitablemente trae la muerte a su pelador, o ser comido por monstruos. en.synopsisFull:
Meisuke "Nube" Nueno, a teacher at Doumori Elementary School and expert in the occult, finds it increasingly difficult to protect his students against dark forces. After one of his students is sent to a parallel world, Nube encounters an unusual spirit that sends him back in time to change one regretful event.

Although Nube manages to fix the situation, this succession of unlikely events suggests that a more serious menace may be threatening the peace of Doumori. To protect everyone he holds dear, Nube will have to overcome the demons of his past and uncover the nature of the looming supernatural danger.

en.synopsisFull:
Having spent his childhood in the slums, Hajime Shinonome desperately sought strength to survive.

Now, he enjoys a peaceful and carefree life as a resident adventurer of the Komai Village.

One day, during a quest, he ventured into a dungeon and finds a young girl being partially eaten by a weakest kind of monster, a slime!

The girl's name was Lirui. Having been abandoned by her parents, she had no place to go and entered the dungeon alone in order to stay alive. Hajime couldn't just leave her there, so he took her back to the village to live with him!
en.synopsisShort: Having spent his childhood in the slums, Hajime Shinonome desperately sought strength to survive.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Tendo passado sua infância nas favelas, Hajime Shinonome desesperadamente procurou força para sobreviver.

Agora, ele desfruta de uma vida pacífica e despreocupada como um aventureiro residente da Vila Komai.

Um dia, durante uma missão, ele se aventurou em uma masmorra e encontra uma jovem sendo parcialmente comida por um tipo mais fraco de monstro, um lodo!

O nome da garota era Lirui. Tendo sido abandonada por seus pais, ela não tinha para onde ir e entrou na masmorra sozinha para se manter viva. Hajime não podia deixá-la lá, então ele a levou de volta para a aldeia para viver com ele!

Habiendo pasado su infancia en los barrios marginales, Hajime Shinonome buscó desesperadamente fuerza para sobrevivir.

Ahora, disfruta de una vida tranquila y sin preocupaciones como aventurero residente de la Villa Komai.

Un día, durante una búsqueda, se aventuró en una mazmorra y encuentra a una joven siendo parcialmente comido por un tipo más débil de monstruo, un baboso!

El nombre de la chica era Lirui. Habiendo sido abandonada por sus padres, no tenía lugar para ir y entrar en la mazmorra solo para mantenerse viva. Hajime no podía dejarla allí, así que la llevó de vuelta al pueblo para vivir con él!

To her surprise, she’s not sure how to handle this new relationship, especially when her newfound friend is a prince himself (and a guy prince, at that). The story of the two high school princes starts here!

en.synopsisFull:
“I will become the world’s most wonderful maid!”

With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count’s family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic. Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Ko)! streamed a week in advance of the TV broadcast on dAnimeStore and ABEMA beginning June 24th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 1st, 2026.

"Eu me tornarei a empregada mais maravilhosa do mundo!"

Quando ela faz isso, até o chá barato se transforma em uma bebida de luxo, e uma mansão em ruínas é rapidamente restaurada para novo! Limpar, servir, caçar, deixar tudo para ela e sua poderosa magia. Sem o conhecimento de Melody, este mundo é na verdade um jogo de otomas, e ela é a heroína mais poderosa e invencível, a santa! No entanto, ela permanece inconsciente desse fato. en.synopsisFull:
We all have embarrassing memories or deep regrets from high school, right? Socially anxious college senior Natsuki Haibara sure does. When he thinks back on that time of his life, all he has are fleeting fantasies of a happy adolescence that could have been. Imagine his bewilderment and surprise, then, when he inexplicably finds himself seven years in the past—one month before his first year of high school! Can Haibara avoid his previous mistakes, make his way to the top of the school social pyramid, and end up with the girl of his dreams? Or will he be forced to relive three years of solitude as the most hated guy in school? He’ll need all the help he can get in order to succeed, from a workout regimen to online how-to guides, a childhood friend, and plenty of sheer willpower. Watch as Haibara takes a second shot at his teenage years!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: The first 4 episodes had an advance screening on March 15th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.

One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.

In order to prevent this type of tragedy from reoccurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston’s masks that are spread around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronting powerful foes. The boy continues on. en.synopsisFull:
A curse that binds past and present.

Mao, a young mystic who lives in the Taisho period of early 1900s Japan, is a mysterious onmyoji who, after suffering a life-altering curse, has continued to live for nine hundred long years. His world becomes even stranger when he meets Nanoka Kiba, a junior high schooler who seems to have traveled from the future. In spite of her tender years, Nanoka has lived a strange life herself, marked by her traumatic experience as a young child losing both her parents to a grisly accident. But when Nanoka decides to return to that fateful shopping arcade, she is transported to another time and place - a world where supernatural ayakashi thrive in an era long before her own. There she meets Mao, whose abrupt and bizarre question prompts Nanoka to see herself and her curious life in a completely new light. Now the two travelers from different worlds unite as they take on the dark powers that grip both their lives.

Seu mundo se torna ainda mais estranho quando ele conhece Nanoka Kiba, um estudante do ensino médio que parece ter viajado do futuro. Apesar de seus tenros anos, Nanoka viveu uma vida estranha, marcada por sua experiência traumática quando criança, perdendo ambos os pais em um terrível acidente. Mas quando Nanoka decide voltar para aquele fatídico arcade de compras, ela é transportada para outro tempo e lugar - um mundo onde ayakashi sobrenatural prospera em uma era muito antes da sua. Lá ela conhece Mao, cuja pergunta abrupta e bizarra leva Nanoka a ver a si mesma e sua vida curiosa sob uma luz completamente nova. Agora os dois viajantes de mundos diferentes se unem enquanto assumem os poderes das trevas que prendem ambas as suas vidas.

As royal obligations intertwine with hints of true love and the stirrings of her own latent power, Carolina moves ever closer to understanding what it truly means to be exceptional.

en.synopsisFull:
"I want to blossom, in this city."

The story follows two Japanese girls who never give up in reaching for étoile (stars) during the difficult times at the start of 20th century. Fujiko, who dreams of becoming a painter, and Chizuru, who is drawn into the world of ballet, meet by chance in Yokohama. Then, as if guided by fate, they meet again in Paris and work hard to follow their dreams together.
en.synopsisShort: "I want to blossom, in this city."

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
"Quero florescer nesta cidade."

A história segue duas garotas japonesas que nunca desistem de alcançar Étoile (estrelas) durante os tempos difíceis no início do século 20. Fujiko, que sonha em se tornar um pintor, e Chizuru, que é atraído para o mundo do balé, se encontram por acaso em Yokohama. Então, como se guiados pelo destino, eles se encontram novamente em Paris e trabalham duro para seguir seus sonhos juntos.
pt-BR.synopsisShort: "Quero florescer nesta cidade."
pt-BR.source: Tradução automática local (OPUS-MT en→pt-BR)

es.synopsisFull:
"Quiero florecer, en esta ciudad."

La historia sigue a dos chicas japonesas que nunca se rinden en alcanzar el étoile (estrellas) durante los tiempos difíciles a principios del siglo XX. Fujiko, que sueña con convertirse en un pintor, y Chizuru, que es dibujado en el mundo del ballet, se reúne por casualidad en Yokohama. Entonces, como si fueran guiados por el destino, se encuentran de nuevo en París y trabajan duro para seguir sus sueños juntos.

en.synopsisFull:
After buying a pair of shoes that end up hurting her feet, Nami returns to the shop feeling dissatisfied.
There, she meets Lebno, the designer, who tells her, “I’ll make you a brand-new pair from scratch—but only if you’ll be my model.”
The shoes are crafted by the artisan Miucha, leading to an unexpected and stylish encounter.

(Source: Toei Animation)

Note: Adaptation of the "episode : NAMI" chapter from the "ONE PIECE novel HEROINES" light novel.

en.synopsisFull:
Movie remake of the Yoshiwara Enjou arc.

Upon meeting a young boy named Haruta who makes a living as a pickpocket, Gintoki discovers that he is pickpocketing out of a desire to meet his long-lost mother, Hiwa, Yoshiwara's number one courtesan. Gintoki and his friends venture to Yoshiwara to fulfill Haruta's wish, but standing in their way is Housen, the Night King who rules Yoshiwara.

Note: This anime was announced at the "Gintama Multiverse Festival," an event held on August 16th, as part of the "Gintama 20th Anniversary Project." This movie features volumes 25 and 26 of the manga, and the TV anime series spans eight episodes, from episodes 139 to 146.
en.synopsisShort: Movie remake of the Yoshiwara Enjou arc.

Gintoki e seus amigos se aventuram em Yoshiwara para cumprir o desejo de Haruta, mas ficar no caminho deles é Housen, o Night King que governa Yoshiwara.

Nota: Este anime foi anunciado no "Gintama Multiverse Festival", um evento realizado em 16 de agosto, como parte do "Gintama 20th Anniversary Project". Este filme apresenta os volumes 25 e 26 do mangá, e a série de anime de TV abrange oito episódios, dos episódios 139 a 146.

en.synopsisFull: In Earthclear, everyone is born into a fixed role, and villagers are the weakest of all. Most never rise above Level 5—except Kouji Kagami, who is Level…999?! On a monster hunt, he meets Alice, the Demon King’s daughter, and discovers they share an impossible dream: coexistence between humans and demons. In a world destined for conflict, they charge into battle to defy fate and shatter the rules.

en.synopsisFull: In a society where torture is legal—and big business—Spirytus dominates the industry with skill, style, and surprisingly cheerful teamwork. Part-timers Cero, Shiu, Mikke, and Hugh tackle “client sessions,” office shenanigans, and even the occasional in-house assassin…all with a smile! Life at Spirytus proves that even in a world of pain, work can still be surprisingly fun!

en.synopsisFull: Wishing she would live up to the ideal, Kanzaki Nao's father named her thusly for “honesty”. Nao has more than lived up to her father's wishes--even exceeding them and earning the label of "a foolishly honest girl". This makes Nao the least qualified candidate for the high stakes 'Liar Game', where winning requires deceiving the opponent out of their money and losing means receiving massive debt. However, that doesn't stop a box containing a hundred million yen in cash and a card informing her of her participation in the game from arriving at her doorstep, nor does it stop her from being promptly tricked out of the entire sum of money. Upon hearing that a genius swindler, responsible for the bankruptcy of a major corporation, is being released from jail, Nao goes to the swindler, Shinichi Akiyama, to enlist his help. With that, the two are drawn into the dark, greed-filled, and deceptive world of the Liar Game.

pt-BR.synopsisFull: Desejando que ela vivesse de acordo com o ideal, o pai de Kanzaki Nao a nomeou assim por "honestidade". Isso faz Nao o candidato menos qualificado para o jogo de apostas altas 'Liar Game', onde a vitória exige enganar o oponente fora de seu dinheiro e perder significa receber dívida maciça. No entanto, isso não impede uma caixa contendo cem milhões de ienes em dinheiro e um cartão informando-a de sua participação no jogo de chegar à sua porta, nem impede que ela seja prontamente enganada com toda a soma de dinheiro. Ao ouvir que um vigarista gênio, responsável pela falência de uma grande corporação, está sendo libertado da prisão, Nao vai para o vigarista, Shinichi Akiyama, para pedir sua ajuda. Com isso, os dois são atraídos para o mundo sombrio, cheio de ganância e enganoso do jogo dos mentirosos.

en.synopsisFull: No one knows how the pampered and wicked Erin Lisus suddenly becomes a top swordsman at Atenz Academy. That's because they don't realize that Erin was actually transported to the past after being killed by her stepmother and was reborn into different worlds. Now, with her past experience as a swordmaster, Erin's out to get revenge and rescue her allies from her stepmother's grasp. But with foes at every corner, can Erin save her loved ones? Or will her reason to wield the sword vanish with them?

en.synopsisFull:
What’s a maid to do when she finds herself suddenly stuck in Japan for a year? Eat, of course! Follow maid-in-training Suzume Tachibana as she tries all sorts of Japanese food, from sweets like taiyaki and melon bread to savory snacks like takoyaki and onigiri! Be warned, though-while Suzume sates her appetite through delicious treat after delicious treat, she might just end up whetting yours!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Maid-san wa Taberu dake was streamed a week in advance on dAnimestore, ABEMA, and U-Next starting with episode 2. Episode 1 was streamed on April 1, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on April 5, 2026.

en.synopsisFull:
Juuzou Oogami is a legendary hitman who has never failed an assignment, no matter how impossible. One day, after wiping out a powerful organization, he is stung by a mysterious wasp and collapses. When he wakes up, the fearsome 39-year-old assassin has been transformed into a 13-year-old boy!

Before he can even process what happened, his boss delivers a new order: “In that body, infiltrate a middle school.”

What awaits him is an unexpected school life filled with colorful classmates, youthful chaos, and looming danger. Can Juuzou ever return to his original form? Or will the assassins closing in on him end his second life before it even begins!?
en.synopsisShort: Juuzou Oogami is a legendary hitman who has never failed an assignment, no matter how impossible. Quando ele acorda, o temível assassino de 39 anos foi transformado em um garoto de 13 anos!

Antes que ele possa processar o que aconteceu, seu chefe entrega uma nova ordem: "Naquele corpo, infiltre-se em uma escola secundária."

O que o espera é uma vida escolar inesperada cheia de colegas coloridos, caos juvenil e perigo iminente. Juuzou pode voltar à sua forma original? Ou os assassinos se aproximando dele terminarão sua segunda vida antes mesmo de começar?

en.synopsisFull: Conan, Ran, Sonoko, and Kogoro were heading to Yokohama's Minato Mirai district with motorcycle enthusiast Masumi Sera for the Kanagawa Motorcycle Festival. Then, a mysterious black motorcycle appeared, leaping over the car carrying Conan and the others. And chasing it was Chihaya Hagiwara of the Kanagawa Prefectural Police Traffic Mobile Unit—the “Goddess of the Wind” Ran had once seen. However, after a fierce car chase, Chihaya's motorcycle was wrecked, and she let the target slip away at the last moment. After arriving at the Yokohama festival venue, Conan and the others witnessed the unveiling of a new police motorcycle equipped with cutting-edge technology, named "Angel." Amidst this, reports surfaced that a runaway "black motorcycle" had now appeared in central Tokyo, evading pursuit by the Metropolitan Police Department. The purpose of the rampage remains unknown, but the vehicle's body bears a striking resemblance to "Angel." Police have dubbed the black Angel bike "Lucifer" and continue their pursuit.

en.synopsisFull:
"I want to learn to love myself—just the way I am!" Renako Amaori, a former gloomy and socially awkward girl, reinvented herself for high school and successfully made her debut. She even managed to join the top-tier popular group... only to be suddenly confessed to by two of its brightest stars?! One is the school’s ultimate prince, Mai Oduka. The other, the beloved angel of the campus, Ajisai Sena. There’s no way she can handle both their affections—no freaking way!

While still struggling to give them an answer, Renako agrees to help her friend Kaho by joining a cosplay event. It’s the perfect excuse to delay her reply… or so she thought. But as she witnesses Kaho's passion firsthand, something begins to stir inside her. What is it that she truly wants? What is she truly searching for?

Can she really not become someone’s lover? Or has that "no freaking way"... not been so impossible after all?

(Source: REMOW)

Note: The anime first premiered in theaters across Japan on November 21, 2025. It was later split into 5 parts on TV, labelled as episodes 13-17.

en.synopsisFull:
"Actually, I’m Touko Kirishima."

The audience erupted in excitement upon learning that the true identity of the mysterious, wildly popular internet singer was none other than the nation’s favorite actress, Mai Sakurajima. The scene was exactly the same as the dream Sakuta Azusagawa had seen on Christmas Eve.

Starting with Mai’s shocking confession on April 1, the impossible events that everyone once dreamed of keep happening one after another.

The social media hashtag "#Yumemiru," where dreams come true, has vanished, and as Sakuta struggles with the disconnect between the reality before him and his own perception, he receives a message from a version of himself in an alternate reality.

―Stop Touko Kirishima,

―Before reality is rewritten.

To restore the world to its original state, Sakuta sets out to find Touko Kirishima. This is a story about overcoming the "Adolescent Syndrome".
en.synopsisShort: "Actually, I’m Touko Kirishima."

en.synopsisFull: Elizabeth Leiston, daughter of the influential prime minister, is a picture-perfect lady on the path to becoming the future queen of the Kingdom of Haldoria. But her life takes a sudden turn for the worst when her fiancé makes a show of publicly calling off their engagement. Soon after, he throws her in jail and starts spreading nasty rumors about her. The encouragement Elizabeth receives from her loyal waiting maid, Mireille, and her inner fury are all she needs to reconsider her goals. Why should she continue devoting herself to a country that doesn’t respect her when she can trample over it instead? She will get even with those who wronged her and bring down the damned kingdom, even if it’s the last thing she does! Luckily, Elizabeth is no damsel in distress and has seven powerful magic grimoires she won’t hesitate to use. Get ready because this ruthless lady is out for blood!

en.synopsisFull:
For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by those known as the Masters.
Among them, the Poison Masters of the Five Great Families hold the most fearsome power and influence.
Hikaru Gero, heir to the Poison Masters’ Gero Family, has lived his entire life in the underworld, far removed from love or marriage.
But when the Gero Family head decrees that Hikaru’s sister must bear an heir to preserve the bloodline—by force if necessary—Hikaru resolves to protect her at all costs.
It is then that Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who becomes the target of his latest job.
Realizing that the only way of solving the family succession problem and protecting his sister is through marriage, Hikaru impulsively asks Mei for help in finding a bride.

Percebendo que a única maneira de resolver o problema da sucessão familiar e proteger sua irmã é através do casamento, Hikaru impulsivamente pede a Mei ajuda para encontrar uma noiva.

en.synopsisFull:
Misaki has often felt the urge to break free from everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere far away. Even though she doesn’t yet know what she wants to become, she longs to find something she can truly be passionate about.

At the start of a new chapter on a lively campus, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Research Club—known as the “Tetsuryo Club.” As her world unfolds along the railway lines, Misaki’s heart begins to race with excitement!

As TETSUDOU MUSUME celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Tetsuryo Club sets off on a journey through the world where the Railway Girls work, in search of moments of wonder.

No início de um novo capítulo em um campus animado, ela conhece os membros do Clube de Pesquisa de Viagens Ferroviárias - conhecido como o "Clube de Tetsuryo". À medida que seu mundo se desdobra ao longo das linhas ferroviárias, o coração de Misaki começa a correr com emoção!

Enquanto TETSUDOU MUSUME celebra seu 20o aniversário, o Tetsuryo Club parte em uma jornada pelo mundo onde as Garotas de Ferro trabalham, em busca de momentos de admiração.

en.synopsisFull:
Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero’s party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as “Lock,” an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

en.synopsisFull:
I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game.

After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum and then become a curator.

So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son.

But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?

Mas longe de seguir a rota da vilania, tudo que essa garota super tímida quer é finalmente usar seu conhecimento de quando ela era uma estudante de graduação estudando para obter seu doutorado em paleontologia. Seu objetivo final é se tornar uma plebeia, escavar fósseis, construir um museu e depois se tornar uma curadora.

Então, a fim de escapar da rota da vilania e evitar ser deportada por seu noivo durante a bola de formatura, Pia decide evitar a próxima dor e mágoa e pede para romper seu noivado com Rufus, o filho do primeiro-ministro.

en.synopsisFull:
The curtains rise on a new mystery surrounding a secret treasure hidden in a city on the water.

The emperor gives Jinshi an order. He must grant the final wish of a concubine who passed away five years ago by returning her to her homeland. In order to return her to her family, Jinshi examines the remains, only to discover that they’re in pristine condition. She’s beautiful, as if she were still alive. To solve the mystery of the remains, Jinshi drags Maomao along on a journey to Binan-shu, the southern province ruled by the Bi clan.

They arrive at a bustling city on the water. Maomao is excited to see herbs and medicines she has never seen before, but tensions are high in the area, as pirates are viciously trying to find the treasure their late leader hid away.

“I hope nothing happens...”

Jinshi’s premonition comes true. On the day of the concubine’s funeral, a huge incident occurs, triggering a chain of events that nobody could see coming.

A fim de devolvê-la à sua família, Jinshi examina os restos mortais, apenas para descobrir que eles estão em condição intocada. Ela é linda, como se ainda estivesse viva. Para resolver o mistério dos restos mortais, Jinshi arrasta Maomao ao longo de uma viagem para Binan-shu, a província do sul governada pelo clã Bi.

Eles chegam a uma cidade movimentada na água. Maomao está animada para ver ervas e remédios que ela nunca viu antes, mas as tensões são altas na área, como piratas estão tentando encontrar o tesouro que seu falecido líder escondeu.

"Espero que nada aconteça..."

A premonição de Jinshi se torna realidade. No dia do funeral da concubina, um grande incidente ocorre, desencadeando uma cadeia de eventos que ninguém podia ver chegando.

en.synopsisFull:
If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out?

Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!

Lent faz parte da festa conhecida como "Skypiercers", e graças ao seu presente único, ele pode emprestar grandes quantidades de magia para os outros. Nenhum deputado? Não há problema com Lent por aí! Exceto que agora que seus companheiros se tornaram heróis formidáveis (graças à sua habilidade), sua utilidade é questionada. Expulso do grupo, Lent está furioso... até descobrir um poder oculto para seu presente. en.synopsisFull:
World-renowned wine critic Yutaka Kanzaki has passed away, leaving behind a wine collection worth over 12 billion yen. His will states that his collection will be given to the one who can identify the origin and year of twelve wines he’s chosen, the “Twelve Apostles”, and one that’s superior even to them, “The Drops of God”.

Competing for the prize are Yutaka’s son, Shizuku, who received a world-class education in wine but rebelled against his father and has never drank a drop, and Issei Tomine, a young charismatic wine critic whom Yutaka had recently adopted as his son.

What is wine? What is a parent and a child? What is life?

The complex and fragrant battle surrounding the legendary ”Drops of God” is about to begin…

Sua vontade afirma que sua coleção será dada àquele que pode identificar a origem e o ano dos doze vinhos que ele escolheu, os "Doze Apóstolos", e que é superior até mesmo a eles, "The Drops of God".

Competindo pelo prêmio está o filho de Yutaka, Shizuku, que recebeu uma educação de classe mundial em vinho, mas se rebelou contra seu pai e nunca bebeu uma gota, e Issei Tomine, um jovem crítico de vinho carismático que Yutaka adotou recentemente como seu filho.

O que é vinho? O que é um pai e uma criança? O que é a vida?

A complexa e perfumada batalha em torno dos lendários "Drops of God" está prestes a começar...

When I woke up, that dream had come true?! I could see a love meter for people, just like in a love simulation game. Once I realized this was real and not a dream I went straight to see Marika. Her love meter was so low it had broken and practically fallen all the way to hell! If she hated me so much why was she so nice?! Is this how she really felt or...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Episode 1 received an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on March 13th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.

en.synopsisFull:
Based on a series of Chiikawa comics posted on X by Nagano from March to November 2023, known as the "Siren Arc".

One day, while Chiikawa and Hachiware were relaxing in the square, Usagi suddenly appeared with a flyer stuck to its face. When Hachiware checked the flyer, it was an invitation reading “Special Invitation to a Special Island.”

Lured by promises like “Get 100x rewards for simple island quests!” and “Limited-edition island ramen, exclusive sweets—sweet and spicy treats all practically free!”, Chiikawa and the others decided to go on the island retreat. Boarding the ship alongside Rakko, who was suspicious of the flyer's contents, the group landed on the island... only to find something waiting for them there...!?

en.synopsisFull:
Anna Akechi is a second-year junior high student living in Makoto Mirai Town. On her 14th birthday, she has a chance encounter with a fairy named Pochitan, and a magical pendant caused her to travel back in time from 2027 to 1999! In the Makoto Mirai Town 28 years in the past, Anna meets Mikuru Kobayashi, a girl her age who wants to become a great detective.

Meanwhile, people in town are in trouble as their prized possessions are being stolen from under their noses - the cause being a group of Phantom Thieves. To stop them, Anna and Mikuru turn into Precures! Maybe if they solve these mysteries, Anna can find her way back to her own time?

en.synopsisFull:
Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit.

A little clumsy and always taking things at their own cozy pace,

but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow —

is filled with unexpected little mishaps and sweet adventures.

A sunny warm spot in the park, the sparkle of the sea,

steam rising from freshly roasted sweet potatoes,

the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall…

These small everyday moments fill their world with warmth and delight.

You can’t help but smile and think, “So true!”

A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments.
en.synopsisShort: Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Shark Meow é um gatinho laranja que usa um terno de tubarão.

Um pouco desajeitado e sempre levando as coisas em seu próprio ritmo,

Mas todos os dias com seus melhores amigos gatinho e o gatinho bebê resgatado, Little Meow

Está cheio de pequenos percalços inesperados e aventuras doces.

Um lugar ensolarado e quente no parque, o brilho do mar,

vapor subindo de batatas doces recém-assadas,

A sensação turbulenta da primeira queda de neve...

Esses pequenos momentos cotidianos enchem seu mundo de calor e prazer.

Você não pode deixar de sorrir e pensar: "Tão verdadeiro!"

Um anime macio e snuggly gatinho que traz alegria para os momentos cotidianos.

es.synopsisFull:
Shark Meow es un gatito de tabby naranja que usa un traje de tiburón.

Un poco torpe y siempre tomando cosas a su propio ritmo acogedor,

pero todos los días con sus mejores amigos gatitos — y el gatito de bebé rescatado, Little Meow —

está llena de pequeñas agitaciones inesperadas y aventuras dulces.

Un lugar cálido soleado en el parque, el brillo del mar,

vapor que se levanta de patatas dulces recién asadas,

la sensación de la primera nevada...

Estos pequeños momentos cotidianos llenan su mundo con calidez y deleite.

No puedes evitar sonreír y pensar, “¡Es verdad!”

Un anime pequeño y suave que trae alegría a los momentos cotidianos.

"I'll easily make it back," she thought, but the world she enters can become heaven or hell in an instant. Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations… but she still wants to buy, sell and make money! With fellow FX addicts Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko along for the ride, the market heats up! Joy, despair, joy, despair — this is an endearing, yet slightly risky money game. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world?

en.synopsisFull:
Born into a life of acting and dance with a traveling theater troupe in 14th-century Japan, 12-year old Oniyasha has one problem—he doesn't know what the point of any of it is. "Why must I step with the left foot here instead of the right? Why is one performance good and another, bad? Why do people dance at all?" It all seems perfectly arbitrary, until a chance encounter in a run-down shack sets him down a path to revolutionizing the art form and influencing much of Japanese culture to come. A fictionalized account of the early life of Zeami Motokiyo (Oniyasha), the founder of modern Noh theater—the world's oldest surviving theater art—this coming-of-age artist's journey vividly brings to life a man far ahead of his time during one of Japan's most culturally and socially vibrant eras.

(Source: Kodansha Comics)

Note: World Is Dancing streamed 3 days in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video and HIDIVE beginning June 29th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 2nd, 2026.

en.synopsisFull:
What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor?

One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...

Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!

(Source: Official Site)

Note: Episode 1 receives an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on September 11th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep.

Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.

Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

(Source: Official Site)

Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

en.synopsisFull: A revolution sparked by nuclear war, natural disaster, and misrule leads to the collapse of Japanese society. The country splits into three nations vying for hegemony, and the Sangoku era begins. Aoteru Misumi, a former agricultural officer, vows to reunify Japan. He rises through the ranks with only his knowledge and eloquence. Witness the legend of the man later hailed as a genius strategist.

en.synopsisFull: A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

pt-BR.synopsisFull: Um grande herói está invicto em seu leito de morte, lamentando que ela nunca encontrou um inimigo que pudesse derrubá-la. Ela nunca teve a intenção de encontrar seu destino em nenhum outro lugar que não no campo de batalha, e sua morte pacífica tem seu desejo desesperadamente que as coisas poderiam ter sido diferentes... Mas quando ela chega de repente no corpo do jovem e frágil Nia Liston, ela tem uma luta totalmente nova pela frente. Nia é uma criança doente, o que significa que ela tem um longo caminho a percorrer antes de estar em forma de luta. Agora que ela foi dada uma segunda chance na vida, no entanto, ela está determinada a conseguir o que quer. Ela vai viver - e morrer - para a batalha desta vez! Abram caminho para a Donzela Impiedosa!

en.synopsisFull:
My reincarnation destination is... “the rib of a harem-loving, happy-ending, overpowered hero”!? An isekai reincarnation anime that defies animation conventions is born!

Beyond traditional animation, this series delivers an exhilarating isekai reincarnation tale through unconventional techniques like stop-motion, puppet theater, and live-action—featuring the aloof “Goddess” in charge of isekai reincarnations and the protagonist “Me,” who endures one absurd reincarnation after another!
en.synopsisShort: My reincarnation destination is... “the rib of a harem-loving, happy-ending, overpowered hero”!? An isekai reincarnation anime that defies animation conventions is born!

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Meu destino de reencarnação é... "a costela de um herói amante de harém, feliz, dominado"! Um anime de reencarnação isekai que desafia convenções de animação nasce!

Além da animação tradicional, esta série oferece um emocionante conto de reencarnação iekai através de técnicas não convencionais como stop-motion, teatro de fantoches e live-action - apresentando o distante "Goddess" responsável pelas reencarnações iekai e o protagonista "Me", que suporta uma reencarnação absurda após a outra!

Mi destino de la reencarnación es... “la costilla de un héroe amante del harem, feliz y dominado”! ¡Un anime de reencarnación isekai que desafia las convenciones de animación nace!
