en.synopsisFull:
In the distant future, on the outskirts left behind by the rapid concentration of advanced science and technology in urban areas, lies a remote mountain village known as Kagami Village.

“Behave yourself, or a Double will come for you.”

Such old folklore still lingers in this village.

Akane Higure, a middle school student living in Kagami Village, has been eagerly awaiting the return of her older sister, Sui Higure, who is finally being discharged from the hospital after a year.

However, not long after her sister comes home, Akane receives a single phone call.

“The girl at home with you… isn’t your sister.”
en.synopsisShort: In the distant future, on the outskirts left behind by the rapid concentration of advanced science and technology in urban areas, lies a remote mountain village known as Kagami Village.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Em um futuro distante, nos arredores deixados para trás pela rápida concentração de ciência avançada e tecnologia em áreas urbanas, encontra-se uma remota aldeia montanhosa conhecida como Kagami Village.

"Comporte-se, ou um duplo virá para você."

Tal folclore antigo ainda perdura nesta aldeia.

Akane Higure, uma estudante do ensino médio que vive em Kagami Village, tem esperado ansiosamente o retorno de sua irmã mais velha, Sui Higure, que finalmente está sendo alta do hospital depois de um ano.

No entanto, não muito tempo depois de sua irmã chegar em casa, Akane recebe um único telefonema.

"A garota em casa com você... não é sua irmã."
pt-BR.synopsisShort: Em um futuro distante, nos arredores deixados para trás pela rápida concentração de ciência avançada e tecnologia em áreas urbanas, encontra-se uma remota aldeia montanhosa conhecida como Kagami Village.

es.synopsisFull:
En un futuro lejano, en las afueras que quedan atrás por la rápida concentración de ciencia y tecnología avanzadas en las zonas urbanas, se encuentra una remota aldea de montaña conocida como Kagami Village.

“Cógete, o vendrá un doble por ti.”

Ese viejo folclore sigue en este pueblo.

Akane Higure, estudiante de secundaria que vive en Kagami Village, ha estado esperando ansiosamente el regreso de su hermana mayor, Sui Higure, que finalmente está siendo despedido del hospital después de un año.

Sin embargo, no mucho después de que su hermana vuelva a casa, Akane recibe una sola llamada telefónica.

“La chica en casa contigo... no es tu hermana.”

en.synopsisFull:
“Make me a love potion.”

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

Ainda assim, quando ele promete ajudá-la a reunir os ingredientes, Rose está emocionado com a chance de olhar para um homem com quem ela normalmente nunca iria interagir. en.synopsisFull:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.

Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.

The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.

Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.

This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!
en.synopsisShort: Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Rein, um encantador, é expulso de sua guilda um dia. Mas em vez de se desesperar, ele declara: "Agora eu posso fazer qualquer coisa!" e começa a recuperar o grande número de pontos de melhoria que ele uma vez derramou no equipamento de seus companheiros de guilda, iniciando um novo caminho como um aventureiro.

Reunindo-se em torno dele estão pessoas carregando feridas que não desaparecem facilmente: um gênio aventureiro que fechou seu coração depois que seu partido foi massacrado, um guerreiro que perdeu sua família, e um assassino criado desde a infância para matar. No entanto, Rein nunca rejeita seus passados ou suas cicatrizes - ele aceita todos eles com calor brilhante e direto.

O palco é um mundo de fantasia único onde Uzis, estilingues e até yakuza existem lado a lado. Mas neste mundo, quanto mais as pessoas dependem de tecnologia conveniente, mais sua magia enfraquece, e aventureiros ficam frágeis.

Monstros inteligentes e cruéis vagam livremente, enquanto no submundo, bandidos revelam sua ganância e ambição enquanto esquemas e traições se entrelaçam. Em um mundo onde ideais e justiça são facilmente esmagados, aventureiros lutam com nada além de sua magia e suas convicções.

Esta é a história daqueles que perderam seu lugar no mundo encontrando uma nova maneira de viver. Rein e a segunda vida selvagem e de espírito livre de seus companheiros começam agora!

es.synopsisFull:
Rein, un encantador, es expulsado de su gremio un día. Pero en lugar de desesperar, declara, “¡Ahora puedo hacer cualquier cosa!” y comienza a reclamar el enorme número de puntos de mejora que una vez vierte en el equipo de sus compañeros, a partir de un nuevo camino como aventurero.

Reunirse a su alrededor son personas que llevan heridas que no se desvanecen fácilmente: un genio aventurero que cerró su corazón después de que su partido fue masacrado, un guerrero que perdió a su familia, y un asesino criado de la infancia para matar. Sin embargo Rein nunca rechaza sus pasados ni sus cicatrices, los acepta a todos con un calor brillante y directo.

El escenario es un mundo de fantasía único donde Uzis, slingshots, e incluso yakuza existen lado a lado. Pero en este mundo, cuanto más gente confía en la tecnología conveniente, más debilita su magia, y los aventureros se vuelven frágiles.

Los monstruos inteligentes y viciosos andan libremente, mientras que en el inframundo, los proscritos desnudan su codicia y ambición como esquemas y traiciones entrelazan. En un mundo donde los ideales y la justicia son fácilmente aplastados, los aventureros luchan con nada más que su magia y sus convicciones.

Esta es la historia de aquellos que han perdido su lugar en el mundo encontrando una nueva manera de vivir. ¡La segunda vida salvaje y libre de espíritu comienza ahora!

en.synopsisFull:
Dandelion follows Tetsuo Tanba and Misaki Kurogane, members of the Japanese Angel Federation’s Send-Off Department. Their job? Tracking down restless earthbound spirits and gently guiding them to the afterlife.

While other angels rush to close their cases, the 21st Division’s Dandelion Clan takes a different approach. Dandelion members Tetsuo Tanba and his leader, Misaki Kurogane, listen to each spirit’s regrets and help them resolve what’s holding them back. They even help a spirit who’s an elderly man running at full speed, desperate to escape.

The angels themselves are full of surprises. Tanba’s permanent scowl and sharp tongue mask a deeply compassionate nature, while Kurogane is a formidable force — despite her girlish appearance. She’s rumored to have laid to rest the legendary soul of Musashi Miyamoto.
en.synopsisShort: Dandelion follows Tetsuo Tanba and Misaki Kurogane, members of the Japanese Angel Federation’s Send-Off Department. Their job? Tracking down restless earthbound spirits and gently guiding them to the afterlife.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Dandelion segue Tetsuo Tanba e Misaki Kurogane, membros do Departamento de Send-Off da Federação dos Anjos do Japão. O trabalho deles? Rastreando espíritos inquietos e gentilmente guiando-os para a vida após a morte.

Enquanto outros anjos correm para fechar seus casos, o Clã Dandelion da 21a Divisão tem uma abordagem diferente. Dandelion membros Tetsuo Tanba e seu líder, Misaki Kurogane, ouvir os arrependimentos de cada espírito e ajudá-los a resolver o que está segurando-os. Eles até ajudam um espírito que é um homem idoso correndo a toda velocidade, desesperado para escapar.

Os próprios anjos estão cheios de surpresas. A carranca permanente de Tanba e a língua afiada mascaram uma natureza profundamente compassiva, enquanto Kurogane é uma força formidável, apesar de sua aparência feminina. Dizem que ela descansou a alma lendária de Musashi Miyamoto.
pt-BR.synopsisShort: Dandelion segue Tetsuo Tanba e Misaki Kurogane, membros do Departamento de Send-Off da Federação dos Anjos do Japão. O trabalho deles? Rastreando espíritos inquietos e gentilmente guiando-os para a vida após a morte.

Dandelion sigue Tetsuo Tanba y Misaki Kurogane, miembros del Departamento de Envío de la Federación Japonesa de Ángel. ¿Su trabajo? Rastreando espíritus inquietos y guiándolos suavemente a la otra vida.

Mientras otros ángeles se apresuran a cerrar sus casos, el Clan Dandelion de la División 21 toma un enfoque diferente. Los miembros de Dandelion Tetsuo Tanba y su líder, Misaki Kurogane, escuchan los pesares de cada espíritu y los ayudan a resolver lo que los sostiene. Incluso ayudan a un espíritu que es un hombre mayor corriendo a toda velocidad, desesperado por escapar.

Los ángeles están llenos de sorpresas. La lengua permanente de Tanba enmascara una naturaleza profundamente compasiva, mientras que Kurogane es una fuerza formidable, a pesar de su aspecto femenino. Se rumorea que ha puesto para descansar el legendario alma de Musashi Miyamoto.

en.synopsisFull:
The world’s first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality.

Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK (Player Killer) known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party—was the Black Swordsman.

Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

en.synopsisFull:
Rin Takanashi, a caregiver in her thirties, was unceremoniously discarded as "trash" despite being summoned as a saint.

However, as a lover of the great outdoors and all things camping, she was blessed with a special skill, "Survival," as well as another unique skill! Thus, a riveting tale begins: one of sweat, tears, and insatiable hunger as Rin, together with companions she picked up along the way, leisurely explores this parallel world and savours gourmet cuisine to her heart's content...

Or so the story should have gone, but it looks like their road is going in an unexpected direction...?

No entanto, como amante do ar livre e de todas as coisas acampando, ela foi abençoada com uma habilidade especial, "Sobrevivência", bem como outra habilidade única! Assim, um conto fascinante começa: um de suor, lágrimas e fome insaciável como Rin, junto com companheiros que ela pegou ao longo do caminho, explora vagarosamente esse mundo paralelo e saboreia a culinária gourmet ao conteúdo de seu coração...

Ou então a história deveria ter ido embora, mas parece que a estrada deles está indo em uma direção inesperada...

As they solve local problems, they learn about food, take part in cooking battles, and grow.

This is a story about a deranged world.

Player name: Yuuki. Occupation: Professional death game player.

Games where death is always close at hand. Her next challenge is on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. There, eight players have gathered. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows.

The game – "Cloudy Beach."

Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she will play death games to put food on the table.

en.synopsisFull:
Six months have passed since the polar opposite classmates Miyu Suzuki and Yuusuke Tani started dating. Through spending time together along with their friends from school, the two have been happier than ever. As the year nears its end, the new couple plans to celebrate Christmas and the New Year together, making memories for years to come.

Meanwhile, Miyu and Yuusuke's friends Shuuji Taira and Kentarou Yamada are puzzled by their own situations. Due to his bad experiences in middle school, Taira still overthinks everything around him, especially after his classmate Shino Azuma began giving him more attention. Simultaneously, the usually energetic and outspoken Yamada finds it difficult to find the perfect time to confess his feelings to his shy schoolmate Natsumi Nishi. Despite everyone's differences, they continue enjoying their adolescence together and find their own ways to turn the winter break into a cherished memory.

Enquanto isso, os amigos Miyu e Yuusuke Shuuji Taira e Kentarou Yamada estão intrigados com suas próprias situações. Devido às suas más experiências no ensino médio, Taira ainda pensa demais em tudo ao seu redor, especialmente depois que seu colega de classe Shino Azuma começou a dar-lhe mais atenção. Ao mesmo tempo, o geralmente energético e franco Yamada acha difícil encontrar o momento perfeito para confessar seus sentimentos ao seu tímido colega de escola Natsumi Nishi. Apesar das diferenças de todos, eles continuam desfrutando de sua adolescência juntos e encontram suas próprias maneiras de transformar a pausa de inverno em uma memória querida.

"No more loss for me. No more loss for anyone.”

Wiping way her fears of sorrow, the young girl takes up her sword.
This is the story of a hero who ties her ribbon and resolves to defy fate.

She notices the burglaries bear a striking resemblance to the events of her favorite anime, Precure, and she's hopeful that she'll get to meet the "PreCures!" if the thieves show up again.

Conan and the Junior Detective League get assigned to guard Kaneko Jewelry Store, which is rumoured to be their next target. After tailing a suspicious customer and discovering the date of the crime, as well as their hideout, the police seem to round up the thieves - but Ayumi notices something odd... Can the Detective League solve the mystery with a cute twist?!

(Source: Official website, translated, edited)

en.synopsisFull:
The earth of the distant future is covered in thick clouds, and the sun no longer shines. Plants wither, and oxygen is thin. To fight extinction, humankind has developed a technology that turns humans into plants, providing a small amount of oxygen. Is this process sustainable? Is it ethical? Toshiro Kamiya must consider these questions as he’s faced with a difficult choice—save his family or save himself.

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society’s waning humanity.

And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?

en.synopsisFull:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by…

À medida que se aproximam, Koyuki e Minato começam a desenvolver sentimentos um pelo outro que vão além da mera amizade. Enquanto isso, Youta finalmente confessa a Miki os sentimentos que ele tem abrigado por anos. Alguns falam seus corações enquanto outros mantêm suas emoções escondidas, fazendo com que seus caminhos - e seus sentimentos um pelo outro - cruzem e passem continuamente...

en.synopsisFull: The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A once-thriving film studio faces bankruptcy. The enormous compound, with structures ranging from the Great Sphinx of Giza to the Forbidden City, is now completely covered in snow and stripped of its former glory. Zha, a lonely janitor, tends to this forgotten place, with only a cat that used to perform in films for company. Running out of money, the studio owner gives him a VR headset as partial compensation. Zha is immediately drawn into the virtual world and embarks on a romantic journey with a female player who invites him on a trip to the moon. Meanwhile, the studio, which is about to close permanently, is temporarily brought back to life when a film crew arrives to shoot an alien invasion movie on the expansive backlot – with the studio’s actual destruction slated to be shot as the movie’s final showdown.

He can create life and even open gateways to other dimensions. But with every dimension he crosses and every incident he resolves, he draws closer to uncovering the truth shrouding his own death…

Among a primordial ocean of stars, two innocent, identical children share a vessel. It comes to ground on a strange, liminal world, where a mischievous spirit appears, announcing itself as their guide on the nine-month journey ahead of them. Here in the world we know, meanwhile, a bereaved and pregnant woman struggles with grief and terrible uncertainty.

en.synopsisFull:
Start Your Survival-Style Healing Life!

I quit my toxic job and logged into a game to relax only to find myself possessed by a character! But the character I’ve possessed isn’t even the game’s strongest mage, whom not even the emperor can mess with, but rather that mage’s frail eldest grandson, Leon Asteri? And to top it off, he’s a real headache who, even after suffering three mana shocks, still hasn’t awakened his mana.

“At this rate, isn’t the little young master actually going to become the head of the family?”

“Shh! Watch what you say! What if we get caught?”

Actually, that’s fine go ahead and blab all you want! Now that I’ve possessed the body of a spoiled, unemployed young master born with a silver spoon, I couldn’t care less about the position of heir. In this life, I’m going to enjoy a blissful, relaxing life no matter what!
en.synopsisShort: Start Your Survival-Style Healing Life!

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Comece sua vida de cura no estilo de sobrevivência!

Eu deixei meu trabalho tóxico e entrei em um jogo para relaxar só para me encontrar possuído por um personagem! Mas o personagem que eu possuo não é nem o mago mais forte do jogo, com quem nem o imperador pode mexer, mas sim o frágil neto mais velho do mago, Leon Asteri? E para completar, ele é uma verdadeira dor de cabeça que, mesmo depois de sofrer três choques de mana, ainda não despertou sua mana.

"Neste ritmo, o jovem mestre não vai realmente se tornar o chefe da família?"

"Shh! Cuidado com o que diz! E se formos pegos?

Na verdade, tudo bem ir em frente e blab tudo o que você quer! Agora que eu possuo o corpo de um jovem mestre mimado e desempregado, nascido com uma colher de prata, eu não poderia me importar menos com a posição de herdeiro. Nesta vida, vou desfrutar de uma vida feliz e relaxante, não importa o que aconteça!
pt-BR.synopsisShort: Comece sua vida de cura no estilo de sobrevivência!
pt-BR.source: Tradução automática local (OPUS-MT en→pt-BR)

es.synopsisFull:
¡Empieza tu vida sanadora de supervivencia y estilo!

Dejé mi trabajo tóxico y me inicié en un juego para relajarme sólo para encontrarme poseído por un personaje! Pero el personaje que he poseído no es ni siquiera el mage más fuerte del juego, con el que ni siquiera el emperador puede meterse, sino más bien el nieto mayor de Mage, Leon Asteri? Y para superarlo, es un verdadero dolor de cabeza que, incluso después de sufrir tres choques de maná, todavía no ha despertado su maná.

“A este ritmo, ¿no va a convertirse el pequeño maestro joven en la cabeza de la familia?”

¡Shh! ¡Mira lo que dices! ¿Y si nos atrapan?

En realidad, está bien ir adelante y culpar todo lo que quieras! Ahora que he poseído el cuerpo de un joven maestro malcriado y desempleado nacido con una cuchara de plata, no me importaba menos la posición del heredero. En esta vida, voy a disfrutar de una vida feliz y relajante sin importar qué!

es.source: Traducción automática local (Argos en→es)

en.synopsisFull:
A special commemorating the 30th anniversary of the anime series.

As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau.

Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.
en.synopsisShort: A special commemorating the 30th anniversary of the anime series.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Um especial comemorando o 30o aniversário da série de anime.

À medida que uma nova nota de 10.000 ienes com o design da Torre Touto é emitida e a nação é levada em excitação, Conan e a Liga de Detetives Júnior, acompanhados por Professor Agasa, Ran e Sonoko, visitam a fábrica Nagano do Escritório de Impressão de Notas do Japão.

Enquanto isso, dinheiro falsificado é descoberto no local de um assassinato em Tóquio, levando o Departamento de Polícia Metropolitana a estabelecer uma sede de investigação. Como a circulação sem precedentes de notas falsas coloca o público em confusão, Conan e Heiji vão para Osaka, onde acredita-se que o dinheiro falsificado tenha sido impresso.
pt-BR.synopsisShort: Um especial comemorando o 30o aniversário da série de anime.
pt-BR.source: Tradução automática local (OPUS-MT en→pt-BR)

es.synopsisFull:
Una conmemoración especial del 30 aniversario de la serie anime.

A medida que se publica un nuevo billete de 10.000 yenes con el diseño de Touto Tower y la nación es barrida en emoción, Conan y la Junior Detective League, acompañados por Professor Agasa, Ran y Sonoko, visitan la fábrica de Nagano del Japan Banknote Printing Bureau.

Mientras tanto, el dinero falsificado es descubierto en la escena de un asesinato en Tokio, lo que incita al Departamento de Policía Metropolitana a establecer un cuartel general de investigación. A medida que la circulación sin precedentes de nuevos billetes falsificados arroja al público en confusión, Conan y Heiji se dirigen a Osaka, donde se cree que el dinero falsificado se ha impreso.

en.synopsisFull:
Takemichi Hanagaki is a freelancer that's reached the absolute pits of despair in his life. He finds out that the only girlfriend he ever had in his life that he dated in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, had been killed by the ruthless Tokyo Manji Gang.

The day after hearing about her death, he's standing on the station platform and ends up being pushed over onto the tracks by a herd of people. He closes his eyes thinking he's about to die, but when he opens his eyes back up, he somehow had gone back in time 12 years.

Now that he's back living the best days of his life, Takemichi decides to get revenge on his life by saving his girlfriend and changing himself that he'd been running away from.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:

Um dia depois de ouvir sobre a morte dela, ele está na plataforma da estação e acaba sendo empurrado para os trilhos por um rebanho de pessoas. Ele fecha os olhos pensando que está prestes a morrer, mas quando ele abre os olhos de volta, ele de alguma forma voltou no tempo 12 anos.

Agora que ele está de volta vivendo os melhores dias de sua vida, Takemichi decide se vingar de sua vida salvando sua namorada e mudando a si mesmo que ele estava fugindo.

en.synopsisFull:
A Hunter is one who travels the world doing all sorts of dangerous tasks. From capturing criminals to searching deep within uncharted lands for any lost treasures. Gon is a young boy whose father disappeared long ago, being a Hunter. He believes if he could also follow his father's path, he could one day reunite with him.

After becoming 12, Gon leaves his home and takes on the task of entering the Hunter exam, notorious for its low success rate and high probability of death to become an official Hunter. He befriends the revenge-driven Kurapika, the doctor-to-be Leorio and the rebellious ex-assassin Killua in the exam, with their friendship prevailing throughout the many trials and threats they come upon taking on the dangerous career of a Hunter.

en.synopsisFull:
Thanks to the efforts of Lieutenant Yoji Itami (now Lieutenant First Class) of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force, the once-closed "GATE" has safely reopened. The Japanese government, determined to maintain exclusive control over the "GATE", continues mobilizing the Self-Defense Forces for political and topographical surveys to build a peaceful relationship with the inhabitants of the Special Region. Captain First Class Edajima Goro of the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF) and his subordinate, Petty Officer Second Class Tokushima Hajime, a skilled former chef, were conducting such diplomatic and investigative missions, traveling across the various nations of the Special Region.

However, one day, their assignment suddenly escalates when they're tasked with a special mission to rescue an American journalist kidnapped on an island in the Special Region's Blue Sea.

Immediately boarding the JMSDF Oyashio-class submarine Kitashio, they set sail into the ocean of another world, discovering the area around the Blue Sea engulfed in turmoil, with archipelago nations and pirates battling fiercely for dominance.

Nuclear winter descends, civilization collapses, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. To protect themselves, humans have built one fortress after another, while beyond the walls, survival comes only through blood and fire.

Ren Xiaosu and his younger brother Yan Liuyuan are among those left outside. Once ordinary boys of the wilderness, they have no shelter and nowhere to run. The only thing they can rely on is each other. When a massive earthquake strikes Jingshan, Fortress 113 comes crashing down, laying bare the chaos of the post-apocalyptic world. During their escape, Ren Xiaosu and his family rescue Luo Lan, a military leader, and make their way into Fortress 109. A new life seems about to begin, but the real trials have only just started…
en.synopsisShort: Nuclear winter descends, civilization collapses, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. To protect themselves, humans have built one fortress after another, while beyond the walls, survival comes only through blood and fire.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
O inverno nuclear desce, a civilização entra em colapso, e a humanidade não é mais o mestre do mundo. Para se protegerem, os humanos construíram uma fortaleza atrás da outra, enquanto além das muralhas, a sobrevivência só vem através do sangue e do fogo.

Ren Xiaosu e seu irmão mais novo Yan Liuyuan estão entre os deixados lá fora. Uma vez garotos comuns do deserto, eles não têm abrigo e para onde fugir. A única coisa em que podem confiar é um no outro. Quando um grande terremoto atinge Jingshan, a Fortaleza 113 cai, expondo o caos do mundo pós-apocalíptico. Durante sua fuga, Ren Xiaosu e sua família resgatam Luo Lan, um líder militar, e entram na Fortaleza 109. Uma nova vida parece prestes a começar, mas os verdadeiros testes acabaram de começar...

en.synopsisFull: Deep in the unexplored reaches of the dungeon, a corpse is discovered—one that shouldn’t exist. After Iarumas is resurrected, his memories of life before death are gone, and he spends his days delving into the dungeon to retrieve the bodies of dead adventurers. Can they be revived as well? Or will God reduce them to piles of ash on the altar? Either way, Iarumas collects his finder’s fee. And though his skills earn him some grudging respect, he’s also scorned for this cold, utilitarian attitude. The living keep their distance—Iarumas consorts primarily with the dead. That is, until he meets Garbage, a feral young swordswoman who’s the sole survivor of a massacred party. With Garbage by his side, Iarumas ventures deeper, scouring the dungeon for clues to his past, avoiding monsters, traps, and the inevitability of a permanent ashen demise.

en.synopsisFull:
The second season of Boushoku no Berserk.

The Gluttony skill. In a world where magical skills shape your destiny, Fate has awakened the unparalleled power of Gluttony—the ability to devour the skills and stats of anyone he kills. After surviving countless deadly battles alongside Greed, his black sword and trusted companion, Fate finally returns to the royal capital. Once one of the have-nots, shunned and looked down upon, Fate has never forgotten what it was like to live at the very bottom. Now, he takes a new step forward as a Holy Knight. But an even greater battle awaits him—one that will lead him closer to the truth behind their world. Now, Fate’s destiny begins to move once more.
en.synopsisShort: The second season of Boushoku no Berserk.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
A segunda temporada de Boushoku no Berserk.

A habilidade Gluttony. Em um mundo onde habilidades mágicas moldam seu destino, o destino despertou o poder incomparável da gluttonia - a capacidade de devorar as habilidades e estatísticas de qualquer um que ele mata. Depois de sobreviver a inúmeras batalhas mortais ao lado de Greed, sua espada negra e companheiro de confiança, o destino finalmente retorna à capital real. Uma vez que um dos não-ter, evitado e desprezado, o destino nunca esqueceu como era viver no fundo. Agora, ele dá um novo passo em frente como um Cavaleiro Sagrado. Mas uma batalha ainda maior o espera, que o levará mais perto da verdade por trás de seu mundo. Agora, o destino do Destino começa a se mover novamente.

La segunda temporada de Boushoku no Berserk.

Después de sobrevivir innumerables batallas mortales junto a Greed, su espada negra y su compañero de confianza, Fate finalmente regresa a la capital real. Una vez que uno de los que no tiene, rehusó y miró hacia abajo, Fate nunca ha olvidado lo que era vivir en el fondo. Ahora, da un nuevo paso adelante como Caballero Santo. en.synopsisFull: All sugar, no spice, and everything nice… that's the impression the beautiful first-year high schooler and "heartthrob angel" class president Otogi Katsura gives to those around her. In reality, Otogi is brash, assertive, and has no problem calling out a jerk when she sees one—the complete opposite of her soft spoken vice presidential counterpart, the equally beautiful and seemingly perfect Toki Ninomae. One day, when a group of boys try to hit on her at the train station, Otogi doesn't hold back and gives them a piece of her mind—and, to her surprise, Toki enjoys seeing this side of her. Not only that, it turns out the seemingly polite, put-together vice president has a hidden side of his own… and Otogi now finds him more attractive than ever! Now "partners-in-crime," Otogi and Toki agree to keep their hidden sides a secret from the rest of their classmates—but could this shared, dark secret also bring them closer together…?!

en.synopsisFull:
A broken world in the not-so distant future.

Humanity is facing a new incident.

"We’re being attacked
by humans who should be dead."

The government has decided to request a specialized organization to deal with this situation.

The Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis, commonly known as "LONA."

Researcher Ao and her apprentice Sango will try to get to the bottom of the mystery by analyzing the brains of the dead.

What do people think of, and what do they leave behind before they die?

Countless memories engraved in the neural circuits. What did they see in those deep depths?
en.synopsisShort: A broken world in the not-so distant future.

O pesquisador Ao e seu aprendiz Sango tentarão chegar ao fundo do mistério analisando os cérebros dos mortos.

O que as pessoas pensam, e o que deixam para trás antes de morrer?

Inúmeras memórias gravadas nos circuitos neurais. O que eles viram nessas profundezas?

That boy could see sound.
Luca, a boy with branches sprouting from his head, serves as a bugler in a mercenary company that thrives on war. Though surrounded by conflict, he dreams of becoming a musician.
One day, amid the chaos of battle, a mysterious power awakens within him. His journey soon brings him into contact with the Pontiff, who stands at the pinnacle of the nation; Zoe, a fellow Branch-Born; and many others whose lives are intertwined with his own.
Through these encounters, Luca's destiny begins to change in ways he could never have imagined.
Arboral Year 1294—a battle that will determine the future is about to begin.

en.synopsisFull: Kaoru Terasaki is a gamer who’s into MMORPGs, and he’s finally meeting up with someone he’s been friends with in-game for a long while—this time, offline and in person. He’s worried that his friend will be disappointed to see Kaoru is a guy, unlike his female character in the game. But he’s the one who’s in for a surprise when, instead of another guy, his friend turns out to be a cute girl, Nanami Ousaka. On top of that, Nanami told her parents that she would be bringing a friend over—a female friend. Even worse, Nanami’s dad is the super overprotective type who won’t allow any guys near his daughter. There’s only one solution to this dilemma: Kaoru has to cross-dress as a girl! Will Kaoru’s efforts pay off in the end?! Will Kaoru and Nanami remain just friends, or will their time together IRL change everything? Follow their romantic-comedy adventures to find out!

en.synopsisFull:
In a land where a queen is chosen every few years solely by winning a tournament, there can be no short supply of formidable opponents. For one woman warrior however, an early defeat clearly shows her that she is lacking in experience though she may be bountiful in body.

Fortunately, while defeat could spell one's doom, her life is saved by a powerful stranger. But unfortunately for this savior, less-than-pure motives and shrewd family members mean her reward is a prison cell. Her release is prompt when the unseasoned warrior she saved, tired of her current lifestyle of nobility, sets off to prove herself.

Felizmente, enquanto a derrota pode significar a própria condenação, sua vida é salva por um poderoso estranho. Mas infelizmente para esse salvador, motivos menos puros e membros da família astutos significam que sua recompensa é uma cela de prisão. Sua libertação é imediata quando a guerreira que salvou, cansada de seu estilo de vida atual de nobreza, parte para provar a si mesma.

en.synopsisFull:
Ex-convict Keiji Ueji appears in Sapporo, causing all the different factions to travel to the city in hopes of obtaining part of the map to the Ainu gold that is tattooed on his skin. At the same time, a figure who appears to be a copycat of Jack the Ripper terrorizes the streets of Sapporo. Saichi Sugimoto, Asirpa, and Yoshitake Shiraishi—joined by Fusatarou "Boutarou the Pirate" Oosawa and Vasily Pavlichenko—temporarily ally themselves with Toshizou Hijikata, as his faction's motives are somewhat less disturbing than those of Seventh Division's First Lieutenant Tokushirou Tsurumi.

Asirpa attempts to collect all the information needed to tell apart the fake skins from the real ones, but she cannot decipher the map with certainty. Sugimoto swears never to part with Asirpa again, but the commotion around the serial killer allows for new betrayals and Tsurumi's plan for capturing Asirpa to advance. As the hunt for the gold nears its conclusion, the future of the Ainu rests in the hands of those who claim it first.

en.synopsisFull:
This is a story about Momo, a high school girl who comes from a family of spirit mediums, and her classmate Okarun, an occult fanatic. After Momo rescues Okarun from being bullied, they begin talking. However, an argument ensues between them since Momo believes in ghosts but denies aliens exist, and Okarun believes in aliens but denies ghosts exist.

To prove to each other what they believe in is real, Momo goes to an abandoned hospital where a UFO has been spotted and Okarun goes to a tunnel rumored to be haunted. To their surprise, they each encounter overwhelming paranormal activities that transcend comprehension. Amid these predicaments, Momo awakens her hidden power and Okarun gains the power of a curse to overcome these new dangers! Their fateful love begins as well!?

The story of the occult battle and adolescence starts!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Notes:

- Worldwide premiere of Episode 1 before the Japanese television premiere occurred at Anime Expo July 6, 2024.

- Episodes 1-3 titled as DAN DA DAN: FIRST ENCOUNTER was pre-screened in advance in theaters on August 31, 2024 in Asia, September 7, 2024 in Europe and September 13, 2024 in North America. The regular TV broadcast began October 4, 2024.

In hopes of reuniting with his beloved wife, Gabimaru heads to the island along with the executioner Yamada Asaemon Sagiri. Upon arriving there, they encounter other death row convicts in search of the Elixir of Life... as well as a host of unknown creatures, eerie manmade statues, and the hermits who rule the island. Can Gabimaru find the Elixir of Life on this mysterious island and make it back home alive?

Shinra Kusakabe, a youth who gained the nickname Devil’s Footprints for his ability to ignite his feet at will, joins the Special Fire Force Company 8 which composes of other flames users as they work to extinguish any Infernals they encounter. As a faction that is creating Infernals appears, Shinra begins to uncover the truth behind a mysterious fire that caused the death of his family twelve years ago.

en.synopsisFull:
The rules of alchemy state that to gain something, one must lose something of equal value. Alchemy is the process of taking apart and reconstructing an object into a different entity, with the rules of alchemy to govern this procedure. However, there exists an object that can bring any alchemist above these rules, the object known as the Philosopher's Stone. The young Edward Elric is a particularly talented alchemist who through an accident years back lost his younger brother Alphonse and one of his legs. Sacrificing one of his arms as well, he used alchemy to bind his brother's soul to a suit of armor. This lead to the beginning of their journey to restore their bodies, in search for the legendary Philosopher's Stone.

Note: Episodes 11, 12 and 37 were adapted from the light novel "Fullmetal Alchemist: The Land of Sand."

Nota: Os episódios 11, 12 e 37 foram adaptados da novela "Fullmetal Alchemist: A Terra da Areia".

en.synopsisFull:
Yuke, a red mage, angrily declares that he's leaving Thunder Pike, the A-rank party he's been with for five years, because he's fed up with being insulted and ridiculed by the other members.

While searching for a new party, he runs into his former students Marina, Silk, and Rain, and decides to join their party, Clover. Encouraged by their admiration of him as their teacher, Yuke leads them in completing several quests that show off his own extraordinary magic and skills while bringing out the girls' abilities to their fullest.

Then, through an "adventure broadcast" by an artifact known as Camelot, Clover becomes well-known throughout society. The party's dream is to conquer Achromatic Darkness, the most challenging dungeon of all, but as they take on other dungeons in hopes of eventually achieving that goal, they gradually become entangled in chaos that threatens the whole world...
en.synopsisShort: Yuke, a red mage, angrily declares that he's leaving Thunder Pike, the A-rank party he's been with for five years, because he's fed up with being insulted and ridiculed by the other members.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Yuke, um mago vermelho, furiosamente declara que ele está deixando Thunder Pike, a festa A-rank que ele está com por cinco anos, porque ele está cansado de ser insultado e ridicularizado pelos outros membros.

Enquanto procura por uma nova festa, ele encontra seus ex-alunos Marina, Silk e Rain, e decide se juntar à sua festa, Clover. Encorajado por sua admiração por ele como seu professor, Yuke os leva a completar várias missões que mostram sua própria magia e habilidades extraordinárias, ao mesmo tempo em que traz as habilidades das meninas ao máximo.

Então, através de uma "transmissão de aventura" por um artefato conhecido como Camelot, Clover se torna bem conhecido em toda a sociedade. O sonho da festa é conquistar a Escuridão Acromática, a masmorra mais desafiadora de todas, mas como eles assumem outras masmorras na esperança de finalmente alcançar esse objetivo, eles gradualmente se enredam no caos que ameaça o mundo inteiro...

en.synopsisFull: Elizabeth Leiston, daughter of the influential prime minister, is a picture-perfect lady on the path to becoming the future queen of the Kingdom of Haldoria. But her life takes a sudden turn for the worst when her fiancé makes a show of publicly calling off their engagement. Soon after, he throws her in jail and starts spreading nasty rumors about her. The encouragement Elizabeth receives from her loyal waiting maid, Mireille, and her inner fury are all she needs to reconsider her goals. Why should she continue devoting herself to a country that doesn’t respect her when she can trample over it instead? She will get even with those who wronged her and bring down the damned kingdom, even if it’s the last thing she does! Luckily, Elizabeth is no damsel in distress and has seven powerful magic grimoires she won’t hesitate to use. Get ready because this ruthless lady is out for blood!

At just seventeen, Yuki is a professional death game player. She’s survived enough rounds to know that survival is calculation, not luck—and that failure is final. For most players, the games are a nightmare with no escape. For Yuki, they’re simply business. Yet in a world where rooms turn into graves and every choice could be her last, even experience offers no protection.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Frustrado por los 13 héroes encargados de destruirlo, ha decidido librarse de la humanidad de una vez por todas. Sin embargo, ha sido acusado de una molestia: revivió a un héroe que personalmente mató y adopta un bebé humanoide huérfano, la última esperanza de salvar un mundo moribundo. El mundo está sobre el borde del Armagedón, con la obligación de criar a un niño reteniéndolo todo. Ahora unidos, ¿qué destino espera este trío improbable?

(Fuente: Anime News Network, Crunchyroll, editado)

Nota: El primer episodio se transmitió con una duración de ~46 minutos en lugar del episodio estándar de 24 minutos.

en.synopsisFull: In a world where humans triumphed in a great war, Kai guards sealed crypts containing their enemies. Now, this lost hero must rise to restore the world’s balance!

en.synopsisFull: Hinako Konohana is the perfect young lady—graceful, elegant, and flawless… or so everyone thinks. Behind closed doors, she’s a total disaster who can’t handle basic chores! en.synopsisFull: Long ago, the most ancient of divine dragons was slain by a human. The mighty dragon accepted its death when suddenly, it was reborn as Dolan, a man who lives in a quiet village. While spending another peaceful day toiling in the fields, he meets Celina, a half-human, half-snake creature looking for a partner. The unlikely duo become friends, but challenges lie ahead that threaten their new bond.

en.synopsisFull: Two centuries have passed since a hero defeated the evil Jaryu and saved the world. In one of the many dungeon cities, Raust, a healer scorned and cast out of his party for being too weak, struggles to find his place. en.synopsisFull: Makoto Misumi was just an average teenager who happened to suddenly be summoned to another world as a "hero." But the goddess of this world called him ugly and took his hero status away from him then sent him to the ends of the world. In the wastelands, he meets dragons, spiders, orcs, dwarves and many other non-human races. Makoto manages to show promises in the use of magic and fighting, which he wouldn't have been able to do in his former world. He has numerous encounters, but will he be able to survive this new world? A fantasy where a guy who had been abandoned by gods and humanity tries to reset his life in this new world is about to begin!

I want to wake up the princess who was put to sleep by a witch's curse… but there are seven of them!
So it seems that I have to kiss...... seven girls!
Now the princesses are awake, but the other people in the kingdom are still asleep...... Why?
Is there more to breaking the curse than just a kiss or am I still missing something......?

In a country where only they are awake, they must work together to save everyone from the curse!

en.synopsisFull: Not even a hero, Takumi Iruma gets accidentally mixed in with a group of heroes chosen to be summoned to another world. As compensation for the mix-up, a goddess offers him the right to choose any skill he wishes for! Hoping for a peaceful and quiet life that has nothing to do with fighting or going into battle, he chooses a seemingly boring creation skill. However, it turns out "alchemy" is the most powerful skill that allows him to create everything from a holy sword to flying ships! This cheat skill he unexpectedly acquired turns him into a wealthy merchant and makes him undefeatable in battles! A heartwarming adventure story about (possibly) the most powerful alchemist in another world!

Esperando por uma vida tranquila e pacífica que não tem nada a ver com lutar ou entrar em batalha, ele escolhe uma habilidade de criação aparentemente chata. No entanto, acontece que "alquimia" é a habilidade mais poderosa que lhe permite criar tudo, desde uma espada sagrada até navios voadores! Essa habilidade trapaceira que ele inesperadamente adquiriu o transforma em um rico comerciante e o torna inviável em batalhas! Uma história de aventura comovente sobre (possivelmente) o alquimista mais poderoso em outro mundo!

A fantasy about a young man, a blind genius, who opens up the world through curiosity in the pursuit for magic is about to begin.

en.synopsisFull: A hard-working boy named Will enters a magic academy in hopes of becoming a great sorcerer. Unfortunately, there's a fatal flaw in his plan: he lacks the ability to use magic. Amid the cold stares of his classmates and instructors, Will feels discouraged at times, but he presses forward with unwavering determination. He can't use a wand, but he can wield a sword in his battle to reach the top of a magic-dominated world. He just needs to believe in his own unique strengths and remember the promise he made with someone precious to him...

en.synopsisFull:
Ein has been saddled with the job of "Appraiser," the weakest and least fortunate of all the jobs one can be born with, as the only power it grants is the ability to appraise things.

Treated cruelly by all and reduced to a litter collector by his peers, Ein has grown to hate himself and lives his days in spineless self-abasement. But when he meets Yuuri, the spirit of the World Tree, and her protector, Ursula the sage, Ein's fate takes a drastic turn.

With the gift of a Spirit Eye from Yuuri and the help of Ursula in learning how to use it, Ein grows stronger and stronger, until he's ready to take Yuuri on her long-desired journey to meet her World Tree's sisters. He goes on to overcome all sorts of challenges, armed with his natural kindness and his new-found courage.
en.synopsisShort: Ein has been saddled with the job of "Appraiser," the weakest and least fortunate of all the jobs one can be born with, as the only power it grants is the ability to appraise things.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Ein foi selado com o trabalho de "Avaliador", o mais fraco e menos afortunado de todos os trabalhos com que se pode nascer, pois o único poder que ele concede é a capacidade de avaliar as coisas.

Tratado cruelmente por todos e reduzido a um coletor de lixo por seus colegas, Ein cresceu para odiar a si mesmo e vive seus dias em auto-abatimento sem espinhas. Mas quando ele conhece Yuuri, o espírito da Árvore do Mundo, e seu protetor, Ursula o sábio, o destino de Ein toma um rumo drástico.

Com o dom de um Olho Espiritual de Yuuri e a ajuda de Ursula em aprender a usá-lo, Ein fica cada vez mais forte, até que ele esteja pronto para levar Yuuri em sua longa e desejada jornada para conhecer as irmãs de sua Árvore do Mundo. Ele vai superar todos os tipos de desafios, armado com sua bondade natural e sua coragem recém-descoberta.

es.synopsisFull:
Ein ha sido entristecido con el trabajo de "Appraiser", el más débil y menos afortunado de todos los trabajos con los que se puede nacer, ya que el único poder que otorga es la capacidad de evaluar las cosas.

Tratado cruelmente por todos y reducido a un coleccionista de basura por sus compañeros, Ein ha crecido para odiarse a sí mismo y vive sus días en el autoabastecimiento sin columna. Pero cuando se encuentra con Yuuri, el espíritu del árbol mundial, y su protector, Ursula el sabio, el destino de Ein toma un giro drástico.

Con el don de un Ojo Espiritual de Yuuri y la ayuda de Ursula para aprender a usarlo, Ein crece más fuerte y más fuerte, hasta que esté listo para tomar Yuuri en su viaje deseado para conocer a las hermanas de su Árbol Mundial. Sigue superando todo tipo de desafíos, armados con su bondad natural y su valor nuevo.

en.synopsisFull:
Seiichirou Kondou, a salaryman approaching his 30s, gets caught up in a holy maiden summoning ritual and is transported to a parallel world called Romany Kingdom. Having worked day and night, he developed the mindset of a corporate slave and even demanded work in this new world, which landed him an accounting job at the Royal Accounting Department.

During his hectic days rebuilding the accounting department, Seiichirou came across a nutritional tonic that wiped away any fatigue. Thanks to the tonic, Seiichirou's chronic ailments and exhaustion completely disappeared, leaving him overjoyed. But because he had no resistance to the world's magic, the side effects put his life in danger!

en.synopsisFull: Ryou is delighted to be reincarnated into the fantastical world of Phi, where he thinks he’ll get to live a quiet life learning to use his newfound water magic. Going with the flow here, however, means something very different. Ryou is immediately pitted against the wild lands he winds up in and the slew of deadly monsters that call the remote subcontinent home. You’d think he’d forget about taking it easy when he’s stuck fighting for his life, but lucky for Ryou, he’s naturally optimistic, clever, and blessed with the hidden “Eternal Youth” trait. Twenty years pass in the blink of an eye, and each encounter along the way pushes him one step closer to the pinnacle of human magic. Little does he realize that’s only the opening chapter of his tale. A fateful meeting soon thrusts Ryou to the forefront of history, forever changing the course of his life... Thus begins the adventures of the strongest water magician the world has ever seen—who also likes to do things at his own pace!

en.synopsisFull:
The ultimate Regimental Food War continues as the culinary rebels led by Souma and the members of Kyokusei square off against epicurean elitist Azami and the Toutsuki Ten. At stake – the future of dining across Japan. Because if the rebels fail, Azami intends to impose his own tastes and techniques on the entire restaurant industry!

But the fine dining control freak has made a serious mistake in threatening the futures of Souma’s friends and family, as while the rebels may seem less experienced overall, this is ultimately a clash of skill, dedication, and, most of all, taste. That may be a recipe for disaster for the seasoned veterans!

Minoru Kido, age 30, cause of death: traffic accident. As a Japanese, I died without leaving any evidence of my life. At the time of my death, I was thinking, "Next time, I want to live a long life and leave behind some proof of my life," when I was reincarnated as an elf with a life span of 1,000 years! That's why I made a vow. I vowed that this time I would spend my whole life living in a way that would leave a mark on my life.

At the age of 20, I was able to use all of the healing magic that elves were originally equipped with at will. By the age of 30, I had mastered all attribute magic, and by the age of 100, I had deciphered all the ancient magic formulas. For the remaining 900 years of my life, all I have to do is run out of the Elven forest and become a warrior.

One day, I'll be missed by a fledgling adventurer who will eventually be called a hero. Sometimes, a country is founded in my name. Sometimes, I was called the founder of magic and became an object of worship. This is the story of a reincarnated elf who roars his name into history as a living legend.

Os e-mails, enviados por uma figura misteriosa chamada "Daisy", tornam-se seu único apoio na vida após a morte de Souichirou. Um dia, depois de acidentalmente quebrar uma janela na escola, Teru acaba trabalhando para Tasuku Kurosaki, o guardião da escola.

Kurosaki é afiado e trabalha até o osso, mas por alguma razão, ele gentilmente cuida de Teru. E depois de conhecer Kurosaki, o destino de Teru começa a mudar drasticamente...

en.synopsisFull:
Wim Strauss is a “granting caster”—a support mage who can increase the strength of his allies through the power of his spells. It’s a useful talent, but since it can’t be used directly in battle, it gets zero respect from the other members of his party. As far as they’re concerned, support magic is dead weight. It isn’t long before they toss him out on his ear, leaving Wim to wonder if his career as an adventurer is over.

Lucky for Wim, he has one big chance: his childhood friend Heidemarie is able to get him an audition with her elite A-rank party, Nachtlibelle. The two of them know his magic is good for more than just menial backup, but now he’ll have to prove it. It’s time to show the world that support mages can do more than just stand on the back lines!

Sorte para Wim, ele tem uma grande chance: sua amiga de infância Heidemarie pode fazer uma audição com sua festa de elite, Nachtlibelle. Os dois sabem que sua magia é boa para mais do que apenas apoio, mas agora ele terá que provar isso. É hora de mostrar ao mundo que os magos de apoio podem fazer mais do que apenas ficar na linha de fundo!

Will Celine be able to find "peaceful happiness"?

en.synopsisFull:
Nothing in this world is more dangerous than a witch. The epitome of fear and terror, they can summon floods on a whim, conjure balls of fire out of the air, or even destroy entire countries overnight. Incur their wrath, and no one is safe.

At least, that’s what everyone thinks, and it’s the very reason they all want Siasha dead. After yet another violent battle for her life, she teams up with Zig, a mercenary, and they depart for unknown lands to find somewhere she can live in peace. But is the pair any match for the lost magic and vicious monstrosities that lie ahead?

Pelo menos, é o que todo mundo pensa, e é a razão pela qual todos querem Siasha morta. Depois de outra batalha violenta por sua vida, ela se junta a Zig, um mercenário, e eles partem para terras desconhecidas para encontrar um lugar onde ela possa viver em paz. Mas o par é compatível com a magia perdida e as monstruosidades viciosas que estão por vir?

en.synopsisFull:
Biblia Koshodou no Jiken Techou is a mystery series where Shinokawa Shioriko, a young owner of a bookstore in Kamakura, unravel mysteries of ancient books that are taken there.

The story begins with a young man named Daisuke, who grew up practically without reading books due to a "phobia," brings the complete (and autographed) works of Natsume Soseki, Japanese writer of the Meiji era, inherited from his grandmother in the mysterious bookstore. Will the shy and introvert Shioriko solve the mystery of the books?

After all, he has man's best friend...er, familiar, to keep him company. When his Level 100 canine companion Pochi demands that he get some fresh air for the first time in two centuries, Asley sets out to reintegrate into society and test his magic mettle. His mission? Dropping several unglamorous titles from his repertoire and restoring his good (okay, decent) name.

A brand-new world and fresh adventures await Asley after his many years of hermitage. Perhaps he'll lend Pochi a hand to place first in the mysterious Familiar Feud. Or maybe he'll lose all vestiges of dignity and turn tail. Whichever comes first! No matter what, Asley has great evil to fight, a big world to save, and even a little growing up to do...that is, if he can endure Pochi's “friendly advice” along the way!

en.synopsisFull:
“You are not the real saint, you’re nothing but a fake—!!!”

I, Eliane, am suddenly exiled. Not only that, my engagement was also annulled by Claude, who was both my fiancé and the first prince of my country.

Claude claims that Leticia is the ‘real saint’, but I know from the beginning, she is the woman he has been cheating on me with. So here I am, sharing his wish to cancel our engagement.

But, is exiling me truly a wise decision, I wonder? Exiling this me, the actual ‘real saint’ who has been setting up barriers and supporting this kingdom from shadows?

Maybe, just maybe, dragons and archdemons will invade my kingdom starting from tomorrow. Who knows—

—not like it’s any of my business anymore.

I have abandoned my own country and have thus decided to have a peaceful life.

Meanwhile, the kingdom, which has lost its true saint, is on the path to ruin.
en.synopsisShort: “You are not the real saint, you’re nothing but a fake—!!!”

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Você não é o verdadeiro santo, você não é nada além de uma farsa!!!

Eu, Eliane, de repente estou exilado. Não só isso, meu noivado também foi anulado por Claude, que era meu noivo e o primeiro príncipe do meu país.

Claude afirma que Leticia é a "verdadeira santa", mas eu sei que desde o início, ela é a mulher com quem ele tem me traído. Então aqui estou eu, compartilhando seu desejo de cancelar nosso noivado.

Mas, está me exaurindo realmente uma decisão sábia, eu me pergunto? Exilando-me, o verdadeiro "santo" que tem estabelecido barreiras e apoiado este reino das sombras?

—no como si fuera asunto mío.

"Fortune and Misfortune are two sides of the same coin?! Reverse any adversary and cease redemption!!" 

Siegbert is reborn after an unfortunate accident in his previous life. His new family is warm and welcoming... so much so it seems as though he may no longer be an unlucky person. In this world, he can finally live a quiet, peaceful life... or so he thought. It seems that he actually holds an insanely high luck stat in this new world...?

"Every chance is a manifestation of good fortune. If you can cease the chances, your wishes shall be granted..." Conquering each "chance" granted by his good fortune, will he now cease redemption on the generational legacy this family has yet to fulfill?!

en.synopsisFull:
The village of Hoori lies deep in the middle of the mountains, inaccessible by rail. Since there isn’t much interaction with its surroundings, the town seems like it is stuck in the past. However, it is because of this exact olden feel and subsequent development that it has turned into a nice hot-springs town for tourists.

One of the popular sightseeing spots is the legendary katana Murasamemaru, embedded in stone. No one has been able to pull it out… until Masaomi somehow broke it in half. He has to take responsibility for his actions: “Marriage” with ‘shrine maiden princess’ Yoshino!? He was perplexed at the unexpected turn of events, but this is only just the beginning. What lies ahead for him is a much more peculiar and mysterious life, including his new fiancée, a mysterious girl who only he could touch, and the secret behind the curse that remains on the town.

What will become of Masaomi’s love amidst his rapidly changing life? The answer lies within the Murasamemaru in his hands.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
A aldeia de Hoori fica no meio das montanhas, inacessível por trem. Como não há muita interação com seus arredores, a cidade parece estar presa no passado. No entanto, é por causa dessa sensação de velhice exata e desenvolvimento subsequente que se transformou em uma boa cidade de fontes termais para os turistas.

Um dos pontos turísticos populares é a lendária katana Murasamamaru, incrustada em pedra. Ninguém foi capaz de tirá-lo... até Masaomi de alguma forma quebrar ao meio. Ele tem que assumir a responsabilidade por suas ações: "Casamento" com Yoshino! Ele ficou perplexo com a mudança inesperada dos eventos, mas isso é apenas o começo. O que está por vir para ele é uma vida muito mais peculiar e misteriosa, incluindo sua nova noiva, uma garota misteriosa que só ele poderia tocar, e o segredo por trás da maldição que permanece na cidade.

O que acontecerá com o amor de Masaomi em meio a sua vida em rápida mudança? A resposta está dentro do Murasamaru em suas mãos.

Estaba perplejo en el inesperado giro de los acontecimientos, pero esto es sólo el principio. Lo que le espera es una vida mucho más peculiar y misteriosa, incluyendo a su nueva prometida, una chica misteriosa que sólo podía tocar, y el secreto detrás de la maldición que permanece en la ciudad.

He has extreme brainrot and views the world through a cute anime girl filter.

en.synopsisFull: Unpei Mochizuki had been working for two years as a spare parts dealer. After making a mistake, he had only one wish: to go far, where no one can recognize him. That’s when he crosses paths with Tsugumi Nagisa, illustrator… and nomad. A woman of indefinable age, who lives with her dog in a van. Unpei begins a new life on the road with Tsugumi and her car. Far from the usual tidy, sedentary lifestyle, the nomadic spirit offers new surprises every single day. From beaches to mountains, from the North to the South… Freedom and endless new landscapes await!

en.synopsisFull: Soara is a young orphan girl who was raised by knights and trained to battle the monsters that constantly attacked their kingdom. But by the time Soara is ready to join the fight herself, peace has been declared and her blade is no longer needed. Searching for a new home and a new purpose, Soara stumbles across Krik the dwarf, leader of the Monster Architects. Suddenly, instead of fighting monsters, Soara finds herself working with Krik to build comfortable homes for them! In the process, will she discover a new home and family for herself?

There's a young man there, Takaaki, who mistakes Hina for his fiancée Hinako. He whisks her back to what he thinks is her home, where Hina's doppelganger is waiting, and Hina realizes this isn't the Tokyo she left behind but Japan in the year 1907! Is this all a dream or something much stranger?

en.synopsisFull:
Matteo, who was supposed to be just a common villager, is reborn as the grandson of an imperial aristocrat, Lawrence. He spends his days being doted on by his powerful grandfather. With his immense magical powers, Matteo rapidly hatches a dragon egg and tames the dragon, naming it Eva. When his magical abilities are measured, it's revealed that he possesses the strongest magic power ever recorded!

He quickly learns how to use magic, reviving ancient spells and effortlessly drawing the most powerful sword that absorbs magic, making it the strongest. Matteo is also favored by the emperor he meets, but the emperor holds a secret—?

Clever, illustrious, strong, as expected! The life of the most beloved noble, where everything is affirmed, boldly begins!

Com seus imensos poderes mágicos, Matteo rapidamente choca um ovo de dragão e doma o dragão, chamando-o de Eva. Quando suas habilidades mágicas são medidas, é revelado que ele possui o poder mágico mais forte já registrado!

Ele rapidamente aprende a usar magia, revivendo feitiços antigos e sem esforço desenhando a espada mais poderosa que absorve magia, tornando-a mais forte. Matteo também é favorecido pelo imperador que encontra, mas o imperador tem um segredo?

Inteligente, ilustre, forte, como esperado! A vida do nobre mais amado, onde tudo é afirmado, corajosamente começa!

en.synopsisFull:
Armageddon—the final war between good and evil, to be waged at the end of the world. Its predetermined outcome was overturned. The desperate wish of those who “did not want to die”—that hopeless selfishness—empowered the evil god. Eight billion humans were sacrificed, and only a handful were allowed to survive—to be toyed with endlessly as the evil god’s playthings. The “Frashokereti” (Renewal of the World), which had been repeated countless times since the dawn of the universe, was shattered here for the first time.

The sun will never rise again.

In a world where reason has gone mad, there is only one thing of value: human blood.

Blood is currency. Blood is fuel. Blood is—a weapon.

After countless sacrifices, the magicians devised a single spell. A forbidden ritual that transforms a girl’s blood into a blade capable of vanquishing demons.

Blood as a weapon. Life as a weapon. Humanity itself—the final weapon to resist the demons.

Chosen… Survivors… The strongest, cursed girls.

Blood-battle humans—.

The younger sister is the strongest blood-battle human, her soul stolen. The older sister was born unable to walk. Yet, she is the only one in this world—her blood alone can awaken the power of her slumbering sister.

Eva and Epica. Sisters bound by fate in the darkness of the apocalypse.

With their blood... strike down the demons that have defiled the world!

An original dark fantasy action series by Seiji Kishi, Makoto Uezu, LAM, and Polygon Pictures is here!

Armagedom - a guerra final entre o bem e o mal, a ser travada no fim do mundo. Seu resultado predeterminado foi derrubado. O desejo desesperado daqueles que "não queriam morrer" - esse egoísmo sem esperança - empoderou o deus mau. Oito bilhões de humanos foram sacrificados, e apenas um punhado foi autorizado a sobreviver - a ser brinquedo infinitamente como os brinquedos do deus do mal. O "Frashokereti" (Renovação do Mundo), que tinha sido repetido inúmeras vezes desde o início do universo, foi quebrado aqui pela primeira vez.

O sol nunca mais nascerá.

Em um mundo onde a razão enlouqueceu, só há uma coisa de valor: sangue humano.

Sangue é moeda. Sangue é combustível. Sangue é uma arma.

Depois de incontáveis sacrifícios, os magos inventaram um único feitiço. Um ritual proibido que transforma o sangue de uma garota em uma lâmina capaz de derrotar demônios.

Sangue como arma. A vida como uma arma. A própria humanidade é a arma final para resistir aos demônios.

Escolhido... Sobreviventes... As garotas mais fortes e amaldiçoadas.

Humanos de batalha de sangue.

A irmã mais nova é a mais forte humana de batalha de sangue, sua alma roubada. A irmã mais velha nasceu incapaz de andar. No entanto, ela é a única neste mundo - seu sangue sozinho pode despertar o poder de sua irmã adormecida.

Eva e Epica. Irmãs ligadas pelo destino na escuridão do apocalipse.

Com o sangue deles... destruam os demônios que contaminaram o mundo!

Uma série de ação de fantasia escura original de Seiji Kishi, Makoto Uezu, LAM e Polygon Pictures está aqui!

es.synopsisFull:
Armagedón, la guerra final entre el bien y el mal, a ser librada al final del mundo. Su resultado predeterminado fue revocado. El deseo desesperado de aquellos que “no querían morir” — ese egoísmo sin esperanza— empoderó al dios malo. Ocho mil millones de humanos fueron sacrificados, y sólo se permitió que un puñado sobreviviera—para ser jugueteado con infinitamente como los juguetes del dios malo. El “Frashokereti” (Renovación del Mundo), que había sido repetido innumerables veces desde el amanecer del universo, fue destrozado aquí por primera vez.

El sol nunca se levantará de nuevo.

En un mundo donde la razón se ha vuelto loca, sólo hay una cosa de valor: sangre humana.

La sangre es moneda. La sangre es combustible. La sangre es un arma.

Después de innumerables sacrificios, los magos diseñaron un solo hechizo. Un ritual prohibido que transforma la sangre de una chica en una espada capaz de vencer demonios.

Sangre como arma. La vida como arma. La propia humanidad —el arma final para resistir a los demonios.

Elegido... sobrevivientes... Las chicas más fuertes y maldecidas.

Los humanos de la batalla de sangre...

La hermana más joven es el humano más fuerte, su alma robada. La hermana mayor nació incapaz de caminar. Sin embargo, ella es la única en este mundo: su sangre sola puede despertar el poder de su hermana sombría.

Eva y Epica. Hermanas atadas por el destino en la oscuridad del apocalipsis.

Con su sangre... golpea a los demonios que han contaminado el mundo!

Una serie original de acción de fantasía oscura de Seiji Kishi, Makoto Uezu, LAM y Polygon Pictures está aquí!

en.synopsisFull:
An original anime series based on the “Death Stranding” video game. 

Once, there was an explosion... 

Lonesome souls of the dead manifest in the physical world, reaching in search of the living. However, the connection they create triggers a massive explosion that eradicates anything of this world—a phenomenon referred to as the Death Stranding. These events wipe out nations as well as civilization itself. People who remain are now isolated, withdrawn, and without connections. As humanity stands at the brink a legendary porter set out to transport both cargo and wishes of its senders, reconnecting people in the hope that they might still be saved. 

Somewhere in North America, just as Sam Bridges walks through the continent in order to save America, the someones are also trying to deal with their isolation in their own way. An old man trying to realize salvation through ways outside of the connection advocated by Bridges. A female warrior who tries to kickstart a world of constant fighting. A boy with a grudge against Bridges. A girl who embraces loneliness. 

On the precipice of the end of humanity and the world, their fates and hopes converge, as another story of Death Stranding begins. 

And now, comes another explosion... 

(Source: KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS, edited)

Note: Title and Relations are provisional and will be updated when more info is announced.

Uma série de anime original baseada no videogame "Death Stranding".

Uma vez, houve uma explosão...

Almas solitárias dos mortos se manifestam no mundo físico, alcançando em busca dos vivos. No entanto, a conexão que eles criam desencadeia uma explosão maciça que erradica qualquer coisa deste mundo - um fenômeno conhecido como Death Stranding. Esses eventos aniquilam nações, assim como a própria civilização. As pessoas que permanecem agora estão isoladas, retiradas e sem conexões. Enquanto a humanidade está à beira de um lendário porteiro, partiu para transportar tanto a carga quanto os desejos de seus remetentes, reconectando as pessoas na esperança de que elas ainda pudessem ser salvas.

Em algum lugar na América do Norte, assim como Sam Bridges atravessa o continente para salvar a América, os outros também estão tentando lidar com o isolamento deles à sua maneira. Um velho tentando realizar a salvação fora da conexão defendida por Bridges. Uma guerreira que tenta dar início a um mundo de lutas constantes. Um garoto com rancor contra Bridges. Uma garota que abraça a solidão.

No precipício do fim da humanidade e do mundo, seus destinos e esperanças convergem, como outra história de Death Stranding começa.

E agora, vem outra explosão...

(Fonte: KOJIMA PRODU ES, editado)

Una vez, hubo una explosión...

Las almas solitarias de los muertos se manifiestan en el mundo físico, llegando en busca de los vivos. Sin embargo, la conexión que crean desencadena una explosión masiva que erradica cualquier cosa de este mundo, un fenómeno conocido como el Estrecho de Muerte. Estos eventos eliminan a las naciones así como a la civilización misma. Las personas que permanecen ahora están aisladas, retiradas y sin conexiones. A medida que la humanidad está al borde de un legendario portero que se prepara para transportar carga y deseos de sus remitentes, reconectando a la gente con la esperanza de que aún puedan ser salvados.

En algún lugar de América del Norte, al igual que Sam Bridges camina por el continente para salvar a América, las personas también están tratando de lidiar con su aislamiento a su manera. Un viejo tratando de realizar la salvación a través de caminos fuera de la conexión defendida por Bridges. Una guerrera que intenta patear un mundo de lucha constante. Un chico con rencor contra Bridges. Una chica que abraza la soledad.

En el precipicio del fin de la humanidad y del mundo, sus destinos y esperanzas convergen, mientras comienza otra historia del Estrecho de la Muerte.

Y ahora, viene otra explosión...

For the sake of their cultivation endeavors, the Qionghua Sect sent its elders to forge two swords, Wangshu and Xihe, and sought two disciples to wield them in dual cultivation, attempting to bind the demon realm and seize its immense spiritual power. This ultimately triggered a great war between humans and demons, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides. During this time, Su Yu, the host of Wangshu, disagreed with the Qionghua Sect's cultivation philosophy and left the sect with Yun Tianqing. The demon realm seized the opportunity to escape, and the Qionghua Sect's leader perished in the war.

The two married on Qingluan Peak and had a son, Yun Tianhe. They both died young due to the icy cold that invaded their bodies. Young Yun Tianhe grew up alone on Qingluan Mountain. He was unaware of his parents' past, and the unexpected arrival of Han Lingsha set the wheels of fate turning once more.

en.synopsisFull:
Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break!

Dweeby high schooler Uehara Yuuki has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she’s bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara’s dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Miyamoto Niina—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara’s concocted, and he certainly isn’t the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?
en.synopsisShort: Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break!

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Os opostos atraem nesta histérica comédia romântica sobre dois artistas de mangá do ensino médio que não conseguem dar um tempo!

A estudante Uehara Yuuki criou a heroína de comédia romântica perfeita - ela é tímida, airheaded, e completamente casta. Quando um editor da editora dos sonhos de Uehara rejeita friamente sua história de mangá como banal e sem realismo, ela envia Uehara para uma espiral de desespero que o empurra para o caminho de seu colega de classe borbulhante e lindo, Miyamoto Niina – uma aspirante a artista de mangá! Tendo recebido comentários semelhantes em seu próprio mangá, Miyamoto propõe que ela e Uehara se envolvam em um relacionamento falso, já que nenhum deles tem nenhuma experiência romântica. Mas Miyamoto está longe da heroína perfeita que Uehara inventou, e ele certamente não é o herói arrogante de sua história também. A relação maluca deles pode transformar seus sonhos de mangá em realidade, ou isso levará a ainda mais desastres cômicos?
pt-BR.synopsisShort: Os opostos atraem nesta histérica comédia romântica sobre dois artistas de mangá do ensino médio que não conseguem dar um tempo!

La estudiante de secundaria Dweeby Uehara Yuuki ha creado la heroína comedia romántica perfecta: es tímida, con cabeza de aire y completamente casta. Cuando un editor del editor de sueños de Uehara descarta fríamente su historia de manga como trito y carente de realismo, envía a Uehara a una espiral de desesperación que lo empuja al camino de su compañero de clase, Miyamoto Niina, un aspirante artista de mangas! Habiendo recibido comentarios similares sobre su propio manga, Miyamoto propone que ella y Uehara se comprometan en una relación falsa, ya que ninguno de ellos tiene experiencia romántica. Pero Miyamoto está lejos de la heroína perfecta de Uehara, y ciertamente no es el héroe arrogante de su historia tampoco. ¿Puede su relación loca convertir sus sueños de manga en realidad, o conducirá a más desastres cómicos?
