en.synopsisFull:
The second cour of Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den.

Through the actions of Reirin and Keigetsu, the series of disturbances caused by a curse in the inner court have settled down.

Through their swap, Reirin and Keigetsu learned of each other’s character, and a friendship was budding between the two of them.

Seasons pass, and we are now at early autumn. The location of the ritual where the Crown Prince and the Maidens wish for a bountiful harvest (the Harvest Festival) has been set within the southern lands ruled by the Shu clan. With no consort as guardian, Keigetsu arduously continues with preparations despite feeling the pressure as the host of the Harvest Festival. Meanwhile, Reirin is wholeheartedly supporting Keigetsu while being thrilled about her first royal outing.

However, right upon arrival, an unforeseen accident occurs and the ritual is interrupted. An agitated Keigetsu’s spell runs out of control, and she once again swaps bodies with Reirin. On top of that, among all the confusion, the post-swap Reirin is abducted...!?

Reirin’s two overprotective brothers Kou Keikou and Kou Keishou get involved and the situation heads in an unexpected direction.

Who is the new mastermind who is sneaking up in order to frame Keigetsu...?

The gratifying tale of switched fates brought to you by two girls who are polar opposites—the curtain rises on the second act, "The First Royal Outing" Arc!

As estações passam, e agora estamos no início do outono. A localização do ritual onde o Príncipe Herdeiro e as Donzelas desejam uma colheita abundante (o Festival da Colheita) foi definido dentro das terras do sul governadas pelo clã Shu. Sem consorte como guardião, Keigetsu continua árduamente com os preparativos, apesar de sentir a pressão como anfitrião do Festival da Colheita. Enquanto isso, Reirin está de todo o coração apoiando Keigetsu enquanto se emociona com sua primeira turnê real.

en.synopsisFull:
With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward. 

At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn’t have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn’t be happier. Hiroto’s breezy attitude isn’t easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life. 

After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old granny who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house, but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin Natsumi moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto’s easygoing lifestyle to the test.
en.synopsisShort: With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward.

pt-BR.synopsisFull:
Com uma visão despreocupada da vida, Hiroto sabe melhor do que ninguém que desacelerar às vezes é a melhor maneira de seguir em frente.

Aos 29 anos, o despreocupado Hiroto Ikuta não tem uma namorada, um emprego em tempo integral ou um plano para o futuro - e ele não poderia estar mais feliz. A atitude alegre de Hiroto não é fácil para todos entenderem. Em um mundo cheio de ansiedade, confusão e tristeza, Hiroto e as pessoas que o cercam estão fazendo o melhor para descobrir essa coisa chamada vida.

Depois de desenvolver uma amizade improvável com a velha avó que vive em seu bairro, Hiroto de repente se encontra herdando não apenas sua casa, mas algumas emoções difíceis também. Seu primo de 18 anos Natsumi se muda com ele, mas como estudante de arte em dificuldades, ela tem seus próprios problemas para lidar e pode colocar o estilo de vida descontraído de Hiroto à prova.
pt-BR.synopsisShort: Com uma visão despreocupada da vida, Hiroto sabe melhor do que ninguém que desacelerar às vezes é a melhor maneira de seguir em frente.

es.synopsisFull:
Con una perspectiva despreocupada sobre la vida, Hiroto sabe mejor que cualquiera que ralentice es a veces la mejor manera de avanzar.

A los 29 años, sin preocupaciones Hiroto Ikuta no tiene novia, un trabajo a tiempo completo o un plan para el futuro, y no podría ser más feliz. Sin embargo, la actitud brisa de Hiroto no es fácil para todos comprender. En un mundo lleno de ansiedad, confusión y dolor, Hiroto y las personas que lo rodean están haciendo todo lo posible para descubrir esta cosa llamada vida.

Después de desarrollar una amistad improbable con la vieja abuelita que vive en su barrio, Hiroto repentinamente se encuentra heredando no sólo su casa, sino también algunas emociones bastante difíciles. Su prima de 18 años Natsumi se mueve con él, pero como estudiante de arte luchador, ella tiene sus propios problemas para lidiar con y puede poner el estilo de vida fácil de Hiroto a la prueba.

en.synopsisFull:
The time is Sengoku.

Japan is fractured into many independent nations entangled in ceaseless war. At the center lies Ashina, a land of sacred earth and ancient mystery. Two decades after Sword Saint Isshin Ashina reclaimed the region in a brutal coup, a new threat emerges from within: The Interior Ministry. Desperate to protect his homeland, Isshin's grandson Genichiro turns to forbidden powers. The only hope lies in a kidnapped boy — the Divine Heir — and his silent protector: a loyal shinobi known only as Sekiro.

This is the story of a lord and his retainer — and their quest to restore balance to a nation on the edge.

en.synopsisFull: A scientific expedition from Blue Star discovered a strange humanoid corpse exposed in a vacuum on the planet Minglong. The expedition brought it back to Blue Star for research, but unexpectedly, they also brought disaster. The energy emanating from the humanoid corpse caused the entire Blue Star biosphere to enter a state of supernatural evolution. Fortunately, the humans on Blue Star were also within the biosphere and entered the supernatural evolutionary sequence, successively evolving into: Human-level, Earth-level, and Celestial-level evolvers. The seven most powerful Celestial-level evolvers were known as the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​protecting Hanxia in this chaotic world fraught with calamities. The anomalies on Blue Star attracted the attention of the Great Yu Empire, which ruled this star field. The Great Yu Empire believed that these anomalies might be related to a fugitive they were hunting. Therefore, taking advantage of the emergence of the Tenth Academy of the Starry Sky, they issued an academy trial, attracting a large number of students from combat academies to Blue Star under the guise of trials to find the fugitive and hone their new blood. On Blue Star, a young man named Lu Yin lies in hiding. He is unaware of his identity and origins; his earliest memories are of a bloody massacre, leaving him alone and stranded on Blue Star. As Blue Star undergoes a dramatic transformation, he realizes this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. He needs a clean new identity to return to that dangerous starry sea and seek revenge for the blood debts of the past. Thus, Lu Yin, the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​students of the Great Yu Empire, and various other forces enter the scene. On Blue Star, an unprecedented evolution and hunt is about to begin.

A energia que emana do cadáver humanoide fez com que toda a biosfera da Estrela Azul entrasse em um estado de evolução sobrenatural. Felizmente, os humanos na Estrela Azul também estavam dentro da biosfera e entraram na sequência evolutiva sobrenatural, evoluindo sucessivamente para: evolutores de nível humano, nível da Terra e nível Celestial. Os sete mais poderosos evolutores de nível celestial eram conhecidos como os Sete Sábios de Hanxia, protegendo Hanxia neste mundo caótico repleto de calamidades. As anomalias na Estrela Azul atraíram a atenção do Grande Império Yu, que governou este campo estelar. O Grande Império Yu acreditava que essas anomalias poderiam estar relacionadas a um fugitivo que estavam caçando. Portanto, aproveitando o surgimento da Décima Academia do Céu Estrelado, eles emitiram um julgamento na academia, atraindo um grande número de estudantes de academias de combate para a Estrela Azul sob o disfarce de julgamentos para encontrar o fugitivo e aprimorar seu novo sangue. Na Estrela Azul, um jovem chamado Lu Yin está escondido. Ele não tem conhecimento de sua identidade e origens; suas primeiras lembranças são de um massacre sangrento, deixando-o sozinho e preso na Estrela Azul. Enquanto Blue Star passa por uma transformação dramática, ele percebe que esta é uma oportunidade única na vida. Ele precisa de uma nova identidade limpa para retornar àquele perigoso mar estrelado e buscar vingança pelas dívidas de sangue do passado. Assim, Lu Yin, os Sete Sábios de Hanxia, estudantes do Grande Império Yu, e várias outras forças entram em cena. Em Blue Star, uma evolução e caça sem precedentes está prestes a começar.

en.title: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
en.synopsis:
The standoff between Raizo and Fukurokuju continues as Raizo is ablaze and Fukurokuju is eventually completely set alight. Unable to withstand the heat of the flames, he collapses and screams for water. Meanwhile, Big Mom is cornered by Kid and Law, as Kid's Damned Punk attempts to knock her into the hole. As a last-ditch effort, she uses Soul Pocus and attempts to take fifty years from their lifespans, effectively killing them. However, as neither Kid nor Law feared her, the attack is rendered ineffective. Using his ability, Law creates an R-ROOM, a Room which attaches to her regardless of where she moves. As a homage to his benefactor, Rosinante, he uses Silent, preventing Big Mom from making any sound as long as she remains inside the Room. Misery attempts to aid Big Mom by attacking Law from behind, but Law uses his sword to slice her in half as Kid uses a second Damned Punk, sending an even stronger ray which finally sends Big Mom falling into the hole. When Big Mom falls and lands in the armory, she grabs one of the frozen bombs, unaware that they were explosive. The bomb explodes, blasting a second hole in the bottom of the island causing her to fall towards the Wano's mainland. Yamato is able to block the explosion with a frozen piece of debris, preventing the other bombs from detonating. However, the explosion considerably damaged Kazenbo, causing it to retreat towards Orochi. The explosion causes the entire island to crumble. A wounded Zoro, who was resting on the edge of the island, falls off the island as a result of the island crumbling. Big Mom is sent falling towards the ground. She notices the Fire Festival celebrations at the nearby Flower Capital, prompting her to reflect on her childhood with Carmel, her failure to defeat Luffy on Whole Cake Island, and finally her involvement in the raid. She curses Gol D. Roger for starting the Golden Age of Piracy, posthumously promoting the proliferation of new, inexperienced rookie pirates. Big Mom falls into the magma chamber, causing a large eruption of lava. Witnessing the fall of one of the Four Emperors, Kid and Law's crewmates cheer over the captains' accomplishment as the two rest from their epic fight with Big Mom. As Momonosuke continues to move Onigashima, Yamato approaches him through a hole caused by the explosion. Momonosuke tells Yamato that he senses that Zunesha had appeared near the island. He also tells him that Zunesha was a companion of Joy Boy who committed a crime eight centuries ago.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (171/189)

pt-BR.title: Para a Nova Era! Settled! A Determinação dos Brats
pt-BR.synopsis:
O impasse entre Raizo e Fukurokuju continua enquanto Raizo está em chamas e Fukurokuju está completamente incendiado. Incapaz de suportar o calor das chamas, ele desaba e grita por água. Enquanto isso, Big Mom é encurralada por Kid e Law, enquanto Kid's Damned Punk tenta derrubá-la no buraco. Como um último esforço, ela usa o Soul Pocus e tenta tirar 50 anos de sua vida, efetivamente matando-os. No entanto, como nem Kid nem Law a temiam, o ataque se torna ineficaz. Usando sua habilidade, Law cria um R-ROOM, uma sala que se liga a ela, independentemente de onde ela se move. Como uma homenagem ao seu benfeitor, Rosinante, ele usa Silent, impedindo a Big Mom de fazer qualquer som enquanto ela permanece dentro da sala. A miséria tenta ajudar Big Mom atacando Law por trás, mas Law usa sua espada para cortá-la ao meio enquanto Kid usa um segundo punk amaldiçoado, enviando um raio ainda mais forte que finalmente faz Big Mom cair no buraco. Quando Big Mom cai e pousa no arsenal, ela pega uma das bombas congeladas, sem saber que eram explosivas. A bomba explode, estourando um segundo buraco no fundo da ilha, fazendo com que ela caia em direção ao continente do Wano. Yamato é capaz de bloquear a explosão com um pedaço congelado de detritos, impedindo que as outras bombas detonem. No entanto, a explosão danificou Kazenbo, fazendo com que ele recuasse em direção a Orochi. A explosão faz com que toda a ilha desmorone. Um Zoro ferido, que estava descansando na borda da ilha, cai da ilha como resultado do desmoronamento da ilha. Big Mom é enviado caindo em direção ao chão. Ela percebe as celebrações do Festival de Fogo na vizinha Flower Capital, levando-a a refletir sobre sua infância com Carmel, seu fracasso em derrotar Luffy em Whole Cake Island, e finalmente seu envolvimento no ataque. Ela amaldiçoa Gol D. Roger por iniciar a Era de Ouro da Pirataria, promovendo postumamente a proliferação de novos piratas novatos inexperientes. Big Mom cai na câmara de magma, causando uma grande erupção de lava. Testemunhando a queda de um dos quatro imperadores, os companheiros de Kid e Law comemoram a realização dos capitães enquanto os dois descansam de sua épica luta com a Big Mom. Enquanto Momonosuke continua a mover Onigashima, Yamato se aproxima dele através de um buraco causado pela explosão. Momonosuke diz a Yamato que ele sente que Zunesha apareceu perto da ilha. Ele também diz que Zunesha era um companheiro de Joy Boy que cometeu um crime há oito séculos.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

He says that Level 6 truly exists and is a place where prisoners who are incredibly dangerous or harmful to the World Government's reputation, such as former head warden Shiryu, are kept. Despite the long time for treatment, and low risk of survival, Bon Clay keeps on cheering for Luffy until his voice gives out, with the other New Kamas joining in. Meanwhile, Ace worries about Luffy always taking risks for his sake while the guards discover Luffy's disappearance and prepare to transport Ace to his execution. Eventually, Luffy's screams stop and he, having completed his treatment after less than a day, eats a large amount of food and declares that he has recovered.

(Source: Wikipedia)

en.title: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames
en.synopsis:
After Queen's blade shatters upon contact with Sanji's neck, Sanji realizes that he may have scientific enhancements just like his siblings. As he starts to run away in a panic, Sanji theorizes that putting on the Raid Suit is what causing him to change Even when his enemies shoot him with firearms, he survives uninjured. Still, he denies his abilities due to contempt of his old family. Drake continues his battle against combatant Beast Pirates when he is confronted by Apoo who suggests that as both side would be heavily injured after the battles over, they should form of an alliance to defeat the weakened victor. On Apoo's side are three Numbers: Inbi, the centaur-like Fuga and Zanki. Drake is uninterested by this offer, untrusting of Apoo. Nami, Usopp, Tama, her tamed Gifters and an injured Komachiyo try to escape the fire, but they come face-to-face with Kin'emon's lower body. His lower body can communicate though farts, but cannot hear others because his ears are on his other half. Nami traces the reverse crescent on his rear, allowing him to identify her as an ally and asks for aid. Usopp and Hamlet takes Kin'emon's leg and head to his location. On the third floor, Brook continues to escort Robin away, but are surrounded by Beast Pirates, who attempts to capture Robin, but Mink combatants come to her support. Unfortunately, they're confronted by the members of CP0, who're also after Robin. As Kin'emon upper body remains in the attic, he thinks that his survival from his defeat at Kaido's hands was due to his body not being reattached properly after it been bifurcated by Law, while he hopes that aid will come soon for Kiku. Kanjuro reveals to have also survived his defeat and is in contact with Orochi. On Orochi's order, Kanjuro decides to give a "final performance" using his Devil Fruit ability. To symbolize the burning hatred of the Kurozumi Clan, he draws and creates a large ghost-like entity wreathed in flames, Kazenbo. The monster passes through walls and sets everything it touches on fire. Shortly after creating the monster, Kanjuro collapses, finally succumbing to his injuries. The Marys announce that the Skull Dome is now on fire. As Orochi eagerly anticipates his enemies to burn, Sanji continues his battle against Queen, Zoro battles fiercely against King outside, and Luffy and Kaido continue their combat on the roof of the Skull Dome.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Ainda assim, ele nega suas habilidades devido ao desprezo de sua antiga família. Do lado de Apoo estão três Números: Inbi, o Centauro como Fuga e Zanki. Drake não está interessado nessa oferta, não confiando em Apoo. Nami, Usopp, Tama, seus domados Gifters e um Komachiyo ferido tentam escapar do fogo, mas ficam cara a cara com o corpo inferior de Kin'emon. Seu corpo inferior pode se comunicar através de peidos, mas não pode ouvir os outros porque seus ouvidos estão em sua outra metade. Nami traça o crescente reverso em sua retaguarda, permitindo que ele a identifique como uma aliada e peça ajuda. Usopp e Hamlet pegam a perna de Kin'emon e vão para sua localização. No terceiro andar, Brook continua a escoltar Robin longe, mas são cercados por Piratas da Besta, que tenta capturar Robin, mas os combatentes Mink vêm em seu apoio. Infelizmente, eles são confrontados pelos membros da CP0, que também estão atrás de Robin. Como Kin'emon parte superior do corpo permanece no sótão, ele acha que sua sobrevivência de sua derrota nas mãos de Kaido foi devido a seu corpo não ser recolocado corretamente depois que foi bifurcado pela Lei, enquanto ele espera que a ajuda virá em breve para Kiku. Kanjuro revela ter sobrevivido a sua derrota e está em contato com Orochi. Por ordem de Orochi, Kanjuro decide dar uma "performance final" usando sua habilidade de Fruta do Diabo. Para simbolizar o ódio ardente do Clã Kurozumi, ele desenha e cria uma grande entidade fantasmagórica envolta em chamas, Kazenbo. O monstro passa pelas paredes e põe tudo o que toca em fogo. Pouco depois de criar o monstro, Kanjuro entra em colapso, finalmente sucumbindo aos seus ferimentos. Os Marys anunciam que a Caveira está pegando fogo. Como Orochi ansiosamente antecipa seus inimigos para queimar, Sanji continua sua batalha contra a Rainha, Zoro luta ferozmente contra King lá fora, e Luffy e Kaido continuam seu combate no telhado da Caveira Dome.

On the Performance Floor, Chopper returns to his normal form and is now able to move, though he worries for Zoro whom he knows will be suffering twice as much once the special medicine he was given wears off. Outside, Zoro is slowly bleeding out and begins to see the Grim Reaper approach him. Meanwhile, at the Right-Brain Tower, Franky searches for Zoro. Elsewhere, Izo is finishing off the last of the Beasts Pirates but is weakened and stabbed in the stomach by a pirate who he shoots to death. He staggers away, his way out of the castle, he hopes that Kin'emon and Kiku have escaped successfully. He comes across the CP0 agents who were after Robin. Instead of letting them go, however, Izo tells them to stop. Yamato has finally reached the armory where the bombs are located just as Kazenbo does, preparing to set fire to the explosives therein. Yamato briefly transforms and freezes everything inside. She then swings at the flame specter, determined to stop it from fulfilling the command given to it by Kanjuro and Orochi. It proceeds to engulf Yamato in flames, with the latter screaming in pain. Back at the Performance Floor, Big Mom continues to wreak havoc with her lightning attacks, knocking back Law and Kid. She remembers that Kaido is on the rooftop fighting Luffy and wonders why she still has not heard the emperor's shout of victory. She commands Hera to take her to the rooftop, but Law stops her with K-ROOM. He impales her with his sword and uses Shock Wille, causing her to fall. Kid then use his Punk Corna Dio to create a metallic bull bigger than Bog Mom and proceeds to charge at her with it into a building. en.title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
en.synopsis:
After a review of the ending of the previous episode, the episode begins with Marine Lieutenant Iron Fist Fullbody pouring a drink to a beautiful lady on his marine ship and saying how he is taking her to the greatest restaurant in the world. The lady then questions if the restaurant is in the middle of the ocean, which Fullbody answers by telling her to just look forward to it. In the meantime, on the Going Merry, Zoro recognizes the intruder who got beat up by Luffy from the last episode as Johnny. Johnny then brings the straw hat pirates' attention to Yosaku, who lies ill on his and Johnny's small ship. Turns out that Johnny, Yosaku, and Zoro used to be bounty hunter partners some time ago. Johnny then proceeds to tell the straw hat pirates that he took Yosaku to a small rock island to rest, which was coincidentally blown up by Usopp and Luffy for target practice in the last episode. Usopp and Luffy quickly apologize. Johnny, however, was more worried about Yosaku's condition, which Nami quickly diagnosed as scurvy caused by a lack of Vitamin C. Luffy and Usopp then shove a bunch of lemons into Yosaku's mouth and Yosaku is revived!... or at least for 5 minutes. The straw hat pirates conclude that they need a cook for their potential nutritional problems. Johnny points out that they probably can find a good candidate in the floating sea restaurant known as Baratie. He also states that the one Zoro has been looking for, Hawk-eyes Mihawk, is near there too. Thus they head to Baratie, which actually is pretty much right next to where they were. They are then passed by Fullbody's marine ship. Fullbody doesn't recognize the straw hat pirates mark, but he recognizes Johnny and Yosaku as worthless pirate hunters. Johnny responds by shouting "this is what pirate hunters do" while throwing a bunch of wanted posters in the air. Nami takes note of the Arlong poster with an angry look and crumbles the poster in her hands. Fullbody then orders his crew to sink the pirate ship. en.title: Tearfully Swearing Allegiance! Oden and Kin'emon!
en.synopsis:
The Mountain God continues its rampage around town in search of its baby. Upon hearing that the Mountain God swallowed Tsurujo, Kin'emon decides to battle it head on. Despite having stabbed the beast, Kin'emon is knocked back into the ground and defeated. Oden then appears and faces the Mountain God, slicing the beast cleanly in half with a single dual-sword slash. Although there were no casualties from the incident, a quarter of the town was destroyed by the Mountain God. When Kin'emon's tries to confess his guilt over incident, Oden knocks him out and takes the blame before he receives the notice of disavowal from his father and is expelled from the capital. Due to their admiration for Oden, Kin'emon and Denjiro decide to follow him. Oden stays at Hakumai and meets the region's daimyo, Yasuie, and his servant, Orochi. After Oden leaves to travel to across Wano and eventually to Kuri. Afterwards it discovered that the room Oden stayed in is absolutely destroyed. When it is also revealed that Yasuie's money has been stolen, Orochi steps forward and claims to have witnessed Oden take it. While the Daimyo's staff quickly believe the young servant, Yasuie himself is suspicious, knowing that Oden would have made more of a spectacle of the matter. As he, Kin'emon and Denjiro travel, Oden is also joined by others. In Ringo they're joined by Kikunojo and her older brother Izo (the future 16th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates) who were sons of a dancing instructor, but their family had recently been split due to the father being jailed for a crime, forcing them to dance in the snow for money. In Kibi they met Kanjuro, who stole hair from the living and the dead to make brushes to sell for a living. In Udon, they met Raizo, who had quit the Kouzuki Clan's Oniwabanshu after a female ninja had turned him down, who begged to join Oden, no longer wanting to live in the shadows. Oden eventually arrives at Kuri and prepares to fight the bandits there, including Ashura Doji.

Apesar de não haver vítimas do incidente, um quarto da cidade foi destruída pelo Deus da Montanha. Quando Kin'emon tenta confessar sua culpa pelo incidente, Oden o nocautea e assume a culpa antes de receber o aviso de desaprovação de seu pai e ser expulso da capital. Devido à sua admiração por Oden, Kin'emon e Denjiro decidem segui-lo. Oden fica em Hakumai e conhece o daimyo da região, Yasuie, e seu servo, Orochi. Depois que Oden sai para viajar para Wano e, eventualmente, para Kuri. Depois descobriu que o quarto em que Oden ficou foi destruído. Quando também é revelado que o dinheiro de Yasuie foi roubado, Orochi avança e afirma ter testemunhado Oden levá-lo. Enquanto a equipe do Daimyo rapidamente acredita no jovem servo, Yasuie é suspeito, sabendo que Oden teria feito mais de um espetáculo do assunto. Enquanto ele, Kin'emon e Denjiro viajam, Oden também é acompanhado por outros. Em Ringo eles são acompanhados por Kikunojo e seu irmão mais velho Izo (o futuro comandante da 16a divisão dos Piratas Whitebeard) que eram filhos de um instrutor de dança, mas sua família havia sido recentemente dividida devido ao pai ser preso por um crime, forçando-os a dançar na neve por dinheiro. Outside in the streets, Sanji and Kin'emon are watching Luffy's fight while observing in disguise the numerous marines surrounding the Colosseum waiting to arrest any criminal that exits the stadium. However, not a single loser of the battle royales came out, confusing even the present vice admiral Bastille over what's happening inside. Elsewhere, Thunder Soldier explains that ten years ago when Doflamingo took over the island, he imposed a strict curfew between humans and toys. Confused, Franky asks why would he separate them like that until the toy soldier reveals that every toy in the island were once humans who became forgotten to their loved ones and that Doflamingo brought a Devil Fruit user that caused those transformations. At Green Bit, Trafalgar Law is barely holding his defense against Issho and Doflamingo's assault. Their battle is felt shaking the Tontatta Kingdom while the dwarves believed it to be Usopp's Haki. When Usopp questions their war with Doflamingo, the dwarves thought it was a joke and explains that 500 of their people including their princess are held as slaves in Doflamingo's dark factory and their goal is to rescue them and destroy the factory revealed to be hidden in the Corrida Colosseum basement, right underneath Luffy's feet.

en.title: The Pact Between Men! The Fierce Fighting of Brachio Tank!
en.synopsis:
Big Mom recognizes Chopper as a Straw Hat, forcing Chopper and Usopp attempt to flee in Brachio Tank V with Big Mom chasing after them. Kanjuro comes to Orochi with an unconscious, beaten Momonosuke. He states that Momonosuke attempted to escape by cutting the rope with the knife, but Kanjuro beat him unconscious. However, Kanjuro reports that he failed to thwart the Akazaya Nine's plans, and that the allied forces are in Onigashima. However, Fukurokuju reports that since there were no enemy ships at the port, the island was safe from enemy attacks. Still, Orochi prepares to execute Momonosuke to damage the enemy morale, Meanwhile, Marco and Cat Viper head to Onigashima with Izo also being with them. The revealed message that Marco wanted deliver to Luffy was simply "I'll be late, but I'll be there" as Marco states joining the raid to help avenge Oden. Denjiro leads the southern forces up the mountain path only to find the map is out-of-date, as they encounter an unmapped gate. Sasaki exits the gate, and recognizes Kyoshiro, unaware that he was Denjiro. Although Sasaki was trusting of Denjiro, Denjiro's men ambush Sasaki, tying him to a tree with Seastone chains. From there, the southern forces split up into two groups; one would enter the Skull Dome while the other continues down the path. Meanwhile, Big Mom chases Chopper and Usopp into a canyon, with Kaido's forces setting up cannons and mortars to fire at the Brachio Tank V. Although the duo destroys the cannons an mortars they're unable to harm Big Mom and once again force to flee. Since Big Mom has been lured away, Kin'emon's forces are able to safely come out of hiding. They make their advance, but Nami's group is spotted by Prometheus. Meanwhile, Ulti insists that Page One carry her down the hall, but they fall down the stairs and encounter Luffy.

Ele afirma que Momonosuke tentou escapar cortando a corda com a faca, mas Kanjuro o derrotou inconsciente. No entanto, Kanjuro relata que ele não conseguiu frustrar os planos do Akazaya Nine, e que as forças aliadas estão em Onigashima. No entanto, Fukurokuju relata que, como não havia navios inimigos no porto, a ilha estava a salvo de ataques inimigos. Ainda assim, Orochi se prepara para executar Momonosuke para danificar o moral inimigo, enquanto isso, Marco e Cat Viper vão para Onigashima com Izo também estando com eles. A mensagem revelada que Marco queria entregar ao Luffy foi simplesmente "Eu chegarei tarde, mas estarei lá" enquanto Marco se junta ao ataque para ajudar a vingar Oden. Denjiro leva as forças do sul até o caminho da montanha só para encontrar o mapa está desatualizado, como eles encontram um portão não mapeado. Sasaki sai do portão e reconhece Kyoshiro, sem saber que ele era Denjiro. Embora Sasaki confiasse em Denjiro, os homens de Denjiro emboscam Sasaki, amarrando-o a uma árvore com correntes Seastone. A partir daí, as forças do sul se dividiram em dois grupos; um entraria na Caveira enquanto o outro continua pelo caminho. Enquanto isso, Big Mom persegue Chopper e Usopp em um desfiladeiro, com as forças de Kaido montando canhões e morteiros para disparar no Tanque Brachio V. Embora a dupla destrua os canhões e os morteiros, eles são incapazes de machucar a Big Mom e mais uma vez forçam a fugir. en.title: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper's Fire Trick!
en.synopsis:
Law finds a Poneglyph while thinking back to when Corazon told him about D. and telling Robin his true name. He continues to look for the Road Poneglyph in order to learn D.'s true meaning as he wonders why he lives the checkered life he lives. Back inside the castle, while Zoro and Drake battle Apoo for the cure, Omasa completely becomes an oni as Chopper, having contracted the Ice Oni virus, attempts to nullify the symptoms by slowing the freezing. Brook uses a torch to keep Chopper's body warm, and this prevents the virus from spreading to the rest of his body. Just then, Big Mom appears riding on both Prometheus and Zeus. In the hallways, as he and Killer head for the rooftop, Kid gathers a ton of metal in preparations against Kaido. They have a brief encounter with Headliner Poker, a rattlesnake SMILE user, though Kid decides not to finish him off and get past him. On the rooftop, despite their best efforts, Kaido easily overwhelms the Akazaya Nine, breaking the rooftop with his strikes sending Kikunojo's severed arm falling into the Performance Floor below. As Big Mom decides to ride up to join Kaido, Zoro notices Kiku's severed arm falling from the roof he becomes further enraged by Queen's lack of empathy for the ailing people and begins cutting the Ice Onis down in rage before cutting Apoo down with a silent Death Lion Song. He gives the cure to Chopper who uses fire to slow the symptoms down, before moving on to another area. hopper announces his findings to the crowd, and works on creating a cure for the virus. Luffy, Sanji, and Jimbei are about to reach the third floor when Sanji hears a woman in trouble.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Elimine o Oni de Gelo! Truque de Fogo do Chopper!

Law encontra um Poneglyph enquanto pensa quando Corazon contou a ele sobre D. e dizendo Robin seu verdadeiro nome. Ele continua a procurar o Poneglyph Estrada, a fim de aprender o verdadeiro significado de D. como ele se pergunta por que ele vive a vida quadriculada que ele vive. De volta ao castelo, enquanto Zoro e Drake lutam contra Apoo pela cura, Omasa se torna completamente um oni como Chopper, tendo contraído o vírus Ice Oni, tenta anular os sintomas retardando o congelamento. Brook usa uma tocha para manter o corpo de Chopper quente, e isso impede que o vírus se espalhe para o resto do corpo. Nesse momento, Big Mom aparece montado em Prometeu e Zeus. Nos corredores, enquanto ele e Killer vão para o telhado, Kid reúne uma tonelada de metal em preparativos contra Kaido. Eles têm um breve encontro com Headliner Poker, um usuário SMILE cascavel, embora Kid decida não acabar com ele e passar por ele. No telhado, apesar de seus melhores esforços, Kaido facilmente domina o Akazaya Nine, quebrando o telhado com seus ataques, enviando o braço cortado de Kikunojo caindo no Piso de Performance abaixo. Enquanto a Big Mom decide se juntar a Kaido, Zoro percebe que o braço cortado de Kiku caindo do telhado, ele fica ainda mais enfurecido com a falta de empatia da Rainha pelas pessoas doentes e começa a cortar o Onis de Gelo com raiva antes de cortar Apoo com uma canção silenciosa do Leão da Morte. Ele dá a cura para Chopper que usa fogo para diminuir os sintomas, antes de passar para outra área. Hopper anuncia suas descobertas para a multidão, e trabalha na criação de uma cura para o vírus. Luffy, Sanji e Jimbei estão prestes a chegar ao terceiro andar quando Sanji ouve uma mulher em apuros.

An argument breaks out between Law and Shinobu when she blames the others for potentially jeopardizing the operation, accusing Bepo, Penguin and Shachi of telling Orochi's men about the symbol. Kanjuro tells her to stop blaming people as the operation will fail without them. Tonoyasu then enters, stating that the rebellion symbol has been leaked all over the capital, before asking if a big battle is coming. In Udon, while fighting the bear SMILE Fruit Gifter, Bearman Luffy still struggles to figure out how to use advance Armament Haki. Meanwhile, at Oihagi Bridge, Zoro continues his clash with Kamazo. During the battle Gyukimaru interferes, allowing Kamazo to land a hit on Zoro. However, Zoro manages to take one of Kamazo's scythes and uses it as a makeshift third sword to deliver a powerful attack to defeat the assassin. Not wanting to fight Zoro, Gyukimaru decides to leave with his weapons as Zoro collapses in the snow from his injury.

Tonoyasu então entra, afirmando que o símbolo da rebelião vazou por toda a capital, antes de perguntar se uma grande batalha está chegando. Em Udon, enquanto luta contra o urso SMILE Fruit Giffer, Bearman Luffy ainda luta para descobrir como usar o Armamento Avançado Haki. No entanto, Zoro consegue pegar uma das foices de Kamazo e usa-a como uma terceira espada improvisada para entregar um poderoso ataque para derrotar o assassino. en.title: Get to Building R! The Pirate Alliance's Great Advance!
en.synopsis:
Though the Straw Hats and Brownbeard managed to escape into the lab, they left behind a gaping hole. But they soon realize that Shinokuni can now enter the lab. The G-5 Marines panically seals the hole back up with various wooden and metal planks. They succeeded in sealing the hole as Shinokuni proceeds to spread throughout the island. Brook uses the power of his Devil Fruit to become a soul and survey the area outside of the lab, noting that 'it was like the land of the dead'. After regaining their senses, the G-5 marines then turn their guns and swords towards the Straw Hats preparing to arrest them. Nami notices Law and demands him to switch back her and Sanji's body, to which Sanji secretly refuses. Law agrees to return them to their original bodies and uses Shambles to switch their hearts back. Nami notices that she was wearing a different coat and punches Sanji, accusing him of peeping at her body. Law then explains to everyone present that they only have two hours to escape, he then continues by saying the only passage that leads safely leads out of the island is called R-66 and is found in Room R. The marines were reluctant, but quickly changes their mind when Smoker repeated the order to them. Smoker then orders Tashigi to take command of the men and rescue the children as he goes to confront Vergo. Meanwhile, Caesar Clown is celebrating the deaths of his victims but notices that the cage has no solidified bodies, which he needed to prove the power of Shinokuni. He also notices the absence of the G-5 Marines. Vergo states that Luffy and the others must have broken out of the cage and helped the G-5 soldiers' escape. Before Luffy went to fight Caesar again, Zoro calls out to Luffy reminding him that this is just the beginning of the New World and he mustn't let his guard down again, and Luffy happily complies as he plows through the Satyr soldiers. Caesar Clown then receives the news that the Straw Hats and Marines have broken into the Lab, leaving him alarmed and flabbergasted at their escape.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Punk Hazard arc: (25/46)

pt-BR.title: Vá para o Edifício R! O Grande Avanço da Aliança Pirata!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Embora os Straw Hats e o Brownbeard conseguiram escapar para o laboratório, eles deixaram para trás um buraco. Mas logo percebem que Shinokuni pode entrar no laboratório. Os fuzileiros do G-5 selaram o buraco com várias tábuas de madeira e metal. Eles conseguiram selar o buraco enquanto Shinokuni se espalha por toda a ilha. Brook usa o poder de sua Fruta do Diabo para se tornar uma alma e examinar a área fora do laboratório, observando que "era como a terra dos mortos". Depois de recuperar seus sentidos, os fuzileiros do G-5 então viram suas armas e espadas para os chapéus Straw se preparando para prendê-los. Nami percebe a Lei e exige que ele mude o corpo dela e do Sanji, para o qual Sanji secretamente se recusa. Lei concorda em devolvê-los aos seus corpos originais e usa Shambles para mudar seus corações de volta. Nami percebe que ela estava usando um casaco diferente e soca Sanji, acusando-o de espiar seu corpo. Lei então explica a todos os presentes que eles só têm duas horas para escapar, ele então continua dizendo que a única passagem que leva com segurança para fora da ilha é chamada R-66 e é encontrada na Sala R. Os fuzileiros estavam relutantes, mas rapidamente mudam de ideia quando Smoker repetiu a ordem para eles. Smoker então ordena Tashigi para assumir o comando dos homens e resgatar as crianças enquanto ele vai enfrentar Vergo. Enquanto isso, Caesar Clown está comemorando a morte de suas vítimas, mas percebe que a gaiola não tem corpos solidificados, que ele precisava para provar o poder de Shinokuni. Ele também percebe a ausência dos G-5 Marines. Vergo afirma que Luffy e os outros devem ter saído da gaiola e ajudado os soldados do G-5 a escapar. Antes de Luffy ir lutar contra César novamente, Zoro chama para Luffy lembrando-o que este é apenas o começo do Novo Mundo e ele não deve baixar sua guarda novamente, e Luffy alegremente cumpre como ele arar através dos soldados Satyr. Caesar Clown então recebe a notícia de que os Straw Hats e Marines invadiram o laboratório, deixando-o alarmado e espantado com sua fuga.

en.synopsis:
As some of the Donquixote Pirates' underlings exclaim that Lao G has been defeated, Zoro looks over the enormous rift in the ground created by Sai before deciding to keep Sai and his fleet in mind due to how powerful they are. Meanwhile, Sai runs up to the battered Chinjao and begs him to not die as Baby 5 states that she will make preparations for two ceremonies, a wedding and a funeral, which prompts both Sai and Chinajo to angrily proclaim that the latter is not dead yet. Above them, Zoro continues dodging Pica's stone spikes as Pica laughs at him. When an irritated Zoro tells him to stop laughing because it is annoying, Pica becomes angered and uses Charlestone once more, which sends several of his subordinates flying. Managing to dodge the spikes, Zoro runs along one of them and cuts Pica's stone face to pieces, only for Pica to escape. Elizabello II offers to assist Zoro, but Zoro states that he will be the one to defeat him before telling Elizabello to save his King Punch. Meanwhile, on Flower Hill, the ground flaps up and down like a flag, causing Kyros to lose his balance and forced to lean on his sword for support. Realizing that the toy soldier who was crying and screaming when he killed Scarlet was actually Kyros, Diamante notes that there is nothing but hatred between them. Kyros agrees and leaps into the air before proclaiming that this is why he came here as he attacks Diamante, who blocks with his steel cape before attacking Rebecca. However, Kyros manages to block the attack, prompting Diamante to run toward him and seemingly attack him only to redirect the attack toward Rebecca at the last second. After Kyros blocks this attack as well, Rebecca realizes that Diamante is targeting her and tells Kyros she will fight as well, prompting Diamante to proclaim he will kill her as well before attacking her once more. As Kyros protects Rebecca again, Diamante states that he wants to see him lose both his wife and daughter as Kyros tells Rebecca he will fight because he wants to avenge Scarlett and compensate for teaching her how to fight before proclaiming that he will no longer let his daughter swing a sword now that he is human once more. Elsewhere in Dressrosa, Sabo saves a mother and her daughter from a burning building as parts of the flaming ceiling fall down around them. After getting the mother and daughter outside, Sabo offers them cups of water before hearing a soldier shouting that his friends are stuck in a cage at the Colosseum. When Sabo tells him to take him there, the soldier agrees and runs off, leaving Sabo to look up at the palace where Luffy is fighting before running after him. Luffy continues to fight Bellamy, whom he unsuccessfully tries to convince to stop attacking him and pushing himself closer to death. Meanwhile, Doflamingo and Trébol defeat Law while Gladius inflates the ground to create a large explosion to kill Cavendish, who furiously demands Bartolomeo to let him into his barrier.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Enquanto isso, Sai corre até o Chinjao maltratado e implora para que ele não morra como Baby 5 afirma que ela fará preparativos para duas cerimônias, um casamento e um funeral, o que leva Sai e Chinajo a proclamar com raiva que este último ainda não está morto. Acima deles, Zoro continua se esquivando dos picos de pedra de Pica enquanto Pica ri dele. Quando um Zoro irritado diz a ele para parar de rir porque é irritante, Pica fica irritado e usa Charlestone mais uma vez, o que envia vários de seus subordinados voando. Conseguindo evitar os picos, Zoro corre ao longo de um deles e corta a pedra de Pica em pedaços, apenas para Pica escapar. Elizabello II se oferece para ajudar Zoro, mas Zoro afirma que ele será o único a derrotá-lo antes de dizer a Elizabello para salvar seu King Punch. Enquanto isso, em Flower Hill, o chão bate para cima e para baixo como uma bandeira, fazendo Kyros perder o equilíbrio e forçado a se apoiar em sua espada para obter apoio. Percebendo que o soldado de brinquedo que estava chorando e gritando quando matou Scarlet era na verdade Kyros, Diamante observa que não há nada além de ódio entre eles. Kyros concorda e salta para o ar antes de proclamar que é por isso que ele veio aqui como ele ataca Diamante, que bloqueia com sua capa de aço antes de atacar Rebecca. No entanto, Kyros consegue bloquear o ataque, levando Diamante a correr em direção a ele e aparentemente atacá-lo apenas para redirecionar o ataque para Rebecca no último segundo. Depois que Kyros bloqueia esse ataque também, Rebecca percebe que Diamante está mirando nela e diz a Kyros que ela vai lutar também, levando Diamante a proclamar que ele vai matá-la também antes de atacá-la mais uma vez. Como Kyros protege Rebecca novamente, Diamante afirma que ele quer vê-lo perder sua esposa e filha como Kyros diz Rebecca ele vai lutar porque ele quer vingar Scarlett e compensar por ensiná-la a lutar antes de proclamar que ele não vai mais deixar sua filha balançar uma espada agora que ele é humano mais uma vez. Em outro lugar em Dressrosa, Sabo salva uma mãe e sua filha de um prédio em chamas enquanto partes do teto flamejante caem ao redor deles. Depois de levar a mãe e a filha para fora, Sabo oferece copos de água antes de ouvir um soldado gritando que seus amigos estão presos em uma gaiola no Coliseu. Quando Sabo diz para levá-lo lá, o soldado concorda e foge, deixando Sabo para olhar para o palácio onde Luffy está lutando antes de correr atrás dele. Luffy continua lutando contra Bellamy, a quem ele tenta, sem sucesso, convencer a parar de atacá-lo e se aproximar da morte. Enquanto isso, Doflamingo e Trébol derrotam Law enquanto Gladius infla o chão para criar uma grande explosão para matar Cavendish, que furiosamente exige Bartolomeo para deixá-lo entrar em sua barreira.

en.title: Sons' Cups! The Straw Hat Fleet is Formed!
en.synopsis:
Somewhere at sea, a group of pirates form an alliance to take revenge on Luffy for taking down Doflamingo's market, which they had relied on. They also plan to ransack Dressrosa if Riku has become king again. Luffy initially refuses his allies' request to serve under him, tell them that he does not want control over them because it would not let him sail freely and become Pirate King like he wanted to. Luffy tells the captains that they already had a bond after they worked together to defeat Doflamingo, and he would come help any of them if they came calling. Suddenly, they come under attack by the pirate alliance, but Fujitora destroys the alliance by dropping his rubble on their ships, saying its a parting gift for Luffy. In response to Luffy's reasoning Cavendish, Bartolomeo, Sai, Ideo, Leo, Hajrudin, and Orlumbus pledge their allegiance to him anyway, forming a one-sided alliance where they will help him whenever he needs. Fujitora thanks Luffy for cleaning up the World Government's messes, but is shocked when Sengoku overhears it from behind. On the Flower Field, Rebecca and Kyros watch the Straw Hats depart as they hold each other's bare hands for the first time in ten years. The newly formed Straw Hat Grand Fleet celebrates their formation as it is hinted that they will play a role in a pivotal event in the future.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Eles também planejam saquear Dressrosa se Riku se tornar rei novamente. Luffy inicialmente recusa o pedido de seus aliados para servir sob ele, dizer-lhes que ele não quer o controle sobre eles, porque não iria deixá-lo navegar livremente e se tornar Rei Pirata como ele queria. Luffy diz aos capitães que eles já tinham um vínculo depois que trabalharam juntos para derrotar Doflamingo, e ele viria ajudar qualquer um deles se eles viessem ligar. De repente, eles são atacados pela aliança pirata, mas Fujitora destrói a aliança deixando seus escombros em seus navios, dizendo que é um presente de despedida para Luffy. Em resposta ao raciocínio de Luffy, Cavendish, Bartolomeo, Sai, Ideo, Leo, Hajrudin e Orlumbus prometem lealdade a ele de qualquer maneira, formando uma aliança unilateral onde o ajudarão sempre que precisar. Fujitora agradece Luffy por limpar as bagunças do governo mundial, mas fica chocado quando Sengoku ouve por trás. No Campo das Flores, Rebecca e Kyros observam os Chapéus Straw partirem enquanto seguram as mãos um do outro pela primeira vez em dez anos. A recém-formada Grande Frota Straw Hat celebra sua formação, pois é sugerido que eles desempenharão um papel em um evento crucial no futuro.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

But Nami's outlook changes for the best when her tangerine trees and the Straw Hats' other lost possessions are returned to them. Franky then arrives and explains to the Straw Hats that he used the money he stolen from them to buy a highly valuable piece of bark from the indestructible Treasure Tree Adam. Franky continues to explain that he bought the fragment of Adam to create a "dream ship" and decided to give his creation to the Straw Hats for their use. But the joyful moment is short lived when a marine platoon under Vice-Admiral Garp arrives to Water 7. Two days later, Usopp and Franky make a grave for the dead Rumbar Pirates, and Zoro lays the broken Yubashiri at the grave. Nami gets a Vivre Card from Lola, which points the way to Lola's mother, a pirate in the New World. Luffy takes out the piece of paper he received from Ace, which is also a Vivre Card, and learns that as it is burning and shrinking, Ace's life is in danger. Believing that Ace can get out of trouble on his own, Luffy decides to head onward rather than go to rescue him, and the Straw Hats sail away from Thriller Bark. en.title: The Secret of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
en.synopsis:
Zoro struggles against King as Emma constantly drains his Haki. When he's thrown back inside, Zoro recalls how he learned of the battle cry, "Sunacchi" and how Momonosuke was prohibited from uttering such cry. He also recalls Hitetsu explaining that his two swords, Wado Ichimonji and Enma were both forged by the legendary swordsmith, Shimotsuki Kozuburo. Zoro then remembers how 13 years ago in his home village, a old man who was rumored to have been a samurai told the phrase "Sunacchi". The old man latter explained Zoro to that every sword had a personality and that it was a swordsman's job to tame them and that a "cursed sword" is a fine sword that was simply called as such because the weak feared it. The old man recalled the greatest sword that he forged that he dubbed "the great king of hell." Remembering all these, Zoro realizes that the aforementioned sword―the great king of hell―was none other than Enma. Outside, Momonosuke accidentally grasps Kaido's flame clouds and realizes that since he is also a dragon, he can also control and manipulate the cloud and proceeds to try and divert Onigashima's path. Inside the castle, the CP0 agents begin to overpower Drake and Apoo when Inbi and Zanki arrive. Meanwhile, Zoro remembers that he learned that the old was Kuina's grandfather after his death and that his village was founded by a pirate. It wasn't a coincidence that the village was named Shimotsuki. Hitetsu mentioned that Shimotsuki Kouzaburou, had left Wano more than fifty years ago. Zoro deduces that the old man and Kouzaburou are one and the same. He remembers Kouzaburou explaining that it is the sword that chooses its wielder. With that, Zoro understood that Enma chose him and was simply testing him. Zoro then recalls the night he and Kuina made their promise to become the world's strongest swordsman, her death and him taking her blade to keep their promise. Back to the present, as a group of Beast Pirates arrive to attack him, Zoro realizes that Enma was not draining him out of malice and admits that he was simply lacking thus unable to withstand the sword unlike Oden who had been using it with ease even though the sword took away so much of his Haki. Zoro tries to figure out how to control the flow of his Haki and keep it from being depleted and ultimately causing his death. Rather than fighting the sword's effects, he decides to let Enma take his Haki instead and "conquers" it, unleashing his Conqueror's Haki and rendering the nearby Beast Pirates unconscious. King notices and asks if he was trying to be a conquer. Remembering when he first met Luffy, Zoro answers by saying that he just remembered his promise to his captain and his best friend.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (164/189)

pt-BR.title: O Segredo de Enma! A Espada Amaldiçoada Confiada ao Zoro
pt-BR.synopsis:
Zoro luta contra King como Emma constantemente drena seu Haki. Quando ele é jogado de volta para dentro, Zoro lembra como ele soube do grito de guerra, "Sunacchi" e como Momonosuke foi proibido de proferir tal grito. Ele também se lembra de Hitetsu explicando que suas duas espadas, Wado Ichimonji e Enma foram forjadas pelo lendário ferreiro, Shimotsuki Kozuburo. Zoro então lembra como 13 anos atrás em sua aldeia natal, um velho que se dizia ter sido um samurai disse a frase "Sunacchi". O velho homem explicou Zoro que cada espada tinha uma personalidade e que era trabalho de um espadachim domá-los e que uma "espada amaldiçoada" é uma espada fina que foi simplesmente chamada como tal porque os fracos temiam. O velho lembrou a maior espada que ele forjou que ele apelidou de "o grande rei do inferno." Lembrando tudo isso, Zoro percebe que a espada acima mencionada - o grande rei do inferno - não era outro senão Enma. Lá fora, Momonosuke acidentalmente agarra as nuvens de fogo de Kaido e percebe que, como ele também é um dragão, ele também pode controlar e manipular a nuvem e continua a tentar desviar o caminho de Onigashima. Dentro do castelo, os agentes do CP0 começam a dominar Drake e Apoo quando Inbi e Zanki chegam. Enquanto isso, Zoro lembra que ele aprendeu que o velho era avô de Kuina após sua morte e que sua aldeia foi fundada por um pirata. Não foi por acaso que a aldeia se chamava Shimotsuki. Hitetsu mencionou que Shimotsuki Kouzaburou, tinha deixado Wano há mais de cinquenta anos. Zoro deduz que o velho e Kouzaburou são um e o mesmo. Ele se lembra de Kouzaburou explicando que é a espada que escolhe seu portador. Com isso, Zoro entendeu que Enma o escolheu e estava simplesmente testando-o. Zoro então lembra a noite em que ele e Kuina fizeram sua promessa de se tornar o espadachim mais forte do mundo, sua morte e ele levando sua lâmina para manter sua promessa. De volta ao presente, como um grupo de Piratas da Besta chegam para atacá-lo, Zoro percebe que Enma não estava drenando-o para fora da malícia e admite que ele estava simplesmente faltando, portanto, incapaz de suportar a espada ao contrário de Oden que tinha sido usá-lo com facilidade, mesmo que a espada tirou muito de seu Haki. Zoro tenta descobrir como controlar o fluxo de seu Haki e mantê-lo de ser esgotado e, finalmente, causando sua morte. Ao invés de lutar contra os efeitos da espada, ele decide deixar Enma tomar seu Haki em vez disso e "conquista-lo", desencadeando Haki de seu Conquistador e deixando os Piratas da Besta próximos inconscientes. King percebe e pergunta se ele estava tentando ser um conquistador. Lembrando quando ele conheceu Luffy, Zoro responde dizendo que ele se lembrou de sua promessa ao seu capitão e seu melhor amigo.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Sanji's Mutation? The Two Arms in Crisis!
en.synopsis:
Momonosuke attempts to make Flame Clouds in order to move Onigashima, but he struggles to create them as the clouds immediately disintegrate. Yamato decides to leave him and go back into the island to secure explosives; as explosives are stored on the island, if the island crashes into the Flower Capital the destruction will be amplified by the explosives. To prevent this, Yamato climbs back onto the island. Rob Lucci contacts the lead CP0 agent and the other members of CP0 on the island, who are planning their moves and inform Lucci of the second pink dragon that allied with Luffy. Lucci informs the agents that if the alliance wins the battle and Kaido falls, the World Government plans to seize the Land of Wano to make it a member state and that reinforcements are on the way. The agents then say the Beast Pirates numbers have been reduced to 12,000 while the alliance now has 8,000 members. Lucci also informs them of another target of interest: Nico Robin. Meanwhile, on the third floor, Brook and a now conscious Robin continue to evade Beast Pirates trying to capture Robin. As Momonosuke continues to struggle making flame clouds, Yamato makes it up to the island and transforms into her divine wolf beast form and runs inside. en.title: Fourth Gear! The Phenomenal Bounce-Man!
en.synopsis:
As the Birdcage closes in on Dressrosa, Marines and pirates alike assist the handicapped. Sai then orders the Corrida Colosseum gladiators who are still standing to rescue the fallen and take them out of the plateau. Meanwhile, Viola, Usopp, and Hack climb down the King's Plateau, and Viola notices that the center of the Birdcage is shifting toward Doflamingo's location, meaning even the King's Plateau will be sliced apart. At the Flower Field, Leo and Mansherry use their abilities to reattach Law's severed arm, while Cavendish tells Law that defeating Doflamingo would cause ripples all over the world, and Law replies that that is what they were after. Back at the palace, Luffy activates Gear Fourth, which causes his torso to balloon and forces him to constantly bounce, while also covering his arms legs and upper torso in Armament Haki. Doflamingo laughs at this new form, but Luffy retracts his fist into his arm and punches him, blowing him into the city far below. Luffy follows using elastic force from his legs to fly and lands more large blows on Doflamingo as the Warlord struggles to keep on even footing. However, Luffy is able to absorb Doflamingo's attacks due to his body being rubbery despite being armored and continuously stretching his arms while also changing the direction of his punches.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (98/118)

pt-BR.title: Quarta Engrenagem! O Homem-Formiga Fenomenal!
pt-BR.synopsis:
À medida que a Birdcage se aproxima de Dressrosa, fuzileiros navais e piratas ajudam os deficientes. Sai então ordena aos gladiadores do Coliseu de Corrida que ainda estão de pé para resgatar os caídos e tirá-los do planalto. Enquanto isso, Viola, Usopp e Hack descem pelo Planalto do Rei, e Viola percebe que o centro da gaiola está se movendo em direção à localização de Doflamingo, o que significa que até mesmo o Planalto do Rei será cortado. No Campo das Flores, Leo e Mansherry usam suas habilidades para recolocar o braço cortado de Law, enquanto Cavendish diz a Law que derrotar Doflamingo causaria ondulações em todo o mundo, e Law responde que era isso que eles estavam procurando. De volta ao palácio, Luffy ativa Gear Fourth, o que faz com que seu torso balongue e o obrigue a saltar constantemente, ao mesmo tempo em que cobre as pernas dos braços e o torso superior em Armament Haki. Doflamingo ri dessa nova forma, mas Luffy retrai seu punho em seu braço e o soca, soprando-o para a cidade bem abaixo. Luffy segue usando a força elástica de suas pernas para voar e aterra golpes mais grandes em Doflamingo como o senhor da guerra luta para continuar em pé de igualdade. No entanto, Luffy é capaz de absorver os ataques de Doflamingo devido ao seu corpo ser emborrachado apesar de ser blindado e continuamente esticando seus braços enquanto também muda a direção de seus socos.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

After the flashback, Luffy and Chinjao prepared for their final showdown when the latter mocks Ace's death. At the ending, Luffy delivers a punch imbued with Busoshoku Haki towards Chinjao's head, which brings back his drill-shaped head back. en.title: The Dawn of the Land of Wano: The All-Out Battle Heats Up!
en.synopsis:
The grouped Akazaya head to Momonosuke to protect him from Kanjuro. Kikunojo states that the pain from her arm was far less than the pain of when Izo left. The Akazaya decide to split up to assist various areas of the battlefield, but Kiku remains with Kin'emon to pursue Kanjuro. Cat Viper is finally informed about Pedro's sacrifice and death, now knowing that his killer, Perospero, is present on Onigashima. To avenge Pedro, Cat Viper goes to assist Wanda and Carrot in battling Perospero. Yamato decides to run off with a decoy of Momonosuke, diverting the Marys' attention from the real Momonosuke. In the crawl space, Momonosuke hears Luffy's voice and senses that Luffy is battling Kaido one-on-one. On the rooftop, they are battling fiercely but neither person could hit the other. On the castle's second floor, Sanji carries a heavily-bandaged Zoro on his back, fighting off swarms of Gifters and Pleasures while the latter heals from his injuries. On the Performance Floor, Chopper battles Queen, but Perospero intervenes by firing candy arrows at Chopper, which angers Queen as he doesn't want any help. Meanwhile, Ulti decides to avenge her defeated brother by attacking Big Mom. She brutally beats Komachiyo down to the ground, and when Tama attempts to stop her, Ulti strikes her in the face. Angry that Ulti assaulted a young girl, Nami and Big Mom both decide to turn on her and fight her directly. Nami attacks Ulti with her Clima-Tact, striking her with lightning, swearing to take her down.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Os Akazaya decidem se separar para ajudar em várias áreas do campo de batalha, mas Kiku permanece com Kin'emon para perseguir Kanjuro. Cat Viper é finalmente informado sobre o sacrifício e morte de Pedro, agora sabendo que seu assassino, Perospero, está presente em Onigashima. Para vingar Pedro, Cat Viper vai ajudar Wanda e Cenoura na luta contra Perospero. Yamato decide fugir com um chamariz de Momonosuke, desviando a atenção das Marys do verdadeiro Momonosuke. No espaço de rastreamento, Momonosuke ouve a voz de Luffy e sente que Luffy está lutando contra Kaido um a um. No telhado, eles estão lutando ferozmente, mas nenhuma pessoa poderia bater na outra. No segundo andar do castelo, Sanji carrega um Zoro fortemente preso nas costas, lutando contra enxames de Gifters e Pleasures enquanto o último cura de seus ferimentos. No Performance Floor, Chopper combate Queen, mas Perospero intervém disparando flechas de doces em Chopper, o que irrita Queen, pois ele não quer ajuda. Enquanto isso, Ulti decide vingar seu irmão derrotado atacando a Big Mom. Ela brutalmente bate Komachiyo até o chão, e quando Tama tenta detê-la, Ulti a golpeia na cara. Irritado que Ulti agrediu uma jovem, Nami e Big Mom decidem se virar contra ela e lutar contra ela diretamente. Nami ataca Ulti com seu Clima-Tact, golpeando-a com um raio, jurando derrubá-la.

en.title: A New Alliance?! Kaido's Army Gathers!
en.synopsis:
At the secret place where Kawamatsu stored weapons, Hiyori explains to Zoro that before he died, Oden gave his two swords to his children, Ame No Hebakiri to Momonosuke, and Enma to Hiyori. Zoro agrees to return Shusui in exchange for Enma, while also being allowed to visit Ryuma's gravesite. At the Flower Capital's Public Cells, Law subdues Hawkins. When Law interrogates him about the alliance he had with Kid and Appo, Hawkins reveals that Apoo was allied with Kaido all along, and when he met face-to-face with Kaido, Hawkins, knowing he wouldn't survived if he tried to fight or escape, immediately submitted to him. However, Kid refused to join Kaido, was defeated, and was sent to the Udon prisoner mine while his crew was forced to work under Orochi under threat of their captain's death. Finishing the story, Law cuts Hawkins down and walks free from the prison with help from an unknown individual. As the day of the Fire Festival draws closer, the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance continues with their preparations for the raid on Onigashima. Kin'emon explains the change in the rebellion flyer. The original snake symbol implied Habu Port in Hakumai, but with the two added strokes the snake resembles a lizard, implying Tokage Port in Udon. Apoo returns to Wano, entering via a hidden tunnel behind the waterfall and riding up a gondola. He arrives with a group of gigantic horned beings known as the Numbers. At Onigashima, Kaido and Big Mom decide to put aside their feud and form an alliance to conquer the world.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (61/189)

pt-BR.synopsis:
No lugar secreto onde Kawamatsu armazenou armas, Hiyori explica a Zoro que antes de morrer, Oden deu suas duas espadas para seus filhos, Ame No Hebakiri para Momonosuke, e Enma para Hiyori. Zoro concorda em devolver Shusui em troca de Enma, enquanto também pode visitar o túmulo de Ryuma. Nas Células Públicas da Capital das Flores, a Lei subjuga Hawkins. Quando Law o interroga sobre a aliança que tinha com Kid e Appo, Hawkins revela que Apoo era aliado de Kaido o tempo todo, e quando ele se encontrou cara a cara com Kaido, Hawkins, sabendo que ele não sobreviveria se tentasse lutar ou escapar, imediatamente se submeteu a ele. No entanto, Kid se recusou a se juntar a Kaido, foi derrotado, e foi enviado para a mina de prisioneiros Udon, enquanto sua tripulação foi forçada a trabalhar sob a ameaça da morte de seu capitão. Terminando a história, Law derruba Hawkins e sai da prisão com a ajuda de um indivíduo desconhecido. À medida que o dia do Festival de Fogo se aproxima, a Aliança Ninja-Pirata-Mink-Samurai continua com seus preparativos para o ataque a Onigashima. Kin'emon explica a mudança no panfleto de rebelião. O símbolo original da cobra implicava Habu Port em Hakumai, mas com os dois traços adicionados a cobra se assemelha a um lagarto, implicando Tokage Port em Udon. Apoo retorna a Wano, entrando através de um túnel escondido atrás da cachoeira e subindo uma gôndola. Ele chega com um grupo de gigantescos seres de chifres conhecidos como os Números. Em Onigashima, Kaido e Big Mom decidem deixar de lado sua rivalidade e formar uma aliança para conquistar o mundo.

When Sanji gives him the cold shoulder, Judge challenges his estranged son to a duel. Sanji proves to unexpectedly be a match for his father, and as they fight he recalls being abused as a child by his brothers, which Judge did nothing to stop. Meanwhile, Luffy is hunted down by the anthropomorphic flora of the Seducing Woods as he searches for his teammates alone.

When Briscola eats a dango and questions its authenticity, Speed discreetly threatens him with the idea of having him tell Queen something he allegedly made was a failure, leading Briscola to suddenly reports to having a surge in energy, encouraging the other Gifters to eat the dumplings. Hours before Tama entered Onigashima, she asked Speed to take her to the island so she could assist the raid. Speed agreed immediately to take her, along with a tamed Daifugo and Gazelleman. On the ship, Tama created several kibi dangos to tame the Gifters on Onigashima despite tiring herself out, determined to help in the fight against Kaido in any way. Back to the present, after uniting with Nami's group, Gazelleman and Daifugo forcefully feed the kibi dangos to the Gifters in the corridors while Usopp shoots a dango into Hamlet's mouth, taming him. At the Performance Floor, while protecting Chopper, Hyogoro becomes infected by a samurai when Marco's flame wears off. Franky continues to battle Sasaki gaining upper hand until the Beast Pirates restrain him and prevent him from moving. Just then, Nami, Usopp, and Tama arrive with several Gifters and they subdue the Armored Corps. Page One and Ulti, who caught up to the Straw Hats, tell Sasaki that the Gifters and Headliners have turned on them, which the siblings deduce that it's the work of a Devil Fruit. Ulti tries to attack them but Nami incapacitates her with a lightning bolt, though Nami state that she needs something even more powerful to beat Ulti. Usopp uses his sniping skills to launch dumplings into the mouths of the Armored Corp, turning them over to their side. This allows an opening for Franky to cut a confused Sasaki with Greneral Franky's sword, Franken.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Horas antes de Tama entrar em Onigashima, ela pediu a Speed para levá-la para a ilha para que ela pudesse ajudar no ataque. A velocidade concordou imediatamente em levá-la, junto com um Daifugo e Gazelleman. Na nave, Tama criou vários kibi dangos para domar os Gifters em Onigashima, apesar de se cansar, determinada a ajudar na luta contra Kaido de alguma forma. en.title: The World That Luffy Wants!
en.synopsis:
As he clashes with Luffy, Kaido's past is revealed. Being raised in Vodka Kingdom, a kingdom forced to steal from other nations to afford membership in the World Government, he entered the army and became its strongest asset at the age of ten. However, his king sold him against his will to the Marines in order to be able to attend the Reverie. Kaido attacked the Marine battleship carrying him, becoming wanted by the World Government. Becoming a wanted fugitive, he would allow himself to get captured by authorities multiple times, eat the food on the battleships, then escape with ease each time. Eventually, at age 15 he was invited by Whitebeard into the Rocks Pirates, further contributing to the crew's feared reputation. However, the Rocks Pirates faced a defeat in God Valley at the hands of Garp, killing Rocks and dismantling the crew. Kaido formed his own crew, the Beast Pirates, and 10 years after Rocks' death formed a coalition with the Kurozumi Family to occupied the Land of Wano. The Beasts Pirates sought to abolish the World Government's nobility system and create a world where prestige was determined by war. Later, he confides to King that he overheard Yamato mentioning "Joy Boy," and if he is the person King is waiting for, then he knows exactly who he is. In the present day, as the last CP0 agent flees the island, the allied forces in the Skull Dome work together to survive the flood created by Raizo. In the Treasure Repository, Denjiro commends Hiyori for enduring her suffering for so long for this moment, which brings her to tears. Meanwhile, with increased determination, Momonosuke successfully creates his own Flame Clouds, using them to move Onigashima away from the Flower Capital. In one final clash, Kaido asks Luffy what world he wanted to create. Luffy responds by claiming he would create a world where his friends could smile and eat their fill everyday. He breaks through Kaido's flame coating, then strikes him with an island-size Ryuo-infused punch to the face, sending him falling below. Luffy floats victorious as wishes of salvation from Wano's citizens rise up around him. As his unconscious body falls into an abyss, his left horn broken off, Kaido remembers a previous conversation he had with King, where he claimed that Joy Boy himself would be the one who would defeat him. Having succeeded in their tasks, Luffy and Momonosuke both collapse from exhaustion.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: O mundo que Luffy quer!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto ele se choca com Luffy, o passado de Kaido é revelado. Sendo criado no Reino Vodka, um reino forçado a roubar de outras nações para pagar a adesão ao Governo Mundial, ele entrou no exército e se tornou seu ativo mais forte aos dez anos de idade. No entanto, seu rei o vendeu contra sua vontade para os fuzileiros navais, a fim de poder participar da Reverie. Kaido atacou o navio de guerra da Marinha carregando-o, tornando-se procurado pelo Governo Mundial. Tornando-se um fugitivo procurado, ele se permitiria ser capturado pelas autoridades várias vezes, comer a comida nos navios de guerra, depois escapar com facilidade cada vez. Eventualmente, aos 15 anos, ele foi convidado por Whitebeard para os Piratas das Rochas, contribuindo ainda mais para a temida reputação da tripulação. No entanto, os Piratas das Rochas enfrentaram uma derrota em God Valley nas mãos de Garp, matando Rocks e desmantelando a tripulação. Kaido formou sua própria tripulação, os Piratas da Fera, e 10 anos após a morte de Rocks formou uma coalizão com a Família Kurozumi para ocupar a Terra de Wano. Os Piratas das Bestas procuraram abolir o sistema de nobreza do Governo Mundial e criar um mundo onde o prestígio era determinado pela guerra. Mais tarde, ele confidencia a King que ouviu Yamato mencionar "Joy Boy", e se ele é a pessoa que King está esperando, então ele sabe exatamente quem ele é. Nos dias de hoje, quando o último agente da CP0 foge da ilha, as forças aliadas na Cúpula da Caveira trabalham juntas para sobreviver ao dilúvio criado por Raizo. No Repositório do Tesouro, Denjiro elogia Hiyori por suportar seu sofrimento por tanto tempo por este momento, o que a leva às lágrimas. Enquanto isso, com maior determinação, Momonosuke cria com sucesso suas próprias nuvens de chamas, usando-as para afastar Onigashima da Capital das Flores. Em um confronto final, Kaido pergunta a Luffy que mundo ele queria criar. Luffy responde afirmando que criaria um mundo onde seus amigos pudessem sorrir e comer sua comida todos os dias. Ele rompe o revestimento de chama do Kaido e o golpeia com um soco de Ryuo no rosto, fazendo-o cair abaixo. Luffy flutua vitorioso como os desejos de salvação dos cidadãos de Wano se levantam ao seu redor. Quando seu corpo inconsciente cai em um abismo, seu chifre esquerdo se rompeu, Kaido se lembra de uma conversa anterior que teve com King, onde ele afirmou que o próprio Joy Boy seria o único que o derrotaria. Tendo conseguido em suas tarefas, Luffy e Momonosuke entram em colapso por exaustão.

en.title: He'll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!
en.synopsis:
After securing the Sunny, Tama, along with Komachijo and the baboon, who Tama names Hihimaru, takes Luffy to the house where she lives with her master, while telling Luffy her dream of becoming a "bewitching" ninja. After feeding Luffy all the rice she had as thanks, Tama walks away for a moment when her stomach starts growling. Tama's master, a swordsmith who dresses as a tengu, Tenguyama Hitetsu, arrives and attacks Luffy, telling him of how Tama can barely get by and that the rice he ate was supposed to be Tama's eighth-birthday dinner. Tama begs Hitestsu to stop, before collapsing due to drinking river water that's highly polluted due to runoff from Kaido's factories to sate her hunger. Despite the land being desolate, the two still live there waiting for the return of the pirate, Ace. Luffy reveals to them that unfortunately they waited in vain since Ace died. Refusing to believe Ace is dead, Tama accuses Luffy of lying before fainting. Hitetsu explains a year ago, X Drake, working under Kaido, ransacked their village and how the capital is the only place in Wano that is not desolate land. He also explains that four years ago, Ace, from before he joined Whitebeard's crew, wrecked on the island and helped them during a famine, having grown particularly close with Tama. Meanwhile, Basil Hawkins, now a subordinate of Kaido, goes to investigate the soldiers defeated by Luffy.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Depois de alimentar Luffy todo o arroz que ela tinha como agradecimento, Tama vai embora por um momento quando seu estômago começa a rosnar. O mestre de Tama, um ferreiro que se veste como tengu, Tenguyama Hitetsu, chega e ataca Luffy, contando-lhe como Tama mal consegue sobreviver e que o arroz que ele comeu era para ser o jantar de oitavo aniversário de Tama. Tama implora a Hitestsu para parar, antes de entrar em colapso devido a beber água do rio que é altamente poluída devido ao escoamento das fábricas de Kaido para saciar sua fome. Apesar da terra estar desolada, os dois ainda vivem lá esperando o retorno do pirata, Ace. Luffy revela a eles que infelizmente esperaram em vão desde que Ace morreu. Recusando-se a acreditar que Ace está morto, Tama acusa Luffy de mentir antes de desmaiar. Hitetsu explica há um ano, X Drake, trabalhando sob Kaido, saqueou sua aldeia e como a capital é o único lugar em Wano que não é terra desolada. en.title: The Pride of a Helmsman? The Enraged Jimbei!
en.synopsis:
As Speed carries Tama, Nami, and Usopp through Onigashima, with Gazelleman and Daifugo following close behind in order to recover Komachiyo, defending the trio along the way, Zeus asks Nami if he can become her attendant again; however, she declines, asking him to be her partner instead. Elsewhere, the present CP0 agents speculate that 2,000 soldiers switched sides due to Tama's abilities, which, after discounting 2,000 Beast Pirates due to injury, leaves the field at 16,000 vs. 9,000. However, they remark it as inconsequential to them, noting that they only need to confirm Who's-Who's death as punishment for leaving CP9. Meanwhile, Jimbei asks why Who's-Who left the World Government and became a pirate, but Who's-Who just responds that Jimbei functionally did the same thing. Who-Who's reveals his grudge against Luffy comes from the latter having the Gum-Gum Fruit and his connection with Shanks (the one who stole the fruit). The two then argue over their opinions of Luffy. In the ocean, the Heart Pirates continue trying to resuscitate Luffy. Thinking back to his past with Luffy, Jimbei swears to fight as the helmsman of the Straw Hat Pirates. As they continue to fight, Who's-Who tells Jimbei that while he was imprisoned, he told about the "Sun God" Nika, a legendary warrior of ancient times who would supposedly free slaves. Jimbei asks how this information is relevant to him, and Who's-Who brings up the past slavery of Sun Pirates members and Fish-Men as a whole, asking Jimbei for more information about Nika while mentioning the guard who mockingly told him about Nika was eventually executed, and asks if it's dangerous to even know of his existence. He begins once again bombarding Jimbei with attacks, asking if he knows a lot about slavery due to being a Fish-Man. However, Jimbei just catches Who's-Who's arms, stating that he has nothing to tell him. Jimbei breaks Who's-Who's fingers and steps on his tail, and tells him that if he wants to investigate history then he needs to be prepared for what he'll find as he defeats Who's-Who with Fish-Man Karate Secret Art: Demon Brick Fist.

(Source: Wikipedia)
