Em outros lugares, os atuais agentes da CP0 especulam que 2.000 soldados trocaram de lado devido às habilidades de Tama, que, depois de descontar 2.000 Piratas da Besta devido a lesão, deixa o campo em 16 mil vs. 9.000. No entanto, eles observam isso como inconsequente para eles, observando que eles só precisam confirmar a morte de Quem é Quem como punição por deixar a CP9. Enquanto isso, Jimbei pergunta por que quem deixou o governo mundial e se tornou um pirata, mas quem responde que Jimbei funcionalmente fez a mesma coisa. Quem revela seu rancor contra Luffy vem deste último ter a Gum-Gum Fruit e sua conexão com Shanks (aquele que roubou a fruta). Os dois então discutem sobre suas opiniões sobre Luffy. No oceano, os Piratas do Coração continuam tentando ressuscitar Luffy. Pensando em seu passado com Luffy, Jimbei jura lutar como o timoneiro dos Piratas Straw Hat. Enquanto eles continuam a lutar, quem-que-diz Jimbei que enquanto ele estava preso, ele falou sobre o "Deus Sol" Nika, um lendário guerreiro dos tempos antigos que supostamente libertaria escravos. Jimbei pergunta como essa informação é relevante para ele, e quem é quem traz a escravidão passada dos membros dos Piratas do Sol e dos Homens-Peixe como um todo, pedindo Jimbei para mais informações sobre Nika ao mencionar o guarda que zombeteiramente lhe contou sobre Nika acabou sendo executado, e pergunta se é perigoso mesmo saber de sua existência. Ele começa mais uma vez bombardeando Jimbei com ataques, perguntando se ele sabe muito sobre escravidão devido a ser um Homem-Peixe. No entanto, Jimbei só pega os braços de quem, afirmando que ele não tem nada para lhe dizer. Jimbei quebra os dedos e os passos de quem na cauda, e diz a ele que se ele quer investigar a história, então ele precisa estar preparado para o que ele vai encontrar como ele derrota quem é quem com Fish-Man Karate Secret Art: Punho de tijolo demoníaco.

Oden's adventure with the Roger Pirates led him back to his homeland of the Land of Wano, since there was a Road Poneglyph there. However, Toki falls ill from the fatigue from several years of adventure, so Oden was forced to leave her and the children in Wano, with Cat Viper and Dogstorm also deciding to stay behind. Oden was also willing to stay, but Toki insisted that Oden finish his journey with the Roger Pirates, threatening to divorce him if he doesn't. After having a brief reunion with his retainers and introducing his family to them, Oden once again leaves the Land of Wano while quickly taking a copy of the Road Poneglyph. The Roger Pirates travel to Zou to get a copy of the final Road Ponegylph needed in order to arrive at the final island. Before departing, Buggy becomes extremely ill and stays behind with Shanks taking care of him, who vows that he and Buggy will reach the final island on their own ship. When faced with the treasure on the last island, the Roger Pirates simply laugh while Roger expresses interest in the humorous tale of Joyboy. Roger then becomes the King of the Pirates as he dubs the final island "Laugh Tale".

Oden também estava disposto a ficar, mas Toki insistiu que Oden terminasse sua jornada com os Roger Pirates, ameaçando se divorciar dele se não o fizesse. Depois de ter uma breve reunião com seus retentores e apresentar sua família a eles, Oden mais uma vez deixa a Terra de Wano enquanto rapidamente pega uma cópia do Poneglyph Road. Os Piratas Roger viajam para Zou para obter uma cópia do Ponegylph estrada final necessária para chegar à ilha final. Quando confrontados com o tesouro na última ilha, os Roger Pirates simplesmente riem, enquanto Roger expressa interesse no conto humorístico de Joyboy. A Família Charlotte e os Piratas da Big Mom têm uma reunião e discutem o status dos intrusos. Acreditando que os intrusos foram tratados, a reunião foi adiada. Law uses his powers to swap places with Zoro and strike at Kaido, but knocked back. This allows Prometheus and Napoleon to escape, while Zeus is still trapped in the box. Prometheus and Napoleon dive into the sea, rescue Big Mom and carry her back to Onigashima. Kid and Killer break off from the group to deal with Big Mom. On the way back to the floating island, Big Mom thanks Prometheus and Napoleon for rescuing her, but gets angry at Zeus for not coming to her aid. Prometheus, no longer wanting to share his power with Zeus, suggests that Big Mom abandons him and creates a new homie to be his girlfriend, which she agrees to. While they rise to the island, the Heart Pirates watch her from the Polar Tang, angry that she survived. Kaido prepares to finish off an unconscious Luffy, but Zoro prepares to use the last of his strength to take him down. Zoro, using Nine Sword Style, slashes Kaido's chest leaving a grievous wound. Seeing his wound, Kaido questions Zoro if he has Conqueror's Haki. Zoro doesn't know what he is talking about as he falls down, saying that he had hoped that attack would have brought Kaido down to the ground. Kaido, however, tells Zoro that his attack will definitely leave a scar. Kaido then retaliates and when Law tries to aid Zoro, he, too, is struck down. Kaido considers it a pity that they didn't decide to work for him, but Luffy, having regain consciousness, stands firm on their choice to ally with the samurai, and once again swears to defeat Kaido.

No caminho de volta para a ilha flutuante, Big Mom agradece Prometheus e Napoleão por resgatá-la, mas fica com raiva de Zeus por não vir em seu auxílio. Prometheus, não querendo mais compartilhar seu poder com Zeus, sugere que Big Mom o abandona e cria um novo homie para ser sua namorada, o que ela concorda. Zoro, usando Nine Sword Style, corta o peito de Kaido deixando uma ferida grave. Vendo sua ferida, Kaido questiona Zoro se ele tem Haki do Conquistador. Zoro não sabe do que está falando quando cai, dizendo que esperava que o ataque tivesse derrubado Kaido. Kaido, no entanto, diz a Zoro que seu ataque definitivamente deixará uma cicatriz. Kaido então retalia e quando Law tenta ajudar Zoro, ele também é derrubado. Kaido considera uma pena que eles não decidiram trabalhar para ele, mas Luffy, tendo recuperado a consciência, permanece firme em sua escolha de se aliar com os samurais, e mais uma vez jura derrotar Kaido.

en.title: Boiled to Death! Oden's One-hour Struggle!
en.synopsis:
Although Orochi initially scoffs at Oden's suggestion, Kaidou accepts the challenge, agreeing to release the retainers if they survive one hour in the pot. As Oden enters the pot, already being singed by the boiling oil, his retainers run on the plank to also enter, but Oden lifts the plank up, allowing his retainers to sit safe from the boiling oil, despite their protests. Kaidou allows him to do this, since they're technically in the pot. The crowd watching the execution criticize Oden, but Shinobu stands up for him and reals the truth of Oden's burden. When he was confronted by Oden five years earlier, Orochi confessed that he only wanted to become the shogun so he could make the citizens of Wano suffer as vengeance for his family's unjust persecution at their hands. Shinobu reveals more, as she was hiding in the ceiling when it happened, Orochi had kidnapped hundreds of citizens meant as tributes to Kaido. At that point, Orochi offered Oden a bargain; Orochi would cease the kidnappings and he and Kaido would leave the Land of Wano after five years. In exchange, Oden had to dance naked in the Flower Capital every week while being humiliated by Orochi, saving 100 people from being kidnapped with each dance. Oden decided he had no choice as he couldn't face Kaido without causing a war that would result in mass casualties. The citizens are shocked by the sacrifices Oden made for them.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Kaidou permite que ele faça isso, já que eles estão tecnicamente na panela. A multidão que assiste a execução critica Oden, mas Shinobu o defende e percebe a verdade do fardo de Oden. Quando ele foi confrontado por Oden cinco anos antes, Orochi confessou que só queria se tornar o shogun para que ele pudesse fazer os cidadãos de Wano sofrerem como vingança pela perseguição injusta de sua família em suas mãos. Shinobu revela mais, como ela estava escondida no teto quando aconteceu, Orochi tinha sequestrado centenas de cidadãos que significava como tributos a Kaido. Nesse ponto, Orochi ofereceu a Oden uma barganha, Orochi cessaria os sequestros e ele e Kaido deixariam a Terra de Wano depois de cinco anos. Em troca, Oden tinha que dançar nu na Capital das Flores toda semana enquanto era humilhado por Orochi, salvando 100 pessoas de serem sequestradas com cada dança. Oden decidiu que não tinha escolha, pois não podia enfrentar Kaido sem causar uma guerra que resultaria em baixas em massa. Os cidadãos estão chocados com os sacrifícios que Oden fez para eles.

But at the last second, an explosive projectile hits the back of Spandam's head. A stream of projectiles falls on the marines gathered around him. en.title: A Giant Ambition! Big Mom and Caesar!
en.synopsis:
Brook and Pedro infiltrate Sweet City, and discover in the newspaper that Jimbei has withdrawn his request to leave the Big Mom Pirates. They then encounter Pudding being forced to try on wedding dresses, as well as Tamago, who reveals that the Big Mom Pirates know everything about the Sanji Retrieval Team's locations, with the exception of Brook and Pedro's. Meanwhile, on the northwestern coast of Whole Cake Island, Capone Bege stands with his wife, Big Mom's twenty-second daughter, Charlotte Chiffon (the woman Sanji saw before), their son Capone Pez and his crew as he prepares to shoot the captured Pekoms for not complying with his wishes. He then shoots Pekoms into shark-infested waters. In the Whole Cake Chateau, Big Mom meets with Caesar Clown, as she seeks to learn the result of the gigantification research she hired him to perform. Caesar, knowing that it was impossible and having blown Big Mom's funds on hedonism, lies that Luffy and Law stalled his research when they destroyed his lab. However, Big Mom reveals that she had her eldest son Charlotte Perospero make an identical lab out of candy with his Lick-Lick Fruit powers, and gives Caesar two weeks to complete the research, threatening to have Perospero turn him into candy otherwise. In the Seducing Woods, Luffy discovers duplicates of Sanji and Pudding that act like animals. He catches them and throws them in a pile, but to his great confusion finds more and more duplicates of his crewmates.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Enquanto isso, na costa noroeste de Whole Cake Island, Capone Bege está com sua esposa, a vigésima segunda filha da Big Mom, Charlotte Chiffon (a mulher que Sanji viu antes), seu filho Capone Pez e sua tripulação enquanto ele se prepara para atirar nos Pekoms capturados por não cumprirem seus desejos. Ele então atira Pekoms em águas infestadas de tubarões. No Château Whole Cake, Big Mom se encontra com Caesar Clown, enquanto ela procura aprender o resultado da pesquisa de gigantificação que ela o contratou para realizar. César, sabendo que era impossível e tendo explodido os fundos da Big Mom no hedonismo, mente que Luffy e Law pararam sua pesquisa quando destruíram seu laboratório. No entanto, Big Mom revela que ela fez seu filho mais velho Charlotte Perospero fazer um laboratório idêntico de doces com seus poderes Lick-Lick Fruit, e dá Caesar duas semanas para completar a pesquisa, ameaçando que Perospero transformá-lo em doces de outra forma. en.synopsis:
Luffy's declaration angers Kaido. Meanwhile, Big Mom takes out a fragment of her soul and gives it to the thundercloud above, creating a new homie to replace Zeus. As her first technique, this new homie fires a powerful lightning bolt at Kid and Killer, hitting them at near point-blank range and shaking the entire island. Meanwhile, Nami, Tama, and Usopp attempt to return to the Performance Floor on Komachiyo while Page One chases them. Page One transforms into his Human-Beast Form and leaps onto Komachiyo's back, but Komachiyo begins to speed up, running into a wall at full speed and ramming Page One into it. Kid and Killer emerge from the rubble somewhere inside the castle. Big Mom is on the floor directly below them, still in pursuit of Kid. Suddenly, they are attacked by Hawkins, and Kid becomes enraged that Hawkins abandoned Kid in favor of Kaido. Killer convinces Kid to advance towards Big Mom while he stays behind to battles Hawkins, who transforms into a scarecrow-like figure. Back on the roof, Luffy admits all the attacks he used on Kaido were shallow, but after being struck with his kanabou, Luffy realized the truth behind Kaido's strength: Kaido can infuse objects with Conqueror's Haki. Kaido laughs in confirmation as he charges at Luffy, revealing that only a select few powerful individuals can pull it off as he brings his club down on Luffy. Remembering Hyogoro's lessons and the defeats he'd experienced in the past, Luffy infuses Conqueror's Haki into his limbs and blocks the attack with his foot without even touching it. With this, Luffy strikes Kaido's stomach without touching him, then unleashes a powerful uppercut knocking Kaido over. As Law is left in disbelief that Luffy did damage without actually touching Kaido, Luffy thanks both him and Zoro for covering him, but tells them to go back downstairs, declaring that he can handle the rest and he will beat Kaido no matter what.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Como sua primeira técnica, este novo homie dispara um poderoso raio em Kid and Killer, atingindo-os perto do ponto e sacudindo toda a ilha. Enquanto isso, Nami, Tama e Usopp tentam retornar ao Piso de Performance em Komachiyo enquanto a Página Um os persegue. A primeira página se transforma em sua forma de besta humana e salta para as costas de Komachiyo, mas Komachiyo começa a acelerar, correndo contra uma parede a toda velocidade e atirando a primeira página nela. Kid e Killer emergem dos escombros em algum lugar dentro do castelo. A Big Mom está no chão logo abaixo deles, ainda perseguindo Kid. De repente, eles são atacados por Hawkins, e Kid fica furioso que Hawkins abandonou Kid em favor de Kaido. Killer convence Kid a avançar em direção a Big Mom enquanto ele fica para trás para lutar contra Hawkins, que se transforma em uma figura de espantalho. De volta ao telhado, Luffy admite que todos os ataques que ele usou em Kaido eram superficiais, mas depois de ser atingido com seu kanabou, Luffy percebeu a verdade por trás da força de Kaido: Kaido pode infundir objetos com Haki do Conquistador. Kaido ri na confirmação como ele cobra em Luffy, revelando que apenas um seleto poucos indivíduos poderosos pode fazê-lo fora como ele traz seu clube para baixo em Luffy. Lembrando as lições de Hyogoro e as derrotas que ele tinha experimentado no passado, Luffy infunde Haki do Conquistador em seus membros e bloqueia o ataque com o pé sem sequer tocá-lo. Com isso, Luffy atinge o estômago de Kaido sem tocá-lo, e então desencadeia um poderoso golpe superior derrubando Kaido. Como Law é deixado em descrença que Luffy causou danos sem realmente tocar Kaido, Luffy agradece a ele e Zoro por cobri-lo, mas diz-lhes para voltar lá embaixo, declarando que ele pode lidar com o resto e ele vai vencer Kaido não importa o que aconteça.

en.title: Chopper Is Furious!! Hogback's Evil Medical Practices
en.synopsis:
Chopper and Robin are outmatched by Jigoro and Inuppe, whose personalities lost most semblance to Zoro and Sanji. Chopper tells Hogback that he had once respected him, but does not anymore after realizing the true nature of Hogbacks experiments. But Hogback, revealing that his research was only for his benefit, insists his zombies are alive as he used Cindry as an example by kicking her to the floor to lick it. Then explaining the room Chopper, Usopp, and Nami found was his, Hogback then tells his story of how he met Cindry and fell in love with the performer. But both the revelation of Cindry having a fiancé and her accidental death on stage made negative impacts on Hogback as he is approached by Moria. Hogback agreed to join his cause on the condition that he can revive her a zombie. Hogback admits that the zombified Cindry lack her original personality, but he only desired her beauty and assumes she is happy to be alive. This infuriates Chopper as he refuses to allow Hogback to continue making everyone suffer, the scientist ordering Cindry to kill the intruders so he can use their corpses in his experiments. Though Cindry is revealed to have modified superhuman strength, she is nearly exposed to salt after Chopper yells that real humans have freedom. When Hogback orders Jigoro and Inuppe to kill everyone to protect Cindry, the two zombies ended up fighting each other before Robin tricks Hogback into ordering the two to jump out the tower. With Chopper intending to beat Hogback to a bloody pulp, the scientist orders Cindry to buy time for him to escape. But everyone is surprised to see a tearful Cindry as she revealed she could not move. Elsewhere, Oars finally returns to Moria's side.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Thriller Bark saga: Thriller Bark arc: (27/45)

pt-BR.title: Chopper é Furioso! Práticas médicas malignas de Hogback
pt-BR.synopsis:
Chopper e Robin são superados por Jigoro e Inuppe, cujas personalidades perderam mais semelhança com Zoro e Sanji. Chopper diz a Hogback que ele já o respeitou, mas não mais depois de perceber a verdadeira natureza dos experimentos de Hogbacks. Mas Hogback, revelando que sua pesquisa foi apenas para seu benefício, insiste que seus zumbis estão vivos enquanto ele usava Cindry como exemplo, chutando-a para o chão para lambê-la. Então explicando o quarto Chopper, Usopp, e Nami encontrado era dele, Hogback então conta sua história de como ele conheceu Cindry e se apaixonou pelo artista. Mas tanto a revelação de Cindry ter um noivo quanto sua morte acidental no palco causaram impactos negativos em Hogback quando ele foi abordado por Moria. Hogback concordou em se juntar a sua causa com a condição de que ele possa revivê-la um zumbi. Hogback admite que o Cindry zombificado não tem sua personalidade original, mas ele só desejava sua beleza e assume que ela está feliz por estar viva. Isso enfurece Chopper como ele se recusa a permitir Hogback para continuar fazendo todos sofrerem, o cientista ordenando Cindry para matar os intrusos para que ele possa usar seus cadáveres em seus experimentos. Embora Cindry tenha modificado a força sobre-humana, ela está quase exposta ao sal depois que Chopper grita que humanos reais têm liberdade. Quando Hogback ordena que Jigoro e Inuppe matem todos para proteger Cindry, os dois zumbis acabaram lutando um contra o outro antes que Robin enganasse Hogback para ordenar que os dois saltassem para fora da torre. Com Chopper com a intenção de derrotar Hogback, o cientista ordena que Cindry ganhe tempo para ele escapar. Mas todos estão surpresos ao ver um Cindry choroso como ela revelou que não podia se mover. Em outro lugar, Oars finalmente retorna ao lado de Moria.

Chopper reveals that not only has Luffy been poisoned, but thanks to the captain's battle with Magellan, he has built up an immunity to it. Meanwhile, Camie asks Madame Shirley, a fortune teller and proprietor of the restaurant, about Sanji and has Luffy and Usopp enter her room. It is revealed that Sharley has predicted the Great Pirate Era and the past wars, including the death of Whitebeard. Later, the Straw Hats reunite with Brook and Pappagu. It is also revealed that Vander Decken had sent a letter once a week to the Princess. As a result, Neptune and his sons formed an army and have been finding Vander Decken for years. When Luffy asks about the candy factory nearby, he learns that the island is under the protection of Big Mom since Whitebeard's death. Meanwhile, Sharley is dismayed about her prediction that the island will be eventually destroyed by Luffy.

en.synopsis:

At the Hidden Harbor, Usopp learned from the dwarves that Thunder Soldier left the group in order to assassinate Doflamingo at his palace, leaving Usopp in command of the army much to his disbelief. Though they were nearly caught by some soldiers the dwarves easily subdued them and their clothes were given to Usopp and Robin for disguise. Near the Harbor elevator, many soldiers were rushing towards the elevator to see the battle between Franky and Senor Pink, unaware that Thunder Soldier and a few dwarves were hiding inside a crate in the lift. Seeing no other way, Thunder Soldier assaults the soldiers in order to hijack the lift. During battle, he recalls his training of Rebecca to teach her battle instinct. He then declares his goal to restore Dressrosa to King Riku's rule. At the Colosseum, an unexplained event caused every fighter in the arena to fall unconscious one after another. en.title: I Won't Kick Even If It Costs Me My Life! Sanji's Chivalry!
en.synopsis:
Finding themselves handcuffed after Kaku's man beast enhanced Tempest Kick damaged the Tower of Law, Zoro and Usopp learn that each of the keys are numbered. But as neither Kaku nor Jabura have the key needed to free their prey from their seastone handcuffs, the two CP9 members are forced to resume the fight. Chopper arrives at that time and is sent off to obtain the Number 2 key from one of the other assassins. Chopper comes across Nami as she attempted to flee Kumadori after stealing the Number 3 key, knocking the CP9 operative out. Soon after, Nami and Chopper find a round and glossy Sanji hitting the ground from a few floors up. After Nami realizes his opponent was Kalifa, Sanji admits to have done his best in trying to get her key but could not bring himself to harm a woman. Despite scolding him for being too easy, Nami decides to take over and fight Kalifa while leaving Sanji in Chopper's care.

pt-BR.title: Eu não vou chutar mesmo que isso me custe a vida! Chivalry de Sanji!

Encontrando-se algemados depois que a besta de Kaku melhorou o Tempest Kick danificou a Torre da Lei, Zoro e Usopp descobrem que cada uma das chaves estão numeradas. Mas como nem Kaku nem Jabura têm a chave necessária para libertar suas presas de suas algemas, os dois membros do CP9 são forçados a retomar a luta. Chopper chega naquele momento e é enviado para obter a chave número 2 de um dos outros assassinos. Chopper se depara com Nami quando ela tentou fugir de Kumadori depois de roubar a chave número 3, nocauteando o agente da CP9. They enter the party hall and find a raucous party being thrown. Although the Akazaya samurai are concerned, Law reassures them that it was part of the plan, as Luffy and Kid were meant to be the first decoys at the front gate. Kanjuro leads Momonosuke down a secret passageway to Orochi, but becomes lost in its maze-like tunnels while dealing with guards as they're unaware of Kanjuro being a spy, as Momonosuke sees a viable knife on the floor. As Luffy and Zoro enter the Performance Floor, the rest of the Straw Hats splits into three groups to go up the mountain pass; Franky and Brook riding the Black Rhino FR-U IV, Usopp, Nami, Chopper, Carrot and Shinobu go in Brachio Tank V, with Sanji riding on top as Robin and Jimbei decide to go by foot, the latter two unaware they're being watch by a masked figure. Ulti throws another temper tantrum in front of the Tobi Roppo before they are finally summoned by Kaido. Meanwhile, Zoro attempts to blend in with the Beast Pirates but ends up enraged when one of the partygoers mocks the impoverished people of Wano who could not afford to drink as lavishly as them. Meanwhile, Luffy also sees Beast Pirates gorging themselves on food from the Paradis Farm and mocking the people of Okobore Town while, wastefully dumping oshiruko on the floor, angering him, as he remembers when he fed Tama oshiruko, who accepted it gratefully.

She and Kaido mention the purpose of their alliance is to acquire the One Piece and Ancient Weapons to bring fear and war. He also announces a new plan: he would take full control of the country and enslave all citizens, including those in the Flower Capital. Orochi objects, arguing that the capital is the pride of the Kurozumi Family. Kaido promptly takes out his sword and decapitates him. Upon seeing Momonosuke on the cross through a crack in the ceiling, Luffy and Yamato fall through the ceiling into the party below. They go to rescue Momonosuke.. Meanwhile, Kikunojo and Kanjuro continue their battle with Kanjuro using their past against her, saying it was all an act. Accepting that the Kanjuro she knew will never return, Okiku defeats him. Kin'emon and Denjiro have reached the back of the castle and join the group, who is still hurt from Kanjuro's betrayal. Still, they decide to move forward and continue their advance. Meanwhile, Kaido gives Orochi's subordinates an ultimatum: join him or die. He also mentions turning Wano into a pirate empire for the war, relocating Onigashima to the Flower Capital and making Yamato the new shogun of New Onigashima. Ela e Kaido mencionam que o propósito de sua aliança é adquirir o One Piece e Armas Antigas para trazer medo e guerra. Ele também anuncia um novo plano: ele assumiria o controle total do país e escravizaria todos os cidadãos, incluindo os da Capital das Flores. Orochi objetos, argumentando que a capital é o orgulho da família Kurozumi. Kaido prontamente tira sua espada e o decapita. en.title: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!
en.synopsis:
King intercepts Chopper's group which is carrying Zoro. Sanji sees this and tries to defend against King but is shot by Queen's laser. Marco manages to block King's attack and the two square off. Marco talks of a race that could ignite themselves and once lived on top of the Red Line and says that he didn't expect to meet one in King. King and Queen are prepared to fight Marco, but he surrenders seeing that Zoro has recovered from his injuries, thanks to the drug given to him by Miyagi. Zoro deflects Queen's attack. He and Sanji then proceed to attack the two Lead Performers. Zoro and Sanji then both say that winning this battle will give them a glimpse of Luffy becoming the King of the Pirates Hyogoro advises the other samurai not to interfere in the fight as Kawamatsu arrives at the Performance Floor. Marco spaces out as he watches the fight. He recalls his conversation with Whitebeard about how Mary Geoise used to be the Land of Gods. He is then saved by Izo when some Beast Pirates shoot at Marco while he is in a daze. During their fight, Sanji notices something different in his body from when he put on his Raid Suit a while back. Queen notices this, too, and (despite Sanji's refutes) claims that Sanji must also be a cyborg like Judge's other children since no human can ignite themselves as he's not a Lunarian. Zoro attempts to attack King but he blocks it with a sword that has several notches in it, in which Zoro's swords are caught, allowing King to simply toss them away and leaving Zoro open to be punched by a retractable-spiked glove. Zoro uses the sword in his mouth to block it as he calls King a bloodthirsty brute. King retorts that he never understood why anyone would stick to traditional forms and techniques in a real battle, which Zoro accepts, admitting King never claimed to be a swordsman himself. Nevertheless, Zoro reclaims his swords and tells King he can't afford to lose to him. As the four continue to battle, Hyougoro and Kawamatsu notice Zoro's similarities with the former Daimyo of Ringo, Shimotsuki Ushimaru, who was a descendant of the God of the Blade, Shimotsuki Ryuma―from the way he stands, his one eye, down to his swordplay. They feel that the fact that he returned Shusui to Wano was fate. Meanwhile in Tokage Port, Luffy regains his strength and looks for Momonosuke. Shinobu responds to Luffy as two giant eyes appear behind the shadows.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Aproveitando! Os dois braços entram em batalha!
pt-BR.synopsis:
King intercepta o grupo de Chopper que está carregando Zoro. Sanji vê isso e tenta se defender contra King, mas é baleado pelo laser da Rainha. Marco consegue bloquear o ataque de King e os dois se afastam. Marco fala de uma raça que poderia se inflamar e uma vez viveu no topo da Linha Vermelha e diz que ele não esperava encontrar uma em King. King e Queen estão preparados para lutar contra Marco, mas ele se rende vendo que Zoro se recuperou de seus ferimentos, graças à droga dada a ele por Miyagi. Zoro desvia o ataque da Rainha. Ele e Sanji então atacam os dois Lead Performers. Zoro e Sanji então ambos dizem que vencer esta batalha lhes dará um vislumbre de Luffy se tornando o Rei dos Piratas Hyogoro aconselha o outro samurai a não interferir na luta quando Kawamatsu chegar ao Piso de Performance. Marco se afasta enquanto assiste a luta. Ele lembra sua conversa com Whitebeard sobre como Mary Geoise costumava ser a Terra dos Deuses. Ele então é salvo por Izo quando alguns Piratas da Besta atiram em Marco enquanto ele está deslumbrado. Durante a luta, Sanji percebe algo diferente em seu corpo de quando ele vestiu seu traje há um tempo. Queen também percebe isso, e (apesar das refutações de Sanji) afirma que Sanji também deve ser um ciborgue como os outros filhos de Judge, já que nenhum ser humano pode se inflamar como ele não é um Lunariano. Zoro tenta atacar King, mas ele o bloqueia com uma espada que tem vários entalhes, em que as espadas de Zoro são capturadas, permitindo que King simplesmente os jogue longe e deixando Zoro aberto para ser perfurado por uma luva retrátil. Zoro usa a espada em sua boca para bloqueá-la como ele chama Rei um bruto sanguinário. Rei retruca que ele nunca entendeu por que alguém se ateria às formas e técnicas tradicionais em uma batalha real, que Zoro aceita, admitindo que King nunca afirmou ser um espadachim. No entanto, Zoro recupera suas espadas e diz a King que ele não pode perder para ele. Enquanto os quatro continuam a batalha, Hyougoro e Kawamatsu notam as semelhanças de Zoro com o antigo Daimyo de Ringo, Shimotsuki Ushimaru, que era um descendente do Deus da Lâmina, Shimotsuki Ryuma - do jeito que ele está, seu único olho, até seu jogo de espadas. Eles sentem que o fato de ele ter devolvido Shusui a Wano foi o destino. Enquanto isso, em Tokage Port, Luffy recupera sua força e procura Momonosuke. Shinobu responde ao Luffy quando dois olhos gigantes aparecem atrás das sombras.

en.title: Explore! Fairies' Island - Green Bit!
en.synopsis:
Upon their arrival to Green Bit, the group discovers a Marine ship that crashed and believed that the Marines had landed on the island. With fourteen minutes left before the exchange, Robin and Usopp begin to scout the island as Law takes Caesar to the meeting point. As they explore, Robin and Usopp discover a squad of Marines who are getting attacked by the forest's inhabitants, losing all of their belongings. As soon as the Marines fled, Robin uses her Devil Fruit power to capture the fast and seemingly invisible thieves. Usopp asks her what she has caught, and she tells him that she believes they are dwarves. Meanwhile at Acacia, Zoro has captured his sword thief, a dwarf named Wicca, who berated herself for being caught and when Zoro calls her a thief she defends herself by explaining that the dwarves take items as presents for nurturing Dressrosa's greenery, though Zoro points out that it's still stealing. Because the fall sprained her ankle, she begged Zoro to take her to the flower field to deliver a report that the Donquixote family is planning to attack the Straw Hats ship. Zoro has no choice but to take her with him due to his horrible sense of direction. With Violet revealing her true self, Sanji was seen beaten and bloodied before Violet who was actually an assassin sent to interrogate him about Law's plan. Her Glare-Glare Fruit power allows her to look into Sanji's mind for the truth, only to recoil from seeing Sanji's perverted mind. Sanji, who was barely conscious, told her that he never doubted her tears, leaving her genuinely shocked, brought to tears by his honesty.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Explore! Ilha das Fadas - Green Bit!

Ao chegarem a Green Bit, o grupo descobre um navio da Marinha que caiu e acreditava que os Fuzileiros Navais haviam desembarcado na ilha. Faltando 14 minutos para a troca, Robin e Usopp começam a explorar a ilha enquanto Law leva César ao ponto de encontro. Enquanto exploram, Robin e Usopp descobrem um esquadrão de fuzileiros que estão sendo atacados pelos habitantes da floresta, perdendo todos os seus pertences. Assim que os Fuzileiros Navais fugiram, Robin usa seu poder de Fruta do Diabo para capturar os ladrões rápidos e aparentemente invisíveis. Usopp pergunta o que ela pegou, e ela diz que acredita que são anões. Enquanto isso, em Acacia, Zoro capturou seu ladrão de espadas, um anão chamado Wicca, que se repreendeu por ser pego e quando Zoro a chama de ladrão, ela se defende explicando que os anões tomam itens como presentes para nutrir a vegetação de Dressrosa, embora Zoro aponte que ainda está roubando. Porque a queda torceu o tornozelo, ela implorou Zoro para levá-la ao campo de flores para entregar um relatório que a família Donquixote está planejando atacar a nave Straw Hats. Zoro não tem escolha a não ser levá-la com ele devido ao seu horrível senso de direção. Com Violet revelando seu verdadeiro eu, Sanji foi vista espancada e ensanguentada antes de Violet, que era na verdade uma assassina enviada para interrogá-lo sobre o plano de Law. O poder da Fruta Glare-Glare permite que ela olhe na mente de Sanji para a verdade, apenas para se afastar de ver a mente pervertida de Sanji. Sanji, que mal estava consciente, disse a ela que ele nunca duvidou de suas lágrimas, deixando-a genuinamente chocada, levada às lágrimas por sua honestidade.

While the others were intending to hold off Oars until Luffy takes out Gecko Moria, Zoro intends to fight the giant to test his new sword Shuusui. Meanwhile, after Nami gained interrogated intel that Perona is taking the Thousand Sunny, she arrive to confront the girl as the mysterious figure makes his presence known. Perona recognizes the figure as Bartholomew Kuma of the Seven Warlords of the Sea, Kuma requesting for Moria before he is forced to make Perona disappear with his ungloved hand due to her defiance. Displaying his unnatural speed to Nami while asking of Luffy's ties to Ace, Kuma takes his leave while telling her of his "choice to be here". Elsewhere, realizing he caught Doppelman, Luffy finds out that he has been chasing after Moria's shadow the entire time.

In the attic, as Nami and Shinobu prepare to help they're intercepted by the ninja, Hanzo, but when he comments on how she lost her beauty from her youth, Shinobu incapacitates him with her signature move, a blow to the groin. Shinobu then rots the attic's floor causing debris to fall on Orochi, causing him release his grip on Komurasaki. During the commotion, Kyoshiro faces the oiran and cuts her down before finding one of Kin'emon's encrypted messages. Orochi then pursues Robin and Toko, intending to kill the little girl. Nami manages to stop Orochi with Zeus' help. Afterwards, the group at the castle escapes with Shinobu. In Udon prison, Kid has escaped. Durante a comoção, Kyoshiro enfrenta o oiran e a corta antes de encontrar uma das mensagens criptografadas de Kin'emon. Orochi então persegue Robin e Toko, com a intenção de matar a garotinha. As Momonosuke continues to react to the mysterious voice, Shinobu begins to panic, allowing Kin'emon and Kikunojo to find them. Meanwhile, on the Performance Floor, Chopper continues to protect everyone from Perospero's arrows. As he does so, he thinks back to a conversation he had with Caesar Clown, where the scientist offered to improve the duration of Chopper's Rumble Ball from three minutes to thirty. Chopper was initially oppose to it, due the side effects that would come with it, but agreed when Caesar pointed out that he'll be facing stronger foes. Back in the present, with less ten minutes left in transformation Chopper charges at back into battle, but is overpowered by Queen. Suddenly, Bao Huang announces the end of the duel between Luffy and Kaido, declaring Kaido as the winner. Across the island, various allies and enemies react to the news, and Bao Huang announces that Kaido will re-enter the castle and begin cleaning up the remaining pirates and samurais. She offers the attackers the option to surrender and join the Beast Pirates, though nobody accepts. Meanwhile, Kanjuro arrives to Momonosuke's hiding spot As he enters disguised as Oden, both Momonosuke and Shinobu fall for his deception, but Kin'emon and Kikunojo see through it, holding the other two back. Kikunojo prepares to fight to avenge Ashura, but she is stopped by her memories of Oden which Kanjuro takes advantage of and stabs her, making her fall to the ground. With Kikunojo out of the fight, Kin'emon and Kanjuro prepare to duel. Kanjuro creates a stage for the fight, and Kin'emon angrily charges at him, cutting the actor down. The two think back on their time together, and Kanjuro declares that he needed to lose Kin'emon, his best friend on the stage, before falling to the ground, defeated. With the fight over, Kin'emon returns to Momonosuke and Shinobu, but Kaido suddenly appears before them, smashing through the ceiling. Kin'emon prepares to fight the Emperor as Shinobu and Momonosuke escape, and he is crushed by Kaido's kanabou while Momonosuke watches helplessly.

en.title: It's Not Okay! The Spider lures Sanji!
en.synopsis:
Sanji splits away from the group to rescue the harassed woman. However, when Sanji burst through the door, he is caught in a sticky spider web, revealed to be a trap created by Black Maria. Luffy and Jimbei are watched by Bao Huang's cat. Huang reports to King that Luffy has reached the third floor. King positions two Headliners, Poker and Mizerka, a gorilla SMILE fruit user, at the stairs to the fourth floor. However, Luffy meets with the Udon prisoners, who have built him a ladder to the next floor allowing him and Jimbei to sneak past the Headliners. Kin'emon tries to battle Kaido but is sent flying. At the Performance Floor Chopper then announces to everyone that he figured out how the virus works: Ice Oni is fused with a gas that chills the body, so everyone needs to use fire to stop the chilling. He declares he will make enough antibodies for everyone, friend and foe alike. Queen sees this and prepares to blast Chopper and Apoo for failing to hold on to the antidote. His gatling gun, however, is destroyed by Zoro, who angrily tells Queen he didn't come all the way to the island to waste time on his stupid game, but to cut down Kaido. Suddenly a earthquake strikes Onigashima as Marco enters the Performance Floor and finds Zoro. Outside, Yamato, Momonosuke and Shinobu start to evacuate, but the tremors abruptly stop. Yamato discovers that the Beast Pirates' ship has disappeared from the port, leaving behind a lilac fog. She explains that dragons can fly by creating Flame Clouds and using them as footholds to move through the air. Kaido, who uses his Devil Fruit powers conjures Flame Clouds from the rooftop, is now using the clouds to lift up the entire island of Onigashima out of the ocean into the air to move it to the Flower Capital as Kaido declares that the Kouzuki Clan are finished, that Wano will become "New Onigashima" and the world of violence has begun.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Não está tudo bem! A aranha atrai Sanji!
pt-BR.synopsis:

No entanto, quando Sanji estourou pela porta, ele foi pego em uma teia de aranha pegajosa, revelada como uma armadilha criada por Maria Negra. Luffy e Jimbei são observados pelo gato de Bao Huang. Huang relata a King que Luffy chegou ao terceiro andar. King posiciona dois Headliners, Poker e Mizerka, um usuário de frutas do gorila SMILE, nas escadas para o quarto andar. No entanto, Luffy se encontra com os prisioneiros Udon, que construíram uma escada para o próximo andar, permitindo que ele e Jimbei passassem pelos Headliners. Kin'emon tenta combater Kaido, mas é enviado voando. No Performance Floor Chopper então anuncia a todos que ele descobriu como o vírus funciona: Ice Oni é fundido com um gás que esfria o corpo, então todo mundo precisa usar fogo para parar o frio. Ele declara que fará anticorpos suficientes para todos, amigos e inimigos. Rainha vê isso e se prepara para explodir Chopper e Apoo por não segurar o antídoto. Sua arma, no entanto, é destruída por Zoro, que furiosamente diz a Rainha que ele não veio até a ilha para perder tempo em seu jogo estúpido, mas para cortar Kaido. De repente, um terremoto atinge Onigashima quando Marco entra no Piso de Performance e encontra Zoro. Lá fora, Yamato, Momonosuke e Shinobu começam a evacuar, mas os tremores param abruptamente. Yamato descobre que a nave dos Piratas da Fera desapareceu do porto, deixando para trás uma névoa lilás. Ela explica que os dragões podem voar criando nuvens de chamas e usando-as como pontos de apoio para se mover pelo ar. Kaido, que usa seus poderes de Fruta do Diabo evoca nuvens de chamas do telhado, agora está usando as nuvens para levantar toda a ilha de Onigashima para fora do oceano para o ar para movê-lo para a Capital das Flores como Kaido declara que o clã Kouzuki está acabado, que Wano se tornará "New Onigashima" e o mundo da violência começou.

en.title: Zoro Faces Adversity: A Monster! King the Wildfire
en.synopsis:
Kazenbo continues to make its way down to the Armory as the he Beast Pirates and samurai try in vain to stop its descent. Realizing that the flame spectre is moving through walls and that it will be reaching the Armory soon, Yamato urgently moves faster, enlisting the help of Fuga. Atop Fuga's head are Brook and Robin. Knowing that the CP0 are just behind the flames, they hop off and quickly put distance between them and the agents. The CP0, still in pursuit, are stopped when Apoo take their pictures to sell the photos to Morgans of the World Economy News Paper. One them of agents attacks Apoo before attacking Drake as well. Drake suggests that they team up to take down the CP0 agents and Apoo gladly accepts. Meanwhile, as Onigashima is inching closer towards the Flower Capital Momonosuke continues try to prevent the floating island from crashing, determined not to betray the promise he made to his friends and keep everyone safe. Inside, Hiyori (under her Komurasaki persona) plays her shamisen while Orochi watches tearfully. The sound of the shamisen causes Enma to drain Zoro's Haki. Seeing Zoro trying to stop Enma from fully draining him, King mocks how Zoro is having a falling out with his "friend." The two continue their clash, with King mockingly allows Zoro to stab him, only to cause a fiery explosion that leaves King unharmed. Elsewhere, Sanji continues fighting Queen, who expresses disappointment in not being able to see Sanji use his Raid Suit. Queen proceeds to provoke Sanji, calling him mentally weak for asking Zoro for emotional support. He tells Sanji that Zoro isn't any better and that he will not be able to defeat King since King is a Lunarian—a thought to be extinct race that could survive in any natural environment and were once revered as gods. Sanji brushes this off, asking how "gods" managed to become extinct. Zoro is at a loss at how to defeat King. He attacks using his Death Lion Song, an attack he deems to be stronger than his previous attacks. However, this does not cause any damage to King. Zoro hears the shamisen and once again, Enma drains his Haki. Meanwhile, King attacks Zoro and lands a hit on him causing him to let go of his swords. King notes that this is the first time he has ever seen a swordsman being held back by his own swords. Zoro falls and tries to retrieve his blades. He recalls the day he obtained Sandai Kitetsu, the cursed sword forged by Tenguyama Hitetsu. King attacks Zoro in midair which sends him crashing onto the side of the floating island. There, he finds Wado Ichimonji, the sword of Kuina, his childhood friend. In a flashback, Hitetsu explains that Enma and Wado Ichimonji were forged by the same person, the legendary swordsmith, Shimotsuki Kouzaburou. This is why Enma fits comfortably in Zoro's hand. These memories make Zoro question how a sword from the Land of Wano ended up in a remote region in the East Blue.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (163/189)

pt-BR.title: Zoro Enfrenta Adversidade: Um Monstro! Rei do Fogo Selvagem
pt-BR.synopsis:
Kazenbo continua a descer para o Arsenal enquanto os Piratas da Besta e samurais tentam em vão parar sua descida. Percebendo que o espectro de chamas está se movendo através das paredes e que chegará ao Arsenal em breve, Yamato se move urgentemente mais rápido, contando com a ajuda de Fuga. No topo da cabeça de Fuga estão Brook e Robin. Sabendo que o CP0 está logo atrás das chamas, eles pulam e rapidamente colocam distância entre eles e os agentes. O CP0, ainda em perseguição, é parado quando Apoo tira suas fotos para vender as fotos para Morgans do World Economy News Paper. Um deles ataca Apoo antes de atacar Drake também. Drake sugere que eles se juntem para derrubar os agentes da CP0 e Apoo aceita com prazer. Enquanto isso, Onigashima está se aproximando da Capital das Flores, Momonosuke continua tentando impedir que a ilha flutuante caia, determinado a não trair a promessa que fez a seus amigos e manter todos seguros. Dentro, Hiyori (sob sua persona Komurasaki) interpreta seu shamisen enquanto Orochi observa chorosamente. O som do shamisen faz Enma drenar o Haki de Zoro. Vendo o Zoro tentando impedir Enma de esvaziá-lo completamente, King zomba de como o Zoro está tendo uma briga com seu "amigo". Os dois continuam seu confronto, com King zombando permitindo que o Zoro o esfaqueie, apenas para causar uma explosão de fogo que deixa King ileso. Em outro lugar, Sanji continua lutando contra a Rainha, que expressa decepção por não poder ver Sanji usar seu traje Raid. Rainha começa a provocar Sanji, chamando-o mentalmente fraco por pedir apoio emocional a Zoro. Ele diz a Sanji que Zoro não é melhor e que ele não será capaz de derrotar King já que King é um Lunariano - uma raça que poderia sobreviver em qualquer ambiente natural e já foi reverenciado como deuses. Sanji escova isso, perguntando como "deuses" conseguiram se extinguir. Zoro está em uma perda em como derrotar King. Ele ataca usando sua Canção do Leão da Morte, um ataque que ele considera mais forte do que seus ataques anteriores. No entanto, isso não causa nenhum dano ao Rei. Zoro ouve o shamisen e, mais uma vez, Enma drena seu Haki. Enquanto isso, King ataca Zoro e acerta nele fazendo-o soltar suas espadas. King observa que esta é a primeira vez que ele já viu um espadachim sendo retido por suas próprias espadas. Zoro cai e tenta recuperar suas lâminas. Ele se lembra do dia em que obteve Sandai Kitetsu, a espada amaldiçoada forjada por Tenguyama Hitetsu. King ataca Zoro no ar, o que o leva para o lado da ilha flutuante. Lá, ele encontra Wado Ichimonji, a espada de Kuina, seu amigo de infância. Em um flashback, Hitetsu explica que Enma e Wado Ichimonji foram forjados pela mesma pessoa, o lendário ferreiro, Shimotsuki Kouzaburou. É por isso que Enma se encaixa confortavelmente na mão de Zoro. Essas memórias fazem Zoro questionar como uma espada da Terra de Wano acabou em uma região remota no leste azul.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Sanji's Shock! Mysterious Old Man and His Super Yummy Cooking!
en.synopsis:
While Chimeney and Gonbe accompany him to gather groceries, Sanji is forced by the two to take them to a small floating restaurant owned by a drunken old man for lunch. Sanji notices the man to be deep asleep and decides to prepare something himself. While he is cooking, the old man wakes up and immediately recognizes Sanji's way of handling the carving knife and reveals himself as a friend of Sanji's mentor "Red-Leg" Zeff. He insists that Sanji taste some of his cooking, Sanji worried by the old man's cooking style yet amazed by the flavor. Curious to know the secret of the old man's secret ingredient, Sanji leaves Chimeney and Gonbe with the old man as he searches around the city for seasonings that might have been used. But when Sanji gets to eat an onigiri made by the old man, he realizes the ingredient is a special salt. The old man reveals that the waters of Aqua Laguna carries salt from the All Blue and litters the rooftops of the lower parts of the city. As Sanji stockpiled on the salt, Chimeney and Gonbe meet up with Kokoro as she is observing Franky and Iceberg building the Straw Hats' new ship with the Galley-La foremen.

Sanji percebe que o homem está dormindo profundamente e decide preparar algo ele mesmo. Enquanto ele cozinha, o velho acorda e imediatamente reconhece a maneira de Sanji de manusear a faca de escultura e se revela como um amigo do mentor de Sanji, "Red-Leg" Zeff. Ele insiste que Sanji provar um pouco de sua cozinha, Sanji preocupado com o estilo de cozinha do velho homem, mas espantado com o sabor. Curioso para saber o segredo do ingrediente secreto do velho, Sanji deixa Chimeney e Gonbe com o velho enquanto ele procura pela cidade por temperos que poderiam ter sido usados. Mas quando Sanji come um onigiri feito pelo velho, ele percebe que o ingrediente é um sal especial. O velho revela que as águas de Aqua Laguna transportam sal do All Blue e espalham-se pelos telhados das partes inferiores da cidade. Enquanto Sanji estocava o sal, Chimeney e Gonbe se encontram com Kokoro enquanto ela observa Franky e Iceberg construindo o novo navio dos Chapéus Straw com o capataz Galley-La.

Kyros joins Luffy's party, and they arrive at the battle taking place in the palace's plateau. Realizing they have no chance against Doflamingo themselves if they can't even easily beat the officers, they put aside their pride and allow Luffy and co. to move forward, while improving their progress in the fight by working together.

Um grupo de cidadãos descobre a localização do Usopp e do Rei Riku e sai para apreendê-los pulando para acabar com o jogo do Doflamingo. Enquanto isso, o Esquadrão de Abelhas Rosas informa aos anões escravos da Fábrica SMILE que eles foram enganados, e os anões escravizados agora estão lutando contra seus superintendentes. Enquanto isso, os combatentes do Coliseu estão lutando contra os oficiais, enquanto Cavendish oferece Luffy e Law uma carona para o palácio. Kyros se junta à festa do Luffy, e eles chegam na batalha que acontece no planalto do palácio. Percebendo que eles não têm chance contra Doflamingo eles mesmos se eles não podem mesmo facilmente bater os oficiais, eles deixam de lado o seu orgulho e permitem Luffy e co. para avançar, enquanto melhorar o seu progresso na luta, trabalhando juntos.

en.title: Arriving! A Burning Island - Punk Hazard!
en.synopsis:
The Straw Hats arrive at a volcanic island that does not appear on the New World Log Pose. Luffy in his enthusiasm, votes to go to the island, though most of his crew are reluctant to go with him. The crew than receives a distress call from someone on the island who is being attacked by a samurai. They then draw sticks on who will go with Luffy, and who will stay on the ship, with Zoro, Robin, and Usopp coming with Luffy. With the help of Nami's clouds, the scouting group arrives at the main entrance which Zoro cuts down with ease. The group wanders the area seeing the whole place on fire, wondering what happened to the island. Their exploration is suddenly cut short when they encounter a dragon looking hungrily at them. At Raijin Island, Smoker and Tashigi intercept the distress call that Luffy picked up and order the G-5 Marines to set a course for Punk Hazard.

(Source: Wikipedia)

A tripulação recebe uma chamada de socorro de alguém na ilha que está sendo atacado por um samurai. Eles então desenhar varas em quem vai com Luffy, e quem vai ficar na nave, com Zoro, Robin, e Usopp vindo com Luffy. Com a ajuda das nuvens de Nami, o grupo de reconhecimento chega à entrada principal que Zoro corta com facilidade. O grupo vagueia pela área vendo o lugar em chamas, imaginando o que aconteceu com a ilha. Sua exploração é interrompida quando eles encontram um dragão olhando com fome para eles. Na Ilha Raijin, Smoker e Tashigi interceptam a chamada de socorro que Luffy pegou e ordenam que os fuzileiros G-5 definam um curso para Punk Hazard.

With Viola's insight, he prepares to fire the special shot prepared with Kanjuro's help but at the last moment, Usopp awakens his Observation Haki, and sees Luffy's aura and fires before the Dressrosa citizens caught him and everyone else with him. Viola watches as the shot successfully reaches Sugar where it takes the shape of Usopp's face which first defeated Sugar, scaring her again into unconsciousness. With the last obstacle gone, Luffy and Law finally reached Doflamingo himself.

Viola observa como o tiro atinge com sucesso Sugar onde toma a forma do rosto de Usopp que primeiro derrotou Sugar, assustando-a novamente em inconsciência. The Straw Hats manage to defeat the Foxy Pirates, and learn that they had been pursuing Lina and Sayo for the girls' notebook, which shows their father's research on how to create a special gem, the solution for which can be found on the ship. Lina considers her father a liar, but Sayo believes him. Suddenly, Sayo is abducted, and the owner of the island, Doran, says that if they want her back, they must complete the research and find the gem.

Os Chapéus Straw conseguem derrotar os Piratas Foxy, e descobrem que estavam perseguindo Lina e Sayo para o caderno das meninas, o que mostra a pesquisa de seu pai sobre como criar uma gema especial, a solução para a qual pode ser encontrada na nave. Lina considera seu pai um mentiroso, mas Sayo acredita nele. en.title: Get the Hang of It! The Land of Wano's Haki: Ryuo!
en.synopsis:
After Hiyori reveals her identity to Zoro, she explains that while her mother sent Momonosuke, Kanjuro, Raizo and Kikunojo twenty years into the future, she was left behind so that if Momonosuke did not make it into the future, the Kouzuki bloodline would not die out and how Kawamatsu the Kappa watched over her after her parents' death until they were separated when she was thirteen. After she finishes the story, Zoro tells her about the status of the operation. In Ebisu Town, after scolding Shinobu for her lack of trust, Law leaves to go save his crew. As Nami and Usopp worry about Law, they spot the three criminals from Komurasaki's procession, Bingo, Bongo and Bungo. An old woman tells Nami and Usopp that the three are actually an arson ring that bribed official to escape punishment until Hiyori, as Komurasaki, swindled them. Tonoyasu welcomed them into Ebisu Town, but they continue to act rude towards the townspeople. Back in the Sumo Inferno, after figuring out what Luffy is trying to achieve, Hyogoro defeats Alpacaman, displaying his knowledge and skills with advanced Armament Haki and offers to teach Luffy.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Pegue o jeito dele! A Terra dos Haki de Wano: Ryuo!

Depois que Hiyori revela sua identidade para Zoro, ela explica que enquanto sua mãe enviou Momonosuke, Kanjuro, Raizo e Kikunojo vinte anos para o futuro, ela foi deixada para trás para que, se Momonosuke não chegasse ao futuro, a linhagem Kouzuki não morreria e como Kawamatsu a Kappa a vigiou após a morte de seus pais até que eles fossem separados quando ela tinha treze anos. Depois que ela termina a história, Zoro diz a ela sobre o status da operação. Na cidade de Ebisu, depois de repreender Shinobu por sua falta de confiança, Law sai para salvar sua tripulação. Enquanto Nami e Usopp se preocupam com a Lei, eles identificam os três criminosos da procissão de Komurasaki, Bingo, Bongo e Bungo. Uma velha diz a Nami e Usopp que os três são na verdade um anel de fogo posto que subornou o oficial para escapar da punição até que Hiyori, como Komurasaki, os enganou. Tonoyasu os recebeu na cidade de Ebisu, mas eles continuam a agir rudemente com os habitantes da cidade. De volta ao Inferno Sumo, depois de descobrir o que Luffy está tentando alcançar, Hyogoro derrota Alpacaman, exibindo seus conhecimentos e habilidades com Armamento avançado Haki e se oferece para ensinar Luffy.

With both Queen and Big Mom away, Luffy continues practicing with advanced Armament Haki. Babanuki then orders the prisoners to subdue Luffy, and they comply out of fear. Daifugo also fires disease-filled bullets created by Queen on the prisoners. Before Luffy can be infected, Kawamatsu shouts out to Luffy telling him to become a beacon of hope for the prisoners. Babanuki orders the guards to kill him, but Kawamatsu manages to fight them off by spitting sharp fishbones at their necks, saying he won't fall so easily.

Daifugo também dispara balas cheias de doenças criadas pela Rainha sobre os prisioneiros. Antes que Luffy possa ser infectado, Kawamatsu grita para Luffy dizendo-lhe para se tornar um farol de esperança para os prisioneiros. en.title: A Legend All over again! Luffy's fist roars in the sky
en.synopsis:
Luffy's proud declaration from the Skull Dome rooftop inspires the remaining fighters of the alliance to continue fighting. With this, Zoro and Sanji increase their efforts, beginning to overpower King and Queen. However, Kaido reemerges from the rubble after being bitten. Transform back into his Human-Beast Form, Kaido asks Luffy if he honestly thinks has a chance at defeating him with Luffy replying that as long as he is still alive, he has infinite chances. As Luffy and Kaido clash once again, their Conqueror's Haki creates a powerful explosion that breaks apart the clouds above and revealing the night sky. As Yamato watches in awe at Luffy and Kaido's clash, he remembers Oden writing about how Roger and Whitebeard's clash split the heavens as well. Upon Luffy's instruction, Momonosuke and Yamato then leap off the edge of the island, aiming to stop Onigashima from moving while Luffy prevents Kaido from stopping them. Though Momonosuke initially struggles, Yamato's encouragement allows him to generate flame cloud and run across the sky. The explosion created by Luffy and Kaido, which revealed the full moon, allows Dogstrom and Cat Viper to transform back into their Sulong forms. Using Oden One Sword Style with their respective claws and sword leg, Cat Viper and Dogstorm defeat Perospero and Jack respectively. Jack's defeat is observed by Orochi, who is still alive and hiding, and horrified that a Lead Performer has been defeated before remembering he is no longer Kaido's ally. On the rooftop, Luffy and Kaido resume their battle, with Kaido warning Luffy that if he loses everyone in the Land of Wano he will become his slave.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (155/189)

pt-BR.title: Uma lenda de novo! O punho de Luffy ruge no céu
pt-BR.synopsis:
A declaração orgulhosa de Luffy do telhado da Caveira inspira os lutadores restantes da aliança a continuar lutando. Com isso, Zoro e Sanji aumentam seus esforços, começando a dominar o Rei e a Rainha. No entanto, Kaido ressurge dos escombros depois de ser mordido. Se transformar de volta em sua forma de besta humana, Kaido pergunta Luffy se ele honestamente acha que tem uma chance de derrotá-lo com Luffy respondendo que enquanto ele ainda está vivo, ele tem infinitas chances. Enquanto Luffy e Kaido se chocam mais uma vez, Haki do Conquistador cria uma poderosa explosão que quebra as nuvens acima e revela o céu noturno. Enquanto Yamato observa admirando o confronto de Luffy e Kaido, ele se lembra de Oden escrevendo sobre como o confronto de Roger e Whitebeard dividiu os céus também. Sob as instruções de Luffy, Momonosuke e Yamato então saltam da borda da ilha, com o objetivo de impedir Onigashima de se mover enquanto Luffy impede Kaido de impedi-los. Embora Momonosuke inicialmente tenha dificuldades, o encorajamento de Yamato permite que ele gere nuvens de chamas e corra pelo céu. A explosão criada por Luffy e Kaido, que revelou a lua cheia, permite que Dogstrom e Cat Viper se transformem de volta em suas formas Sulong. Usando Oden One Sword Style com suas respectivas garras e perna de espada, Cat Viper e Dogstorm derrotam Perospero e Jack, respectivamente. A derrota de Jack é observada por Orochi, que ainda está vivo e escondido, e horrorizado que um Lead Performer foi derrotado antes de lembrar que ele não é mais aliado de Kaido. No telhado, Luffy e Kaido retomam sua batalha, com Kaido avisando Luffy que se ele perder todos na Terra de Wano ele se tornará seu escravo.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Desire to be Oden! Yamato's Dream!
en.synopsis:
Deciding to trust Yamato, Luffy agrees to hear him out as Pade One and the Beast Pirates attempt to locate them. Orochi prepares to execute Momonosuke to damage the enemy morale. He explains to the crowd that Momonosuke was a time traveler who was transported twenty years into the future by his mother, Toki. The crowd votes on his method of execution. Although Robin, Jimbei, Hyougoro and the other allies are unhappy to see Momonosuke on the cross, they are forced to jeer at him to blend in. At Onigashima's coast, Law's submarine approaches the back of the island, battling strong currents. When the submarine goes up to the surface, then Law uses his Devil Fruit ability to transport himself, Bepo, Penguin, Shachi onto the island. Marco also arrives, having carried Cat Viper and Izou to Onigashima. As Kikunojo has a heartfelt reunion with his brother after twenty years separated, the Heart Pirates and Akazaya members prepare to enter the castle as Marco flies off to inspect something heading to the island. Elsewhere, as Kaido feels frustrated that Yamato has not been captured yet, he decides to personally appear at the party, appearing by Momonosuke. Along with the execution, Kaido introduces a certain "New Onigashima Project." Finally in private, Luffy grants Yamato five minutes to explain himself. Yamato explains that he idolized Oden and when he was executed, Yamato proclaimed himself to be Oden. He went to Kuri and found Oden's logbook, reading about his adventures with the Whitebeard and Roger Pirates. Yamato removes his mask, revealing his face. As Yamato is actually a woman and doesn't look masculine, Luffy is confused on why she called herself Kaido's son. Yamato says that she decided to become a man because Oden was a man, and took on Oden's name to continue his dream of opening Wano's borders. Yamato then tells Luffy that he reminds her of Ace, shocking him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (98/189)

pt-BR.title: Desejo de ser Oden! O Sonho de Yamato!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Decidindo confiar em Yamato, Luffy concorda em ouvi-lo enquanto Pade One e os Piratas da Fera tentam localizá-los. Orochi se prepara para executar Momonosuke para danificar o moral inimigo. Ele explica para a multidão que Momonosuke era um viajante do tempo que foi transportado vinte anos para o futuro por sua mãe, Toki. A multidão vota em seu método de execução. Embora Robin, Jimbei, Hyougoro e os outros aliados estejam infelizes em ver Momonosuke na cruz, eles são forçados a zombar dele para se misturar. Na costa de Onigashima, o submarino de Law se aproxima da parte de trás da ilha, lutando contra fortes correntes. Quando o submarino sobe à superfície, então Law usa sua habilidade de Akuma para se transportar, Bepo, Pinguim, Shachi para a ilha. Marco também chega, tendo levado Cat Viper e Izou para Onigashima. Como Kikunojo tem uma reunião sincera com seu irmão depois de vinte anos separados, os Piratas do Coração e membros da Akazaya se preparam para entrar no castelo enquanto Marco voa para inspecionar algo indo para a ilha. Em outro lugar, como Kaido se sente frustrado por Yamato ainda não ter sido capturado, ele decide aparecer pessoalmente na festa, aparecendo por Momonosuke. Junto com a execução, Kaido apresenta um certo "Novo Projeto Onigashima". Finalmente, em privado, Luffy concede a Yamato cinco minutos para se explicar. Yamato explica que ele idolatrava Oden e quando ele foi executado, Yamato proclamou-se ser Oden. Ele foi para Kuri e encontrou o diário de Oden, lendo sobre suas aventuras com os Whitebeard e Roger Pirates. Yamato remove sua máscara, revelando seu rosto. Como Yamato é na verdade uma mulher e não parece masculina, Luffy está confusa sobre por que ela se chamava filho de Kaido. Yamato diz que ela decidiu se tornar um homem porque Oden era um homem, e assumiu o nome de Oden para continuar seu sonho de abrir as fronteiras de Wano. Yamato então diz a Luffy que ele a lembra de Ace, chocando-o.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: The Truth Behind the Disappearance! Sanji Gets a Startling Invitation!
en.synopsis:

Kaidou is disappointed that Orochi interrupted his party, Meanwhile, Zoro is in the halls but is surrounded on both sides. en.title: Iron Pirate! Here Comes General Franky!
en.synopsis:

Seeing this, Daruma decides to join the fight, targeting the Brachio Tank V and collapsing the ground underneath it. Upon Franky also driving the Kurosai FR-U IV into the same sinkhole, he decides to reveal that he can 'dock' both new vehicles onto his body, turning him into the 'Iron Pirate' Franky Shogun, much to the delight of Usopp, Chopper and Luffy. It is revealed that Hordy has been forcing Surume to follow his commands by threatening to kill his brothers at the North Pole if he does not do as he says, and commands Surume to crush Shirahoshi. Surume originally obeys, before Luffy instead offers to save his brothers, and heads towards Hordy to fight him. Ikaros and Dosun attempt to intercept Luffy, but are blocked by Zoro and Sanji, leaving Luffy to land a blow on Hordy. Meanwhile, the giant ship Noah came into full view of the island, shocking the citizens and King Neptune the most as it's on a direct collision course with Fishman Island.

É revelado que Hordy tem forçado Surume a seguir seus comandos, ameaçando matar seus irmãos no Pólo Norte se ele não fizer o que ele diz, e ordena Surume a esmagar Shirahoshi. en.title: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!
en.synopsis:
Pica reaches the King's Plateau and begins mocking Riku's failure to protect Dressrosa because of his lack of military strength and inability to defeat his enemies. Riku admits that Pica is right and claims that he will never take the throne again before proclaiming that he tried his best to be a good man. As Pica prepares to attack, Zoro has Orlumbus throw him at high speed toward Pica. Flying through the air Zoro imbues his swords with Armament Haki before delivering a powerful attack, horizontally slicing Pica's stone body in two, shocking all observing. Upon seeing Pica's eyes reappear, Zoro leaps off the plateau while noting that Pica escaped into the upper half of his body before slicing that half in two vertically. As the two halves fall apart, Zoro notes that Pica's body will not be able to separate into different parts of the stone before cutting off the arm of the left half where Pica is residing. Upon seeing the fingers of the stone hand twitching, Zoro notes that Pica cannot escape into the ground while in midair before cutting off the fingers of the stone hand and demanding that Pica come out. When Pica does not respond, Zoro cuts the rest of the arm into five sections. Pica emerges and clads his whole body with Armament Haki and leaps forward in a final attempt to kill Zoro, only for Zoro to cut him down with his Three Thousand World. As the ruble from Pica's stone body begins to fall toward the plateau, Elizabello uses his King Punch to blow it away before expressing irritation at Zoro for making him use his punch to blow away stones as Zoro commends him for doing a good job.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (91/118)

pt-BR.title: Uma batalha decisiva em Midair! As Novas Explosões da Técnica Secreta Especial de Zoro!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Pica chega ao Planalto do Rei e começa a zombar do fracasso de Riku em proteger Dressrosa por causa de sua falta de força militar e incapacidade de derrotar seus inimigos. Riku admite que Pica está certo e afirma que ele nunca mais vai assumir o trono antes de proclamar que ele tentou o seu melhor para ser um bom homem. Enquanto Pica se prepara para atacar, Zoro faz Orlumbus jogá-lo em alta velocidade em direção a Pica. Voando pelo ar Zoro imbui suas espadas com Armament Haki antes de realizar um ataque poderoso, cortando horizontalmente o corpo de pedra de Pica em dois, chocando todas as observações. Ao ver os olhos de Pica reaparecer, Zoro salta do planalto, observando que Pica escapou para a metade superior de seu corpo antes de cortar a metade em dois verticalmente. Como as duas metades se desmoronam, Zoro observa que o corpo de Pica não será capaz de se separar em diferentes partes da pedra antes de cortar o braço da metade esquerda onde Pica está residindo. Ao ver os dedos da mão de pedra se contorcendo, Zoro observa que Pica não pode escapar para o chão enquanto no ar antes de cortar os dedos da mão de pedra e exigindo que Pica saia. Quando Pica não responde, Zoro corta o resto do braço em cinco seções. Pica emerge e reveste seu corpo inteiro com Armamento Haki e salta para a frente em uma tentativa final de matar Zoro, apenas para Zoro para cortá-lo com seu Três Mil Mundos. Como o rublo do corpo de pedra de Pica começa a cair em direção ao planalto, Elizabello usa seu King Punch para explodi-lo antes de expressar irritação em Zoro para fazê-lo usar seu soco para explodir pedras como Zoro o elogia por fazer um bom trabalho.

en.title: A Risky Invitation! A Plot to Eliminate Queen!
en.synopsis:
Drake watches the alliance take on the Beast Pirates and thinks back to Koby telling him how Luffy draws people in. He tells Hawkins it is the best time to turncoat, but Hawkins refuses and predicts someone only has 1% chance of surviving until tomorrow. King contacts the Tobi Roppo and tells them to prevent the intruders from reaching the roof. Who's-Who then asks Drake to help him kill Queen. The samurai clash with the Mimawarigumi (a samurai squad that served Orochi) and the Orochi Oniwabanshu while Zoro and Jimbei save them from Goki's attack. Meanwhile, Drake and Who's-Who confront Queen only for, Who's-Who to instead turns on Drake, shooting him in the arm. Hawkins then reveals that his prediction was for Drake. Queen reveals that they were aware of Drake's betrayal all along; he was spotted letting Law out of prison, so they deduced that he was a traitor. Queen prepares to torture Drake for information regarding his true allegiances. The Straw Hats aid the samurai in battling another one of the Numbers, Goki. Luffy remembers when they defeated Oars in Thriller Bark. Although that battle required the efforts of the entire crew, Luffy transforms into his Boundman form to battle Goki on his own. Drake escapes, throwing a grenade at Queen before transforming into his Human-Beast Form and fleeing. Leaping into the party, he uses his sword and four-bladed axe to cut down another Number, Juki, just as Luffy defeats Goki. Noticing each other, Drake detransforms and asks Luffy to fight alongside him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Ele diz a Hawkins que é o melhor momento para se virar, mas Hawkins se recusa e prevê que alguém só tem 1% de chance de sobreviver até amanhã. King entra em contato com o Tobi Roppo e diz a eles para evitar que os intrusos cheguem ao telhado. Quem é... Quem então pede a Drake para ajudá-lo a matar a Rainha. Os samurais se chocam com os Mimawarigumi (um esquadrão samurai que serviu Orochi) e os Oniwabanshu Orochi enquanto Zoro e Jimbei os salvam do ataque de Goki. Enquanto isso, Drake e Who's-Who confrontam Queen apenas por, Who's-Who, em vez disso, vira Drake, atirando nele no braço. Hawkins então revela que sua previsão era para Drake. Queen revela que eles estavam cientes da traição de Drake o tempo todo, ele foi visto deixando Law sair da prisão, então eles deduziram que ele era um traidor. Rainha se prepara para torturar Drake para obter informações sobre suas verdadeiras lealdades. Os Chapéus Straw ajudam os samurais a lutar contra outro dos Números, Goki. Luffy lembra quando derrotaram Oars em Thriller Bark. Embora essa batalha exigisse os esforços de toda a tripulação, Luffy se transforma em sua forma Boundman para lutar contra Goki por conta própria. Drake escapa, jogando uma granada no Queen antes de se transformar em sua forma de besta humana e fugir. Saltando para a festa, ele usa sua espada e machado de quatro lâminas para cortar outro Número, Juki, assim como Luffy derrota Goki. Lily attempts to go inside Shuzo to explode him by growing to full size, but he senses her intentions using Haki & uses Luffy as a shield so that she ends up inside Luffy instead. Lilly then takes advantage of the situation and turns Luffy into a giant with a combination of her ability and Luffy's rubbery form. Luffy defeats Shuzo and his pet alpaca and the group gets to eat the heavenly food from Panz Fry before parting ways with Lilly & Pans Fry and setting off for another adventure in the New World. Meanwhile, Ain is talking with Zephyr, where it is revealed to him that Shuzo lost. Ain takes the blame, but Zephyr does not care since neither Shuzo nor his men will tell the marines anything. Therefore, they begin their assault on the first island in the New World, which leads to Film Z.

Lily tenta entrar em Shuzo para explodi-lo crescendo em tamanho, mas ele sente suas intenções usando Haki e usa Luffy como um escudo para que ela acabe dentro de Luffy. en.title: A Legendary Battle! Garp and Roger!
en.synopsis:
At the new Marine Headquarters, the Marine officers hold a meeting where Sengoku explains the Rock Pirates and the history concerning this crew. The Rocks Pirates were a group of extremely violent pirates who even fought each other onboard the ship, but were kept under control by their captain, Rocks D. Xebec, who sought world conquest and was considered as Gol D. Roger's fist and greatest enemy. Among the crew were some of the most dangerous pirates today, including Whitebeard, Kaidou, Big Mom and Shiki. However, 38 years ago in what would be known as the God Valley Incident, Garp joined forces with the Roger Pirates and defeated the Rocks Pirates, protecting endangered World Nobles. Since the incident, the World Government attempted to remove all traces of the incident, erasing Rocks' name from history and removing the island of God Valley from all maps. Strangely, both Roger and Rocks have the mysterious initial D in their name. It is also revealed that the main reason Garp has refused a promotion to admiral several times is because he does not want to become a direct subordinate of the World Nobles while his achievements kept him from being fired for insubordination. Brannew then reveals the bounty of each of the current Emperors as well as Gol D. Roger and Edward Newgate, which are all in the billions, with Whitebeard's bounty of over 5 billion and Roger's being over 5.5 billion, the highest bounties for a pirate in history. Sakazuki declares that the Marines will not go to the Land of Wano due to a lack of manpower and resources and Sengoku talks about Kozuki Oden, saying he was not only a commander of the Whitebeard Pirates, but also sailed with Roger on his last voyage.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (64/189)

pt-BR.title: Uma Batalha Lendária! Garp e Roger!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Na nova Sede da Marinha, os oficiais da Marinha realizam uma reunião onde Sengoku explica os Piratas do Rock e a história sobre esta tripulação. Os Piratas das Rochas eram um grupo de piratas extremamente violentos que até lutaram uns contra os outros a bordo do navio, mas foram mantidos sob controle por seu capitão, Rocks D. Xebec, que procurou a conquista mundial e foi considerado como Gol D. O punho de Roger e o maior inimigo. Entre a tripulação estavam alguns dos piratas mais perigosos hoje, incluindo Whitebeard, Kaidou, Big Mom e Shiki. No entanto, 38 anos atrás, no que seria conhecido como o Incidente de God Valley, Garp uniu forças com os Roger Pirates e derrotou os Rocks Pirates, protegendo os World Nobles ameaçados. Desde o incidente, o Governo Mundial tentou remover todos os vestígios do incidente, apagando o nome de Rocks da história e removendo a ilha de God Valley de todos os mapas. Estranhamente, Roger e Rocks têm o misterioso D inicial em seu nome. Também é revelado que a principal razão pela qual Garp recusou uma promoção para almirante várias vezes é porque ele não quer se tornar um subordinado direto dos Nobres do Mundo, enquanto suas realizações o impediram de ser demitido por insubordinação. Brannew então revela a recompensa de cada um dos imperadores atuais, bem como Gol D. Roger e Edward Newgate, que estão na casa dos bilhões, com a recompensa de Whitebeard de mais de 5 bilhões e Roger sendo mais de 5,5 bilhões, as maiores recompensas para um pirata da história. Sakazuki declara que os Fuzileiros Navais não irão para a Terra de Wano devido à falta de mão de obra e recursos e Sengoku fala sobre Kozuki Oden, dizendo que ele não era apenas um comandante dos Piratas Whitebeard, mas também navegou com Roger em sua última viagem.
