en.title: A Countercharge! Law and Kid's Return-Attack Combination
en.synopsis:
As Momonosuke attempts to create the flame clouds needed to stop Onigashima, Yamato runs to the armory to secure the explosives. Meanwhile, Law and Kid continue their battle against Big Mom, but their attacks are futile because of her homies. They both reveal to each other their "trump card": their awakened Devil Fruit powers. While they both admit that their awakened powers greatly drain their stamina, but Kid points out that they can't win if they don't go all out, before telling Law to follow his lead. Elsewhere, on Orochi's command, Kazenbo also heads towards the armory to ignite the explosives to destroy the island, while Orochi waits to escape with Fukurokuju's (who is still fighting Raizo) aid. Kid creates Punk Rotten to combat Big Mom, but she overpowers him and hit Kid with Ikoku, blasting him into the Performance Hall just as Yamato arrives. When Big Mom prepares to finish off Kid, Law seizes the opportunity and use his awakened powers. Law creates a miniature ROOM (K ROOM) and coats his sword with it before phasing it into Big Mom's neck, and unleashes Shock Wille, striking her with an electrical shock that also knocks out her homies. Kid follows up with his awakened powers, he makes Big Mom magnetic, causing metallic objects, including Napoleon, to fly towards her. Then, he use Punk Clash causing even the castle's pillars to be pulled in, causing them both buy and crush her under a mountain of metal. Although Big Mom was finally damaged for the first time in the battle, she survived the entire attack, now enraged. Using Soul Pocus, she steals the lifespans of the nearby Beast Pirates, using the souls to revive Napoleon, Prometheus and Hera, while also creating new homies. Then, she consumes an entire year's worth of her own lifespan in order to increase her size and power. Yamato, who carries on her mission, decides to take a detour through the Cave Chamber. Big Mom admits to Kid and Law that it has been decades since she last felt such pain, and like Luffy, they are serious about dethroning her. She then dares them to continue fighting, as she will show them what it means to be an emperor. Law confirms saying he wants to learn the true history, and Kid says that no matter the costs, he plans on taking her down.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Ambos revelam um ao outro seu "cartão de trump": seus poderes Devil Fruit despertados. Enquanto ambos admitem que seus poderes despertados drenam muito sua resistência, mas Kid aponta que eles não podem ganhar se não saírem, antes de dizer a Law para seguir sua liderança. Em outro lugar, sob o comando de Orochi, Kazenbo também se dirige para o arsenal para incendiar os explosivos para destruir a ilha, enquanto Orochi espera para escapar com a ajuda de Fukurokuju (que ainda está lutando contra Raizo). Kid cria Punk Rotten para combater Big Mom, mas ela o domina e bate em Kid com Ikoku, explodindo-o no Performance Hall assim que Yamato chega. Quando Big Mom se prepara para acabar com Kid, Law aproveita a oportunidade e usa seus poderes despertos. Law cria um quarto em miniatura (K ROOM) e reveste sua espada com ele antes de colocá-lo no pescoço da Big Mom, e desencadeia Shock Wille, golpeando-a com um choque elétrico que também nocauteia seus amigos. O garoto segue com seus poderes despertos, ele faz Big Mom magnético, fazendo com que objetos metálicos, incluindo Napoleão, voem em direção a ela. Então, ele usa Punk Clash fazendo com que até os pilares do castelo sejam puxados, fazendo com que ambos a comprem e a esmaguem sob uma montanha de metal. Embora Big Mom foi finalmente danificado pela primeira vez na batalha, ela sobreviveu a todo o ataque, agora enfurecido. Usando a Alma Pocus, ela rouba a vida dos Piratas da Besta, usando as almas para reviver Napoleão, Prometeu e Hera, ao mesmo tempo em que cria novas amizades. Ela então se atreve a continuar lutando, como ela vai mostrar-lhes o que significa ser um imperador. en.title: Here Comes Main Act! Powerful Techniques of Shockwave and Magnetism
en.synopsis:
As Momonosuke continues to pull Onigashima away from the Flower Capital, he is momentarily distracted when he suddenly hears someone calling out to him. At the Performance Floor, Big Mom knocked down by Kid's Corna Dio leaving her right arm shattered. With her ribs also broken from Law's shockwaves, Big Mom uses her Devil Fruit powers to heal her arm by giving her bones life and having them repair themselves. Seeing Big Mom unleash her Conqueror's Haki, Law tells Kid that he will be out of energy in the next barrage. Before he can ask Kid to coordinate their attacks, Kid demands not to tell him what to do. Big Mom combines her homies into a Maser Saber which cuts Kid's metallic bull in half. Kid uses Assign on Big Mom, magnetizing her and the tower behind her. She is flung towards its wall, unable to escape. Kid's metallic bull is launched towards her, so she tears the wall down and uses it to shield herself from Kid's attack. Kid proceeds to attack her legs, causing her to fall to her knees. Kid and Law bombard her with attacks and manage to damage her bit by bit. She is seemingly unable to keep up with the assault but finally shields herself and counters, sending the two Supernovas flying. The emperor then uses Mother's Visit Cannon: 3,000 Leagues of Misery to fuse Napoleon, Prometheus, and Hera into a giant phantom-like homie composed of flames and lightning, Misery. The homie appears before Kid and immediately lunges to attack him. Her continuous onslaught kills those who are nearby and Kid's crew can only watch as their captain takes a beating. Law suddenly uses Takt and sends a nearby tower to crush Big Mom. knocking her on her back. Law then coats his sword with K-ROOM again and stabs her through the chest, extending his blade longer as it pierces straight through the floating island and all the way down to Wano's surface, which Yamato observes. Big Mom starts pummeling Law to force him to release her, but he holds on and drives his sword even deeper, despite his crew begging to lo let go. Once long enough, Law uses Puncture Wille, unleashing a shockwave causing Big Mom to howl in pain as his attack makes a hole both in the island and on Wano, which even Momonosuke sees. Big Mom almost falls into the hole but manages to grab on. Big Mom has Misery aim its attention at Law, but Law shouts to Kid to "do it." Kid appears in the air with a railgun made of the scrap metal as he readies to attack. Big Mom eggs him on, saying that it will not be enough to take her down, but Kid uses his Damned Punk to fire a huge blast of energy at Big Mom that hits her right in the chest, as Law declares her era is over.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Aqui vem o ato principal! Técnicas poderosas de ondas de choque e magnetismo
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto Momonosuke continua a afastar Onigashima da Capital das Flores, ele fica momentaneamente distraído quando de repente ouve alguém chamando por ele. No Performance Floor, Big Mom derrubado pelo Kid's Corna Dio deixando seu braço direito quebrado. Com as costelas também quebradas das ondas de choque de Law, a Big Mom usa seus poderes de Fruta do Diabo para curar seu braço, dando-lhe vida aos ossos e fazendo com que eles se consertem. Vendo a Big Mom soltar o Haki do Conquistador, Law diz a Kid que ele estará sem energia na próxima barragem. Antes que ele possa pedir a Kid para coordenar seus ataques, Kid exige não dizer a ele o que fazer. A Big Mom combina seus amigos em um Maser Saber que corta o touro metálico do Kid ao meio. O garoto usa Assign na Big Mom, magnetizando ela e a torre atrás dela. Ela está atirada para a parede, incapaz de escapar. O touro metálico do Kid é lançado em direção a ela, então ela rasga a parede e usa para se proteger do ataque do Kid. O garoto ataca as pernas, fazendo com que ela caia de joelhos. Kid e Law a bombardeiam com ataques e conseguem danificá-la pouco a pouco. Ela parece incapaz de acompanhar o ataque, mas finalmente se protege e contra-ataca, enviando as duas Supernovas voando. O imperador então usa o Canhão de Visita da Mãe: 3.000 Ligas de Miséria para fundir Napoleão, Prometeu e Hera em um gigante fantasma-como homie composto de chamas e relâmpagos, Miséria. O homie aparece diante de Kid e imediatamente o ataca. Seu ataque contínuo mata aqueles que estão por perto e a tripulação de Kid só pode assistir enquanto seu capitão toma uma surra. De repente, a Lei usa Takt e envia uma torre próxima para esmagar a Big Mom. Law então revestiu sua espada com K-ROOM novamente e a esfaqueou pelo peito, estendendo sua lâmina por mais tempo enquanto ela atravessa a ilha flutuante e até a superfície de Wano, que Yamato observa. A Big Mom começa a atacar Law para forçá-lo a libertá-la, mas ele se agarra e atira sua espada ainda mais fundo, apesar de sua tripulação implorar para deixar ir. Uma vez que o tempo suficiente, Law usa Punctura Wille, desencadeando uma onda de choque causando Big Mom para uivar de dor como seu ataque faz um buraco tanto na ilha e em Wano, que até Momonosuke vê. A Big Mom quase cai no buraco, mas consegue se agarrar. Big Mom tem Misery mirando sua atenção na Lei, mas Law grita para Kid "fazer". Kid aparece no ar com um canhão feito de sucata enquanto se prepara para atacar. A Big Mom o coloca, dizendo que não será o suficiente para derrubá-la, mas Kid usa seu maldito punk para disparar uma enorme explosão de energia na Big Mom que a atinge bem no peito, enquanto Law declara que sua era acabou.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: A Top Officer! The Sweet 3 General Cracker Appears!
en.synopsis:
Charlotte Cracker confronts Luffy and Nami and pulls the buried man, Pound, out of the ground. Cracker reveals to Pound that Big Mom gave permission to kill him, and Pound begs him to let him see his daughters Chiffon and Lola one last time. The mention of Lola's name shocks Nami, who recalls meeting her on Thriller Bark. She remembers getting a Vivre Card pointing to Lola's mother, and realizes that Lola's mother is Big Mom. Randolph, Charlotte Brûlée, and the giant tree homie King Baum arrive to finish the job against the Straw Hats, and Brûlée reveals that she has Carrot and Chopper trapped in a mirror, which she shatters. Cracker asserts that taking out their enemies is now his responsibility, and attempts to execute Pound. However, Luffy blocks his strike, and as the two fight, Nami and Pound run away. They are chased by Brûlée and the homies, but on her hunch, Nami pulls out Lola's Vivre Card. The Vivre Card emits the aura of Big Mom's powerful soul, rendering all of the homies unable to attack.

(Source: Wikipedia)

A menção do nome de Lola choca Nami, que se lembra de conhecê-la em Thriller Bark. Ela se lembra de ter um cartão Vivre apontando para a mãe de Lola, e percebe que a mãe de Lola é Big Mom. Randolph, Charlotte Br lée, e o gigante homie árvore Rei Baum chegam para terminar o trabalho contra os chapéus Straw, e Br lée revela que ela tem cenoura e Chopper preso em um espelho, que ela quebra. Cracker afirma que tirar seus inimigos agora é sua responsabilidade, e tenta executar Pound. No entanto, Luffy bloqueia sua greve, e enquanto os dois lutam, Nami e Pound fogem. Oars was about to crush Sanji when Usopp used his Fire Star to set the zombie's head on fire, only to provoke him as Zoro and Franky attempt to fight him. But Oars is too fast and overpowers everyone before destroying bridge where Usopp, Chopper, and Robin were standing. As a wounded Usopp cursed "Luffy" while lying on the ground below alongside his teammates, Oars stood over the seemingly defeated Straw Hats while proclaiming that he is a servant of Moria. en.title: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke's Determination!
en.synopsis:
After sending Kaido flying across the rooftop, Luffy thanks Yamato for holding back Kaido and Yamato expresses her relief that Luffy has finally arrived. Kaido then emerges in his dragon form, unscathed. He is in disbelief that Luffy survived his previous injuries. He notices the pink dragon before him and demands to know who he is. Although frightened at first, Momonosuke answers that he is Kouzuki Momonosuke, the one who will become the Shogun of Wano. Meanwhile, the people in the Flower Capital are oblivious to the events on Onigashima. Toko and Hitetsu join the festivities, with Toko remembering her farther, Yasuie while Hitetsu worries for Tama's safety. A Mary reports updates on the rooftop to all of Onigashima, with the Straw Hats relief at their captain's return. Elsewhere, Dogstorm and Cat Viper seem to be winning their fights against Jack and Perospero, respectively. However, clouds slowly obstruct the full moon, causing the minks to loss their Sulong form. Deprived of their Sulong form and drained of their energy, the minks are overwhelmed by their opponents, as Jack and Perospero prepare to strike down their opponents, with the latter turning his cane into a candy ax. On the rooftop, Kaido is about to breathe fire on Momonosuke, so Luffy urges the pink dragon to do the same. However, Momonosuke doubts he can produce such an attack so Luffy instead, tells him to bite the emperor. Momonosuke is horrified by this suggestion. Kaido blasts him with successive Blast Breaths which Momonosuke barely manages to evade. Momonosuke remembers what he and his family went through in the hands of Kaido so he musters up the courage to sink his teeth onto the blue dragon. An angered Kaido is about to blast another attack when Luffy punches him in the face, preventing Kaido from breathing fire. Luffy shouts his praises for Momonosuke which is heard all throughout Onigashima. Luffy tells Momonosuke that he just bit an Emperor of the Sea so there should be nothing left in the world that can scare him. Momonosuke realizes what he just did and concurs.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (154/189)

pt-BR.title: Dois dragões se enfrentam! Determinação de Momonosuke!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Depois de enviar Kaido voando pelo telhado, Luffy agradece Yamato por segurar Kaido e Yamato expressa seu alívio que Luffy finalmente chegou. Kaido então emerge em sua forma de dragão, ileso. Ele está descrente de que Luffy sobreviveu aos ferimentos anteriores. Ele percebe o dragão rosa diante dele e exige saber quem ele é. Embora assustado no início, Momonosuke responde que ele é Kouzuki Momonosuke, aquele que se tornará o Shogun de Wano. Enquanto isso, as pessoas na Capital das Flores estão inconscientes dos eventos em Onigashima. Toko e Hitetsu se juntam às festividades, com Toko se lembrando dela, Yasuie enquanto Hitetsu se preocupa com a segurança de Tama. Uma Mary relata atualizações no telhado de toda Onigashima, com os Straw Hats aliviados no retorno do capitão. Em outros lugares, Dogstorm e Cat Viper parecem estar vencendo suas lutas contra Jack e Perospero, respectivamente. No entanto, as nuvens obstruem lentamente a lua cheia, fazendo com que os minks percam sua forma de Sulong. Privados de sua forma Sulong e drenados de sua energia, os minks são esmagados por seus oponentes, enquanto Jack e Perospero se preparam para derrubar seus oponentes, com este último transformando sua bengala em um machado de doces. No telhado, Kaido está prestes a respirar fogo em Momonosuke, então Luffy pede ao dragão rosa para fazer o mesmo. No entanto, Momonosuke duvida que ele possa produzir tal ataque, então Luffy em vez disso, diz-lhe para morder o imperador. Momonosuke está horrorizado com essa sugestão. Kaido o explode com respirações sucessivas que Momonosuke mal consegue escapar. Momonosuke se lembra do que ele e sua família passaram nas mãos de Kaido, então ele reúne coragem para afundar os dentes no dragão azul. Um Kaido irritado está prestes a explodir outro ataque quando Luffy o golpeia na cara, impedindo Kaido de respirar fogo. Luffy grita seus louvores por Momonosuke que é ouvido por todo Onigashima. Luffy diz a Momonosuke que ele mordeu um Imperador do Mar, então não deve haver nada no mundo que possa assustá-lo. Momonosuke percebe o que ele acabou de fazer e concorda.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: The Sea Is For Pirates! Raid! To Onigashima!
en.synopsis:
No allies have to come to aid the raid on Onigashima so the Akazaya Nine jump on a rowboat to go to Onigashima. Kikunojo deduces that there must be a traitor amongst them. Kin'emon struggles to accept that one of his friends betrayed them, Kanjuro coldly confesses that he is the traitor. He claims that while he had no ill will towards them, the persona of Oden's loyal retainer was just a role given to him to him by Orochi after witnessing his parents murder, revealing himself as a member of the Kurozumi Family. He reveals he was responsible not only for leaking Oden's plan to attack Kaido 20 years ago, but also for Jack finding Zou and leaking information about the raid to Orochi, just three Beast Pirate ships come to attack them. Kin'emon cuts down Kanjuro, only to reveal that it is only a drawing of him made by his Devil Fruit. The real Kanjuro is still at the port were he restrains Shinobu with drawn snakes and captures Momonosuke. As the Beast Pirates bombard the Akazaya's boat with cannonballs, their ships are attacked as the Thousand Sunny emerges from the high waves. Meanwhile, the Akazaya's boat is lifted from the water by the Polar Tang with Law scolding the samurai for underestimating the sea. Another of the Beast Pirates' ship is attacked on the other side by the Kid Pirates' ship, the Victoria Punk. Kid states he is only there to take down Kaido, also commenting that the rebels and their ships are at another port. As Luffy, Law and Kid prepare for battle, Luffy tells the samurai, that the sea is meant for pirates.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: O mar é para piratas! Raid! Para Onigashima!

Nenhum aliado tem que vir para ajudar a incursão em Onigashima, então os Akazaya Nine pulam em um barco a remo para ir a Onigashima. Kikunojo deduz que deve haver um traidor entre eles. Kin'emon luta para aceitar que um de seus amigos os traiu, Kanjuro confessa friamente que ele é o traidor. Ele afirma que enquanto ele não tinha má vontade para com eles, a persona do fiel retentor de Oden foi apenas um papel dado a ele por Orochi depois de testemunhar o assassinato de seus pais, revelando-se como um membro da família Kurozumi. Ele revela que foi responsável não só por vazar o plano de Oden para atacar Kaido há 20 anos, mas também por Jack encontrar Zou e vazar informações sobre o ataque a Orochi, apenas três navios Piratas da Fera vêm atacá-los. Kin'emon derruba Kanjuro, só para revelar que é apenas um desenho dele feito por sua Fruta do Diabo. O verdadeiro Kanjuro ainda está no porto se ele contiver Shinobu com cobras desenhadas e capturar Momonosuke. Enquanto os Piratas da Besta bombardeiam o barco do Akazaya com balas de canhão, suas naves são atacadas quando o Mil Ensolarado emerge das ondas altas. Enquanto isso, o barco do Akazaya é levantado da água pelo Tang Polar com Law repreendendo o samurai por subestimar o mar. Outro navio dos Piratas da Besta é atacado do outro lado pelo navio dos Piratas Kid, o Punk Victoria. Kid afirma que ele só está lá para derrubar Kaido, também comentando que os rebeldes e seus navios estão em outro porto. Enquanto Luffy, Law e Kid se preparam para a batalha, Luffy diz ao samurai, que o mar é para piratas.

Luffy uses his advance Observation Haki to avoid Madilloman's attacks while also giving Hyogoro instructions to avoid attacks from Alpacaman as Luffy continues trying to use an advanced Armament Haki technique. After the battle with Kamazo, Zoro's wound is treated by Komurasaki. When Zoro tries to leave to retrieve Shusui, Komurasaki and Toko convince him to stay. They tell Zoro that Gyukimaru is well known ambushing anyone who comes to Oihagi Bridge to steal their weapons. During their conversation, Komurasaki reveals herself to actually be Momonosuke's sister, Hiyori.

Eles dizem a Zoro que Gyukimaru é bem conhecido emboscando qualquer um que venha à Ponte Oihagi para roubar suas armas. Durante a conversa, Komurasaki revela ser a irmã de Momonosuke, Hiyori.

en.title: The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired's Imperial Rage
en.synopsis:
As the Straw Hat Pirates and Heart Pirates continue to participate in the Flower Capital's festivities. In the outskirts of the Flower Capital, the Akazaya Nine continue their battle against Ryokugyu, but are overwhelmed by his ability. Raizo attempts to use his scrolls to blast Ryokugyu, but the Admiral reveals that his wood is flame-resistant before piercing Raizo with his vines and drains him of liquids. Momonosuke orders Yamato not to participate in the combat, but becomes cornered by Ryokugyu's vines. Sukiyaki directs Robin and Law (who had followed Robin) to a passage leading underground. The passage leads deep into the sea, showing an ancient lost civilization on the sea floor. The predecessor to the current Land of Wano, the civilization was flooded by rainwater eight centuries prior after they erected boundary walls around the country. Sukiyaki shows Robin and Law to the Road Poneglyph at the bottom of the staircase, and reveals that Pluton is even further underground, but the only way to reveal it would be to open the country's borders by destroying the physical boundary walls. Robin asks why Oden would want the borders open knowing an Ancient Weapon would be unleashed, but Sukiyaki says he's unsure, believing Oden may had discovered something during his voyage overseas. As Ryokugyu ensnares Yamato and the Akazaya, he states that while cruel, Kaido deterred potential threats before once again demanding for Luffy. after relying on the Straw Hats for so long, he needs to prove that he and his retainers can fend for themselves once they leave. Yamato urges Momonosuke to call Luffy and the others to take Ryokugyu down, but he refuses to involve them, saying after relying on the Straw Hats for so long, he needs to prove that he and his retainers can fend for themselves once they leave. Remembering Luffy, Momonosuke successfully manages to breathe fire in a similar manner to Kaido's Blast Breath, destroying Ryokugyu's wooden golem form and forcing him to revert to his human form. Before he can retaliate Shanks, a short distance from the coast, sends a powerful wave of Conqueror's Haki at Ryokugyu from a distance, overwhelming him. Shanks himself says that he thinks that going after the new generation of pirates while they have their guard down seems tasteless, asking if the new age scares him that much. His presence convinces Ryokugyu to abandon his mission, and the samurai and Yamato celebrate their victory. Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, and Jimbei, are shown to have been watching the fight waiting to intervene only if needed. They remark that their samurai friends were amazing and how intense Shanks' Haki was to be able to drive Ryokugyu away. They don't know that it was him though, but Luffy has his suspicions as Shanks sails away.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: A vinda da Nova Era! A Raiva Imperial do Red-Haired
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto os Piratas Straw Hat e Piratas do Coração continuam a participar das festividades da Capital das Flores. Nos arredores da Capital das Flores, os Akazaya Nine continuam sua batalha contra Ryokugyu, mas estão sobrecarregados por sua habilidade. Raizo tenta usar seus pergaminhos para explodir Ryokugyu, mas o Almirante revela que sua madeira é resistente a chamas antes de perfurar Raizo com suas videiras e drena-lo de líquidos. Momonosuke ordena Yamato não participar do combate, mas fica encurralado pelas videiras de Ryokugyu. Sukiyaki dirige Robin e Law (que tinha seguido Robin) para uma passagem que leva ao subterrâneo. A passagem leva ao fundo do mar, mostrando uma antiga civilização perdida no fundo do mar. O antecessor da atual Terra de Wano, a civilização foi inundada pela água da chuva oito séculos antes, depois que eles ergueram muros de fronteira em todo o país. Sukiyaki mostra Robin e Law para o Poneglyph Estrada no fundo da escada, e revela que Pluton é ainda mais subterrâneo, mas a única maneira de revelá-lo seria abrir as fronteiras do país, destruindo as paredes de fronteira física. Robin pergunta por que Oden iria querer as fronteiras abertas sabendo que uma Arma Antiga seria desencadeada, mas Sukiyaki diz que não tem certeza, acreditando que Oden possa ter descoberto algo durante sua viagem ao exterior. Como Ryokongyu enlaça Yamato e os Akazaya, ele afirma que, embora cruel, Kaido dissuadiu ameaças potenciais antes de mais uma vez exigindo Luffy. depois de confiar nos Chapéus Straw por tanto tempo, ele precisa provar que ele e seus retentores podem se defender quando saírem. Yamato pede que Momonosuke ligue para Luffy e os outros para derrubar Ryokugyu, mas ele se recusa a envolvê-los, dizendo que depois de confiar nos Chapéus Straw por tanto tempo, ele precisa provar que ele e seus retentores podem se defender quando saírem. Lembrando-se de Luffy, Momonosuke consegue respirar fogo de uma maneira semelhante à Respiração Explosiva de Kaido, destruindo a forma golem de madeira de Ryokungyu e forçando-o a reverter para sua forma humana. Antes que ele possa retaliar Shanks, a uma curta distância da costa, envia uma poderosa onda de Haki do Conquistador em Ryokugyu de longe, esmagando-o. O próprio Shanks diz que ele acha que ir atrás da nova geração de piratas enquanto eles têm a guarda baixa parece insípido, perguntando se a nova era o assusta tanto. Sua presença convence Ryokongyu a abandonar sua missão, e os samurais e Yamato celebram sua vitória. Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, e Jimbei, são mostrados para ter sido assistindo a luta esperando para intervir apenas se necessário. Eles observam que seus amigos samurais eram incríveis e como o Haki de Shanks era intenso para poder afastar Ryokugyu. Eles não sabem que foi ele, mas Luffy tem suas suspeitas enquanto Shanks navega.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: She Loves Sweets! Big Mom of the Four Emperors!
en.synopsis:
The rest of the Straw Hats are waiting for Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji to return with the treasure. Meanwhile, Pekoms and Tamago came for the candy but the Minister of the Left claims that here is no more candy and the factory machines have been destroyed by Hordy. Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji find Caribou and the treasure and start to carry the treasure back, searching for a ride back to Ryugu Palace. They find Pekoms and Tamago with the Minister of the Left. Luffy gets interested by Pekoms and Tamago's looks and then realize they are part of Big Mom's crew. Big Mom in the New World on Whole Cake Island is waiting for the candy from Fishman Island. Bobbin comes right after Big Mom eats some of her crewmates. Bobbin tells her that he destroyed an island and it smelled sweet when he did. She then learns that Fishman Island will not be giving her candy. She calls Tamago and Pekoms and they dare not answer so Luffy does. Luffy tells her that he ate the rest of the candy and he is willing to give the treasure to her for repayment. Big Mom refuses, stating that she can't eat treasure. Tamago steps in and tries to talk Big Mom into accepting Luffy's offer in order to replace the ships that were lost after a run-in with Captain Kid. She refuses, saying that pirates don't make deals and that she will go after Luffy in the New World instead of the Fishman Island. Luffy agrees to a fight with her and says that he will beat her up and claim Fishman Island as his own territory.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Enquanto isso, Pekoms e Tamago vieram buscar os doces, mas o Ministro da Esquerda afirma que aqui não há mais doces e as máquinas da fábrica foram destruídas por Hordy. Luffy, Zoro e Sanji encontram Caribou e o tesouro e começam a levar o tesouro de volta, procurando uma carona de volta ao Palácio Ryugu. Eles encontram Pekoms e Tamago com o Ministro da Esquerda. Luffy se interessa pela aparência de Pekoms e Tamago e então percebe que eles são parte da tripulação da Big Mom. Big Mom no Novo Mundo em Whole Cake Island está esperando os doces de Fishman Island. Bobbin vem logo depois que Big Mom come alguns de seus companheiros de tripulação. Bobbin diz a ela que ele destruiu uma ilha e cheirava doce quando ele fez. Ela então descobre que Fishman Island não lhe dará doces. Ela liga para Tamago e Pekoms e eles não ousam responder assim que Luffy faz. Luffy diz a ela que ele comeu o resto do doce e ele está disposto a dar o tesouro para ela para o pagamento. Big Mom se recusa, afirmando que não pode comer tesouro. Tamago entra e tenta convencer a Big Mom a aceitar a oferta de Luffy para substituir as naves que foram perdidas depois de um encontro com o Capitão Kid. Ela se recusa, dizendo que piratas não fazem acordos e que ela irá atrás de Luffy no Novo Mundo em vez da Ilha dos Pescadores. Chopper manages to run into Mocha who was still hallucinating and manages to defeat the soldiers trying to apprehend her and give her a sedative to calm her down. Chopper then pleaded for her help to prevent the other children from eating the drugged candy. Meanwhile, Luffy and Smoker were racing towards building C where they believed Caesar and Vergo were located. Essa ação foi suficiente para fazer Sanji vir ao resgate, alegando que ele ouviu suas lágrimas caindo. Chopper então pediu sua ajuda para evitar que as outras crianças comessem o doce drogado. Enquanto isso, Luffy e Smoker estavam correndo para a construção C, onde acreditavam que César e Vergo estavam localizados. en.title: History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea
en.synopsis:
Celebrating Mr. Satan's victory at the IGO tournament, the group discovers that the tournament was planned with the ulterior motive of gathering the world's strongest fighters to capture the legendary Deep Sea Glutton creature Akami, which has the ability to suck the energy out of living things. The Akami appears and attacks Mr. Satan, Usopp and Gohan, poisoning them and absorbing their energy, before disappearing again; This leaves the group with only 30 minutes to find Akami and create an antidote to its poison. After defeating Sanji, Piccolo, Franky, Gotenks and others, Akami evolves into an even more powerful monster, even gaining the ability to absorb and use the power of energy attacks intended to stop it. Luffy and Toriko distract the monster while Goku charges a Spirit Bomb using the energy from everyone at the tournament. Yamato explains that it is a cyborg, known as a Mary, that serves as Kaido's surveillance unit by broadcasting their findings to human Marys. Now that Yamato's location has been revealed, enemy Beast Pirates approach the storehouse. With Momonosuke hiding in his robe, Yamato battles the pirates to escape. Carrot becomes furious after Wanda was defeated by Perospero. She charges Perospero, melting his candy and breaking through his candy armor. However, before she can deliver the final blow clouds block the moon, she loses her Sulong form. Upon hearing Bao Huang broadcast, is unsure to help either Kin'emon's groups or Momonosuke, so he decides to go down a random path, hoping to meet with some of the allies. After defeating and taunting Carrot, Perospero leaves to join the others in battle. On the roof, Kaido reveals his hybrid form to the Worst Generation. One minute remains before Luffy can use Haki again, so he sleeps to get rest. Killer attempts to cut Kaido, but his body is now too hard for him to cut. Killer is struck away by Kaido's club. As Black Maria was unavailable, Jack, having been bandaged and his tusk reattached, decides to go to the treasure repository to kill the samurai. Bao Huang reports that somehow, the Akazaya Nine's injuries have been bandaged. Now that Jack is taking care of the samurai, Black Maria now focuses on battling Robin, as she removes her robe to reveal a tattoo reading "女難" ("Girl Trouble") while wielding a large weapon with a Wanyuudou at the end. Hajrudin catches Luffy, the Straw Hats, samurai, and Corrida Colosseum gladiators escape from Admiral Fujitora and run to their ships. As Fujitora prepares to crush them with his floating rubble, he begins reflecting, knowing that the Straw Hats and their allies will soon perish. However, even if they somehow managed to escape, they would be targeted by the Four Emperors. Fujitora notes Luffy's sympathy for his blindness, but reveals that he blinded himself because he had seen many things he did not want to. Suddenly, the citizens of Dressrosa chase after the criminals with the apparent intention of taking down the Straw Hats themselves due to Luffy kidnapping Rebecca. As the citizens run past Fujitora, he hears one of them ask why they are doing this, as Rebecca was really with Kyros as they always knew about Kyros' and Scarlett's marriage. Another citizen replies that they knew this, as well as who the fairies really were. As such, the citizens are only putting on a facade, shouting threats with smiles on their faces and stopping at the edge of the coast to cheer on the Straw Hats. Fujitora reflects that everyone really does want to help Luffy and begins wondering what Luffy looks like, as he regrets blinding himself. The Straw Hats are awestruck when they reach the enormous flagship Yonta Maria, and Bartolomeo promises to show them his ship later. Hajrudin reveals that he and four other giants are going to reform the Giant Warrior Pirates, and Orlumbus says that his fleet of 56 ships should also help them, which confused the Straw Hats. Leo says that he and the Tonta Corps were given permission to help as well, Ideo reveals that he has formed an alliance with Blue Gilly, Abdullah, and Jeet, and Suleiman reveals that he has joined Cavendish. Luffy gets confused at the sudden onslaught of news, and they reveal that they had planned this while staying at the palace for two days. Bartolomeo then steps forward and requests Luffy to allow the seven crews present to serve under him.

Fujitora observa a simpatia de Luffy por sua cegueira, mas revela que ele se cegou porque tinha visto muitas coisas que não queria. Como os cidadãos passam Fujitora, ele ouve um deles perguntar por que eles estão fazendo isso, como Rebecca estava realmente com Kyros como eles sempre souberam sobre o casamento de Kyros e Scarlett. Outro cidadão responde que eles sabiam disso, assim como quem eram as fadas. Como tal, os cidadãos estão apenas colocando uma fachada, gritando ameaças com sorrisos em seus rostos e parando na beira da costa para torcer pelos chapéus Straw. Fujitora reflete que todo mundo realmente quer ajudar Luffy e começa a se perguntar como é Luffy, enquanto ele se arrepende de se cegar. Os chapéus Straw ficam impressionados quando chegam ao enorme carro-chefe Yonta Maria, e Bartolomeo promete mostrar sua nave mais tarde. However, instead of attacking Dogstorm and Master Cat Viper and the rest of the tribe all bow to the two samurai, quickly explaining to the Straw Hats that they have been friends with Kin'emon's clan and that they are like family to them. The allies continue to discuss their plans on getting past the front gate when they notice the Straw Hats are missing. They realize that they have already taken over the torii gate, despite it being heavily armed. As Kaido yells at his subordinates that he wants his son to show up at the banquet, he is informed that the Tobi Roppo have arrived and he decides to introduce them to Big Mom, only to learn she is changing into a kimono. Queen begins the Golden Kagura festivities with a musical performance with Apoo as DJ, while Orochi is confident the Akazaya Nine are now taken care of. Meanwhile, all six members the Tobi Roppo, X Drake, Page One and his older sister Ulti, Sasaki, Who's-Who and Black Maria, meet to hear their captain's request, though they all know what it is. The Straw Hats set up to toast Jimbei joining, but after the Akazaya Nine and their other allies advance on Onigashima, they decide to wait to celebrate with everyone after they defeat Kaido, Orochi and Big Mom.

Unwilling to be associated with Germa, Sanji instead dons the name Soba Mask. As Sanji fights Page One with the Raid Suit he and displays its capabilities, including invisibility. As Saniji notes the cruel irony of how his childhood dream of invisibility came true through the Germa technology that he hated, Page One transform into his Human-Beast Form and reengages with Sanji. After unleashing one powerful attack, Sanji escapes into the sky as Usopp, Law and Franky also flee to avoid being identified. Back in the shogun's caste, Robin sneaks around trying to find important information but she is confronted by the Orochi Oniwabanshu, Orochi's personal ninja force, as Fukurokuju, the ninja leader, gives Robin a chance to explain herself.

en.title: Bink's Booze! The Song that Connects the Past with the Present!
en.synopsis:
Brook recalls the Rumbar Pirates' journey through the Grand Line, where they faced many dangers but still managed to enjoy themselves. The captain contracted an illness and attempted to leave the Grand Line through the Calm Belt with the other infected crew, leaving Brook in charge of the remaining pirates. The journey continued until some powerful enemies defeated the Rumbar Pirates in the Florian Triangle, fatally poisoning them. As they were dying, they sang Binks's Brew one last time, recording it in a Tone Dial in the hopes that Brook would revive with his Devil Fruit power and deliver the shell to Laboon. Back in the present, Brook silently hopes Laboon will wait just a little longer for his return.

(Source: Wikipedia)

A jornada continuou até que alguns inimigos poderosos derrotaram os Piratas Rumbar no Triângulo de Florian, envenenando-os fatalmente. Quando estavam morrendo, cantaram "Binks's Brew" uma última vez, gravando em um Dial de Tom na esperança de que Brook revivesse com seu poder de Fruta do Diabo e entregasse a concha para Laboon. en.title: Uncontrollable! Chopper's Forbidden Rumble!
en.synopsis:
As Zoro's strategy to use Usopp as a weapon falls apart, Chopper's breather concludes as an overweight Kumadori frees himself from the fridge after eating everything inside. But Kumadori uses his Life Return ability to digest the eaten food and regain his usual figure, explaining the ability to a fascinated Chopper before they resume their fight. Chopper quickly realizes that he cannot break through Kumadori's body-hardening technique without the effect of his Rumble Ball drug. Regardless of the risk as he already used one to save Nami and should not take another for six hours, Chopper uses a second Rumble Ball. Despite the erratic transformations, Chopper manages to enter Armed Point to land a hit on Kumadori. However, the attack only infuriated Kumadori as he beats the now weakened Chopper to submission before preparing for the deathblow. But Chopper, remembering Kureha warning him not to take the risk again after learning of the devastation he caused the first time he did it, is left with no recourse but to use a third Rumble Ball with the thought to protect his friends. As a consequence, Chopper transforms into an oversized and purely instinct-driven version of himself that Kureha had best described as a monster.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Incontrolável! Chopper's Proibido Rumble!

Como a estratégia do Zoro de usar o Usopp como arma se desfaz, a respiração do Chopper termina quando um Kumadori com sobrepeso se liberta da geladeira depois de comer tudo lá dentro. Mas Kumadori usa sua habilidade de Retorno de Vida para digerir a comida e recuperar sua figura habitual, explicando a habilidade de um Chopper fascinado antes que eles retomem sua luta. Chopper rapidamente percebe que ele não pode romper a técnica de endurecimento do corpo de Kumadori sem o efeito de sua droga Rumble Ball. Independentemente do risco como ele já usou um para salvar Nami e não deve levar outro por seis horas, Chopper usa um segundo Rumble Ball. Apesar das transformações erráticas, Chopper consegue entrar no Ponto Armado para atingir Kumadori. No entanto, o ataque só enfureceu Kumadori enquanto ele bate o agora enfraquecido Chopper para submissão antes de se preparar para o golpe mortal. Mas Chopper, lembrando-se de Kureha advertindo-o para não correr o risco de novo depois de saber da devastação que ele causou na primeira vez que ele fez isso, é deixado sem nenhum recurso, mas para usar uma terceira Bola Rumble com o pensamento de proteger seus amigos. Como conseq ência, Chopper se transforma em uma versão exagerada e puramente instintiva de si mesmo que Kureha melhor descreveu como um monstro.

He describes a civilization that existed hundreds of years ago and vanished at the time that the world government assumed power. He considers the collective evidence, which leads him to believe that the government tried to erase their former enemies from history. After stating that Ohara has learned too much, the Elder Star orders Spandaine to kill the professor and to give the order to destroy the island. Suddenly, the library is set aflame; while the scholars try to save the books, Robin admits to being an archeologist and unites with her mother. However, their union does not last long. Around them, cannon shots from the Buster Call's battleships start to hail down and Olvia sends her daughter off with Saul to flee the island, while she joins the effort to save the library's knowledge.

en.title: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!
en.synopsis:
The Marines are having difficulty maintaining order in the streets of Dressrosa as they deal with rampaging animals and pillaging pirates as well as the absence of Admiral Fujitora. Luffy is struggling against a Doflamingo clone and a controlled Bellamy while Law questions Doflamingo's feat in manipulating CP-0 and the World Government. Doflamingo explains that he learned of a national treasure that the World Nobles would not want revealed and used the knowledge to blackmail them into granting him their power. He also reveals the full potential of Law's Op-Op Fruit with its power to give eternal life at the cost of the user's own life, but Law is not interested in using it and states that it was thanks to Corazon that he has the power to defeat Doflamingo. Law then remembers his time in the Donquixote Pirates 16 years ago when he discovered that he had little over three years to live, which fueled his desire to destroy everything. He was part of the new recruits that recently joined the crew and was met Corazon, a clumsy but talented officer of Doflamingo's crew. Law also learned the hard way that Corazon hates children when he was thrown out the window.

Luffy está lutando contra um clone de Doflamingo e uma Bellamy controlada enquanto Law questiona a façanha de Doflamingo em manipular a CP-0 e o Governo Mundial. Ele também revela todo o potencial da Fruta Op-Op de Law com seu poder de dar vida eterna à custa da própria vida do usuário, mas Law não está interessado em usá-la e afirma que foi graças a Corazon que ele tem o poder de derrotar Doflamingo. Law então se lembra de seu tempo nos Piratas Donquixote há 16 anos, quando descobriu que ele tinha pouco mais de três anos de vida, o que alimentou seu desejo de destruir tudo. Ele fazia parte dos novos recrutas que recentemente se juntaram à tripulação e conheceram Corazon, um oficial desajeitado, mas talentoso da tripulação de Doflamingo. Law também aprendeu da maneira mais difícil que Corazon odeia crianças quando foi jogado pela janela.

Zoro's team are seen desperately trying to outrun the approaching gas while Nami and Usopp help Brownbeard after their vicious attack by Caesar. At the Lab, Caesar reveals to his captives that they will get to experience the poison gas as well, moving them outside dangling in a cave. Depois que Smiley engole os doces de tamanho grande, o casaco de doces se dissolve revelando uma droga especial projetada para converter todo o conteúdo do corpo de Smiley em uma arma de destruição "perfeita", Shinokuni. No processo, Smiley morre e em um saco de maçãs, uma maçã se transforma em uma Fruta do Diabo. O corpo da besta se transforma em gás venenoso se espalhando rapidamente por toda a ilha. Seu poder letal foi demonstrado quando os homens de César foram pegos, sendo petrificados diante dos olhos dos Corretores e dos Chapéus Straw cativos. A equipe do Zoro é vista tentando desesperadamente fugir do gás que se aproxima, enquanto Nami e Usopp ajudam Brownbeard após seu ataque vicioso por César. No laboratório, César revela aos seus cativos que eles também experimentarão o gás venenoso, movendo-os para fora pendurados em uma caverna. Apesar de sua situação, Law disse a Luffy que seu plano original ainda continuará e que é hora de atacar César.

en.title: Z's Ambition! A Great and Desperate Escape Plan!
en.synopsis:
Several of Shuzo's men appear and fight against the Marines and easily begin to overwhelm them. Luffy continues to fight Shuzo while Zoro fights Momonga to which the Vice-admiral states they shouldn't interfere with their business like this. Zoro uses his 360 pound cannon and sends Momonga back that destroys a Marine ship. From the sidelines, Nami notices the wave changes in the ocean and realizes a Thrust-up Stream is coming. When Usopp asks what that is and asks if it's similar to the Knock-up Stream like the one that took them to Sky Island, Nami says it is, but smaller, but still has enough power to destroy a Marine ship. She has Franky fire the anchors to the raft Panz Fry and the others are on and lets Sanji and Lily know in advance. Luffy has a hard time against Shuzo's fighting style due to his long arms, but then starts using Haki to overwhelm Shuzo again. As Robin, Chopper, and Brook make their way back to the Sunny, several Thrust-up Streams take out some ships, one of the streams has Usopp in the Shark Submerge flying back to the ship. As Nami has everyone get on the ship she has Franky use a Coup de Burst after the raft everyone is one get close to the thrust and they fly away. However, Luffy and Zoro fall off due to the raft breaking and Luffy uses his arms to grab the raft while Shuzo uses a knife with a Vivre Card attached to it on the raft. After they get away, Momonga gathers his men on a broken ship and laments them having gotten away again while Shuzo goes to finish the Marines off with an attack and defeats Momonga. He then travels to the Straw Hats location and recalls his past fight with Ain and how their fight lasted for over five hours till she won, prompting their leader Z to give her the win and the title of next in command. Shuzo is determined to become the new next in command and destroy the pirates. The Straw Hats land in a location around some rocks and Robin notes they will be safe for now and Nami happy that the planned worked and that they finally got out of the sea. Chopper works on Panz Fry noting he had some bad injuries and that he'll be fine if he rests. Lily thanks Chopper for helping her father and the rest of the crew. Luffy is excited that he can try Panz Fry's cooking and Lily reveals she took some food from the Marines and while Zoro notes that's odd given the circumstances, he changes his tone after seeing she took some sake also. As Luffy asks Panz Fry to make some food, Sanji kicks him stating he needs to rest and Chopper says Luffy didn't listen. However, Panz Fry says he will cook for then despite Lily's protest stating that as a chef and Giant, he was saved by the crew and would shame himself if he didn't repay them for risking their lives and thanks Luffy for saving him and will cook the food. Shuzo arrives at the location and notes they are out of torpedoes and several of his men offer their lives to use as torpedoes, prompting Shuzo to acknowledge their sacrifice and say they are true men and state he will not let their deaths be for nothing. The ships then prepare to attack the Straw Hats.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Z's Ambition! Um grande e desesperado plano de fuga!

Zoro usa seu canhão de 360 libras e envia Momonga de volta que destrói um navio da Marinha. Do lado de fora, Nami percebe que a onda muda no oceano e percebe que um fluxo de impulso está chegando. Quando Usopp pergunta o que é isso e pergunta se é semelhante ao Knock-up Stream como aquele que os levou para Sky Island, Nami diz que é, mas menor, mas ainda tem poder suficiente para destruir uma nave da Marinha. Ela tem Franky disparar as âncoras para a jangada Panz Fry e os outros estão em e deixa Sanji e Lily saber com antecedência. Luffy tem dificuldade contra o estilo de luta de Shuzo devido aos seus longos braços, mas então começa a usar Haki para dominar Shuzo novamente. Enquanto Robin, Chopper e Brook voltam para o Sunny, vários Thrust-up Streams derrubam alguns navios, um dos córregos tem Usopp no Shark Submerge voando de volta para o navio. Como Nami tem todo mundo na nave ela tem Franky usar um golpe de Burst depois da jangada todos são um chegar perto do impulso e eles voam para longe. No entanto, Luffy e Zoro caem devido à quebra da jangada e Luffy usa seus braços para pegar a jangada enquanto Shuzo usa uma faca com um cartão Vivre ligado a ela na jangada. Depois que eles escapam, Momonga reúne seus homens em um navio quebrado e os lamenta ter escapado de novo enquanto Shuzo vai acabar com os fuzileiros com um ataque e derrota Momonga. Ele então viaja para o local do Straw Hats e lembra sua luta passada com Ain e como a luta durou mais de cinco horas até que ela ganhou, levando seu líder Z a dar-lhe a vitória e o título de próximo no comando. Shuzo está determinado a se tornar o próximo no comando e destruir os piratas. Os Chapéus Straw pousam em um local ao redor de algumas rochas e notas Robin eles estarão seguros por enquanto e Nami feliz que o planejado funcionou e que eles finalmente saíram do mar. Chopper trabalha em Panz Fry observando que ele teve alguns ferimentos ruins e que ele vai ficar bem se ele descansar. Lily agradece a Chopper por ajudar seu pai e o resto da tripulação. Luffy está animado que ele possa experimentar a culinária de Panz Fry e Lily revela que ela pegou um pouco de comida dos fuzileiros e enquanto Zoro observa que é estranho, dadas as circunstâncias, ele muda seu tom depois de ver que ela tomou um pouco de saquê também. Como Luffy pede a Panz Fry para fazer alguma comida, Sanji o chuta dizendo que ele precisa descansar e Chopper diz que Luffy não ouviu. No entanto, Panz Fry diz que vai cozinhar para então, apesar do protesto de Lily afirmando que como um chef e gigante, ele foi salvo pela tripulação e se envergonharia se ele não os pagasse por arriscar suas vidas e agradecesse Luffy por salvá-lo e vai cozinhar a comida. Shuzo chega ao local e observa que eles estão sem torpedos e vários de seus homens oferecem suas vidas para usar como torpedos, levando Shuzo a reconhecer seu sacrifício e dizer que eles são homens de verdade e afirmam que ele não vai deixar suas mortes ser por nada. en.title: A Big Clash! Sanji vs. Doflamingo
en.synopsis:
Sanji put up a valiant fight but was ultimately defeated by Doflamingo. Before Doflamingo could deliver the killing blow, Sanji was saved by Law who teleported themselves back to the Thousand Sunny. With Caesar Clown back in their control, Law ordered the Straw Hats to head to Zou immediately. Though the Straw Hats were reluctant in leaving their remaining friends behind, they were forced to agree when they were assaulted by a flying Marine battleship, courtesy of Fujitora, and another one of Doflamingo's string whips, but not before Sanji questions Law on why he's so fixated on Doflamingo when their true objective is to defeat Kaido. Law reveals that Doflamingo cannot pursue them in cloudless areas with his String-String Fruit and advises them to find one fast. Once the Straw Hats escaped with Caesar Clown and the Marines heading to Dressrosa, the two Warlords have a showdown on the iron bridge. Law told his former leader that he is ending the alliance with the Straw Hats because once they stop the production of SMILE, Kaido will wipe out Doflamingo. Law also reveals his goal was to make Doflamingo pay for what he did 13 years ago, even if it cost him his life.

(Source: Wikipedia)

en.title: A Deadly Fight in a Blizzard! The Straw Hats vs. The Snow Woman!
en.synopsis:
Mocha runs off with the candy and she thinks back in a flashback. Mocha and Sind are on a ship to escape from the poison gas. Mocha wants to go back home to her family, cries, and Sind tries to calm her down, but he cries too. Caesar Clown finds them later and tells them that his own son died from the gas, and he hoped to not see any more children die from the poison gas. She uses her devil fruit powers to reach the three and Zoro blocks her attack from hitting Nami. Monet hopes to finish off the weaker Straw Hats because it is a strategic tactic. Monet blocks the entrance with a snow wall and is about to bite Nami on the arm until Robin prevents that from happening. Zoro opens up a pathway out of the room so that Nami, Robin and Chopper to get away from Monet. Luffy and Momonosuke is still getting out of the garbage chute until Momonosuke stopped and they both fell back down the chute. Caesar Clown is watching Monet fighting Zoro and the children chasing after Mocha. He talks about Shinokuni getting inside the facility being an important use. He says that they'll be killed soon. Usopp, Kin'emon and Brook are getting chased by the poison gas and are trying to find the sea stone cuffs and Momonosuke. Monet asks Zoro why he is only blocking her attacks instead of attacking her. Sanji and the G-5 Marines arrived, and Sanji sees Zoro and makes fun of him and the marines do the same. Sanji and the marines see Monet and admire her beauty. Monet uses her devil fruit powers and bites off a shoulder of a few marines causing them to panic. Sanji and the marines run off while Tashigi stays with Zoro to fend off Monet.

Caesar Clown os encontra mais tarde e diz a eles que seu próprio filho morreu do gás, e ele esperava não ver mais crianças morrerem do gás venenoso. Mocha ainda está sendo perseguida pelas crianças que são drogadas pelo doce, e ela está se certificando de que não coloquem as mãos no doce. Monet apresentou novas crianças para as outras crianças em um flashback. Zoro está lutando contra Monet enquanto Nami, Robin e Chopper estão indo atrás de Mocha e das crianças. Zoro abre um caminho para fora da sala para que Nami, Robin e Chopper se afastem de Monet. Luffy e Momonosuke ainda estão saindo da rampa de lixo até que Momonosuke parou e ambos caíram de volta. en.title: Crossing Swords! Roger and Whitebeard!
en.synopsis:
Orochi became Oden's proxy as he was at sea, but the other daimyos suspect him because he was a member of the Kurozumi Family. It is revealed that before Sukiyaki was born Orochi's grandfather had attempted to take over by assassinating the other daimyos. When assassination plot was exposed, Orochi's grandfather was forced to commit seppuku, and the people grew to despise the Kurozumi name to the point lynch mobs were formed to hunt down any members. While hiding from the mobs one day, Orochi met his distant relatives Semimaru and Higurashi, the latter being a former user of the Clone-Clone Fruit. After being told of his family history and being given Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi, Orochi plots to take the shogunate with Higurashi's assistance. Orochi needed to collect funding to buy weapons, so he stole money from Yasuie while working undercover as a servant and asked Oden for loans without paying him back. Higurashi then disguised herself as Oden to convince the shogun to let Orochi into the palace, where he became the shogun's faithful servant. Years later, Higurashi disguised herself as Sukiyaki, pretended to fall ill and spread news that Sukiyaki died of the illness, allowing Orochi to rise to power. Overseas, Oden on his fourth year under the Whitebeard Pirates, along with Toki had another child, their daughter Hiyori. One day, the Whitebeard Pirates approach an island being plundered the Roger Pirates. Oden charges in to face them, but Roger sends the samurai flying though several trees with a single swing of his sword. Oden quickly recovers and tries to return to Roger, but Whitebeard then comes and engages in a monstrous clash with the pirate, the force of their power so great, it blows back everything on the island without their blades even touching.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (71/189)

pt-BR.title: Cruzando Espadas! Roger e Whitebeard!

É revelado que antes de Sukiyaki nascer, o avô de Orochi tentou assumir o controle assassinando os outros daimyos. Quando o plano de assassinato foi exposto, o avô de Orochi foi forçado a cometer seppuku, e o povo passou a desprezar o nome Kurozumi até que multidões de linchamento foram formadas para caçar qualquer membro. Enquanto se escondeu das multidões um dia, Orochi conheceu seus parentes distantes Semimaru e Higurashi, sendo este último um ex-usuário da Fruta Clone-Clone. Depois de ser informado de sua história familiar e ser dado Snake-Snake Fruit, Modelo: Yamata no Orochi, Orochi planeja levar o xogunato com a ajuda de Higurashi. Orochi precisava coletar fundos para comprar armas, então ele roubou dinheiro de Yasuie enquanto trabalhava disfarçado como servo e pediu empréstimos a Oden sem pagar de volta. Higurashi então se disfarçou como Oden para convencer o shogun a deixar Orochi entrar no palácio, onde ele se tornou o servo fiel do shogun. Anos depois, Higurashi se disfarçava de Sukiyaki, fingia adoecer e espalhar notícias de que Sukiyaki morreu da doença, permitindo que Orochi ascendesse ao poder. No exterior, Oden em seu quarto ano sob os Piratas Whitebeard, junto com Toki teve outro filho, sua filha Hiyori. Um dia, os Piratas Whitebeard se aproximam de uma ilha sendo saqueados os Piratas Roger. Oden cobra para enfrentá-los, mas Roger envia o samurai voando através de várias árvores com um único balanço de sua espada. Oden rapidamente se recupera e tenta voltar para Roger, mas Whitebeard então vem e se envolve em um confronto monstruoso com o pirata, a força de seu poder tão grande, que explode tudo na ilha sem suas lâminas sequer tocar.

en.title: To the Land of Wano! The Roger Pirates Disband!
en.synopsis:
After attaining everything and becoming the King of the Pirates, Roger disbands his crew. After discussing about who would surpass them, the Roger Pirates threw one last party together and Roger was the first one to leave the crew. Later, Oden returned to Wano with intentions to open its borders before Joy Boy's return and reunited with his family. The citizens were happy to see him return; he had become a celebrity since his wife helped the town after she recovered. Oden also met his retainers, except for Ashura and Denjiro. Ashura had returned to being a mountain bandit and Denjiro wandered around the country borrowing money. Kin'emon reveals to Oden what happened to the country while he was gone. Since Sukiyaki died of an illness, Orochi became the temporary shogun. Backed up by a powerful pirate, Kaido, Orochi had almost absolute power and built several weapons factories operated with slavery. After a family was executed by Orochi, the Oden's retainers protested the cruelty by going to Orochi's palace. However, while they were away, Kaido's men invaded Oden Castle and attempted to kill Momonosuke. Although the enemies were fought off, Toki was shot in the leg with an arrow protecting her child. Angry that his family was threatened and hurt by Orochi, Oden decides to confront him while the others to watch over Kuri while he is gone.

Mais tarde, Oden retornou a Wano com a intenção de abrir suas fronteiras antes do retorno de Joy Boy e se reuniu com sua família. Os cidadãos ficaram felizes em vê-lo voltar, ele se tornou uma celebridade desde que sua esposa ajudou a cidade depois que ela se recuperou. Oden também conheceu seus retentores, exceto Ashura e Denjiro. Ashura voltou a ser um bandido de montanha e Denjiro vagava pelo país pedindo dinheiro emprestado. Kin'emon revela a Oden o que aconteceu com o país enquanto ele estava fora. Desde que Sukiyaki morreu de uma doença, Orochi se tornou o shogun temporário. Apoiado por um pirata poderoso, Kaido, Orochi tinha poder quase absoluto e construiu várias fábricas de armas operadas com escravidão. Depois que uma família foi executada por Orochi, os guardas de Oden protestaram contra a crueldade indo ao palácio de Orochi. No entanto, enquanto eles estavam fora, os homens de Kaido invadiram o Castelo de Oden e tentaram matar Momonosuke. Embora os inimigos foram combatidos, Toki foi baleado na perna com uma flecha protegendo seu filho. en.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
en.synopsis:
The episode opens with Usopp pretending he is in a great battle as captain of the Going Merry, fending off attacking pirates. As he is doing so, Luffy announces that he has finished the pirate flag for their ship, and holds it up. It's a terribly drawn skull and crossbones, of course. The others are horrified of the artwork, and so Usopp tells them that he is a great painter. He paints a pirate flag with his own face on it, but the others reject it so he paints a proper pirate flag, a very nice one at that. They fly it on the mast and continue to sail. As they are sailing, Nami spots an island in the distance with her telescope, saying it is Legendary Treasure Island. Usopp says how he heard that there is a valuable treasure on the island, but if one tries to claim it they will face God's wrath. As the Straw Hats draw nearer to the island, the weather turns foul and the waters very choppy. After a tough sail they make it to the island. The Straw Hats head into the jungle, looking for treasure. Zoro lies down and starts to nap, and as Usopp is shocked at how he can sleep in a creepy place like this, the Straw Hats find themselves surrounded by strange animals, creatures that are combinations of two or more animals. A voice booms through the jungle, claiming to be the Guardian God of the island and telling them to leave. Luffy picks up a lion pig that bites him on the face. The voice is shocked and Luffy explains he ate the Devil's Fruit. A gun then pokes out through a bush and shoots Luffy in the back, but Luffy bounces the bullet into the air with his Gum Gum powers. Luffy then spots a twitching green bush, and the owner of the voice takes off running. Luffy, Usopp, and Nami catch up to the man in the treasure chest, named Gaimon. Luffy explains to him how he wants to go to the Grand Line and claim One Piece, but Gaimon doesn't think he can do it. Luffy and Gaimon converse about how they can't read a map, and Nami is angered by this. Gaimon then explains how he became trapped in the treasure box as Zoro finally joins them. He explains that twenty years ago, he was with his crew in search of the treasure, and as they were leaving, he noticed how the captain never searched on top of a large cliff. Gaimon scaled the cliff but slipped and fell, getting stuck in a treasure box. He found that his crew had left, and he thought he would have the treasure on the ridge to himself, but found he could not climb in the box. When Luffy tries to pull Gaimon out of the box, he explains that his body grew to match the shape of the box, and his body will be ruined if the box is broken. Luffy then realizes that Gaimon uses the strange animals of the island to ward off visitors. Inspired by Gaimon's story, the Straw Hats decide to help Gaimon find the treasure. They come to the ridge and Luffy uses Gum Gum Rocket to launch himself up to the top, where there are five treasure chests. He refuses to hand them over to Gaimon, and while this shocks and angers Nami and Usopp, Gaimon realizes that the treasure boxes must be empty. Luffy confirms this, and so Gaimon begins to cry, saying that he's been guarding nothing for twenty years. Luffy says it could be worse, as he could have died guarding nothing, and he offers Gaimon to join their crew. Gaimon decides to stay with the strange animals of the island, however, as he has decided to protect them instead of the treasure. With this adventure behind them, the Straw Hats set sail in the Going Merry once again, waving goodbye to Gaimon as the episode draws to a close.

Como ele está fazendo isso, Luffy anuncia que ele terminou a bandeira pirata para a nave deles, e segura-lo. É um crânio terrivelmente desenhado e ossos cruzados, é claro. Os outros estão horrorizados com a arte, e então Usopp diz que ele é um grande pintor. Ele pinta uma bandeira pirata com seu próprio rosto, mas os outros a rejeitam, então ele pinta uma bandeira pirata adequada, muito boa nisso. Eles voam no mastro e continuam a navegar. Enquanto navegam, Nami vê uma ilha à distância com seu telescópio, dizendo que é a Ilha do Tesouro Lendário. Usopp diz que ouviu que há um tesouro valioso na ilha, mas se alguém tentar reivindicá-lo, eles enfrentarão a ira de Deus. À medida que os chapéus Straw se aproximam da ilha, o tempo fica sujo e as águas muito agitadas. Depois de uma vela dura, eles chegam à ilha. Os chapéus Straw vão para a selva, à procura de tesouros. Zoro se deita e começa a cochilar, e como Usopp está chocado em como ele pode dormir em um lugar assustador como este, os Chapéus Straw se encontram cercados por animais estranhos, criaturas que são combinações de dois ou mais animais. Uma voz explode através da selva, alegando ser o Deus Guardião da ilha e dizendo-lhes para sair. Luffy pega um porco leão que o morde no rosto. A voz está chocada e Luffy explica que ele comeu a Fruta do Diabo. Uma arma, em seguida, cutuca através de um arbusto e atira Luffy nas costas, mas Luffy salta a bala para o ar com seus poderes Gum Gum Gum. Luffy então vê um arbusto verde se contorcendo, e o dono da voz sai correndo. Luffy, Usopp e Nami alcançam o homem no baú do tesouro, chamado Gaimon. Luffy explica a ele como ele quer ir para a Grand Line e reivindicar One Piece, mas Gaimon não acha que ele pode fazer isso. Luffy e Gaimon conversam sobre como eles não podem ler um mapa, e Nami está irritado com isso. Gaimon então explica como ele ficou preso na caixa do tesouro como Zoro finalmente se junta a eles. Ele explica que vinte anos atrás, ele estava com sua tripulação em busca do tesouro, e quando eles estavam saindo, ele percebeu como o capitão nunca procurou em cima de um grande penhasco. Gaimon escalou o penhasco, mas escorregou e caiu, ficando preso em uma caixa de tesouro. Ele descobriu que sua tripulação tinha partido, e ele pensou que ele teria o tesouro na crista para si mesmo, mas descobriu que ele não poderia subir na caixa. Quando Luffy tenta tirar Gaimon da caixa, ele explica que seu corpo cresceu para combinar com a forma da caixa, e seu corpo será arruinado se a caixa estiver quebrada. Luffy então percebe que Gaimon usa os estranhos animais da ilha para afastar os visitantes. Inspirados na história de Gaimon, os Chapéus Straw decidem ajudar Gaimon a encontrar o tesouro. Eles vêm para o cume e Luffy usa Gum Gum Rocket para lançar-se até o topo, onde há cinco baús do tesouro. Ele se recusa a entregá-los a Gaimon, e enquanto isso choca e irrita Nami e Usopp, Gaimon percebe que as caixas do tesouro devem estar vazias. Luffy confirma isso, e assim Gaimon começa a chorar, dizendo que não guarda nada há 20 anos. Luffy diz que poderia ser pior, como ele poderia ter morrido não guardando nada, e ele oferece Gaimon para se juntar a sua tripulação. Gaimon decide ficar com os estranhos animais da ilha, no entanto, como ele decidiu protegê-los em vez do tesouro. Hammond is using human pirates as slaves in his Slave Tank and Robin frees the slaves at Jimbei's request. She creates a clone of herself and easily defeats Hammond with her Double Clutch technique, breaking his back. The freed slaves them revolt against the New Fishman Pirates and ally with the crew. The Minister of the Left gets in touch with the Air Tank and is informed of the situation and order an immediate evacuation of the island. It is revealed that Hordy is a monster born from their environment. He states the officers are all the same and how their just monsters born of hatred born from their ancestors and they fear their hatred will one day fade and so will their hatred towards humans and want them to be evil to justify their actions not even wanting peace for Fishmen. He recalls what he asked what humans did to Hordy and Hordy answers "nothing" and that they've been chosen by the heavens to punish humans and granted power. en.title: I Won't Forgive Him! Chopper's Determination!
en.synopsis:
Shinobu and Momonosuke are chased by Yamato into the right brain tower. Shinobu uses a falling piece of paper to divert Yamato away from him. They are now safe from him, but they are spied on by Bao Huang's black cat. Bao Huang reports back to King about Momonosuke's location, and King sends the report to his subordinates. He orders all available Headliners and Tobi Roppo to go to the right brain tower to kill Momonosuke. Shinobu runs into a dark location only to be ambushed by the Beast Pirates' Armored Division, led by Sasaki. All members of this division have SMILE abilities that give them an armor-like defense. Shinobu is attacked by a turtle SMILE user, and Momonosuke refuses to run away to save himself. Just then, Yamato appears at his aid, defeating the turtle man and sending him crashing into a wall. Yamato declares that she will fight for the Kouzuki Family. Queen starts to get bored of shooting the enemy samurai, so he decides to start firing at his own men as well. He shoots the Pleasures, knowing that they would simply laugh in response to being shot. Zoro, Chopper, Robin, Brook, the uninfected samurai, Mimawarigumi and Orochi Oniwabanshu battle the ice oni to avoid infection, the latter wondering where Fukurokuju went. However, one of the yakuza, Omasa, is scratched by an oni's nail and is infected. Chopper swears revenge on Queen for his gross misuse of man-made viruses. Luffy, Jimbei and Sanji run through the hallways and defeat Hamlet, a giraffe SMILE user who has an entire giraffe's body growing from his backside starting from the neck, thus leaving his main body hanging several meters in the air, and Fourtricks, a chicken SMILE user whose body is transformed into a large rooster, although his head is at the chicken's rear end. After being slashed by Kaido's attack, Kiku loses her left arm, her helmet shatters and her sword breaks in two. Dogstorm orders his subordinates to evacuate the rooftop to avoid the slash attacks. Izou bandages Kiku's arm and Kin'emon cauterizes the wound with his flaming sword to stop it from bleeding. Fully treated, Kiku returns to battle. Kaido says that that is how samurai should behave and states that he likes them, similar to how Roger and Whitebeard did too. He changes back into his human form and says that stating that death brings completion to a human. He asks if the samurai are ready to finish the fight but Kin'emon retorts that dying at his hand would bring no honor to any of them.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Não vou perdoá-lo! Determinação de Chopper!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Shinobu e Momonosuke são perseguidos por Yamato na torre do cérebro direito. Shinobu usa um pedaço de papel para desviar Yamato dele. Agora estão a salvo dele, mas são espionados pelo gato preto de Bao Huang. Bao Huang se reporta a King sobre a localização de Momonosuke, e King envia o relatório para seus subordinados. Ele ordena que todos os Headliners disponíveis e Tobi Roppo vão para a torre do cérebro direito para matar Momonosuke. Shinobu corre para um local escuro só para ser emboscado pela Divisão Blindada dos Piratas da Fera, liderada por Sasaki. Todos os membros desta divisão têm habilidades SMILE que lhes dão uma defesa tipo armadura. Shinobu é atacado por um usuário de tartarugas SMILE, e Momonosuke se recusa a fugir para se salvar. Então, Yamato aparece em seu auxílio, derrotando o homem tartaruga e enviando-o bater em uma parede. Yamato declara que lutará pela família Kouzuki. Rainha começa a se cansar de atirar no samurai inimigo, então ele decide começar a atirar em seus próprios homens também. Ele atira nos Prazeres, sabendo que eles simplesmente ririam em resposta a serem baleados. Zoro, Chopper, Robin, Brook, o samurai não infectado, Mimawarigumi e Orochi Oniwabanshu batalham o gelo para evitar a infecção, este último se perguntando para onde Fukurokuju foi. No entanto, um dos yakuza, Omasa, é arranhado por um prego de oni e está infectado. Chopper jura vingança à Rainha pelo uso grosseiro de vírus feitos pelo homem. Luffy, Jimbei e Sanji correm pelos corredores e derrotam Hamlet, um usuário de girafa SMILE que tem o corpo de uma girafa inteira crescendo a partir do pescoço, deixando seu corpo principal pendurado vários metros no ar, e Fourtricks, um usuário de frango SMILE cujo corpo é transformado em um grande galo, embora sua cabeça esteja na extremidade traseira da galinha. Depois de ser cortada pelo ataque de Kaido, Kiku perde seu braço esquerdo, seu capacete se quebra e sua espada se quebra em dois. Dogstorm ordena que seus subordinados evacuem o telhado para evitar os ataques. Izou ligaduras do braço de Kiku e Kin'emon cauteriza a ferida com sua espada flamejante para impedi-lo de sangrar. Totalmente tratado, Kiku retorna à batalha. Kaido diz que é assim que samurai deve se comportar e afirma que ele gosta deles, semelhante ao que Roger e Whitebeard fizeram também. Ele muda de volta para sua forma humana e diz que afirmar que a morte traz a conclusão para um ser humano. Ele pergunta se os samurais estão prontos para terminar a luta, mas Kin'emon responde que morrer em sua mão não traria honra a nenhum deles.

Brook uses his Devil Fruit powers to coat his sword, Soul Solid, with the "Chill of the Underworld" and defeats Zeo with a freezing slash Usopp uses his Green Star techniques against Daruma, defeating him with a wolf-shaped Pop Green with an shockwave-emitting nose. Chopper uses his claws to defeat Dosun, while Franky blasts Ikaros by firing a laser beam from his hands. Jimbei sends Wadatsumi flying with a powerful Fishman Karate technique, and Sanji, using his memories Kamabakka Kingdom to sets himself on fire with rage, finishes him off with a burning kick that sets Wadatsumi ablaze. Hyouzou attempts to attack Zoro from behind only for Zoro to counter and destroy his swords again and defeats him, calling him "a frog in a well". Luffy uses his Elephant Gatling technique on the ship and Hordy is finally blasted out unconscious. Luffy prepares to destroy the ship to save everyone on the island.

en.title: Drunken Dragon Bagua! The Lawless Dragon Closing in on Luffy
en.synopsis:
While the final battle between Luffy and Kaido is taking place at the rooftop of the Skull Dome, Momonosuke is desperate to steer Onigashima away from the Flower Capital where its citizens are oblivious to the catastrophe that could befall them. In the Flower Capital, the people are drinking their fill and dancing to the music. They send lanterns to the sky, with their wishes written on them so that they may reach heaven. In hers, Toko writes that she wants to see her father again, which breaks Hitetsu's heart. Back at the rooftop, Kaido starts drinking, much to Luffy's annoyance. Kaido, now drunk, uses his Drunken Dragon Bagua fighting style, making his movements become more unpredictable and his Haki stronger while switching rapidly between his Zoan forms, during which Kaido reveals a bulkier, dark blue version of his Human-Beast Form. Enduring Kaido drunken assault, Luffy continues to retaliate and finally lands a kick to his stomach which causes Kaido to cough up blood. Meanwhile, in Mary Geoise, the Five Elders complain how this year's Reverie is cursed. They mention that it resulted in the total abolition of the Seven Warlords of the Sea, an incident concerning the Alabasta Kingdom, and the Revolutionary Army's infiltration of Mary Geoise. The blond elder says that they need to set those aside for now and immediately deal with what is happening in the Land of Wano. He is expectant that the CP0 have captured Nico Robin by now, and says they should use Big Mom and Kaido as an excuse to wipe out their "inconveniences". He mentions of the need to erase the existence of a certain Devil Fruit. Another elder rebuffs its existence, saying that the said fruit is a mere legend even to them as it has not awakened for centuries. However, the blond elder says that the World Government would not have bothered giving that Devil Fruit another name if they did not want to hide its name from history. At the seas just outside of Wano, a fleet of Marine Ships are on standby awaiting orders as they spot Zunesha approaching the country.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Dragão Bagua bêbado! O Dragão Sem Lei fechando em Luffy
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto a batalha final entre Luffy e Kaido está ocorrendo no telhado do Skull Dome, Momonosuke está desesperado para afastar Onigashima da Capital das Flores, onde seus cidadãos estão alheios à catástrofe que poderia acontecer com eles. Na Capital das Flores, as pessoas estão bebendo e dançando à música. Eles enviam lanternas para o céu, com seus desejos escritos neles para que possam chegar ao céu. Na dela, Toko escreve que quer ver seu pai de novo, o que quebra o coração de Hitetsu. De volta ao telhado, Kaido começa a beber, para o aborrecimento de Luffy. Kaido, agora bêbado, usa seu estilo de luta Drunken Dragon Bagua, fazendo seus movimentos se tornarem mais imprevisíveis e seu Haki mais forte enquanto alterna rapidamente entre suas formas de Zoan, durante o qual Kaido revela uma versão azul-escuro mais volumosa de sua Forma de Fera Humana. Sustentando Kaido assalto bêbado, Luffy continua a retaliar e finalmente consegue um chute em seu estômago que faz Kaido tossir sangue. Enquanto isso, em Mary Geoise, os Cinco Anciãos se queixam de como a Reverie deste ano é amaldiçoada. Eles mencionam que resultou na abolição total dos Sete Senhores da Guerra do Mar, um incidente relativo ao Reino Alabasta, e infiltração do Exército Revolucionário de Mary Geoise. O ancião loiro diz que precisa deixar isso de lado por enquanto e imediatamente lidar com o que está acontecendo na Terra de Wano. Ele está esperando que o CP0 tenha capturado Nico Robin agora, e diz que eles devem usar Big Mom e Kaido como uma desculpa para acabar com suas "inconveniências". Ele menciona a necessidade de apagar a existência de uma certa Fruta do Diabo. Outro ancião rejeita sua existência, dizendo que o dito fruto é uma mera lenda até mesmo para eles, pois não desperta há séculos. No entanto, o ancião loiro diz que o Governo Mundial não teria se incomodado em dar a essa Fruta do Diabo outro nome se eles não quisessem esconder seu nome da história. Nos mares fora de Wano, uma frota de Navios Marinhos aguarda ordens enquanto eles avistam Zunesha se aproximando do país.
