Kaido tells Luffy that Devil Fruit Awakening occurs when one's mind and body catch up to their powers. Kaido laments the damage his crew had taken during the raid, having lost all his top officers and having his castle destroyed by battle. He continues his battle with Luffy on the Skull Dome, and as Luffy launches himself into the air as he gets an idea. Below inside the Skull Dome, the allied forces are separated and cornered by the spreading fires. Chopper reunites with Nami and Tama but fail to locate any other allies or combat the fires. Brook, Robin, Apoo, and Inbi are trapped in the basement, Sanji and the other women are cornered in the left brain tower, Usopp's group, Franky and Zoro are also trapped in the corridors, and Mink forces are trapped on the third floor. On the fourth floor, Raizo and Jimbei carry out a plan to extinguish the flames, with Raizo having been prepared for such a situation since Oden Castle was set on fire. Using his Devil Fruit ability, Raizo summons a scroll producing vast quantities of water he gathered from Zou's Rain-Ruption. Then, using a Fish-Man Jujutsu technique, Jimbei controls the water flow and floods all parts of the Skull Dome, extinguishing the flames and saving the allied forces below. However, outside Onigashima, Yamato pressures Momonosuke to create Flame Clouds to support the island. As Kaido's power is rapidly declining, the Flame Clouds he created are weakening and about to collapse. Momonosuke needs to create his own Flame Clouds before this happens, or Onigashima will fall and crash into the mainland. Luffy then appears in front of Kaido, holding a lightning bolt.

Brook, Robin, Apoo e Inbi estão presos no porão, Sanji e as outras mulheres estão encurraladas na torre do cérebro esquerdo, o grupo de Usopp, Franky e Zoro também estão presos nos corredores, e as forças Mink estão presas no terceiro andar. No quarto andar, Raizo e Jimbei realizam um plano para extinguir as chamas, com Raizo tendo sido preparado para tal situação desde que o Castelo de Oden foi incendiado. Usando sua habilidade de Fruta do Diabo, Raizo convoca um pergaminho produzindo grandes quantidades de água que ele recolheu da Operação Chuva de Zou. Então, usando uma técnica de Jujutsu de Homem-Peixe, Jimbei controla o fluxo de água e inunda todas as partes do Domo da Caveira, extinguindo as chamas e salvando as forças aliadas abaixo. en.title: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!
en.synopsis:
At dinner, Doflamingo discusses their next target who has been allying with other groups as Law walks in. Machvise points out a white patch on Law's chest and Giolla recognizes it as Amber Lead Syndrome, but Doflamingo angrily tells her not to spread rumors, explaining how it's caused by poisoning. When asked how he escaped Flevance, Law reveals that he hid under a mountain of corpses. Doflamingo asks Law who he holds a grudge against, prompting Law to claim he wants to destroy everything and telling Corazon that he will get his revenge at any cost. The next day, the Donquixote Pirates executives attack a pirate hideout and take their treasure. Baby 5 asks what Flevance was like and learn how it is a white city caused by the Amber Lead and used to create different types of goods. But, it would poison and erode the body if dug up and handled, something the World Government and Flevance royalty kept secret because of the fortune it would bring. It also consequentially shortens the lifespan by about 20 more years each generation, effectively killing the kids before adulthood. People eventually began to collapse at the same time due to the buildup of Amber Lead in their bodies and began to die with immense pain flooding their bodies. Surrounding countries placed a quarantine on Flevance because they thought it was contagious and the royalty escaped with the help of the World Government. However, Flevance wouldn't remain quiet as war broke out with neighboring countries showing no mercy. In the past, Flevance citizens were killed as soldiers gun down anyone they find. A nun tries to get Law to come with her and the other children after some soldiers promised to let them escape, but Law stays because his sister is dying. The nun promises to come back on the next ship to get Law and tells him that there is always hope and that a loving hand will one day reach out to him. Law's father tries to get help from other doctors but none will come, afraid of becoming infected. Elsewhere, Law stands next to his sister, Lami, who tells him that her body hurts and is turning more white every day. Law holds her hand and promises that their father will find a cure because he is the greatest doctor in the country. As soldiers gun down civilians outside, Lami asks Law why it is so noisy, prompting Law to lie about there being a festival going on because Flevance is always prosperous. Soldiers enter the hospital to kill anybody they find and Law hides Lami in a closet, but finds his parents killed and screams in grief. Law leaps through a window as the soldiers fire at him and runs away in tears as they pursue him. He hides under a bridge and finds the children and nun lying dead, causing him to fall into tears while remembering the nun's words about hope. He returns to the hospital but finds it burning and suffers a complete mental breakdown screaming Lami's name. In the present, Senor Pink reveals that Flevance perished as the Donquixote Pirates finish off the pirates and notes that any 10-year-old who experienced that would have their personality screwed up. Law walks through the garbage dump and sees Corazon reading a newspaper. Law notes that his family and everyone from Flevance died while Corazon lived claiming it's not fair. Holding a dagger, Law lunges toward Corazon and stabs in the back but gets caught by Buffalo who exclaims that he must inform Doflamingo.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (73/118)

pt-BR.title: Lembranças tristes! Lei, o Garoto da Cidade Branca!
pt-BR.synopsis:
No jantar, Doflamingo discute seu próximo alvo que se aliou a outros grupos enquanto Law entra. Machvise aponta uma mancha branca no peito de Law e Giolla a reconhece como Síndrome de chumbo âmbar, mas Doflamingo irritadamente diz a ela para não espalhar rumores, explicando como isso é causado por envenenamento. Quando perguntado como ele escapou de Flevance, Law revela que ele se escondeu sob uma montanha de cadáveres. Doflamingo pede a Law contra quem ele guarda rancor, levando Law a alegar que quer destruir tudo e dizendo a Corazon que ele vai se vingar a qualquer custo. No dia seguinte, os executivos dos Piratas Donquixote atacam um esconderijo de piratas e pegam seu tesouro. Baby 5 pergunta como era Flevance e aprende como é uma cidade branca causada pelo chumbo âmbar e usada para criar diferentes tipos de bens. Mas, envenenaria e corroeria o corpo se desenterrado e manuseado, algo que o Governo Mundial e a realeza da Flevance mantiveram em segredo por causa da fortuna que traria. Também reduz a vida útil em cerca de 20 anos a cada geração, efetivamente matando as crianças antes da idade adulta. As pessoas eventualmente começaram a entrar em colapso ao mesmo tempo devido ao acúmulo de chumbo âmbar em seus corpos e começaram a morrer com imensa dor inundando seus corpos. Os países vizinhos colocaram uma quarentena em Flevance porque acharam que era contagioso e a realeza escapou com a ajuda do Governo Mundial. No entanto, Flevance não ficaria quieta enquanto a guerra eclodiu com os países vizinhos não mostrando misericórdia. No passado, cidadãos Flevance foram mortos como soldados atirando em qualquer um que encontrassem. Uma freira tenta fazer Law vir com ela e as outras crianças depois que alguns soldados prometeram deixá-los escapar, mas Law fica porque sua irmã está morrendo. A freira promete voltar no próximo navio para pegar Law e diz a ele que sempre há esperança e que uma mão amorosa um dia chegará até ele. O pai de Law tenta obter ajuda de outros médicos, mas nenhum virá, com medo de se infectar. Em outro lugar, Law fica ao lado de sua irmã, Lami, que lhe diz que seu corpo dói e está ficando mais branco todos os dias. A lei segura a mão dela e promete que seu pai vai encontrar uma cura porque ele é o maior médico do país. Enquanto soldados matam civis lá fora, Lami pergunta a Law por que é tão barulhento, levando Law a mentir sobre ter um festival acontecendo porque Flevance é sempre próspero. Soldados entram no hospital para matar qualquer um que encontrem e Law esconde Lami em um armário, mas encontra seus pais mortos e grita de tristeza. A lei salta através de uma janela enquanto os soldados disparam contra ele e fogem em lágrimas enquanto o perseguem. Ele se esconde sob uma ponte e encontra as crianças e freiras mortas, fazendo com que ele caia em lágrimas enquanto se lembra das palavras da freira sobre esperança. Ele retorna ao hospital, mas o encontra queimando e sofre um colapso mental total gritando o nome de Lami. No presente, Senor Pink revela que Flevance pereceu quando os Piratas Donquixote terminaram com os piratas e observa que qualquer criança de 10 anos que experimentasse isso teria sua personalidade estragada. Lei atravessa o depósito de lixo e vê Corazon lendo um jornal. Lei observa que sua família e todos de Flevance morreram enquanto Corazon vivia alegando que não é justo. Segurando uma adaga, Law se aproxima de Corazon e apunhala nas costas, mas é pego por Buffalo que exclama que deve informar Doflamingo.

en.title: The First Line of Defense? The Giant Whale Laboon Appears!
en.synopsis:
As the Straw Hats ride down Reverse Mountain into the Grand Line, a huge whale appears in front of them. With the helm still broken, they are about to crash into it, but Luffy fires a cannon, sufficiently slowing the ship, just breaking Luffy's beloved seat, the ship's sheep figurehead. Infuriated, Luffy punches the whale directly in the eye. The whale swallows the Straw Hats and their ship. Only Luffy falls overboard and gets on the whale. The whale submerges. In the last second, Luffy notices a door on top of the whale. While Luffy winds up in some sort of passageway, his crew finds itself in front of a small island in the middle of green waters, with a clear blue-sky overhead. There they encounter Crocus, the whale's caretaker, who painted the inside of its stomach to look like the sky. Suddenly everything starts to shake as Laboon—which is the name of the whale—rams its head against the Red Line. Crocus leaves to give Laboon a sedative. Meanwhile, Luffy and two individuals, crash into the whale's stomach. As Crocus returns, they shot two cannonballs from their bazookas, to rip a hole in the whale's stomach, but Crocus takes the cannonballs with his own body. Then Luffy knocks them both out. Leading the Straw Hats out of the whale, Crocus explains that Laboon is a whale with a heart like a person, who has been waiting for a certain group of pirates for fifty years.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Alabasta saga: Reverse Mountain arc: (1/2)

pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto os Chapéus Straw descem a Montanha Reversa até a Grand Line, uma enorme baleia aparece na frente deles. Com o leme ainda quebrado, eles estão prestes a colidir com ele, mas Luffy dispara um canhão, o suficiente retardando a nave, apenas quebrando o assento amado de Luffy, a cabeça de carneiro da nave. Enfurecido, Luffy soca a baleia diretamente no olho. A baleia engole os Chapéus Straw e sua nave. Só Luffy cai ao mar e fica na baleia. A baleia submerge. No último segundo, Luffy percebe uma porta em cima da baleia. Enquanto Luffy acaba em algum tipo de passagem, sua tripulação se encontra em frente a uma pequena ilha no meio de águas verdes, com um céu azul claro. Lá eles encontram Crocus, o zelador da baleia, que pintou o interior de seu estômago para parecer com o céu. De repente, tudo começa a tremer como Laboon, que é o nome da baleia, lança a cabeça contra a Linha Vermelha. Crocus sai para dar a Laboon um sedativo. Enquanto isso, Luffy e dois indivíduos colidem com o estômago da baleia. Quando Crocus retorna, eles atiraram duas bolas de canhão de suas bazucas, para rasgar um buraco no estômago da baleia, mas Crocus leva as bolas de canhão com seu próprio corpo. Então Luffy nocauteia os dois. Levando os Chapéus Straw para fora da baleia, Crocus explica que Laboon é uma baleia com um coração como uma pessoa, que está esperando por um certo grupo de piratas há cinquenta anos.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

Rebecca advice others to head to the New King's Plateau, but fearing the efforts of trying to stop the Birdcage might be in vain, she takes a sword and plans to face Doflamingo himself, only to find he's already being confronted by Viola. Viola tells Rebecca to not to interfere before attacking Doflamingo with a knife, but he effortlessly dodges her and kicks her to the ground. Meanwhile, Fujitora appears behind Zoro and the samurai and imbues his blade in Haki and begins to push the Birdcage along with them with several Marines going so as well, while those who can't use Haki go to aid Franky at the SMILE Factory. As the Marines come to help Franky, several citizens come to aid not only them, but also Robin, Kyros, Leo and the Colosseum fighters. Eventually, their titanic effort causes the cage to briefly come to a standstill. However, it quickly starts moving again, and they resume pushing. Riku Doldo III and Tank Lepanto join the effort at the SMILE Factory, with the former king praising the citizens' efforts. Viola gets back up and attacks Doflamingo again, but he easily overpowers and immobilizes her. Doflamingo then takes control of Rebecca and forces her to attack her aunt, as sixty seconds remain before the Birdcage completely closes, as well as how long until Luffy regains his Haki.

en.title: A Pledge for the Next Genesis! Luffy and Uta!
en.synopsis:
Luffy and Uta spend their time competing with each other. After one competition, Uta reveals that she dreams of travelling around the world with Shanks, and bringing joy with her singing. When the Red Hair Pirates leave Luffy swears to Uta that he'll be strong enough to join Shank's crew. However, when the Red Hair Pirates return, Luffy is shocked to learn Uta is gone. Shanks claims Uta left the crew to become a singer, but Luffy doesn't believe him, knowing that Uta loved Shanks and that something must have happen to he. When Shanks still doesn't tell him, Luffy runs off telling Shanks he's done with him. Some time later, news of Elegia's destruction spread across the world, with a reported 100% mortality rate and Shanks being held responsible. Back in Windmill Village Shanks' first mate, Beckman tries to Luffy to forgive Shanks, saying there are somethings people can't talk about, but Luffy instead runs off to the mountains, where he is attacked by bandits he and Uta had a previous encounter with. He is eventually saved by Beckman and brought back to the village. The Next day Luffy asks to join Shanks' crew, but is swiftly rejected. He sits with the Red Hair Pirates, telling Shanks that he won't ask what happened because it's his and Uta's business. Back in the present day, Usopp tells Luffy that Uta is putting on a live performance, and Nami adds that it's her first one. Luffy decides to go, and the crew head for Elegia. On the island, Uta prepares for the concert, stating that a new genesis is going to begin, leading to the events of One Piece Film: Red.

en.title: Anger Erupts! I Will Take Everything upon Myself!
en.synopsis:
Cavendish shows up just in time to stop Doflamingo's attack from hitting Robin, allowing Luffy to focus on fighting Doflamingo. Luffy tells Cavendish to flee the plateau with everybody, which he obliges. As Bartolomeo makes a barrier staircase for everyone to descend on, Law wakes up and begs to stay and watch the fight between Luffy and Doflamingo. tells them that he got Luffy into this fight and that it was his duty to be there during Luffy's victory or die with him in his defeat. Robin tells Law that Luffy did not fight unless it was for personal reasons, but Law insists on staying. Cavendish and the dwarves decide to stay with Law as Robin, Rebecca and Kyros leave using stairs made by Bartolomeo. During their fight Doflamingo tells Luffy that, he's aware of Luffy being the one who defeated Crocodile, having kept an eye on him and his crew since then, while also remembering his shock upon seeing the D. in Luffy's name. Meanwhile, the Birdcage is closing in, and Luffy notices this during the fight. Many attacks are exchanged, but Doflamingo gains the upper hand. Luffy struggles to get up as Doflamingo asks him if he can win before the Birdcage closes. Even though the Birdcage will close in one hour, its effects will happen before that. People unable to run effectively could possibly be caught in 30 minutes, and in 40 minutes they would be able to hear screams. In 50 minutes, Dressrosa would be caked in blood. Doflamingo proceeds to state that the island would still be at peace if Luffy never set foot on the island. However, Luffy, remembering how Doflamingo had treated the toys and the prisoner gladiators, retorts saying there was no peace in the first place, before raising his arm and preparing to activate Fourth Gear.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (97/118)

pt-BR.title: Erupções de raiva! Eu tomarei tudo sobre mim!

Luffy diz a Cavendish para fugir do planalto com todos, o que ele obriga. Como Bartolomeo faz uma escada de barreira para todos descerem, Law acorda e implora para ficar e assistir a luta entre Luffy e Doflamingo. diz a eles que ele colocou Luffy nesta luta e que era seu dever estar lá durante a vitória de Luffy ou morrer com ele em sua derrota. Robin diz a Law que Luffy não lutou a menos que fosse por razões pessoais, mas Law insiste em ficar. Cavendish e os anões decidem ficar com Law como Robin, Rebecca e Kyros saem usando escadas feitas por Bartolomeo. Durante sua luta Doflamingo diz Luffy que, ele está ciente de Luffy ser o único que derrotou Crocodile, tendo mantido um olho nele e sua tripulação desde então, enquanto também se lembra de seu choque ao ver o D. em nome de Luffy. Enquanto isso, a Birdcage está se aproximando, e Luffy percebe isso durante a luta. Muitos ataques são trocados, mas Doflamingo ganha vantagem. Luffy se esforça para se levantar enquanto Doflamingo pergunta se ele pode ganhar antes que o Birdcage feche. Mesmo que a gaiola feche em uma hora, seus efeitos acontecerão antes disso. Pessoas incapazes de correr de forma eficaz poderiam ser pegas em 30 minutos, e em 40 minutos seriam capazes de ouvir gritos. Em 50 minutos, Dressrosa seria encharcado de sangue. Doflamingo afirma que a ilha ainda estaria em paz se Luffy nunca pisasse na ilha. No entanto, Luffy, lembrando como Doflamingo tratou os brinquedos e os gladiadores prisioneiros, retruca dizendo que não havia paz em primeiro lugar, antes de levantar o braço e se preparar para ativar a Quarta Engrenagem.

en.title: All Set! Chopperphage Nebulizer!
en.synopsis:
After taking the antidote, Chopper is cured, and the ice crumbles off his skin. Marco struggles against King and Queen, who attack him from two angles. He is sent crashing into a wall. Meanwhile, Yatappe and Tsunagoro hesitate to kill Hyougoro and Omasa, reluctant to kill their comrades. The Waiters and Pleasures beg Queen to save them. Queen turns into his brachiosaurus form and berates them, calling them useless to the crew since they have no special abilities. He tells them that they should simply succumb to the virus. He also tries to turn the pirates against Chopper, claiming that he cured himself and escaped. Delighted, he prepares to administer the cure to the people. Just before Yatappe could behead Hyougoro, Chopper kicks the sword away. He sprays the antidote sample into Hyougoro's mouth, curing him as well. Then, Miyagi and Tristan load and fire a cannon. The cannonball, named the "Chopperphage", releases a pink mist into the Performance Floor, curing all those who inhale it. Chopper confronts a furious Queen for his abhorrent use of a virus in war. Queen fires bullets at Chopper but the Pleasures rush to his aid. Since Chopper saved them, the Pleasures decide to join his side, fighting Queen. Marco takes this opportunity to grab Queen by the neck, allowing Chopper to transform into his Monster Point form and strikes Queen, as he yells at everyone, who inwardly apologizes, that he isn't a raccoon. On the rooftop, Luffy rejoins the battle against Kaido. Meanwhile, in the treasure repository, the Akazaya Nine wake up to find their wounds bandaged. They open the door to find, to their surprise, Oden greeting them.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Enquanto isso, Yatappe e Tsunagoro hesitam em matar Hyougoro e Omasa, relutantes em matar seus companheiros. Os Garçons e Prazeres imploram à Rainha para salvá-los. Rainha se transforma em seu braquiossauro e os repreende, chamando-os de inúteis para a tripulação, já que eles não têm habilidades especiais. Ele diz que eles devem simplesmente sucumbir ao vírus. Ele também tenta virar os piratas contra Chopper, alegando que ele se curou e escapou. Encantado, ele se prepara para administrar a cura ao povo. Pouco antes de Yatappe decapitar Hyougoro, Chopper chuta a espada. Ele pulveriza a amostra do antídoto na boca de Hyougoro, curando-o também. Então, Miyagi e Tristan carregam e disparam um canhão. A bala de canhão, chamada de "Chopperphage", libera uma névoa rosa no Piso de Performance, curando todos aqueles que a inalam. Chopper confronta uma rainha furiosa por seu uso abominável de um vírus na guerra. Rainha dispara balas em Chopper mas os Prazeres correm em sua ajuda. Desde que Chopper os salvou, os Pleasures decidem se juntar a ele, lutando contra a Rainha. Marco aproveita esta oportunidade para agarrar a Rainha pelo pescoço, permitindo que Chopper se transforme em sua forma de Ponto Monstro e golpeie a Rainha, enquanto ele grita para todos, que interiormente se desculpa, que ele não é um guaxinim. No telhado, Luffy se junta à batalha contra Kaido. Enquanto isso, no repositório do tesouro, os Akazaya Nine acordam para encontrar suas feridas enfaixadas. Eles abrem a porta para encontrar, para sua surpresa, Oden cumprimentando-os.

At the Royal Palace, Viola approaches Riku Doldo III, revealing that Rebecca had asked her to become crown princess in her stead, much like Scarlett had done years ago. Meanwhile, Fujitora approaches the Straw Hats and the Colosseum gladiators as they wait for Luffy to return. At the Marine camp, Bastille receives reports that Marine troops all across the island have lost their weapons and their battleships have been stitched together. Unbeknownst to them, their weapons were stolen by the dwarves, and Leo had sewn their ships together, while those who donated energy to Mansherry become paralyzed. en.title: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
en.synopsis:
In the Right Brain Tower, Yamato and Shinobu defend Momonosuke from enemy Beast Pirates, but Momonosuke becomes frustrated by his inability to fend for himself. He accidentally transforms into a pink dragon, shocking Yamato. Momonosuke thinks back to when he was in Punk Hazard, he broke into a restricted area and ate a fruit, not knowing it was Vegapunk's Artificial Devil Fruit. Yamato comments that his ability is very similar to Kaido's. In the room CP0 are in, agent talks about when the Punk Hazard scientists, led by Vegapunk, created the fruit by extracting Kaido's Lineage Factor when he was once captured by the Navy. However, the experiment was deemed a failure and the fruit was left abandoned in the laboratory following its closure. In the treasure repository, the Akazaya Nine are happy to see Oden, assuming that he must have escaped the boiling pot and survived. Oden claims to have been saved by Toki's power and offers to lead them once again. However, Ashura and Raizo become suspicious and the latter reminding Kin'emon that Toki told them that it is impossible to return to the past. Ashura slices Oden's face, but he does not bleed. Furthermore, Oden stabs Ashura with his sword, confirming he is an impostor. It is revealed he is a drawing made by Kanjuro. Kanjuro states that he was fatally wounded by Kikunojo and would not survive the battle, but he plans to kill Momonosuke in his final moments. While in the hallways, Momonosuke returns to normal and somehow reveals that Luffy is worn out but still in high spirits. On the Skull Dome's roof, as the Worst Generation are being pushed back by Kaido and Big Mom, they decide to split them up in order to beat them.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (130/189)

pt-BR.title: Oden aparece! Os corações confusos dos membros da Akazaya!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Na Torre do Cérebro Direito, Yamato e Shinobu defendem Momonosuke dos piratas inimigos, mas Momonosuke fica frustrado por sua incapacidade de se defender. Ele acidentalmente se transforma em um dragão rosa, chocando Yamato. Momonosuke pensa quando estava em Punk Hazard, ele invadiu uma área restrita e comeu uma fruta, sem saber que era a Fruta do Diabo Artificial de Vegapunk. Yamato comenta que sua habilidade é muito parecida com a de Kaido. Na sala em que o CP0 está, o agente fala sobre quando os cientistas Punk Hazard, liderados por Vegapunk, criaram a fruta extraindo o Fator de Linhagem de Kaido quando ele foi capturado pela Marinha. No entanto, o experimento foi considerado um fracasso e o fruto foi deixado abandonado no laboratório após seu fechamento. No repositório do tesouro, os Akazaya Nine estão felizes em ver Oden, assumindo que ele deve ter escapado da panela fervente e sobrevivido. Oden afirma ter sido salvo pelo poder de Toki e se oferece para liderá-los novamente. No entanto, Ashura e Raizo tornam-se suspeitos e este último lembrando Kin'emon que Toki lhes disse que é impossível voltar ao passado. Ashura corta o rosto de Oden, mas ele não sangra. Além disso, Oden esfaqueia Ashura com sua espada, confirmando que ele é um impostor. É revelado que ele é um desenho feito por Kanjuro. Kanjuro afirma que ele foi fatalmente ferido por Kikunojo e não sobreviveria à batalha, mas ele planeja matar Momonosuke em seus momentos finais. Enquanto nos corredores, Momonosuke volta ao normal e de alguma forma revela que Luffy está desgastado, mas ainda em estado elevado. Nami and Usopp who still are dealing with children who are going through severe withdrawals from not getting get any of their drug candy. Suddenly Caesar Clown appears and convinces the children to go back to the laboratory by bribing them with candy. Zorro's group are still dealing with Smiley and is furious that Kin'emon destroyed so much of the slime and decides to send huge slime attacks at them chasing them back to the laboratory. Luffy, Law, Robin, Franky, Tashigi, and Smoker in prison cell introduced to both Vergo and Monet. Meanwhile Caesar Clown's soldiers close all entrances to the laboratory leaving the G-5 Marines stranded outside to deal with Smiley. Vergo and Monet talk about what Caesar is planning but both are still quite not sure what he is planning. Smoker than calls out Vergo saying that his subordinates will die if he doesn't do anything. But Vergo doesn't care less about what happens to them. Smoker pieces it together that Vergo is responsible for the cover-ups behind the missing children in the New World. Law then states that Vergo was never really loyal to the navy because he was originally a pirate all along working for the notorious underworld broker "Joker". Vergo then threatens both Tashigi and Smoker saying they will both die, leaving his secret intact. Luffy then asks Law "who is the Joker" and Law responds as someone that they all know the notorious pirate who works for the World Government; none other than one of the Warlords Donquixote Doflamingo.

Previously, Law teleported Zoro and the others downstairs and ran into Sanji on the way. Law instructed Sanji to take care of Zoro while his group ran off to another area. Sanji begrudgingly took Zoro to another room and bandaged his wounds. Back in the present, Sanji continues to carry Zoro down the halls when he encounters Kawamatsu and Izo. On Zoro's advice, they go to the Performance Floor. On the rooftop, Luffy and Kaido continue to fight. They clash, destroying the floor under them, and Luffy is nearly thrown off the island. Luckily, he restabilizes himself on the island and continues the clash. Luffy declares he will restore the Kouzuki Family, free the Land of Wano and become the King of the Pirates. Back in the castle, Ulti gets back up and attacks Nami, grabbing her arm. However, Big Mom's homies, Prometheus, Napoleon and her new thundercloud homie, Hera, combine into a single weapon. They use Maser Cannon, unleashing a powerful beam piercing Ulti's abdomen, causing the Tobi Ropp collapse. Zeus watches from the corner, hurt that the other homies and Big Mom prefer Hera over him, even though she shows no respect to the other homies. Zeus then spots Nami, but she coldly ignores him, something he doesn't blame her for. Big Mom then approaches Zeus and he's eager to rejoin his master, but Big Mom coldly states that he's been replaced and is no longer needed in her crew. On the rooftop, Luffy begins to tire but refuses to back However, Kaido eventually triumphs, knocking Luffy unconscious and throwing him off the island, transformed back into his human form, Kaido regrets not taking Luffy's head, knowing his allies will still maintain their hope and belief in him.

Anteriormente, Law teletransportou Zoro e os outros lá embaixo e correu para Sanji no caminho. Lei instruiu Sanji a cuidar de Zoro enquanto seu grupo corria para outra área. Sanji a contragosto levou Zoro para outro quarto e enfaixou suas feridas. No presente, Sanji continua carregando Zoro pelos corredores quando encontra Kawamatsu e Izo. Seguindo o conselho de Zoro, eles vão para o Piso de Performance. No telhado, Luffy e Kaido continuam a lutar. Eles se chocam, destruindo o chão sob eles, e Luffy é quase jogado fora da ilha. Felizmente, ele se reestabiliza na ilha e continua o confronto. Luffy declara que restaurará a Família Kouzuki, libertará a Terra de Wano e se tornará o Rei dos Piratas. De volta ao castelo, Ulti se levanta e ataca Nami, agarrando seu braço. No entanto, os homens da Big Mom, Prometeu, Napoleão e seu novo inimigo, Hera, se combinam em uma única arma. Eles usam Maser Cannon, desencadeando um poderoso raio perfurando o abdômen de Ulti, causando o colapso de Tobi Ropp. Zeus assiste da esquina, machuca que os outros homens e a Big Mom preferem Hera a ele, mesmo que ela não mostre respeito aos outros homens. en.title: Sending a Shock Wave! The Worst Generation Goes Into Action!
en.synopsis:
As Fujitora apologizes, King Riku tells him to raise his head, but the Admiral says that it is important for the world to see his actions, as he reveals his reason for not attacking Doflamingo himself early on. He didn't want the Navy to appear to be heroes as they were the ones who allowed Doflamingo to do what he pleased in the first place and that he left the Straw Hats to do everything in hopes that they would succeed. Knowing the Navy may want to save face Riku orders Tank to take the Straw Hat and their allies as well as any homeless civilians to the palace. The Straw Hats reunite after the battle on Dressrosa, and Kyros disbands the Tontatta army. In Mariejois, Sakazuki meets with the Gorosei, angry about Doflamingo's deception earlier in the day. He and the Gorosei are then told about Doflamingo's defeat, shocking them. As the news about Doflamingo's defeat is carried all over the world, people that relied on Doflamingo's Underworld brokering lose their resources, and some get angry at Luffy and Law. Jewelry Bonney and the alliance of Eustass Kid, Killer, Scratchmen Apoo, and Basil Hawkins read the news, and the alliance is glad that Luffy and Law are after Kaido and not their target, Shanks. Capone Bege comments on the news, saying his friends are doing well, and orders his men to retrieve Caesar Clown, as Big Mom's flag is seen behind him. On a sky island, Urouge recovers from his wounds, when he is approached by a mysterious man. On another island, X Drake tells his crew that his father was killed by Doflamingo, but he doesn't hold a grudge about it anymore. However, his comrades are more concerned about the news, and scramble to tell Kaidou that Doflamingo has been defeated and his supply of "Smiles" has been lost. On Dressrosa, Fujitora and Sakazuki get into an argument over the Transponder Snail over Fujitora telling the world about Doflamingo's defeat so quickly. At sea, Smoker expresses relief that Fujitora got the truth out unlike he did during Crocodile's defeat, as he, Tashigi and the children from Punk Hazard are on their way to see Vegapunk. At Dressrosa, Sakazuki admits there were many ways he could have covered this up. Fujitora states that he does not want to be made into a hero for something he did not do, and that the World Government needs to take responsibility for their actions. Sakazuki shouts that it is a matter of credibility and trust, but Fujitora responds that if such meaningless trust is important, it would be better not to have any. Sakazuki tells Fujitora that he can never set foot in a Marine base until he captures Luffy and Law, which Fujitora agrees to.

Ele e os Gorosei são informados sobre a derrota de Doflamingo, chocando-os. À medida que as notícias sobre a derrota de Doflamingo são veiculadas em todo o mundo, as pessoas que confiaram no Underworld de Doflamingo perdem seus recursos, e algumas ficam com raiva de Luffy e Law. Jóias Bonney e a aliança de Eustass Kid, Killer, Scratchmen Apoo, e Basil Hawkins leram as notícias, e a aliança está feliz que Luffy e Law estão atrás de Kaido e não seu alvo, Shanks. Capone Bege comenta no noticiário, dizendo que seus amigos estão indo bem, e ordena que seus homens recuperem Caesar Clown, enquanto a bandeira da Big Mom é vista atrás dele. Em uma ilha no céu, Urouge se recupera de suas feridas, quando é abordado por um homem misterioso. Em outra ilha, X Drake diz a sua tripulação que seu pai foi morto por Doflamingo, mas ele não guarda rancor sobre isso. No entanto, seus camaradas estão mais preocupados com as notícias, e se esforçam para dizer a Kaidou que Doflamingo foi derrotado e seu suprimento de "sorrisos" foi perdido. Em Dressrosa, Fujitora e Sakazuki entram em uma discussão sobre o Snail do Transponder sobre Fujitora contando ao mundo sobre a derrota de Doflamingo tão rapidamente. No mar, Smoker expressa alívio pelo fato de Fujitora ter descoberto a verdade, ao contrário do que fez durante a derrota de Crocodile, quando ele, Tashigi e as crianças de Punk Hazard estão a caminho de ver Vegapunk. Em Dressrosa, Sakazuki admite que havia muitas maneiras de encobrir isso. Fujitora afirma que ele não quer ser transformado em herói por algo que ele não fez, e que o Governo Mundial precisa assumir a responsabilidade por suas ações. Sakazuki grita que é uma questão de credibilidade e confiança, mas Fujitora responde que se tal confiança sem sentido é importante, seria melhor não ter nenhuma. en.title: Luffy is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
en.synopsis:
Taking a critical strike from Kaido's kanabo, Luffy is defeated, deflating out of his Fourth Gear form and collapses. Unhappy with being given an unfair advantage, Kaido directs his rage at the lead CP0 agent for intervening in the battle. The agent accepts Kaido's rage as he is killed. Transforming into his dragon form, Kaido returns to the Performance Floor, declares victory against Luffy, and demands the alliance's unconditional surrender. While those like Chopper and Tama cry for the loss of Luffy, Nami refuses to believe Kaido's words, even revealing herself to him to say so. He fires a Blast Breath at her but Marco blocks it while yelling for everyone not to give up until it is over. He declares his intentions to continue the New Onigashima Project, moving Onigashima to the Flower Capital and subjecting the remaining citizens of the Land of Wano to forced labor. His words cause the samurai's morale to waver as he once demands Momonosuke presents himself, while the Beasts Pirates decide to take out Law and Kid only to be held back by their respective crews. Carrot and Cat Viper decide to rejoin the fight, while Kid and Law force themselves to stand back up as opposed to letting Kaido kill them both. As for Momonosuke, he decides that surrendering might be the best option for everyone if Luffy cannot beat him anymore, but Yamato retorts that even if surrendering may save everyone present, eventually they will all die from exhaustion as Kaido's slaves, and because of that, he will not stop fighting, even claiming that Kaido is at his limit too. He also reminds Momonosuke that this battle carries 20 years worth of weight on the people of Wano, so with that, he would rather die with him than surrender. Momonosuke accepts his words, and the battle rages on, with him stopping pulling the island away to join in the fight. On the rooftop, Luffy's unconscious body suddenly regains a heartbeat, which takes on the rhythm of drums. Hearing this, Zunesha speaks to Momonosuke and tells him that it can hear the "Drums of Liberation" for the first time in 800 years, and proclaims that Joy Boy has returned, just as Luffy's body undergoes a mysterious transformation.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (174/189)

pt-BR.title: Luffy está derrotado? A determinação dos que ficaram para trás
pt-BR.synopsis:
Tomando um ataque crítico do kanabo de Kaido, Luffy é derrotado, deflacionando fora de sua forma de Quarta Engrenagem e entra em colapso. Infeliz por ter uma vantagem injusta, Kaido dirige sua raiva contra o principal agente da CP0 por intervir na batalha. O agente aceita a raiva de Kaido quando ele é morto. Transformando-se em sua forma de dragão, Kaido retorna ao Piso de Performance, declara vitória contra Luffy, e exige a rendição incondicional da aliança. Enquanto aqueles como Chopper e Tama choram pela perda de Luffy, Nami se recusa a acreditar nas palavras de Kaido, até se revelando a ele para dizer isso. Ele dispara um sopro nela, mas Marco bloqueia enquanto grita para que todos não desistam até que acabe. Ele declara suas intenções de continuar o Novo Projeto Onigashima, movendo Onigashima para a Capital das Flores e sujeitando os cidadãos remanescentes da Terra de Wano ao trabalho forçado. Suas palavras fazem com que o moral do samurai vacile enquanto ele exige que Momonosuke se apresente, enquanto os Piratas das Bestas decidem tirar Law e Kid apenas para serem retidos por suas respectivas tripulações. Cenoura e Cat Viper decidem voltar à luta, enquanto Kid e Law se forçam a se levantar em vez de deixar Kaido matar os dois. Quanto a Momonosuke, ele decide que a rendição pode ser a melhor opção para todos se Luffy não puder mais vencê-lo, mas Yamato responde que mesmo que a rendição possa salvar todos os presentes, eventualmente todos eles morrerão de exaustão como escravos de Kaido, e por isso, ele não vai parar de lutar, mesmo alegando que Kaido está no seu limite também. Ele também lembra Momonosuke que esta batalha carrega 20 anos de peso sobre o povo de Wano, então com isso, ele prefere morrer com ele do que se render. Momonosuke aceita suas palavras, e a batalha continua, com ele parando de puxar a ilha para se juntar à luta. No telhado, o corpo inconsciente de Luffy de repente recupera um batimento cardíaco, que assume o ritmo da bateria. Ao ouvir isso, Zunesha fala com Momonosuke e diz que ele pode ouvir os "Drums of Liberation" pela primeira vez em 800 anos, e proclama que Joy Boy voltou, assim como o corpo de Luffy passa por uma transformação misteriosa.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!
en.synopsis:
Across Onigashima, the Gifters who have eaten Tama's dango begin to switch sides, attacking former allies. A Mary reports the mass-betrayal to CP0 as the combat devolves even further into chaos. The Beasts Pirates react in angry confusion, while the Alliance members welcome the change. Nami, Tama, and Usopp celebrate their success, drawing attention from Queen; however, as he tries to shoot them, he is attacked by Sanji, instead shooting the inside of his mouth. Queen welcomes him as Judge's son, angering Sanji, and reveals that he and Judge were former members of the science group MADS. As he prepares to fight, Queen reveals he is a cyborg and enters his Human-Beast Form. The surrounding Beast Pirates panic at his transformation, but Sanji ignores him, confirming with Chopper that Zoro will recover. As he turns to ask, however, he notices that Chopper has entered a new transformation, the Baby Geezer, as a result of his Rumble Ball transformation. However, as they talk, Sanji is attacked by Queen, and he prepares to face off. Chopper begins explaining his new form to Tristan, and Sanji begins fighting Queen. His explanation complete, Chopper turns to helping Zoro. Miyagi informs him about a powerful instant recovery drug from Zou; however, should he take it, his pain will be doubled when the drug wears off. Chopper decides not to give Zoro the drug, but Zoro insists on receiving it, stating that he wants to return to the fight. Elsewhere, the CP0 agents calculate the traitorous Gifters, estimating 300 people switched sides. Meanwhile, Nami, Tama, and Usopp try to find a safe space to hide, having completed their mission. As they run through the halls, they are attacked by a group of Waiters; however, they're suddenly saved by Daifugo and joined by Speed and Gazelleman, who offer lifts to the group. Gazelleman also informs them that he found Komachiyo unconscious. Elsewhere, Jimbei and Who's-Who begin to fight. Among his attacks, Who's-Who incorporates the Six Powers, prompting Jimbei to remark that he's using a World Government fighting style. He brings up a story about a CP9 agent escaping from prison, and Who's-Who confirms that he's the agent as he transforms into his Human-Beast Form. As the two continue fighting, Who's-Who begins explaining his past as a Government agent who was on par with Rob Lucci, though Jimbei has trouble understanding how the story is relevant to him. However, Who's-Who explains that 13 years ago, a Devil Fruit that he was assigned to protect on a Government ship was stolen; the Gum-Gum Fruit.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (143/189)

pt-BR.title: Um dramático aumento de aliados! Straw chapéus lutar de volta!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Do outro lado de Onigashima, os Gifters que comeram o dango de Tama começam a mudar de lado, atacando antigos aliados. Uma Maria relata a traição à CP0 enquanto o combate se transforma ainda mais no caos. Os Piratas das Bestas reagem com raiva, enquanto os membros da Aliança dão as boas vindas à mudança. Nami, Tama e Usopp comemoram seu sucesso, chamando a atenção da Rainha; no entanto, enquanto ele tenta atirar neles, ele é atacado por Sanji, em vez disso, atirando no interior de sua boca. Rainha o recebe como filho do juiz, irritando Sanji, e revela que ele e Judge eram ex-membros do grupo de ciência MADS. Enquanto ele se prepara para lutar, Queen revela que ele é um ciborgue e entra em sua forma de besta humana. Os Piratas da Besta ao redor entram em pânico com sua transformação, mas Sanji o ignora, confirmando com Chopper que Zoro se recuperará. Quando ele se vira para perguntar, no entanto, ele percebe que Chopper entrou em uma nova transformação, o Baby Geezer, como resultado de sua transformação Rumble Ball. No entanto, enquanto falam, Sanji é atacado pela Rainha, e ele se prepara para enfrentar. Chopper começa a explicar sua nova forma para Tristan, e Sanji começa a lutar contra a Rainha. Sua explicação completa, Chopper se volta para ajudar Zoro. Miyagi o informa sobre uma poderosa droga de recuperação instantânea de Zou. No entanto, se ele a tomar, sua dor será dobrada quando a droga se desgastar. Chopper decide não dar Zoro a droga, mas Zoro insiste em recebê-lo, afirmando que ele quer voltar para a luta. Em outro lugar, os agentes da CP0 calculam os traidores Gifters, estimando 300 pessoas trocando de lado. Enquanto isso, Nami, Tama e Usopp tentam encontrar um espaço seguro para se esconder, tendo completado sua missão. Enquanto correm pelos corredores, eles são atacados por um grupo de Garçons, no entanto, eles são subitamente salvos por Daifugo e unidos por Speed e Gazelleman, que oferecem elevadores para o grupo. Gazelleman também informa que encontrou Komachiyo inconsciente. Em outro lugar, Jimbei e Who's-Who começam a lutar. Entre seus ataques, Who's-Who incorpora os Seis Poderes, levando Jimbei a observar que ele está usando um estilo de luta do Governo Mundial. Ele traz uma história sobre um agente da CP9 fugindo da prisão, e quem confirma que ele é o agente enquanto se transforma em sua forma de besta humana. Enquanto os dois continuam lutando, Who's-Who começa a explicar seu passado como um agente do governo que estava a par com Rob Lucci, embora Jimbei tenha dificuldade em entender como a história é relevante para ele. No entanto, Who's-Who explica que 13 anos atrás, uma Fruta do Diabo que ele foi designado para proteger em uma nave do governo foi roubada, a Fruta Gum-Gum.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Thunder Bagua! Here Comes Kaido's Son!
en.synopsis:
A mysterious masked figure runs through the halls, excited to meet someone while being chased by the Beast Pirates who see them. They crosses through several rooms, including the one where Kid is fighting Beast Pirates. Meanwhile, Ulti checks on her brother Page One. She again throws a fit in front of him, remembering how she rode on Page One's back down the staircase. She then confronts Luffy, being told that he is a pirate intruder. They immediately clash and headbutt each other, each attempting to knock the other down. Ulti gets the upper hand and slams Luffy into the floor. She transforms into the Human-Beast Form form of her Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Ancient Type Model: Pachycephalosaurus while Page One transforms into his full spinosaurus form. Although Luffy gets up, he acknowledges that he is in an Emperor's castle and fights at full strength. Eventually, Luffy grabs onto Ulti's horns and slams her into the ground, then defeats Page One with a Haki-imbued Gear Third punch. Enrage, Ulti transforms into her Beast Form, headbutting Luffy. She prepares a more powerful headbutt, but the masked figure appears and uses a kanabou to strike her down with the same move Kaido used to beat Luffy in their fight. Excited to see Luffy, the masked figure carries him away, saying he has been waiting for Luffy, before revealing himself to be Yamato, Kaidou's son.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.synopsis:
Uma misteriosa figura mascarada corre pelos corredores, animada para conhecer alguém enquanto é perseguida pelos Piratas da Besta que os vêem. Atravessam várias salas, incluindo aquela onde Kid está lutando contra os Piratas da Besta. Enquanto isso, Ulti verifica o irmão dela, Page 1. Ela novamente joga um ataque na frente dele, lembrando como ela montou na página um de volta para a escada. Ela então confronta Luffy, sendo dito que ele é um pirata intruso. Eles imediatamente se chocam e batem a cabeça um no outro, cada um tentando derrubar o outro. Ulti pega a mão superior e bate Luffy no chão. Ela se transforma na forma humano-besta de sua Fruta Dragão-Dragão, Tipo Antigo Modelo: Paquicéfalosauro, enquanto a Página Um se transforma em sua forma completa de spinosaurus. Embora Luffy se levante, ele reconhece que está no castelo de um imperador e luta com força total. Eventualmente, Luffy se agarra aos chifres de Ulti e a derruba no chão, depois derrota a Página Um com um terceiro soco de Haki-imbued Gear. Enfurecedora, Ulti se transforma em sua forma de besta, batendo na cabeça Luffy. Ela prepara uma cabeça mais poderosa, mas a figura mascarada aparece e usa um kanabou para derrubá-la com o mesmo movimento que Kaido usou para vencer Luffy em sua luta. Animado para ver Luffy, a figura mascarada o leva embora, dizendo que ele estava esperando por Luffy, antes de revelar-se ser Yamato, filho de Kaidou.

Though Doberman's crew were shocked by Lucci's actions, the Vice Admiral voices that is the reason why he is not taking actions in securing Robin as Lucci is suitable for the task. At the forest, Ace becomes more fond of Luffy as a brother when Luffy is nearly mauled by a bear. After seven years of intensive training, Ace departs from the Goa Kingdom to the ocean and Dadan is emotionally distraught. Three more years pass and Luffy bids farewell to everyone as he departs on his journey to the Grand Line. Marco also tells Cat Viper leave the island because Edward Weevil and his mother, Buckin, who used to be shipmates with Whitebeard nearly forty years ago, are looking for Whitebeard's treasure. Though unsure if Buckin's claims that Weevil is Whitebeard's biological son are true or not, Marco doubts they'll believe that the treasure no longer exists. en.title: Luffy Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!
en.synopsis:
Kaido watches as Luffy falls into the ocean, remarking that though Luffy coated himself in Conqueror's Haki, he was still sloppy and unable to wield it perfectly. He then declares that Luffy will never become Joy Boy. Inside the palace, Big Mom rejects Zeus, no longer wanting him in her crew. She instructs Hera to eat Zeus so she can gain more power from his soul. Knowing that Big Mom is trying to take his life, Zeus attempts to reconcile with Nami, apologizing for his cowardice, but Nami refuses to forgive her. So, Zeus rebels for one final time against his mother, . Big Mom effortlessly subdues him and removes his soul before offering him to Hera. Taking pity in Zeus, Nami tries to help him by giving him Black Balls, but both they and Zeus are devoured by Hera. Meanwhile, on the Performance Floor, Queen and Perospero battle against and Chopper and the defected Beast Pirates, with Perospero raining down a swarm of candy arrows onto the floor striking down many combatants. An enraged then Chopper gets the upper hand by slamming Queen's body into the floor and throwing him into a wall, but Queen is unharmed while Chopper is left exhausted. On the third floor, Yamato continues to run through the halls with her fake Momonosuke, defeating a group of Gifters who fall for his decoy. The real Momonosuke is waiting in the crawl space for backup. While he is in hiding, he reads the Oden's, which tells of his adventures as a pirate. However, Momonosuke suddenly detects another mysterious voice. Unbeknownst to him, he is watched by another Mary. Having located him, Bao Huang reports Momonosuke's location to Kaido, who decides to personally pursue him. Hera receives a surge in energy from eating Zeus, and Nami's group decides to leave. As Tama also fled with them, Big Mom loses her compassion for her. Big Mom attacks them, but Kid appears and confronts her.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Ele então declara que Luffy nunca se tornará Joy Boy. Dentro do palácio, Big Mom rejeita Zeus, não querendo mais ele em sua tripulação. Ela instrui Hera a comer Zeus para que ela possa ganhar mais poder de sua alma. Sabendo que Big Mom está tentando tirar a vida, Zeus tenta se reconciliar com Nami, pedindo desculpas por sua covardia, mas Nami se recusa a perdoá-la. Então, Zeus se rebela pela última vez contra sua mãe. Big Mom sem esforço subjuga-o e remove sua alma antes de oferecê-lo a Hera. Com pena de Zeus, Nami tenta ajudá-lo dando-lhe Bolas Negras, mas ambos eles e Zeus são devorados por Hera. Enquanto isso, no Performance Floor, Queen e Perospero lutam contra Chopper e os piratas da Besta desertas, com Perospero chovendo um enxame de flechas doces no chão atingindo muitos combatentes. Um Chopper enfurecido então consegue a vantagem batendo o corpo da Rainha no chão e jogando-o em uma parede, mas a Rainha está ilesa enquanto Chopper fica exausto. No terceiro andar, Yamato continua a correr pelos corredores com seu falso Momonosuke, derrotando um grupo de Gifters que se apaixonam por seu chamariz. O verdadeiro Momonosuke está esperando no espaço para reforços. Enquanto ele está escondido, ele lê Oden's, que fala de suas aventuras como um pirata. No entanto, Momonosuke de repente detecta outra voz misteriosa. Sem o conhecimento dele, ele é vigiado por outra Maria. Tendo localizado ele, Bao Huang relata a localização de Momonosuke para Kaido, que decide persegui-lo pessoalmente. Hera recebe uma onda de energia de comer Zeus, e o grupo de Nami decide sair. On the sea floor, Vander Decken IX reveals that he plans to marry the princess, using his Mark-Mark Fruit curse to throw a giant axe at her. Meanwhile, at Ryugu Palace, the Minister of the Left accuses the Straw Hats for the conspiracy of destroying the Island and kidnapping the mermaids. Luffy saves the princess by stopping the axe. When the palace guards rush in, the princess hides Luffy and is told that the Straw Hat Pirates will be detained in the castle's dungeons, as Zoro has been captured. The princess apologizes for her rudeness and allows Luffy to eat her food, revealing that her name is Shirahoshi. She then reveals that she was in the tower for 10 years. After being accidentally insulted by Luffy, Shirahoshi reveals that she wants to see a lot of places and Luffy immediately orders her to leave with him. Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp and Brook confront the palace guards just as Zoro, who has escaped from the guards, arrives. On the Noah, Decken meets Hordy, and the two fishmen form an alliance to plot the complete destruction of Fishman Island.

Quando os guardas do palácio correm, a princesa esconde Luffy e é informada que os Piratas Straw Hat serão detidos nas masmorras do castelo, como Zoro foi capturado. A princesa se desculpa por sua grosseria e permite que Luffy coma sua comida, revelando que seu nome é Shirahoshi. Ela então revela que esteve na torre por 10 anos. Depois de ser insultada acidentalmente por Luffy, Shirahoshi revela que ela quer ver muitos lugares e Luffy imediatamente ordena que ela saia com ele. Enquanto isso, Nami, Usopp e Brook confrontam os guardas do palácio assim como Zoro, que escapou dos guardas, chega. en.title: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
en.synopsis:
Wano Country starts to thrive after Orochi is deposed and Kaido is defeated. The tale of the Raid on Onigashima is narrated on stage in front of an audience. Elsewhere, Momonosuke, Kin'emon, and Yamato rush towards Tokage Port to catch up to the Straw Hat Pirates. On the way, Yamato tells Momonosuke that she will be staying in Wano instead of going with Luffy because she wants to do as Oden did and travel across Wano before setting out into the world. Meanwhile, Momonosuke feels betrayed that Luffy would leave him behind before even saying farewell, despite all the adventures they had together. Kin'emon also feels slighted by the Straw Hats' actions. At the Tokage Port, Luffy parts ways with Law and Kid and they say their not-so-friendly farewells. The Kid Pirates and Heart Pirates sail towards their agreed destinations. Before the Straw Hats can follow them, Momonosuke arrives at the beach, running. The young shogun expresses how hurt he is that the Straw Hats were leaving without saying their goodbyes. He bursts into tears, begging them not to go. Luffy hands him a Straw Hat Jolly Roger as a sign of their friendship and to remind him of their time together. He tells Momonosuke that he will always think of him as his little brother. He adds that if Momonosuke, Kin'emon, and Yamato ever decided to become pirates, he will return and pick them up anytime. The Straw Hats finally set sail and head to Hakumai, Wano's official port that has a lift to lower ships, which is a much safer alternative than going through the waterfalls they previously went through when they arrived at Wano. Kid ridicules Luffy and Law for using the official port―a much safer option, which is characteristic of an "average pirate". Law and Luffy are irked by Kid's remarks and take the provocation as a challenge and head towards the waterfalls instead, causing call all three crews to go over the falls. Meanwhile, the tale of the Raid on Onigashima continues and the audience listened to how Wano was saved from its darkest hour. The citizens of Wano learned of Big Mom's role in the great battle and as a result has become a legend in the country called "O-Lin the Great Youkai" and Kaido is now known as the "Dragon King". As everyone listened in awe of how the "three mighty outlaws" recruited by Shogun Momonosuke overcame the menacing forces, the narrator of the epic tale told Hiyori's final words to the former shogun as he burned to death: "Black charcoal would not be called Kurozumi if it wasn't burned!" As Momonosuke heads back to the Flower Capital, he contemplates where to fly the Straw Hats' flag as the curtain closes on the Land of Wano Arc.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (189/189)

pt-BR.title: A à ltima Cortina! Luffy e Voto de Momonosuke
pt-BR.synopsis:
Wano Country começa a prosperar depois que Orochi é deposto e Kaido é derrotado. A história do Raid em Onigashima é narrada no palco na frente de uma audiência. Em outro lugar, Momonosuke, Kin'emon e Yamato correm em direção ao Porto Tokage para alcançar os Piratas Straw Hat. No caminho, Yamato diz a Momonosuke que ela vai ficar em Wano em vez de ir com Luffy porque ela quer fazer o que Oden fez e viajar através de Wano antes de sair para o mundo. Enquanto isso, Momonosuke se sente traído que Luffy iria deixá-lo para trás antes mesmo de dizer adeus, apesar de todas as aventuras que tiveram juntos. Kin'emon também se sente menosprezado pelas ações dos Straw Hats. No Porto de Tokage, Luffy se separa de Law e Kid e eles dizem suas despedidas não tão amigáveis. Os Piratas Kid e Piratas Heart navegar em direção aos seus destinos acordados. Antes que os Straw Hats possam segui-los, Momonosuke chega na praia, correndo. O jovem shogun expressa como ele está ferido que os chapéus Straw estavam saindo sem dizer suas despedidas. Ele explode em lágrimas, implorando-lhes para não ir. Luffy dá-lhe um Straw Hat Jolly Roger como um sinal de sua amizade e para lembrá-lo de seu tempo juntos. Ele diz a Momonosuke que sempre pensará nele como seu irmão mais novo. Ele acrescenta que se Momonosuke, Kin'emon e Yamato decidirem se tornar piratas, ele vai voltar e pegá-los a qualquer momento. Os Straw Hats finalmente zarparam e se dirigem para Hakumai, o porto oficial de Wano que tem um elevador para navios mais baixos, o que é uma alternativa muito mais segura do que atravessar as cachoeiras que eles anteriormente passaram quando chegaram em Wano. Kid ridiculariza Luffy e Law por usar o porto oficial - uma opção muito mais segura, que é característica de um "pirata comum". Law e Luffy estão irritados com as observações de Kid e tomam a provocação como um desafio e vão em direção às cachoeiras, fazendo com que as três equipes passem pelas quedas. Enquanto isso, a história do Raid em Onigashima continua e o público ouviu como Wano foi salvo de sua hora mais escura. Os cidadãos de Wano souberam do papel da Big Mom na grande batalha e, como resultado, tornou-se uma lenda no país chamado "O-Lin, o Grande Youkai" e Kaido é agora conhecido como o "Rei Dragão". Enquanto todos ouviam com admiração como os "três poderosos foras-da-lei" recrutados por Shogun Momonosuke superaram as forças ameaçadoras, o narrador do conto épico disse as últimas palavras de Hiyori ao ex-xogun enquanto ele queimava até a morte: "Carvão preto não seria chamado Kurozumi se não fosse queimado!" Enquanto Momonosuke volta para a Capital das Flores, ele contempla onde voar o Straw's Hat.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

Hearing Sai's and Baby 5's conversation Chinjao, also misunderstanding, reminds Sai he's arranged to be married to the daughter of the Niho Navy's leader to form an alliance. When Baby 5 asks Sai how to be of use to him he jokingly tells her to die, which she responds by happily preparing to commit suicide. In a flashback, it's revealed that as a young child, Baby 5 was abandoned by her mother who called her useless and unwanted, which is why she is willing to do whatever's asked of her as a way to feel needed. Not wanting to win this way, Sai tries to stop her, but Chinjao attacks him for trying to help an enemy. Sai counters resulting in Chinjao's head drill getting bent, before slapping Baby 5 and telling her to value her life more. Chinjao awakens and instead of being angry, is proud of Sai for surpassing him and officially dubs him the head of the Happo Navy, promises to break off Sai's engagement and bestows his technique on Sai's leg, before being struck down by Lao G, who had used a technique to restore his body to its prime. en.title: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
en.synopsis:
As Doflamingo sleeps, he starts dreaming about his past when people talk about how they should kill the Donquixote Family because they are former World Nobles who will not be saved by the Marines, Doflamingo begins to sweat and grind his teeth in agitation. In the past, Doflamingo, Rosinante, and Homing were hung from the windows of their burning house by ropes around their arms and blindfolded. A mob of commoners desired revenge for the suffering the Celestial Dragons had inflicted on them and debated how they should kill them, but keep them alive so they could suffer. The citizens recount the sufferings caused by the World Nobles, who had hurt them, their relatives, and their countries whenever they felt like it. Doflamingo screams in terror as a man demanded to know if they ever felt any kind of pain before waking up in a cold sweat as the Transponder Snail rings. After putting on his sunglasses and drinking alcohol, Doflamingo picks it up and is informed that Law did something. Seventeen years ago in Mariejois, several World Nobles expressed their shock at Homing and his family giving up their status to become normal humans. This prompted Homing to claim they had been human ever since they was born, offending the World Nobles. Soon after, they were taking to a non-member island in the North Blue with a house and assets prepared for them. Homing then handed over his family's World Noble identification chips and told his family that they would lead a humble life there. But, after Homing revealed that they moved from Mariejois, the people burned their house downed searching for them. The Donquixote Family watched in terror from the forest nearby and ran through a rainy forest to a run-down shack in a garbage dump where they took shelter. Then, they found shelter in a small village, and Homing contacted the World Nobles for help, however they refused and told him to never call again. Soon after, Doflamingo and Rosinante were caught stealing bread and were beat up as punishment and ate from a garbage pile before bringing their mother some food, only to find her sick. Eventually, she dies leaving Rosinante crying as Doflamingo blamed Homing for her death. the angry mob then finds them and Homing begs them to pardon his sons as Doflamingo cursed his father for bringing them to ruin. In the present, Giolla and Machvise bring Law to Doflamingo as Giolla reveals that they found him trying to escape. As Buffalo and Baby 5 watch, with Buffalo noting that they will torture Law for stabbing Corazon, Law notices Corazon is present and wonders if he will die. However, Doflamingo reveals that he called Law to welcome him to the Donquixote Pirates. Doflamingo explains how Law has a certain quality in his eyes after experiencing such a horrible past, while Law wonders why Corazon has not yet told Doflamingo what happened. When Law points out that he is going to die in three years regardless, but Doflamingo claims that this depends on his luck before explaining how they specialize the black market and handle Devil Fruits, which means there could be a fruit that can cure him. Doflamingo states that he will train Law to become his right-hand man in ten years. Corazon begins coughing and reveals the wound on his abdomen, prompting Doflamingo to ask what happened. However, Corazon communicates that an enemy caused it and he finished him off, prompting Doflamingo to tell him to get his wound treated as a shocked Law wonders if Corazon covered up for him. Later, Doflamingo informs his crew that they will be moving their base toward Reverse Mountain while expanding their business. As they were moving across the sea, they engaged in combat with the Marines and pulled bank heists. At one point, Law and Baby 5 were attacked by a pirate named Wellington, but were saved by Doflamingo and his executives. Law began studying under Doflamingo, training with firearms under Gladius, learning martial arts with Lao G, and practicing swordsmanship with Diamante. Two years later, Baby 5 and Buffalo tell Law their real names, but he initially refuses to tell them his. However, Buffalo claims that he will tell Doflamingo of Law stabbing Corazon two years ago if he does not reveal his true name, prompting Law to reveal his full name is Trafalgar D. Water Law, which alerts Corazon. Law admits that he should not be telling them this because his family has kept the initial D. a secret for many generations, and is irritated when Baby 5 and Buffalo complain about it not being interesting. However, Law is suddenly grabbed by the collar and hauled away by Corazon. After being thrown into an alley, Corazon asks Law if what he said before is true. A surprised Law finds out Corazon can speak and Corazon tells him to get away because he should not be around Doflamingo with the initial D. in his name.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (74/118)

pt-BR.title: Um Dragão Celestial! Doffy's Stormy Past!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto Doflamingo dorme, ele começa a sonhar com seu passado quando as pessoas falam sobre como devem matar a Família Donquixote porque são ex-Nobres do Mundo que não serão salvos pelos Fuzileiros Navais, Doflamingo começa a suar e moer os dentes em agitação. No passado, Doflamingo, Rosinante e Homing foram pendurados nas janelas de sua casa em chamas por cordas ao redor de seus braços e vendados. Uma multidão de plebeus desejava vingança pelo sofrimento que os Dragões Celestiais infligiram a eles e debateram como deveriam matá-los, mas mantê-los vivos para que pudessem sofrer. Os cidadãos contam os sofrimentos causados pelos Nobres do Mundo, que os feriram, seus parentes e seus países sempre que se sentiam assim. Doflamingo grita de terror como um homem exigiu para saber se eles já sentiram algum tipo de dor antes de acordar em um suor frio como o Snail Transponder toca. Depois de colocar seus óculos de sol e beber álcool, Doflamingo pega e é informado que Law fez algo. Dezessete anos atrás, em Mariejois, vários Nobres do Mundo expressaram seu choque em Homing e sua família desistindo de seu status para se tornarem humanos normais. Isso levou Homing a afirmar que eles eram humanos desde que nasceram, ofendendo os Nobres do Mundo. Logo depois, eles estavam levando para uma ilha não-membro no norte azul com uma casa e bens preparados para eles. Homing então entregou os chips de identificação World Noble de sua família e disse a sua família que eles levariam uma vida humilde lá. Mas, depois que Homing revelou que eles se mudaram de Mariejois, as pessoas queimaram sua casa procurando por eles. A Família Donquixote assistiu aterrorizada da floresta próxima e correu através de uma floresta chuvosa até uma cabana em um depósito de lixo onde se refugiaram. Então, encontraram abrigo em uma pequena aldeia, e Homing contatou os Nobres do Mundo para obter ajuda, mas eles se recusaram e disseram a ele para nunca mais ligar. Logo depois, Doflamingo e Rosinante foram pegos roubando pão e foram espancados como punição e comeram de uma pilha de lixo antes de trazer comida para sua mãe, só para encontrá-la doente. Eventualmente, ela morre deixando Rosinante chorando enquanto Doflamingo culpava Homing por sua morte. A multidão enfurecida então os encontra e Homing os implora para perdoar seus filhos como Doflamingo amaldiçoou seu pai por trazê-los à ruína. No presente, Giolla e Machvise trazem Law para Doflamingo, enquanto Giolla revela que o encontraram tentando escapar. Como Buffalo e Baby 5 assistem, com Buffalo observando que eles vão torturar a Lei por esfaquear Corazon, Law percebe Corazon está presente e se pergunta se ele vai morrer. No entanto, Doflamingo revela que ele chamou Law para recebê-lo aos Piratas Donquixote. Doflamingo explica como Law tem uma certa qualidade em seus olhos depois de experimentar um passado tão horrível, enquanto Law se pergunta por que Corazon ainda não contou ao Doflamingo o que aconteceu. Quando Law aponta que ele vai morrer em três anos, independentemente, mas Doflamingo afirma que isso depende de sua sorte antes de explicar como eles se especializam no mercado negro e lidam com as frutas do diabo, o que significa que pode haver uma fruta que possa curá-lo. Doflamingo afirma que treinará Law para se tornar seu braço direito em dez anos. Corazon começa a tossir e revela a ferida em seu abdômen, levando Doflamingo a perguntar o que aconteceu. No entanto, Corazon comunica que um inimigo causou isso e ele terminou, levando Doflamingo a dizer-lhe para obter sua ferida tratada como uma Lei chocada se pergunta se Corazon encobriu para ele. Mais tarde, Doflamingo informa sua tripulação que eles estarão movendo sua base para a Montanha Reversa enquanto expandem seus negócios. Enquanto se moviam pelo mar, eles se envolveram em combate com os fuzileiros navais e puxaram assaltos a bancos. Em um ponto, Law e Baby 5 foram atacados por um pirata chamado Wellington, mas foram salvos por Doflamingo e seus executivos. Law começou a estudar sob Doflamingo, treinando com armas de fogo sob Gladius, aprendendo artes marciais com Lao G, e praticando espadachim com Diamante. Dois anos depois, Baby 5 e Buffalo dizem a Law seus nomes reais, mas ele inicialmente se recusa a dizer-lhes o seu. No entanto, Buffalo afirma que ele vai dizer Doflamingo da Lei esfaqueando Corazon há dois anos, se ele não revelar seu verdadeiro nome, levando Law a revelar seu nome completo é Trafalgar D. Lei da Água, que alerta Corazon. Law admite que ele não deveria estar dizendo isso porque sua família manteve o D inicial em segredo por muitas gerações, e fica irritado quando Baby 5 e Buffalo reclamam que não é interessante. No entanto, Law é subitamente agarrada pelo colarinho e levada por Corazon. Depois de ser jogado em um beco, Corazon pergunta a Law se o que ele disse antes é verdade. Uma Lei surpresa descobre que Corazon pode falar e Corazon diz para ele fugir porque ele não deveria estar perto de Doflamingo com o D. inicial em seu nome.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.synopsis:

Meanwhile, Usopp, Franky, and Law hide at a house in Ebisu Town, as Yasuie tells them Zoro ran off after someone stole one of his swords. Usopp, Franky, and Law start to wonder where Sanji is when Usopp realizes he's going to use his Raid Suit to sneak into women bathhouses. At the bathhouse in the Flower Capital, Shinobu tell Nami and Robin about Hyogoro, who was highly-respected person during Oden's reign, often using his influence to help those in need, even gaining the loyalty from the leaders of the other five regions and Oden himself. However, it is rumored that when Hyougoro refused to serve Orochi after took over he was killed. On the other hand, Fukurokuju agreed to serve Orochi and was spared, becoming the leader of his personal ninja force, with Shinobu being a member before defecting. In Udon prison, Raizo is surprised to see that the prisoner being fed poisoned fish is Kawamatsu while Queen forces Luffy and Hyogoro fight in sumo matches with collars that will cut their heads off if they leave the ring, giving Luffy a chance to live if he agrees to join the Beast Pirates. Queen then uncuffs Luffy to give him a fighting chance, leaving Raizo shocked upon realizing he stole the wrong key. Luffy then asks if they could be released from prison if they beat Queen.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (37/189)

Enquanto isso, Usopp, Franky e Law se escondem em uma casa na cidade de Ebisu, como Yasuie diz a eles que Zoro fugiu depois que alguém roubou uma de suas espadas. Usopp, Franky, e Law começam a se perguntar onde Sanji é quando Usopp percebe que ele vai usar seu terno Raid para esgueirar-se em banheiros de mulheres. No banheiro na Capital das Flores, Shinobu diz a Nami e Robin sobre Hyogoro, que era uma pessoa muito respeitada durante o reinado de Oden, muitas vezes usando sua influência para ajudar os necessitados, até mesmo ganhando a lealdade dos líderes das outras cinco regiões e do próprio Oden. No entanto, há rumores de que quando Hyougoro se recusou a servir Orochi depois de assumir, ele foi morto. Por outro lado, Fukurokuju concordou em servir Orochi e foi poupado, tornando-se o líder de sua força ninja pessoal, com Shinobu sendo um membro antes de desertar. Na prisão de Udon, Raizo fica surpreso ao ver que o prisioneiro que está sendo alimentado com peixe envenenado é Kawamatsu enquanto a Rainha força Luffy e Hyogoro a lutarem em partidas sumô com colares que cortarão suas cabeças se saírem do ringue, dando a Luffy uma chance de viver se ele concordar em se juntar aos Piratas da Fera. Rainha então desfaz Luffy para dar-lhe uma chance de lutar, deixando Raizo chocado ao perceber que ele roubou a chave errada. Luffy então pergunta se eles poderiam ser libertados da prisão se vencessem Queen.

en.title: The Onslaught of Kazenbo: Orochi's Evil Clutches Close in
en.synopsis:
An angered Big Mom promises to inflict unspeakable pain towards Law and Kid. She sics her homies on the two which they barely fend off, while at the same time Izo has Marco carry him to the inner castle Meanwhile, Kazenbo is wreaking havoc and burning everything on its path, causing both samurai and Beast Pirates all flee in a panic. Elsewhere, Brook and Robin are on the run with the CP0 hot on their tail, jumping down to a lower floor. Yamato is still charging her way towards the armory, with Apoo and Fuga following her and Drake chasing Apoo. When Robin and Brook land in Fuga's hair CP0 tries to follow them but they're engulfed by Kazenbo as it falls from the ceiling. Not wasting time Yamato tells Fuga as she heads to the armory. In the Treasure Repository, Orochi listens with excitement to the chaos brought about by Kazenbo, which was created to exact vengeance in the name of the Kurozami Clan. Suddenly, he hears a shamisen playing nearby. He is drawn to the sound which reminds him of his beloved Komurasaki. Outside, a determined Momonosuke is frantically creating flame clouds to prevent Onigashima from crashing down onto the Flower Capital. Zoro and King are still in battle. In his pteranodon form, King grabs his crest and pulls his head back, which also pulls back his beak before letting go of his crest causing his head flings forward at extreme speed in a attack Zoro deems to be unblockable. He notices the flames on King's back, and wonders out loud if this is an ability from his Devil Fruit. King hears this and answers that it is not a feature of the Pteranodon. Zoro attacks with Black Rope Dragon Twister but King easily overcomes this. Zoro is at a loss at how durable King is, noting that it must be because of his dinosaur Devil Fruit. King, turning back into his human form, agrees but hints that it might also be because he is also a little unique. Zoro concludes that King's durability, wings, and flames are a feature of a tribe that is unknown to him. Zoro is knocked down and exhausted. All of a sudden, Zoro hears the sound of a shamisen which causes Enma to start draining his Haki and emaciate his arm. Inside, Orochi crawls towards the shamisen player and sees Komurasaki alive and well. He cries out in tears while she greets him with a smile.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: As garras do mal de Orochi
pt-BR.synopsis:
Uma mãe enfurecida promete infligir dor indescritível para Law e Kid. Ela sics seus homies sobre os dois que mal se afastam, enquanto ao mesmo tempo Izo tem Marco levá-lo para o castelo interior Enquanto isso, Kazenbo está causando estragos e queimando tudo em seu caminho, causando samurai e Piratas da Besta todos fogem em pânico. Em outro lugar, Brook e Robin estão fugindo com o CP0 quente na cauda, pulando para um andar inferior. Yamato ainda está correndo em direção ao arsenal, com Apoo e Fuga seguindo ela e Drake perseguindo Apoo. Quando Robin e Brook pousam no cabelo de Fuga, CP0 tenta segui-los, mas eles são engolidos por Kazenbo quando cai do teto. Não perdendo tempo Yamato diz a Fuga como ela vai para o arsenal. No Repositório do Tesouro, Orochi ouve com entusiasmo o caos causado por Kazenbo, que foi criado para vingar-se em nome do Clã Kurozami. De repente, ele ouve um shamisen tocando nas proximidades. Ele é atraído pelo som que o lembra de sua amada Komurasaki. Lá fora, um determinado Momonosuke está freneticamente criando nuvens de chamas para evitar que Onigashima caia na Capital das Flores. Zoro e King ainda estão em batalha. Em sua forma de pteranodonte, King agarra sua crista e puxa a cabeça para trás, o que também puxa seu bico antes de soltar sua crista, fazendo com que sua cabeça avance em velocidade extrema em um ataque que Zoro considera ser inbloqueável. Ele percebe as chamas nas costas do Rei, e se pergunta em voz alta se esta é uma habilidade de sua Fruta do Diabo. King ouve isso e responde que não é uma característica do Pteranodon. Zoro ataca com Black Rope Dragon Twister mas King facilmente supera isso. Zoro está em uma perda de quão durável King é, observando que deve ser por causa de seu dinossauro Devil Fruit. King, voltando à sua forma humana, concorda, mas sugere que também pode ser porque ele também é um pouco único. Zoro conclui que a durabilidade, as asas e as chamas de King são uma característica de uma tribo desconhecida para ele. Zoro é derrubado e exausto. De repente, Zoro ouve o som de um shamisen que faz com que Enma comece a drenar seu Haki e emaciar seu braço. Dentro, Orochi rasteja em direção ao jogador shamisen e vê Komurasaki vivo e bem. Ele grita em lágrimas enquanto ela o cumprimenta com um sorriso.
