en.title: Finally Time to Go! Goodbye, Fish-Man Island!
en.synopsis:
The mermaids and Keimi from the Mermaid Cafe ask Sharley if they can say farewell to the Straw Hats. Sharley says that her prediction that Luffy will destroy Fishman Island might not happen after all since they defeated Hordy and the New Fishman Pirates. However, Keimi fears that Madam Sharley still believes that Luffy will destroy the Fishman Island because she knows that her predictions are always right. Shirahoshi meanwhile is crying and asking the Straw Hats to not go. While Minister of the Right talks to Neptune about mentioning the exploding tamate box to the Straw Hats, Neptune points out that Usopp, Brook, and Chopper complain that they are going to die in the New World and that they shouldn't tell them more bad news, later having optimistic ideas about how Big Mom might not open it herself or that the explosives might not explode. The Minister of the Left gives Nami a new Log Pose with three needles so they can get to the islands in the New World. He explains that the new log pose takes in the magnetic waves of 3 surrounding islands and that the needle that moves the most is the direction of the most dangerous island. After hearing that, Nami, Chopper, and Usopp tell the Minister of the left to keep it down so Luffy doesn't hear, which he evidently does. He then grabs onto Nami wanting to see the new Log Pose and says to go in the direction of the needle that moves the most, stating, "that's where the party is". Nami insists that she will tell the crew where to go. However, Luffy states that he should decide where they should go, as he is the captain. Franky gets a new haircut and they start to leave but Shirahoshi comes and ask them to pinky promise to come back and they did. The Straw Hats and the fishmen go their separate ways and Luffy remembers the times when Shanks, Rayleigh, Jimbei, and Ace told him something important. The Straw Hats then comment about what they will do once they are in the New World.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Fish-Man Island saga: Fish-Man Island arc: (50/51)

pt-BR.title: Finalmente é hora de ir! Adeus, Ilha dos Homens-Peixe!
pt-BR.synopsis:
As sereias e Keimi do Mermaid Cafe perguntam a Sharley se podem se despedir dos Straw Hats. Sharley diz que sua previsão de que Luffy destruirá Fishman Island pode não acontecer, afinal, já que derrotaram Hordy e os Novos Piratas dos Peixes. No entanto, Keimi teme que Madame Sharley ainda acredite que Luffy destruirá a Ilha Fishman porque ela sabe que suas previsões estão sempre certas. Shirahoshi, enquanto isso, está chorando e pedindo aos Chapéus Straw para não irem. Enquanto o Ministro da Direita fala com Netuno sobre mencionar a caixa de domado explodindo para os Chapéus Straw, Netuno aponta que Usopp, Brook, e Chopper se queixam que eles vão morrer no Novo Mundo e que eles não devem dizer-lhes mais más notícias, mais tarde tendo ideias otimistas sobre como Big Mom pode não abri-lo sozinho ou que os explosivos podem não explodir. O Ministro da Esquerda dá a Nami um novo Log Pose com três agulhas para que possam chegar às ilhas do Novo Mundo. Ele explica que a nova pose de tronco absorve as ondas magnéticas de 3 ilhas vizinhas e que a agulha que mais se move é a direção da ilha mais perigosa. Depois de ouvir isso, Nami, Chopper e Usopp dizem ao ministro da esquerda para mantê-lo para que Luffy não ouça, o que ele evidentemente faz. Ele então pega Nami querendo ver o novo Log Pose e diz para ir na direção da agulha que se move mais, afirmando: "É aí que a festa está". Nami insiste que ela dirá à tripulação para onde ir. No entanto, Luffy afirma que ele deve decidir onde eles devem ir, como ele é o capitão. Franky recebe um novo corte de cabelo e eles começam a sair, mas Shirahoshi vem e pede a eles que prometam a Pinky que voltarão. Os Chapéus Straw e os pescadores seguem caminhos separados e Luffy se lembra dos tempos em que Shanks, Rayleigh, Jimbei e Ace lhe contaram algo importante. Os Straw Hats comentam o que farão quando estiverem no Novo Mundo.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Operation Failed! Usoland the Hero Dies!?
en.synopsis:
Ten years ago, when Dressrosa is attacked by the Donquixote Pirates, Kyros rushes to the palace to see what's happening. He is ambushed by the pirates and chained to the ground by his left leg as Doflamingo presents himself, showing King Riku's beaten body. Furious, Kyros cuts his own leg off to attack Doflamingo, until Sugar transforms him to a toy. Kyros escapes, rescuing Riku in the process, but the king does not remember him. Days later, Kyros witnesses Diamante murdering his wife, Scarlett, leaving him to bring the food to and care for his daughter, Rebecca. In the underground trade port, Usopp attempts to fight Trébol, but is easily defeated and glued to the ground. Sugar proceeds to feed him the Tatababasco berry, but Usopp unleashes a great flame as his eyes pop out, scaring Sugar unconscious.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Furioso, Kyros corta sua própria perna para atacar Doflamingo, até que Sugar o transforma em um brinquedo. Kyros escapa, resgatando Riku no processo, mas o rei não se lembra dele. Dias depois, Kyros testemunha Diamante assassinando sua esposa, Scarlett, deixando-o para levar a comida e cuidar de sua filha, Rebecca. No porto subterrâneo, Usopp tenta lutar contra Trébol, mas é facilmente derrotado e colado ao chão. O açúcar passa a alimentá-lo com a baga de Tatababasco, mas Usopp libera uma grande chama quando seus olhos saem, assustando o Sugar inconsciente.

en.title: Luffy's Training Begins! To the Place We Promised in 2 Years!
en.synopsis:
Jimbei thanks Luffy for what he has done to him. Vowing to meet again at Fishman Island, Jimbei and Luffy go their separate ways. At Rayleigh's request, Hancock's ship lands on a Ruskaina, an abandoned island northwest of Maiden Island. As Hancock and Luffy go their separate ways, Rayleigh tells Luffy about the island. Luffy tries to attack a large elephant with Gear Second, but it fails. Rayleigh teaches Luffy two Haki techniques, using the first technique, Observation Haki (a power feeling a person's presence) to avoid the elephant's attack. Rayleigh then knocks out the elephant with Armament Haki (another technique used as an invisible shield and can render a Logia-type Devil Fruit user unconscious). Rayleigh also reveals that the Armament Haki can be transferred into a weapon. When the elephant tries to attack again, Rayleigh finally defeats it using the Conqueror's Haki, a rare type of Haki that can only be awakened by a user. Luffy promises to Rayleigh that he will stay for the next two years to control his Haki techniques and prepare to reunite with his crew. The next day, Luffy begins his training with Rayleigh.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Summit War saga: Post-War arc: (26/26)

pt-BR.title: O treinamento do Luffy começa! Para o lugar que prometemos em 2 anos!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Jimbei agradece Luffy pelo que ele fez com ele. Votando para se encontrar novamente na Ilha Fishman, Jimbei e Luffy seguem caminhos separados. A pedido de Rayleigh, o navio de Hancock pousa em uma Ruskaina, uma ilha abandonada a noroeste de Maiden Island. Enquanto Hancock e Luffy seguem caminhos separados, Rayleigh diz a Luffy sobre a ilha. Luffy tenta atacar um grande elefante com Gear Second, mas falha. Rayleigh ensina Luffy duas técnicas Haki, usando a primeira técnica, Observação Haki (um poder sentindo a presença de uma pessoa) para evitar o ataque do elefante. Rayleigh então nocauteia o elefante com Armament Haki (outra técnica usada como um escudo invisível e pode deixar um usuário do tipo Logia Devil Fruit inconsciente). Rayleigh também revela que o Armamento Haki pode ser transferido para uma arma. Quando o elefante tenta atacar de novo, Rayleigh finalmente o derrota usando o Haki do Conquistador, um tipo raro de Haki que só pode ser despertado por um usuário. Luffy promete a Rayleigh que ele ficará pelos próximos dois anos para controlar suas técnicas Haki e se preparar para se reunir com sua tripulação. No dia seguinte, Luffy começa seu treinamento com Rayleigh.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Fights a Battle in Extreme Heat!
en.synopsis:
As Bill mocks Desire for believing him, he admits to using all the bounties and treasures his subordinates brought him to live lusciously. An angered Luffy attacks and easily overwhelms Bill in battle before more of Bill's subordinates appear. Desire tries to tell them of Bill's true nature, but he lies to them saying Desire is a traitor and has them attack Luffy. Luffy knocks them out with Conqueror Haki before attacking Bill again and sends him down the underground mine were Tanaka tells Bill that his superior will discard him if he fails. In response, Bill eats massive amounts of ore and returns while having grown massive, releasing large amounts of molten ore that severely damages Silver Mine. Bartolomeo uses him barrier to push the molten ore back towards Bill. However, Bill emerges unharmed with his body now complete coated in silver and creates a massive sphere of molten ore. Luffy uses his Gum-Gum Grizzly Magnum to break the ball of ore and defeat Bill. Luffy, Bartolomeo, Desie and the members of the Silver Pirate Alliance escape as Silver Mine sinks into the ocean along with Bill. As the Straw Hats and Barto Club set off for Zou, Bartolomeo offers Desire to join his crew, but she turns him down, wanting to follow her own dreams instead of Luffy's, and departs with her crew. Meanwhile, the Revolutionary Army approaches Gran Tesoro, as a powerful man known as Gild Tesoro receives the report of Bill's death.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Uma situação desesperada! Luffy luta uma batalha em extremo calor!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Como Bill zomba do Desejo por acreditar nele, ele admite usar todas as recompensas e tesouros que seus subordinados o trouxeram para viver lusciously. Um Luffy irritado ataca e facilmente esmaga Bill em batalha antes que mais subordinados de Bill apareçam. O desejo tenta contar a eles sobre a verdadeira natureza de Bill, mas ele mente para eles dizendo que o desejo é um traidor e faz com que eles ataquem Luffy. Luffy os nocautea com o Conquistador Haki antes de atacar Bill novamente e o manda para a mina subterrânea. Tanaka diz a Bill que seu superior o descartará se ele falhar. Em resposta, Bill come grandes quantidades de minério e retorna enquanto cresce, liberando grandes quantidades de minério derretido que danifica gravemente a Mina de Prata. Bartolomeo usa a barreira para empurrar o minério derretido de volta para Bill. No entanto, Bill emerge ileso com seu corpo agora revestido de prata e cria uma enorme esfera de minério fundido. Luffy usa seu Gum-Gum Grizzly Magnum para quebrar a bola de minério e derrotar Bill. Luffy, Bartolomeo, Desie e os membros da Silver Pirate Alliance escapam enquanto Silver Mine afunda no oceano junto com Bill. Enquanto o Straw Hats e o Barto Club partem para Zou, Bartolomeo oferece o Desire para se juntar à sua tripulação, mas ela o recusa, querendo seguir seus próprios sonhos em vez do Luffy, e parte com sua tripulação. Enquanto isso, o Exército Revolucionário se aproxima de Gran Tesoro, como um homem poderoso conhecido como Gild Tesoro recebe o relatório da morte de Bill.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: The Three-Sword Style of the Supreme King! Zoro vs. King
en.synopsis:
With his swords now infused with both Armament and Conqueror's Haki, emanating the black lightning and a green smoke-like aura, Zoro with his newly dubbed King of Hell Three Sword Style, faces off King yet again. As they clash, Zoro lands manages to make King bleed and also rips up the Lead Performer's mask. Zoro finally figures out that King's durability and speed are directly linked to the flames on his back―that once the said flames go out, King's speed increases, but his defense gets weaker. A couple of Beast Pirates see King without his mask and observe that he has black wings, white hair, and brown skin. They say that he is of a race so rare that the World Government awards 100,000,000 Berries to those with information about their existence. King overhears this and burns them to death. King and Zoro continue their battle outside the Skull Dome. King finally acknowledges Zoro's strength and the danger he poses. Zoro accepts the compliment and vows to end Kaido's and the Beasts Pirates' reign. King rebuffs this and declares that Kaido will be the King of the Pirates. Zoro rejects this declaration and attacks. King recalls the first time he met Kaido. Years ago both Kaido and King (who back then went by Alber) were both World Government test subjects on Punk Hazard until Kaido broke them out. King agreed to join the pirate crew Kaido was forming after he guaranteed that he would change the world. After noting how strong Alber was, Kaido gave him the name "King" and promised that he would never betray him and made him his right-hand man. Back in the present, King attacks with Imperial Flaming Wings, which sends a magma-like flame dragon onto Zoro but Zoro is able to counter and cut King. As the battle continues King sends a multitude of magma-like flame dragons onto Zoro. The flames try to engulf Zoro, but he cuts them down while he makes his way towards King. Zoro attacks with King of Hell, Three Sword Serpent: 103 Mercies Dragon Damnation and King, coating himself with a flame dragon, counters with his Extra Large Imperial Flaming Wings. As the clash sends a shockwave throughout Onigashima, Zoro emerge victorious. King's sword is broken, and his right wing is ripped apart. As King's consciousness fades as he falls to the mainland, he thinks of his captain. He had thought of Kaido as the prophesied Joy Boy. Thankful for the life Kaido gave to him, he asked his captain to remain the strongest. He also promised that he would never lose so that he can make Kaido the King of the Pirates. Meanwhile, Zoro, too, recalls his vow to become the world's greatest swordsman―a vow he made to Luffy, the man who he declared will become the King of the Pirates.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (166/189)

pt-BR.title: O estilo de três espadas do Rei Supremo! Zoro vs. Rei
pt-BR.synopsis:
Com suas espadas agora infundidas com Armamento e Haki do Conquistador, emanando o raio negro e uma aura verde parecida com fumaça, Zoro com seu recém-batizado King of Hell Three Sword Style, enfrenta King novamente. Como eles se chocam, Zoro terras consegue fazer King sangrar e também rasga a máscara do Performer chumbo. Zoro finalmente descobre que a durabilidade e a velocidade de King estão diretamente ligadas às chamas em suas costas - que uma vez que as chamas se apagam, a velocidade de King aumenta, mas sua defesa fica mais fraca. Alguns Piratas da Besta vêem King sem sua máscara e observam que ele tem asas pretas, cabelos brancos e pele marrom. Dizem que ele é de uma raça tão rara que o governo mundial concede 100.000.000 de berries para aqueles com informações sobre sua existência. King ouve isso e os queima até a morte. King e Zoro continuam sua batalha fora da Caveira. King finalmente reconhece a força de Zoro e o perigo que ele representa. Zoro aceita o elogio e promete acabar com o reinado de Kaido e os Piratas das Feras. King rejeita isso e declara que Kaido será o Rei dos Piratas. Zoro rejeita esta declaração e ataques. King se lembra da primeira vez que conheceu Kaido. Anos atrás, Kaido e King (que na época eram de Alber) eram ambos sujeitos de teste do governo mundial em Punk Hazard até Kaido os libertar. King concordou em se juntar à tripulação pirata que Kaido estava formando depois que ele garantiu que mudaria o mundo. Depois de notar o quão forte Alber era, Kaido deu-lhe o nome de "Rei" e prometeu que ele nunca iria traí-lo e fez dele seu braço direito. No presente, King ataca com as asas de fogo imperiais, que envia um dragão de chama magma para Zoro, mas Zoro é capaz de combater e cortar King. Enquanto a batalha continua, King envia uma multidão de dragões de chamas magma para Zoro. As chamas tentam engolir Zoro, mas ele as corta enquanto ele se dirige para King. Zoro ataca com King of Hell, Three Sword Serpent: 103 Mercies Dragon Damnation e King, revestindo-se com um dragão de chama, conta com suas Alas Imperiais Extragrandes. Como o choque envia uma onda de choque em Onigashima, Zoro sair vitorioso. A espada do Rei está quebrada, e sua asa direita está rasgada. Como a consciência de King desaparece quando ele cai no continente, ele pensa em seu capitão. Ele tinha pensado em Kaido como o Joy Boy profetizado. Agradecido pela vida que Kaido deu a ele, ele pediu ao capitão para permanecer o mais forte. Ele também prometeu que nunca perderia para que pudesse fazer de Kaido o Rei dos Piratas. Enquanto isso, Zoro, também, lembra sua promessa de se tornar o maior espadachim do mundo - um voto que ele fez para Luffy, o homem que ele declarou que se tornará o Rei dos Piratas.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Risking Their Lives! Luffy is the Trump Card for Victory!
en.synopsis:
Now that Rebecca has reached the flower field, Leo leaves with Kabu to rescue Mansherry. Rebecca stays to waits for Luffy, but her brief respite turns to horror when she sees her mother's killer, Diamante, standing before her. Gladius first attacks with multiple rupture balls sent at Luffy, but Bartolomeo blocks them with a large barrier, which he then converts into a long staircase towards the 4th level. Sabo's fight with Fujitora continues as the Admiral creates a horizontal gravity force that pushes Sabo back. Sabo on the other hand wonders if the Admiral is hiding something. As Luffy climbs the stairs, Gladius attacks him again, but Bartolomeo takes it head on, leaving him injured. Robin thanks him for helping Luffy since the Straw Hats always knew Luffy as their winning trump card. Cavendish remains behind to stall the nutcrackers while Kyros moves ahead to the 4th level.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.synopsis:
Agora que Rebecca chegou ao campo de flores, Leo sai com Kabu para resgatar Mansherry. Rebecca fica esperando por Luffy, mas sua breve pausa se transforma em horror quando ela vê o assassino de sua mãe, Diamante, de pé diante dela. Gladius primeiro ataca com várias bolas de ruptura enviadas em Luffy, mas Bartolomeo os bloqueia com uma grande barreira, que ele então converte em uma longa escada em direção ao 4o nível. en.title: 20 Years Worth of Prayers! Take Back the Land of Wano
en.synopsis:
Momonosuke is tasked with moving Onigashima out of the way of Luffy's final powerful attack. However, he feels he is unable to move the island in time. Kaido uses his Flame Dragon Torch to cover himself in flames to form a gigantic dragon as large as Luffy's compressed fist, made of fire so hot that its tail melts through the Skull Dome's remaining horn. Luffy decides he will need to utilize Ryuo to defeat him without touching him. Kaido then performs his Rising Dragon: Flame Bagua while Luffy uses his Gum-Gum Bajrang Gun, as the two attacks collide head-on. In the Skull Dome below, as the light from the final clash can be seen, memories of Wano's suffering are seen. Orochi usurped the throne through force with Kaido's help, forcing the citizens of the Land of Wano into harsh labor. During Orochi's reign, civilians fell into poverty and struggled to feed themselves, being forced to eat defective SMILE fruits or drink polluted water to survive. Meanwhile, Orochi prepares to kill Hiyori in his Yamata no Orochi form. However, Denjiro arrives to her aid, beheading Orochi for the last time and severing his last head. Denjiro comforts Hiyori as citizens at the Fire Festival write on Sky Ships their wishes to remove Orochi from power. Remembering his family, Momonosuke regains the determination to move Onigashima. As allied combatants pray for Luffy's victory against Kaido, the two pirates continue their final clash.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Luffy decide que precisará utilizar Ryuo para derrotá-lo sem tocá-lo. Kaido então executa seu Dragão Nascente: Flame Bagua enquanto Luffy usa sua Arma Gum-Gum Bajrang, enquanto os dois ataques colidem de frente. Na Caveira abaixo, como a luz do confronto final pode ser vista, memórias do sofrimento de Wano são vistas. Orochi usurpou o trono através da força com a ajuda de Kaido, forçando os cidadãos da Terra de Wano em trabalho duro. Durante o reinado de Orochi, os civis caíram na pobreza e lutaram para se alimentar, sendo forçados a comer frutos SMILE defeituosos ou beber água poluída para sobreviver. Enquanto isso, Orochi se prepara para matar Hiyori em sua forma Yamata no Orochi. No entanto, Denjiro chega em seu auxílio, decapitando Orochi pela última vez e cortando sua última cabeça. Denjiro conforta Hiyori como cidadãos no Festival de Fogo escrever em Sky Ships seus desejos para remover Orochi do poder. Lembrando de sua família, Momonosuke recupera a determinação de mover Onigashima. Later, it is announced that the Block C match is about to start. The scene changes to Trafalgar Law and his group, who are about to cross the bridge. They are attacked by a school of Fighting fish but manages to get to Green Bit safely. Law is revealed to have Caesar's heart, the latter who is freed of his bonds for help. They also witness strange voices at a point on the bridge. Green Bit is shown to be a dense jungle. The plot shifts to Sanji's location, where he and Violet arrives at the next town. When the two recent lovebirds share a moment, Violet cuffs Sanji and is revealed to know Sanji's true identity as Black Leg, much to Sanji's astonishment.

Elsewhere, the Whitebeard Pirates are having difficulty getting past the Vice-Admirals, and Squard attempts to sneak past, only to encounter someone. Moria attacks with a group of zombies, halting Luffy's progress, while Marine reinforcements enter. Ace yells that Luffy must not try to save him, saying that he cannot bear to be saved by a weakling, while actually not wanting Luffy to die. However, Luffy tells him he does not care, and will save Ace even if he dies. Ace grita que Luffy não deve tentar salvá-lo, dizendo que ele não pode suportar ser salvo por um fraco, enquanto na verdade não quer que Luffy morra. No entanto, Luffy diz que ele não se importa, e vai salvar Ace mesmo que ele morra. en.title: For Luffy: Sanji and Zoro's Oath
en.synopsis:
Apoo tries to convince Drake to team up against Kaido after the emperor defeats Luffy, stating Kaido has never been so weakened before. However, Drake rejects his offer and attacks Apoo instead. The skirmish is interrupted by Yamato who is in a hurry to go to the armory and stop Onigashima from exploding, with Fuga (who seems to be on friendly terms with Yamato) chasing after her, Apoo (who now wants Yamato to ally with him) chasing after both of them and Drake chasing after Apoo. Elsewhere, CP0 agents have come to take Nico Robin. However, the Minks attack the agents as a distraction, allowing Brook and Robin to escape. Meanwhile, Sanji is fleeing from his fight against Queen after he noticed that his body had started mutating. As he fears of turning into a cold-blooded Germa soldier like his brothers, he fails to notice a lady calling to him for help and he only regains his senses when he sees the said lady on the floor bleeding and looking at him in terror. He rushes to help her, but she begs him not to come closer. The woman, Some, rushes to a nearby room where other geishas have been hiding. Sanji again offers to help Some, but the other women chastise him for hurting a defenseless woman, before driving him outside their hiding place where he finds Queen who had been looking for him. Shaken by the thought of possibly striking a woman, Sanji comes to the realization that his mutation was brought about by his use of his Raid Suit. He wonders if Luffy would rather have an unreliable crewmate who is helpless against women or a cruel and heartless warrior who is able to bring anybody's head when he's ordered. He ponders what the future King of Pirates needs and decides to destroy his Raid Suit. Using a Transponder Snail that he slip on him, Sanji calls Zoro, who is in the middle of his fight against King. Unsure if his mutation will change him for good, he asks the swordsman, once the battle is won, to kill him if he ever loses his humanity. Zoro gladly accepts and tells Sanji not to die before then. Shortly after, Sanji turns seemingly invisible and hits Queen with his Hell Memories attack.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (161/189)

pt-BR.title: Para o juramento de Luffy: Sanji e Zoro
pt-BR.synopsis:
Apoo tenta convencer Drake a se unir contra Kaido depois que o imperador derrota Luffy, afirmando que Kaido nunca esteve tão enfraquecido antes. No entanto, Drake rejeita sua oferta e ataca Apoo. A escaramuça é interrompida por Yamato que está com pressa para ir ao arsenal e parar Onigashima de explodir, com Fuga (que parece estar em termos amigáveis com Yamato) perseguindo ela, Apoo (que agora quer Yamato para se aliar com ele) perseguindo ambos e Drake perseguindo Apoo. Em outro lugar, agentes da CP0 vieram tomar Nico Robin. No entanto, os Minks atacam os agentes como distração, permitindo que Brook e Robin escapem. Enquanto isso, Sanji está fugindo de sua luta contra Queen depois que ele percebeu que seu corpo tinha começado a sofrer mutação. Como ele teme se transformar em um soldado Germa de sangue frio como seus irmãos, ele não percebe uma senhora chamando-o por ajuda e ele só recupera seus sentidos quando ele vê a senhora no chão sangrando e olhando para ele com terror. Ele corre para ajudá-la, mas ela implora para ele não se aproximar. A mulher, alguns, corre para um quarto próximo onde outras gueixas se escondem. Sanji novamente se oferece para ajudar alguns, mas as outras mulheres o castigam por ferir uma mulher indefesa, antes de levá-lo para fora de seu esconderijo onde ele encontra a rainha que estava procurando por ele. Abalado pelo pensamento de possivelmente golpear uma mulher, Sanji chega à conclusão de que sua mutação foi provocada pelo uso de seu terno de Raid. en.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
en.synopsis:
When Luffy, Zoro, and Nami land on another island, Usopp appears to greet them, with three children hiding in the bushes. After a failed attempt on Usopp's part to scare the pirates away they talk about Shanks and his marksman Yasopp, Usopp's father. Usopp brings them to a restaurant, where after a meal, he leaves them to head for a mansion outside town. The mansion belongs to the sickly young woman Kaya. She and Klahadore, her butler, talk about Usopp and Klahadore forbids her to see him. Usopp comes anyway and he tells Kaya a story about fighting a giant goldfish with droppings the size of islands. Back at the restaurant, Usopp's small friends, the Usopp Pirates enter in search of their captain. They bring Luffy, Zoro, and Nami to Kaya's mansion, and tell them how Usopp tells Kaya lies to cheer her up since her parents died and she became ill. Luffy decides they should ask her for a ship and as there are bodyguards guarding the gate, he slingshots the whole group over the fence. They crash into the ground near Usopp, and as they get up, Klahadore comes out and calls them intruders.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Quando Luffy, Zoro e Nami aterrissam em outra ilha, Usopp parece cumprimentá-los, com três crianças escondidas nos arbustos. Depois de uma tentativa fracassada da parte de Usopp para assustar os piratas, eles falam sobre Shanks e seu atirador Yasopp, o pai de Usopp. Usopp os leva a um restaurante, onde depois de uma refeição, ele os deixa para ir para uma mansão fora da cidade. A mansão pertence à jovem e doente Kaya. Ela e Klahadore, seu mordomo, falam sobre Usopp e Klahadore a proíbe de vê-lo. Usopp vem de qualquer maneira e ele conta a Kaya uma história sobre lutar contra um peixe dourado gigante com excrementos do tamanho de ilhas. De volta ao restaurante, os pequenos amigos do Usopp, os Piratas do Usopp entram em busca do capitão. Eles trazem Luffy, Zoro e Nami para a mansão de Kaya, e dizem a eles como Usopp diz a Kaya mentiras para animá-la desde que seus pais morreram e ela ficou doente. Luffy decide que eles devem pedir a ela um navio e como há guarda-costas guardando o portão, ele atira o grupo inteiro sobre a cerca. Eles caem no chão perto de Usopp, e quando se levantam, Klahadore sai e os chama de intrusos.

en.title: The Numerous Rivals Struggle Amongst Themselves! The Raging Monsters of the New World
en.synopsis:
On the Yonta Maria, the Straw Hat Grand Fleet's party continues. Law stands abovedeck looking at the sea, and Robin approaches him and asks what he will do next. However, Law leaves and tells her to leave him alone. Rob Lucci and Spandam, now CP-0 agents, search Dressrosa for weapons, but find none. The people of Dressrosa celebrate a new era in their history, as the existence of the dwarves is revealed to the humans and they begin fully coexisting, and Leo has the humans build statues of Luffy, Kyros, and Usopp, as Riku Doldo III prepares for Reverie. Out at sea, an imprisoned Doflamingo wonders who will gain power over the entire world. Meanwhile, the pirate Jack prepares to attack the Marine convoy transporting Doflamingo. Elsewhere, the Straw Hats are shocked to see Bartolomeo's ship, the Going Luffy-senpai. The entire ship pays homage to the Straw Hats, as the masthead is a giant Luffy statue, a wall in the middle is a large replica of the Going Merry's head, there is a giant Chopper figurehead in the stern, and they also have tangerine groves like Nami's. Franky compliments the design, and everyone in the Barto Club is dazzled to hear this. Bartolomeo points to their most important edition, the newly acquired vivre card that Sabo gave to Luffy. Back on the Yonta Maria some time ago, Luffy had given pieces of the vivre card to Bellamy, who decided to go on his own path, as well as all the Grand Fleet crews as they departed. As the group starts hearing to Zou, Bartolomeo shows them their updated bounties and wanted posters, although notably Sanji is wanted only alive. Meanwhile, a man eats a lump of coal, causing his skin to glow red.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (118/118)

pt-BR.title: Os inúmeros rivais lutam entre si! Os Monstros Raging do Novo Mundo
pt-BR.synopsis:
Na Yonta Maria, o partido da Grande Frota Straw Hat continua. Law fica acima do convés olhando para o mar, e Robin se aproxima dele e pergunta o que ele fará a seguir. No entanto, Law sai e diz a ela para deixá-lo em paz. Rob Lucci e Spandam, agora agentes da CP-0, procurem por armas, mas não a encontrem. O povo de Dressrosa celebra uma nova era em sua história, como a existência dos anões é revelada aos humanos e eles começam a coexistir completamente, e Leo tem os humanos construir estátuas de Luffy, Kyros, e Usopp, como Riku Doldo III se prepara para Reverie. No mar, um Doflamingo aprisionado se pergunta quem ganhará poder sobre o mundo inteiro. Enquanto isso, o pirata Jack se prepara para atacar o trem da Marinha transportando Doflamingo. Em outro lugar, os Straw Hats estão chocados ao ver a nave de Bartolomeo, o Going Luffy-senpai. O navio inteiro presta homenagem aos chapéus Straw, como o mastro é uma estátua Luffy gigante, uma parede no meio é uma grande réplica da cabeça do Going Merry, há uma figura Chopper gigante na popa, e eles também têm bosques de tangerina como Nami. Franky complementa o projeto, e todos no Barto Club estão deslumbrados ao ouvir isso. Bartolomeo aponta para sua edição mais importante, o cartão de vivre recém-adquirido que Sabo deu ao Luffy. De volta à Yonta Maria há algum tempo, Luffy tinha dado pedaços do cartão de vivre para Bellamy, que decidiu seguir seu próprio caminho, assim como todas as tripulações da Grande Frota quando partiram. Como o grupo começa a ouvir Zou, Bartolomeo mostra-lhes suas recompensas atualizadas e cartazes procurados, embora notavelmente Sanji só é procurado vivo. en.title: Sanji's Scream! An SOS Echoes Over the Island!
en.synopsis:
Black Maria's women beat Sanji until he's knocked out and he wakes up to see Black Maria has crucified him with webs. Maria orders Sanji to call for Robin using a surveillance unit. When Bao Huang attempts to locate the Akazaya Nine her shared vision with the Marys. She determines they are in the Treasure Repository and there is an unknown person in the room helping them. Carrot and Wanda turn into their Sulong form and confront Perospero, but he covers them with candy, turning them into Candymen. Carrot frees herself and Wanda, using Electro to melt the candy. However, when Perospero distracts them with the fact the full moon is about to be obscured by clouds, he catches Wanda in a candy net before crushing her with a Candy Maiden. On the Performance Floor, Marco battles King as Chopper continues to try to make an antidote for the Ice Onis. Hyougoro, who was infected, decides to fight as much as he can as he suddenly transforms into a younger version of himself. Before she goes to pursue the wounded samurai, Black Maria carries out her plan. She tortures Sanji into calling for Robin's help by punching him with brass knuckles. Sanji calls out for help at the top of his lungs, and the Marys announce the message throughout the Performance Floor. His message is heard throughout the castle with some of them thinking his call for help is pathetic. Jimbei deduces that the Beast Pirates are after Robin for her knowledge and Franky mocks Sanji for his whining when he also deduces that Robin is being set up to be captured. Marco admits that the Straw Hats are fun and Nami is not surprised that Sanji was calling for help if his opponent is a woman. Usopp points to a cat with a paper with an eye on it over its face and wonders what they are for. Black Maria prepares to deliver one final blow to finish Sanji, but Robin sprouts a giant arm, striking Black Maria.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (126/189)

pt-BR.title: Sanji's Scream! Um SOS ecoa sobre a ilha!
pt-BR.synopsis:
As mulheres da Maria Negra bateram Sanji até ele ser nocauteado e ele acorda para ver que a Maria Negra o crucificou com teias. Maria ordena Sanji para chamar Robin usando uma unidade de vigilância. Quando Bao Huang tenta localizar o Akazaya Nine sua visão compartilhada com as Marys. Ela determina que eles estão no Repositório do Tesouro e há uma pessoa desconhecida na sala ajudando-os. Cenoura e Wanda se transformam em sua forma Sulong e confrontam Perospero, mas ele os cobre com doces, transformando-os em Candymen. Cenoura se liberta e Wanda, usando Electro para derreter o doce. No entanto, quando Perospero os distrai com o fato de que a lua cheia está prestes a ser obscurecida pelas nuvens, ele pega Wanda em uma rede de doces antes de esmagá-la com uma Donzela de Doces. No Performance Floor, Marco luta contra King enquanto Chopper continua tentando fazer um antídoto para o Ice Onis. Hyougoro, que estava infectado, decide lutar o máximo que puder, de repente se transforma em uma versão mais jovem de si mesmo. Antes que ela vá atrás do samurai ferido, a Maria Negra realiza seu plano. Ela tortura Sanji para pedir a ajuda de Robin socando-o com dedos de bronze. Sanji pede ajuda no topo de seus pulmões, e as Marys anunciam a mensagem em todo o Piso de Performance. Sua mensagem é ouvida por todo o castelo com alguns deles achando que seu pedido de ajuda é patético. Jimbei deduz que os Piratas da Besta estão atrás de Robin por seu conhecimento e Franky zomba de Sanji por seu lamento quando ele também deduz que Robin está sendo criado para ser capturado. Marco admite que os chapéus Straw são divertidos e Nami não está surpreso que Sanji estava pedindo ajuda se seu oponente é uma mulher. Usopp aponta para um gato com um papel com um olho no rosto e se pergunta para que eles servem. Maria Negra se prepara para dar um golpe final para terminar Sanji, mas Robin brota um braço gigante, atingindo Maria Negra.

The Marines swarm Kyros' house, and the Straw Hats, Law, Bartolomeo, and Bellamy escape from it. However, Luffy departs from the group, saying he needed to do something. Marines occupy the entirety of Dressrosa, but the Corrida Colosseum gladiators take them out in order to clear the way for the Straw Hats. After fighting through hordes of Marines, Luffy reaches the Royal Palace and speaks to Rebecca through the window, asking her if she is fine with Kyros' decision to exit her life. Rebecca confesses that she is not, and Luffy breaks her out of the palace, outraging both the Marines and the citizens of Dressrosa.

Depois de lutar por hordas de fuzileiros navais, Luffy chega ao Palácio Real e fala com Rebecca pela janela, perguntando se ela está bem com a decisão de Kyros de sair de sua vida. en.title: Good Luck?! Leader Kin'emon's Plot!
en.synopsis:
After destroying the Beast Pirates' ships, Kyoshiro removes his fake pompadour and reveals his real identity as Denjiro. He then reveals that he freed 1000 prisoners from the Flower Capital, all of whom were willing to join the alliance, along with his 200 yakuza members. Then, Denjiro explains the new flyer given by Yasuie. What the lines really meant was to remove the middle syllables of "Habuminato" (Habu Port), getting "Hato" (wharf). The correct rendezvous point was at the wharf of Habu Port all along. Furthermore, although Orochi bombed the connecting bridges between regions, the allied forces had already crossed the bridge before then, due to Orochi misjudging the distance between locations and waited too long to act. Their ships were safely hidden away at the Habu wharf, while the ones destroyed at Itachi Port were the ones left behind. The other samurai arrive and with the men Denjiro brought, the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance numbers now stand at 5400 strong. Denjiro commends Kin'emon for cleverly misinforming the other Akazaya to mislead the spy Kanjuro, unaware that Kin'emon had actually misunderstood the message himself, something the other Akazaya members realize. Kanjuro laments having let the alliance get away but attempts to escape with Momonosuke by drawing a crane, which is surprisingly good, revealing him being a bad artist was also a lie. Kawamatsu swims back to shore to confront Kanjuro, but he manages to flee, flying away with Momonosuke. As Luffy and Kid sink another enemy ship, they see them flying away.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (85/189)

pt-BR.title: Boa sorte? Conspiração do Líder Kin'emon!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Depois de destruir as naves dos Piratas da Fera, Kyoshiro remove seu falso pompadour e revela sua verdadeira identidade como Denjiro. Ele então revela que libertou 1000 prisioneiros da Capital das Flores, todos os quais estavam dispostos a se juntar à aliança, junto com seus 200 membros yakuza. Então, Denjiro explica o novo panfleto dado por Yasuie. O que as linhas realmente significavam era remover as sílabas do meio de "Habuminato" (Porto de Habu), recebendo "Hato" (Wharf). O ponto de encontro correto foi no cais do Porto Habu o tempo todo. Além disso, embora Orochi tenha bombardeado as pontes de conexão entre regiões, as forças aliadas já haviam cruzado a ponte antes disso, devido a Orochi julgar mal a distância entre os locais e esperar muito tempo para agir. Suas naves estavam escondidas em segurança no cais Habu, enquanto as destruídas no Porto de Itachi foram as que ficaram para trás. Os outros samurais chegam e com os homens que Denjiro trouxe, os números da Aliança Ninja-Pirata-Mink-Samurai agora estão em 5.400. Denjiro elogia Kin'emon por desinformar o outro Akazaya para enganar o espião Kanjuro, sem saber que Kin'emon tinha entendido mal a mensagem, algo que os outros membros da Akazaya percebem. Kanjuro lamenta ter deixado a aliança escapar, mas tentar escapar com Momonosuke desenhando um guindaste, o que é surpreendentemente bom, revelando que ele era um artista ruim também era uma mentira. Kawamatsu nada de volta à costa para confrontar Kanjuro, mas ele consegue fugir, voando com Momonosuke. Enquanto Luffy e Kid afundam outra nave inimiga, eles os vêem voando.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Barrier-Barrier! Homage God Fist Strikes!
en.synopsis:
While being restrained by Robin, Cavendish struggles to regain control of his body from Hakuba. Gladius attempts to blow up both Robin and Cavendish by rupturing the cliffside they are on. When Bartolomeo tries to stop him, Gladius shoots him with his paralytic-coated needle-like hair, before inflating himself, threatening to injure Robin if he ruptures. Seeing no other option Bartolomeo traps both himself and Gladius in a barrier before stabbing him causing Gladius to explode. Though injured by the explosion, Bartolomeo is able to contain the blast. Galdius, having only been stabbed in the shoulder, survives and ruptures the cliff side, but Cavendish manages to carry Robin to safety using Hakuba's speed while also keeping Hakuba from hurting her. Enraged at being unable to protect Robin, Bartolomeo forms a barrier around his fist and vows to grow stronger as to be someone who can properly help Luffy before defeating Gladius with an homage to Luffy. While Bartolomeo proclaims to never work with someone as troublesome as Cavendish again, Robin arrives at the Flower Hill just in time to protect Rebecca from Diamante's attack.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (85/118)

pt-BR.title: Barreira-barreira! Homage God Fist Strikes!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto está sendo contido por Robin, Cavendish luta para recuperar o controle de seu corpo de Hakuba. Gladius tenta explodir Robin e Cavendish rompendo o penhasco em que estão. Quando Bartolomeo tenta detê-lo, Gladius o atira com o cabelo paralítico, antes de se inflar, ameaçando ferir Robin se ele se romper. Não vendo nenhuma outra opção Bartolomeo prende a si mesmo e Gladius em uma barreira antes de esfaqueá-lo fazendo Gladius explodir. Embora ferido pela explosão, Bartolomeo é capaz de conter a explosão. Galdius, tendo apenas sido esfaqueado no ombro, sobrevive e rompe o lado do penhasco, mas Cavendish consegue levar Robin para a segurança usando a velocidade de Hakuba enquanto também impede Hakuba de machucá-la. Enfurecido por ser incapaz de proteger Robin, Bartolomeo forma uma barreira em torno de seu punho e promete crescer mais forte como alguém que pode ajudar corretamente Luffy antes de derrotar Gladius com uma homenagem a Luffy. Enquanto Bartolomeo proclama nunca trabalhar com alguém tão problemático quanto Cavendish novamente, Robin chega ao Flower Hill bem a tempo de proteger Rebecca do ataque de Diamante.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Death to Your Partner! Killer's Deadly Gamble!
en.synopsis:
Killer continues his battle against Hawkins, but the battle is not in his favor. With his Devil Fruit abilities, total immunity from Killer's attacks, with the damage inflicted being redirected to Kid, Hawkins begins to mock Killer upon learning he ate a defective SMILE Fruit. Members of the Kid Pirates arrive to Killer's aid, but he forbids them from attacking Hawkins, telling them the situation. As Killer refuses to fight back, Hawkins decides to harm Kid himself. As he fights Big Mom, Kid head starts to feel severe pain, proving especially disadvantageous to Law, who struggles to fight and protect Kid. Kid's pain is caused by Hawkins repeatedly slamming his head into a pillar, redirecting the pain to Kid. Desperate, Killer offers his life in exchange for Kid's, but Hawkins refuses further claiming that all of Killer's suffering was caused by Kid's refusal to submit to Kaido before an offer to Killer to join the Beast Pirates if he surrenders. Killer refuses, calling Hawkins out for his own regret for not standing up to Kaido before declaring that Kid will become the King of the Pirates. This angers Hawkins, causing him to ruthlessly beat Killer. Killer gets back up and asks Hawkins what will happen if he takes damage that has nowhere to go. Then with a single attack, Killer slices off Hawkins' left arm. As Hawkins writhes in pain, questioning why the attack worked, Killer reminds him Kid already lost his left arm, meaning the damage had nowhere to be transferred to. Killer pulls the straw doll out of Hawkins' severed arm and destroys it, undoing the damage dealt to Kid's body. Hawkins no longer has any people left to redirect damage to and is now completely vulnerable to attacks. In a last-ditch effort, Hawkins uses his Strawman Cards. He reveals the "Death" card upright, summoning a giant straw monster, but Killer decapitates the monster, instantly destroying it. Hawkins draws a second card, only to find to his horror that he drew the "Tower" card. With this, Killer slices Hawkins with Spin & Sonic, defeating him and causing him to collapse. The narrator explains the "Tower" card is assigned two meanings: the death of the old and a new path. Sure enough, once Hawkins falls, Kid says he feels better now as Killer cheers him on.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Morte ao seu parceiro! Killer's Deadly Gamble!
pt-BR.synopsis:

Membros dos Kid Pirates chegam em ajuda do assassino, mas ele os proíbe de atacar Hawkins, dizendo-lhes a situação. Como Killer se recusa a revidar, Hawkins decide prejudicar o próprio Kid. Enquanto luta contra a Big Mom, Kid Head começa a sentir dor severa, provando ser especialmente desvantajoso para Law, que luta para lutar e proteger Kid. A dor do garoto é causada por Hawkins repetidamente batendo a cabeça em um pilar, redirecionando a dor para Kid. Desesperado, Killer oferece sua vida em troca de Kid, mas Hawkins se recusa ainda mais alegando que todo o sofrimento de Killer foi causado pela recusa de Kid em se submeter a Kaido antes de uma oferta para Killer se juntar aos Piratas da Besta se ele se render. Assassino se recusa, chamando Hawkins para seu próprio arrependimento por não enfrentar Kaido antes de declarar que Kid se tornará o Rei dos Piratas. Isso irrita Hawkins, fazendo com que ele vença o assassino impiedosamente. O assassino se levanta e pergunta ao Hawkins o que acontecerá se ele levar dano que não tem para onde ir. Então, com um único ataque, Killer corta o braço esquerdo de Hawkins. Enquanto Hawkins se contorce de dor, questionando por que o ataque funcionou, Killer lembra que Kid já perdeu o braço esquerdo, o que significa que o dano não tinha para onde ser transferido. O assassino tira a boneca de palha do braço cortado do Hawkins e a destrói, desfazendo o dano causado ao corpo do Kid. Hawkins não tem mais ninguém para redirecionar danos e agora está completamente vulnerável a ataques. Em um último esforço, Hawkins usa seus Strawman Cards. Ele revela o cartão "Morte" em pé, invocando um monstro de palha gigante, mas Killer decapita o monstro, destruindo-o instantaneamente. Hawkins desenha uma segunda carta, só para descobrir para seu horror que ele desenhou a carta "Torre". Com isso, Killer corta Hawkins com Spin & Sonic, derrotando-o e fazendo-o entrar em colapso. O narrador explica que a carta "Torre" tem dois significados: a morte do velho e um novo caminho. Com certeza, uma vez que Hawkins cai, Kid diz que se sente melhor agora enquanto Killer o aplaude.

Vize-Admiral Kuzan, later known as Admiral Aokiji, enters the scene to engage in battle with Saul. While they fight, the evacuation ship is sunk by the fanatical Vice-Admiral Sakazuki, later known as Admiral Akainu. Saul, on the verge of dying, instructs Robin to flee on his raft. Persuaded by Saul's argument and Sakazuki's action, Kuzan helps Robin escape. From then on, Robin lives a life on the run, not being able to trust even the kindest of people, in a world that believes that her existence alone is a sin. In the present, Robin admits her greatest fear: to be seen as a burden by her crew mates and cast away, because being with her means having the world as their enemy. Finally knowing what kept her away, Sogeking, on Luffy's order, burns the government's flag, declaring war against the World Government itself.

Franky proceeds to explain that he and the previous shipwrights only kept the blueprints in case a counter is needed against another ancient weapon revived by the World Government through Robin. But seeing Robin not to be the monster the rumors made her out to be, Franky decides to gamble the fate of the world on the Straw Hats' resolve to save their friend and burns the blueprints. But then emotionally touched to find his gang are also on Enies Lobby to save him, a distracted Franky finds himself shoved off the balcony by a furious Spandam. As Luffy falls asleep and Yamato catches him, Onigashima lands safely near the Flower Capital. With the Raid on Onigashima ending in Kaido's defeat, Cat Viper declares the prophecy fulfilled and Oden avenged. Allied forces in the Skull Dome celebrate their victory, Chopper and Miyagi tend to their wounds, and Yamato pressures remaining Beasts Pirates to forfeit. Momonosuke states to Zunesha that he will not open borders of the Land of Wano, instead personally protecting it from external threat. In the Flower Capital, right before the lanterns were sent up, Tenguyama explains to Toko that Yasuie allowed himself to be captured despite knowing he'd be killed in order to give Wano another chance, otherwise the alliance wouldn't have been able to fight this day and hopefully give Toko a better life. Toko remembers how when she was desperately-starving she ate a SMILE fruit and suffered from its permanent effects, Yasuie decided to eat the fruit as well so she would not have to suffer alone. In honor of her father's sacrifices to make the raid possible, Toko edits her Sky Ship to thank Yasuie. Refusing to believe they lost, The Beasts Pirate attempted to continue the battle, only for Yamato to reveal that it was thanks to Momonosuke that she carefully placed Onigashima away from the Flower Capital and threaten to beat them if they do not stop. An unconscious Kaido reverts into his human form as he falls underground. Falling into the same magma chamber as Big Mom, the impact triggers a volcanic eruption, filling the sky with ash. Momonosuke return to the Flower Capital to calm the panicked townspeople, as well as announce their victory over Kaido. He changes back to his human form as several other people appear from the smoke, among them Hiyori in her "Komurasaki" guise, which surprises everyone as they all thought she was dead, and then Denjiro, who everyone still thinks is "Kyoshiro." Denjiro tells everyone that the story is long, but he first wants everyone to meet Wano's new shogun.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Com o Raid em Onigashima terminando na derrota de Kaido, Cat Viper declara a profecia cumprida e Oden vingado. As forças aliadas na Cúpula da Caveira comemoram sua vitória, Chopper e Miyagi cuidam de suas feridas, e Yamato pressiona os restantes Piratas das Bestas a perder. Momonosuke afirma a Zunesha que ele não abrirá fronteiras da Terra de Wano, em vez de protegê-la pessoalmente de ameaças externas. Na Capital das Flores, bem antes das lanternas serem enviadas, Tenguyama explica a Toko que Yasuie se permitiu ser capturado apesar de saber que seria morto para dar a Wano outra chance, caso contrário a aliança não teria sido capaz de lutar hoje e espero dar a Toko uma vida melhor. Toko lembra como quando ela estava desesperadamente faminta ela comeu uma fruta SMILE e sofreu de seus efeitos permanentes, Yasuie decidiu comer a fruta também para que ela não tivesse que sofrer sozinha. Em homenagem aos sacrifícios de seu pai para tornar a invasão possível, Toko edita sua Nave Celestial para agradecer Yasuie. Recusando-se a acreditar que perderam, o Pirata das Feras tentou continuar a batalha, só para Yamato revelar que foi graças a Momonosuke que ela cuidadosamente colocou Onigashima longe da Capital das Flores e ameaçou vencê-los se eles não parassem. Um Kaido inconsciente volta à sua forma humana quando cai no subsolo. Caindo na mesma câmara de magma que Big Mom, o impacto desencadeia uma erupção vulcânica, enchendo o céu de cinzas. Momonosuke volta para a Capital das Flores para acalmar os moradores em pânico, bem como anunciar sua vitória sobre Kaido. Ele muda de volta para sua forma humana como várias outras pessoas aparecem da fumaça, entre eles Hiyori em seu disfarce "Komurasaki", o que surpreende a todos como todos pensavam que ela estava morta, e depois Denjiro, que todo mundo ainda acha que é "Kyoshiro". One night, Zoro is arrested for street murders. Zoro plans to defend himself, but remembers how Kin'emon told them not to cause trouble, as any acts against Wano's corrupt shogun, Kurozumi Orochi, or his men will be heard about by Kaido, who's backing them. On the next day, he is sentenced to commit seppuku. Deducing that the magistrate is the culprit, Zoro using the small seppuku knife cuts down the magistrate and his house from a distance, before combating his men. en.synopsis:
Zoro carries Tashigi away from the poisonous gas. Sanji and the G-5 marines continue to assist Chopper vaccinate the children. Usopp finds a door that leads to the room where Caesar and his subordinates are watching the Straw Hats and the Marines on a screen. Caesar notices Brownbeard on the screen and confronts him. Brownbeard tells Caesar that he wants to get his crew back, but Caesar tells him they were all killed by the poison gas. Brownbeard tries to warn Caesar's subordinates, but Caesar drugs him to keep him quiet. Caesar orders his subordinates to get rid of Brownbeard, and they fire at him. Luffy arrives just in time and punches Caesar, before asking him about the island. Caesar tells him Punk Hazard is not supposed to exist, and nobody is supposed to know what happens on that island. Vergo covers up any information about that island and anything that happens there – the SAD production is run by Doflamingo, and SAD produces SMILE, an artificial Zoan Devil Fruit. One of the Emperors is forming an army of people who have eaten these artificial fruits. Caesar challenges Luffy to dare pick a fight with such people, only for Luffy to punch Caesar, and tell him that he has been picking fights all along.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Barba-marrom diz a César que ele quer recuperar sua tripulação, mas César diz a ele que todos foram mortos pelo gás venenoso. Barba-marrom tenta avisar os subordinados de César, mas César o droga para mantê-lo quieto. César ordena que seus subordinados se livrem do Barba Marrom, e eles disparam contra ele. Luffy chega bem a tempo e socos César, antes de perguntar-lhe sobre a ilha. César diz que Punk Hazard não deveria existir, e ninguém deveria saber o que acontece naquela ilha. At the sick bay, Tiger tells his crew that he will not allow human blood to be donated to him. Before his death, Tiger informs the Sun Pirates that he was never on a voyage and stayed at Mariejois as a slave; he begs them not to reveal what happened at Mariejois.

Though Franky tries to brave through the antagonizing torture, he is confronted by Iceburg revealing that the only real reason why he wants to stay is out of guilt and needs to forgive himself so he can join the Straw Hats and see his dream through. Franky's followers then arrive with Franky's luggage. After Zambai apologizes for the others for bro being naked, Robin revealing she stopped after the first time, Franky starts crying when his posse only want him to be happy and that they will protect Water 7 in his stead. Sanji and Zoro suddenly arrive in a hurry, revealing that Garp has returned and is on his way to capture them. en.title: Law Dies - Luffy's Raging Onslaught!
en.synopsis:
As Doflamingo calls Luffy to the rooftop, it is shown what happened a few minutes earlier. Trébol used Sticky Launcher to send Law sprawling at the edge of the roof, and he and Doflamingo stood over the severely injured Warlord. Trébol expressed his surprise that Law was still alive, mockingly suggesting that he give up. Doflamingo echoed his executive's thoughts, telling Law he pitied how escaping the White City, meeting Corazon, working for 13 years to depose Doflamingo, and his alliance with Luffy had been worthless. As he pointed his gun at Law's chest, Doflamingo offered him a chance to make the rest of Law's short life meaningful by performing the Perennial Youth Operation on him. In exchange, Doflamingo offered to make any wish of Law's come true. Law appeared to accept at first, but then requested that Doflamingo bring his dead brother Corazon back to life and submit himself to all the citizens of Dressrosa. Law laughed that Doflamingo's life was the pitiful one, saying that the Straw Hats can cause miracles. Doflamingo shot Law eight times in various places, mocking the word "Corazon" on Law's jacket. He furiously yelled that despite all Law's efforts to imitate Corazon, the Heart legacy will end. Across the island, Tank Lepanto and the crowd of citizens on the King's Plateau decide to climb down to the city in order to assist their former king Riku. Viola confirms to Zoro and Usopp that of the opposing forces, only Doflamingo and Trébol remain standing, but their own forces have also taken a hit. Meanwhile, Luffy breaks through the palace roof, eager to fight Doflamingo. The Warlord taunts him about Bellamy and blocks a Gear Third punch with Spider's Web. Luffy leaps over the web and uses Hawk Gatling to attack Doflamingo from above, but Doflamingo uses Break White to surround Luffy in a mass of strings. Luffy breaks out of Doflamingo's trap but steps on a pool of blood. Looking around, he sees Law lying on the ground. In confusion, Luffy asks Law what has happened, but he remains unresponsive. Doflamingo tells Luffy that Law is dead, shocking the pirate. As the citizens of Dressrosa realize that the Birdcage is shrinking, Doflamingo mocks Law's last words and states that it is time for the game to end. Luffy prepares to fight but faintly hears Law's voice telling him to listen closely.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (93/118)

pt-BR.title: Lei Morre - Luffy's Raging Onslaught!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Como Doflamingo chama Luffy para o telhado, é mostrado o que aconteceu alguns minutos antes. Trébol usou o Sticky Launcher para mandar Law se espalhar pela borda do telhado, e ele e Doflamingo ficaram sobre o senhor da guerra gravemente ferido. Trébol expressou sua surpresa por Law ainda estar vivo, sugerindo que ele desistisse. Doflamingo ecoou os pensamentos de seu executivo, dizendo a Law que ele lamentava como escapar da Cidade Branca, conhecer Corazon, trabalhando por 13 anos para depor Doflamingo, e sua aliança com Luffy tinha sido inútil. Enquanto apontava sua arma para o peito de Law, Doflamingo lhe ofereceu uma chance de tornar o resto da vida curta de Law significativa, realizando a Operação Perene da Juventude sobre ele. Em troca, Doflamingo se ofereceu para realizar qualquer desejo da Lei. Lei parecia aceitar no início, mas então pediu que Doflamingo trouxesse seu irmão morto Corazon de volta à vida e se submetesse a todos os cidadãos de Dressrosa. Law riu que a vida de Doflamingo era lamentável, dizendo que os chapéus Straw podem causar milagres. Doflamingo atirou na Lei oito vezes em vários lugares, zombando da palavra "Corazon" na jaqueta da Lei. Ele gritou furiosamente que apesar de todos os esforços de Law para imitar Corazon, o legado do Coração vai acabar. Do outro lado da ilha, Tank Lepanto e a multidão de cidadãos no Planalto do Rei decidem descer até a cidade para ajudar seu ex-rei Riku. Viola confirma para Zoro e Usopp que das forças opostas, apenas Doflamingo e Trébol permanecem de pé, mas suas próprias forças também tomaram um golpe. Enquanto isso, Luffy atravessa o telhado do palácio, ansioso para lutar contra Doflamingo. O Senhor da Guerra zomba dele sobre Bellamy e bloqueia um terceiro soco com a Teia do Aranha. Luffy salta sobre a web e usa Hawk Gatling para atacar Doflamingo de cima, mas Doflamingo usa Break White para cercar Luffy em uma massa de cordas. Luffy sai da armadilha de Doflamingo mas pisa em uma poça de sangue. Olhando ao redor, ele vê Law deitada no chão. Em confusão, Luffy pergunta a Law o que aconteceu, mas ele permanece sem resposta. Doflamingo diz a Luffy que Law está morta, chocando o pirata. Como os cidadãos de Dressrosa percebem que a gaiola está encolhendo, Doflamingo zomba das últimas palavras de Law e afirma que é hora do jogo acabar. Luffy se prepara para lutar, mas fracamente ouve a voz de Law dizendo-lhe para ouvir atentamente.

en.title: A Nightmare! The Tragic Night of Dressrosa!
en.synopsis:
While Doflamingo continues to control Riku Dold III, his subordinates manage to take control of the castle with the help of Monet, who was at the time undercover as a servant and also took princess Viola hostage. With the people's trust in him in tatters, and his spirit broken, King Riku begs for death. Then, Doflamingo appears with his strongest subordinates and defeats the king and his army, setting the grounds for his takeover of the island. After telling the Straw Hat Pirates of the tragedies of the past, Thunder Soldier explains that the king is still alive since Viola pledged her service to Doflamingo in exchange for the King's life. He, also, explained that although the toys of Dressrosa were once people who despised Doflamingo, they still remember who they were, but not each other and that the drive for revolution is still in them. Thunder Soldier also explains that the reason for their rebellion was the news of Doflamingo resignation was false, shocking Usopp, Robin and Franky, who realize they unintentionally caused the rebellion. In the underground chamber, almost all of the fighters were transformed except for Riku and Chinjao, with the latter having mysteriously forgotten that he had grandchildren. In the Colosseum, Luffy meets up with Zoro and Kin'emon with the help of Bartolomeo, although he was nowhere to be seen.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Com a confiança do povo nele em farrapos, e seu espírito quebrado, o Rei Riku implora pela morte. Então, Doflamingo aparece com seus subordinados mais fortes e derrota o rei e seu exército, estabelecendo as bases para sua tomada da ilha. Depois de contar aos Piratas Straw Hat das tragédias do passado, o Soldado Trovão explica que o rei ainda está vivo desde que Viola prometeu seu serviço a Doflamingo em troca da vida do rei. Ele, também, explicou que, embora os brinquedos de Dressrosa fossem pessoas que desprezavam Doflamingo, eles ainda se lembram quem eram, mas não um ao outro e que o impulso para a revolução ainda está neles. Thunder Soldier também explica que a razão para sua rebelião foi a notícia de que a renúncia de Doflamingo foi falsa, chocante Usopp, Robin e Franky, que percebem que involuntariamente causaram a rebelião. Na câmara subterrânea, quase todos os lutadores foram transformados, exceto Riku e Chinjao, com o último tendo misteriosamente esquecido que ele tinha netos. No Coliseu, Luffy encontra-se com Zoro e Kin'emon com a ajuda de Bartolomeo, embora ele não estivesse em nenhum lugar para ser visto.

en.title: We're Here to Win! Luffy's Desperate Scream!
en.synopsis:
Babanuki's men continue firing Plague Rounds at the prisoners, with ehe bullet wounds form black skull marks, spreading green blotches all over the body. Prisoners affected suffer excruciating, burning pain, fever and bleeding, and eventually become emaciated and zombie-like while also being highly contagious by touch as well. Daifugo dubs the viral weapon as Queen's masterpiece, the Mummy virus. The prisoners surround Luffy and his allies, blaming them for getting infected and casting their doubts that Luffy will defeat Kaido. Luffy grabs the prisoners, infecting himself and tells them that he made a promise to make Wano a prosperous place again and prompts the prisoners to either join him and liberate the country or continue to live a life of despair under Kaidou's regime. Babanuki decides to try to kill all the prisoners at once, using an Plague Shot, a cannonball containing two hundred doses of the Mummy virus. He places it in his elephant's trunk to fire, but Luffy walks up to him and ties a knot in the elephant's trunk. With the cannonball still inside, it detonates in Babanuki's body, knocking him out. With the last of his strength, Luffy orders his new followers to take out the vice wardens. Following his orders, the prisoners turn on and defeat Daifugo and Solitaire. Eight days before the Onigashima raid, Luffy scores his first victory, liberating Udon's prisoner mine.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Os prisioneiros afetados sofrem dores excruciantes, abrasadoras, febre e sangramento, e eventualmente se tornam emaciados e zumbis, além de serem altamente contagiosos pelo toque também. Daifugo chama a arma viral de obra-prima da rainha, o vírus da múmia. Os prisioneiros cercam Luffy e seus aliados, culpando-os por serem infectados e lançando suas dúvidas de que Luffy derrotará Kaido. Luffy agarra os prisioneiros, infectando-se e diz-lhes que ele fez uma promessa de fazer Wano um lugar próspero novamente e pede aos prisioneiros para se juntar a ele e libertar o país ou continuar a viver uma vida de desespero sob o regime de Kaidou. Babanuki decide tentar matar todos os prisioneiros de uma só vez, usando um tiro de peste, uma bala de canhão contendo duzentas doses do vírus da múmia. Ele a coloca no porta-malas do elefante para atirar, mas Luffy caminha até ele e dá um nó no porta-malas do elefante. Com a bala de canhão ainda dentro, detona no corpo de Babanuki, nocauteando-o. Com a última de suas forças, Luffy ordena que seus novos seguidores tirem os vice-diretores. Seguindo suas ordens, os prisioneiros se viram e derrotaram Daifugo e Solitaire. Oito dias antes da invasão de Onigashima, Luffy marca sua primeira vitória, libertando a mina prisioneira de Udon.

en.title: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
en.synopsis:
Momonosuke and Yamato fly away from the island to try to move it back. They learn that Kaido's flame clouds are becoming unstable due to Kaido weakening and the island risks collapsing and crashing into the Flower Capital below, with all the explosives stored inside Onigashima threatening to destroy the capital if the island falls. Momonosuke panics and considers getting Luffy to stop fighting Kaido, but Yamato smacks him on the head and reminds him that Luffy is already putting everything on his shoulders with his fight, and he doesn't need anymore pressure, meaning the two of them need to figure out how to stop the island themselves. Momonosuke attempts to push the island, but to no avail. Yamamoto advises him that he will have to create flame clouds of his own to support the island. On the Performance Floor, Sanji's battle with Queen continues and Zoro's battle with King. Sanji is hit with a strong attack from Queen, but is surprised that none of his bones are broken. Zoro sends a flying slash that slices off a spike from King's outfit. As this was the first time that King's mask was compromised, he quickly grows infuriated and transforms back into his Human-Beast Form, sending flying slashes into the battle. Several fighters are hit by the slashes, with one slash hits Queen's behind while Zoro is sent flying into a hallway with King following. Meanwhile, as they battle inside the Performance Floor, Queen begs Sanji to put on his Raid Suit, but Sanji refuses stating again he despises the Vinsmokes as his body starts to feel weird again. In the hallway, Zoro clashes with King but is overpowered, though he manages to slice off another piece of King's mask, revealing part of his scalp. King's attacks send Zoro flying off the island but Zoro manages to get back onto the island. As King reverts to his human form, Zoro tell him he will not forgive him for trying to kill him without a sword with King saying he will not forgive Zoro either.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (156/189)

pt-BR.title: A situação cresceu. O fim de Onigashima!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Momonosuke e Yamato voam para longe da ilha para tentar movê-la de volta. Eles descobrem que as nuvens de fogo de Kaido estão se tornando instáveis devido ao enfraquecimento de Kaido e a ilha corre o risco de entrar em colapso e colidir com a Capital das Flores abaixo, com todos os explosivos armazenados dentro de Onigashima ameaçando destruir a capital se a ilha cair. Momonosuke entra em pânico e considera conseguir que Luffy pare de lutar com Kaido, mas Yamato bate na cabeça dele e lembra que Luffy já está colocando tudo em seus ombros com sua luta, e ele não precisa mais de pressão, o que significa que os dois precisam descobrir como parar a ilha. Momonosuke tenta empurrar a ilha, mas sem sucesso. Yamamoto o aconselha que ele terá que criar nuvens de chamas para sustentar a ilha. No Piso de Performance, a batalha de Sanji com a Rainha continua e a batalha de Zoro com o Rei. Sanji é atingido por um forte ataque da Rainha, mas está surpreso que nenhum de seus ossos esteja quebrado. Zoro envia uma barra voadora que corta um pico da roupa de King. Como esta foi a primeira vez que a máscara de King foi comprometida, ele rapidamente se enfurece e se transforma de volta em sua forma de besta humana, enviando cortes voadores para a batalha. Vários lutadores são atingidos pelas barras, com um golpe atrás da rainha enquanto Zoro é enviado voando para um corredor com King seguindo. Enquanto isso, enquanto lutam dentro do Piso de Performance, a Rainha implora para Sanji vestir seu Terno de Raid, mas Sanji se recusa a dizer novamente que ele despreza os Vinsmokes enquanto seu corpo começa a se sentir estranho novamente. No corredor, Zoro se choca com King, mas é dominado, embora ele consiga cortar outro pedaço da máscara de King, revelando parte de seu couro cabeludo. Os ataques de King enviam Zoro voando para fora da ilha, mas Zoro consegue voltar para a ilha. Como King reverte para sua forma humana, Zoro dizer-lhe que ele não vai perdoá-lo por tentar matá-lo sem uma espada com King dizendo que ele não vai perdoar Zoro também.

en.title: Slash the Nightmare: Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!
en.synopsis:
As Robin runs from Black Maria's Gifters, she is joined by Brook, who relieves that she was not tricked by the Illusion Mist. However, they are suddenly attacked by Black Maria herself as Robin remarks that Brook was immune to the mist as well. He explains that he saw his old crew, the Rumbar Pirates, in the mist. However, he saw though the illusion because of how often he hallucinated that his old crew was alive while he was stuck in the Florian Triangle for 50 years and was able to cut down the enemies hiding in the illusion. As the two continue running, Robin points out that they have a lot in common, and Brook thinks back to his time joining the Straw Hat Pirates. While Robin and Brook keep running, Black Maria swipes at them with Wanyudo, who is actually a Pug SMILE user who runs on the inside of the wheel of her weapon to generate flames, setting the floor ablaze. Robin to grab onto the ceiling and lift the two Straw Hats off the floor. Brook realizes that Wanyudo is a living being, sending his soul through him and freezing him, before Brook extinguishes the flames by covering the ground in ice. Black Maria tries to state that Sanji sold out Robin, hence the reason he called for help, but Robin ignores her. Brook leaves Black Maria to Robin, promising to defeat her underlings instead. Once Brook leaves, Robin argues with Black Maria's description of Sanji, and begins fighting back in earnest. Robin creates a giant version of herself, grabbing Black Maria with multiple extra sets of giant hands. However, Black Maria begins slicing at the arms, causing injuries to form on Robin herself. Noticing Robin receive the injuries, Black Maria launches multiple tendrils of thread, blocking the movement of Robin's enlarged limbs. Back on mainland, as Momonosuke and Shinobu watch as Onigashima flies more inland, they're reunited with the Heart Pirates and Luffy, the latter loudly shouting for meat, having already quickly ate through all the Heart Pirates' provisions, while still asking for more. en.synopsis:
Kin'emon explains to Luffy's group what happened in the past. He recounts stories such as the one of his Lord and Momonosuke's farther, Kozuki Oden. Despite being the son of Shogun Sukiyaki, Oden's nonconformist lifestyle and violent ways led to his banishment from the Flower Capital. Sometime later he brought order to the once lawless Kuri after defeating the criminal Ashura Doji, and reforming the criminals that lived there, eventually being given the title of daimyo of Kuri at the age of twenty, though he maintained he disorderly behavior. Meanwhile, Dogstorm reminisces on how when he and Cat Viper washed ashore on Wano, Oden saved them from being persecuted for their appearance and took them under his wing. After beating the tiger, Zoro turns his attention to a nearby fishing pier. Kin'emon continues telling how Kaido and Orochi formed an alliance and had Oden executed as a criminal. Kin'emon, Kanjuro, Kiku, Raizo and another samurai were able to escape the same fate, and headed to Oden Castle as they knew Orochi would target Momonosuke next, but were forced to abandon the captured Cat Viper and Dogstom. They'd arrived at the already burning Oden Castle to rescue Momonosuke, as well as his mother Toki and his younger sister Hiyori. Toki, having been rumored to be from the distant past, having decided to die in the time of her husband, used her Time-Time Fruit ability to send Kin'emon, Kanjuro, Kiku, Raizo and Momonosuke into the future, with Kin'emon vowing to avenge Oden and fulfill his lord's dream of opening Wano's borders. After arriving into the future, Kin'emon's group learned of what has happen to their home, and were surprised to find allies still loyal to Oden.

Quando Luffy é de alguma forma capaz de entender o dragão, Apis diz que ela comeu o Sussurro-Sussurro Fruta e pode ler as mentes dos animais, Luffy e Nami encontrar a razão pela qual Apis está sendo perseguido.

en.title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
en.synopsis:
The episode begins with the Usopp Pirates and Kaya running from Jango through the forest. Jango hurls his chakram and cuts down many trees, searching everywhere for them, and Kaya falls down. She tells the Usopp Pirates to run before they are killed, but they stay and fight, deciding to follow their captain's orders and fight to the death for Kaya. Back at the slope, Kuro claims that he hated being a pirate. Luffy refuses to be like him and Kuro uses his Silent Step to move quickly. Luffy gets the timing right, however, and pounds Kuro down. Kuro gets back up and announces that he is going to kill his entire crew, and that it was part of his plan from the beginning. Luffy claims that Usopp could beat Kuro. Kuro laughs it off and uses Shakushi, causing him to disappear. As Luffy wonders where he went, Nami finishes up looting the Black Cat pirate ship, disappointed by the amount of treasure. She then wonders if the battle is over, but sees that Kuro slashes through several of his crewmates, taking them down quicker than the naked eye can see. Luffy gets even more angry, but just after Kuro slashes him in the chest, he grabs Kuro's arm and slams him onto the ground. Kuro stands up and says that now his crew is suffering because Luffy wouldn't let them die quickly, and so Kuro uses Shakushi once again to disappear. In the forest, at that moment, Jango continues searching for the Usopp Pirates, and they toss him a white flag. Jango walks forward and so the Usopp Pirates launch their ambush. Jango trips over a rope and one of the Usopp Pirates showers him with pepper, making him sneeze. The second jumps out and strikes Jango in the groin with a frying pan. The third leaps down from a large rock and takes a swing at Jango's head, but Jango sits up in time and knocks his attacker away. Kaya then comes out, telling Jango not to hurt the kids, but Jango reports that it was his orders from Kuro to kill the children. Kaya then grabs Jango's chakram and holds it in front of her throat, threatening to kill herself without writing the will. Jango agrees, and so he gets Kaya to write the will. Once finished, he grabs her by the neck and holds her against a tree, holding up a chakram to kill her. Zoro is still running through the woods with Usopp on his back, and Usopp spots Jango. Kuro slices up the rocks, followed by cutting up Luffy's left shoulder as he glances in anger as the episode ends.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Proteja Kaya! Os Grandes Esforços dos Piratas Usopp!
pt-BR.synopsis:
O episódio começa com os Piratas Usopp e Kaya correndo de Jango pela floresta. Jango lança seu chakram e corta muitas árvores, procurando por todos os lugares, e Kaya cai. Ela diz aos Piratas Usopp para correrem antes de serem mortos, mas eles ficam e lutam, decidindo seguir as ordens de seu capitão e lutar até a morte por Kaya. De volta à encosta, Kuro afirma que odiava ser um pirata. Luffy se recusa a ser como ele e Kuro usa seu Passo Silencioso para se mover rapidamente. Luffy tem o tempo certo, no entanto, e pesa Kuro para baixo. Kuro se levanta e anuncia que ele vai matar toda a sua tripulação, e que era parte de seu plano desde o início. Luffy afirma que Usopp poderia vencer Kuro. Kuro ri e usa Shakushi, fazendo com que ele desapareça. Enquanto Luffy se pergunta para onde ele foi, Nami acaba saqueando o navio pirata Black Cat, decepcionado com a quantidade de tesouro. Ela então se pergunta se a batalha acabou, mas vê que Kuro corta vários de seus companheiros de tripulação, levando-os para baixo mais rápido do que a olho nu pode ver. Luffy fica ainda mais irritado, mas logo depois que Kuro o corta no peito, ele agarra o braço de Kuro e bate no chão. Kuro se levanta e diz que agora sua tripulação está sofrendo porque Luffy não os deixaria morrer rapidamente, e então Kuro usa Shakushi mais uma vez para desaparecer. Na floresta, naquele momento, Jango continua procurando os Piratas Usopp, e eles jogam uma bandeira branca para ele. Jango vai em frente e então os Piratas Usopp lançam sua emboscada. Jango tropeça em uma corda e um dos Piratas Usopp o toma com pimenta, fazendo-o espirrar. O segundo salta e atinge Jango na virilha com uma frigideira. O terceiro salta de uma grande rocha e dá um balanço na cabeça de Jango, mas Jango senta-se a tempo e nocauteia seu atacante. Kaya então sai, dizendo a Jango para não machucar as crianças, mas Jango relata que foi ordens dele de Kuro para matar as crianças. Kaya então pega o chakra de Jango e o segura na frente de sua garganta, ameaçando se matar sem escrever o testamento. Jango concorda, e então ele faz Kaya escrever o testamento. Uma vez terminado, ele a agarra pelo pescoço e a segura contra uma árvore, segurando um chacra para matá-la. Zoro ainda está correndo pela floresta com Usopp nas costas, e Usopp vê Jango. Kuro corta as rochas, seguido de cortar o ombro esquerdo de Luffy enquanto ele olha com raiva enquanto o episódio termina.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)
