en.title: Back to the Present Day! 20 Years Later!
en.synopsis:
Orochi frustration grows over the fact Oden's retainers had not been caught. Meanwhile, Oden's remaining followers were devastated by the deaths. Ashura, who survived the encounter in the forest with injuries, reflected on the prophecy given by Toki just before her death. Kawamatsu attempted to cheer up a grieving Hiyori, but to no avail.Denjiro had a meltdown while hidden in a secluded wooden cabin. In the end, this transformed him into a cold and cynical person under the new name, Kyoshiro. He created a new yakuza group and very begrudgingly pledged allegiance to Orochi to work undercover. It is also revealed that Denjiro is also "Ushimitsu Kozo" who steals money from the Capital and distributes it to the poor. After running away from Kawamatsu, Hiyori meets Denjiro and agrees to take on the alias "Komurasaki" for the next 20 years, instructing to carry fake blood at all times so she could fake her death when needed. A few months before the present day, Orochi receives a letter from a Kurozumi spy that informs him about the return of the Akazaya Nine sent through time. When Kaido questions the spy's credibility, Orochi explains the spy is a member of the Kurozumi Family. He was originally part of a theater troupe but his parents were killed in front of him by a lynch mob. The spy met with Orochi and Higurashi, who tasked him with working undercover as one of Oden's retainers while giving a Devil Fruit. The narrator then recounts the trails the retainers who were transported to the future endured, their separation, their meeting with the Straw Hats Pirates and the struggles with them though Punk Hazard, Dressrosa, Zou and Wano as Luffy leads a group of samurai to the rendezvous.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (82/189)

pt-BR.title: De volta ao presente! 20 anos depois!
pt-BR.synopsis:
A frustração de Orochi cresce com o fato de que os retentores de Oden não foram pegos. Enquanto isso, os seguidores restantes de Oden foram devastados pelas mortes. Ashura, que sobreviveu ao encontro na floresta com ferimentos, refletiu sobre a profecia dada por Toki pouco antes de sua morte. Kawamatsu tentou animar um Hiyori de luto, mas sem sucesso. Denjiro teve um colapso enquanto estava escondido em uma cabana de madeira isolada. No final, isso o transformou em uma pessoa fria e cínica sob o novo nome, Kyoshiro. Ele criou um novo grupo de yakuza e prometeu lealdade a Orochi para trabalhar disfarçado. Também é revelado que Denjiro também é "Ushimitsu Kozo" que rouba dinheiro da Capital e distribui para os pobres. Depois de fugir de Kawamatsu, Hiyori conhece Denjiro e concorda em assumir o pseudônimo "Komurasaki" pelos próximos 20 anos, instruindo a carregar sangue falso o tempo todo para que ela possa fingir sua morte quando necessário. Alguns meses antes do dia de hoje, Orochi recebe uma carta de um espião Kurozumi que o informa sobre o retorno dos Akazaya Nine enviados através do tempo. Quando Kaido questiona a credibilidade do espião, Orochi explica que o espião é um membro da família Kurozumi. Ele era originalmente parte de uma trupe de teatro, mas seus pais foram mortos na frente dele por uma multidão de linchamento. O espião se encontrou com Orochi e Higurashi, que o encarregou de trabalhar disfarçado como um dos retentores de Oden enquanto dava uma Fruta do Diabo. O narrador então relata as trilhas que os retentores que foram transportados para o futuro suportaram, sua separação, seu encontro com os Straw Hats Pirates e as lutas com eles, embora Punk Hazard, Dressrosa, Zou e Wano como Luffy levem um grupo de samurais ao encontro.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Many Problems Lie Ahead! A Trap Awaiting in the New World!
en.synopsis:
During a check on the palace, the Minister of the Right gets a report that the Tamate Box is gone along with all the treasures and remembers something very important about it. Caribou starts searching for his treasure that he stole from the royal family after realizing it was taken after waking up from getting beat by Luffy. Jimbei and Neptune talk about how Jimbei might join the Straw Hats and putting a new pirate flag in Fishman Island which is the Straw Hat Pirate flag. Later, the Minister of the Right tells King Neptune that the Tamate Box is gone and it might explode in the hands of Luffy if he opens it. However, when Luffy returns, he announces that he gave all the treasure that he recovered to Pekoms and Baron Tamago, along with the tamate box, and tells everyone that he talked back to Big Mom. While Neptune and the Minister of the Right worry about the fate of the Straw Hats, and Nami beats Luffy up for giving away the treasure, Jimbei decides to cut off the alliance with Big Mom before things get ugly. Caribou finds Tamago and Pekoms with his treasure that he stole and attacks Pekoms with his Gatling Gun. Pekoms reveals himself to be a Zoan-type Devil Fruit user. Caribou then attempts to slice off Pekom's head, saying that he was stronger because he was a logia-type devil fruit eater, only to get punched in the stomach by Pekoms, rendering him unconscious again. Pekoms and Tamago then leave Fishman island. It is later revealed that Smoker and Tashigi were reassigned to the G-5 Marine Branch, the most ruthless marine branch that don't even take orders from the HQ, and arrested a bunch of pirates emerging from Fishman Island, who tell Smoker that Luffy beat Hordy, with Smoker replying that he already knows and calls them idiots.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Fish-Man Island saga: Fish-Man Island arc: (49/51)

pt-BR.title: Muitos problemas estão à frente! Uma Armadilha Esperando no Novo Mundo!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Durante um cheque no palácio, o Ministro da Direita recebe um relatório de que a Caixa de Tamato se foi junto com todos os tesouros e se lembra de algo muito importante sobre isso. Caribou começa a procurar seu tesouro que roubou da família real depois de perceber que foi roubado depois de acordar de ser espancado por Luffy. Jimbei e Neptuno falam sobre como Jimbei pode se juntar aos Chapéus Straw e colocar uma nova bandeira pirata na Ilha Fishman, que é a bandeira Pirata Straw Hat. Mais tarde, o Ministro da Direita diz ao Rei Netuno que a Caixa de Tamato se foi e pode explodir nas mãos de Luffy se ele abrir. No entanto, quando Luffy retorna, ele anuncia que deu todo o tesouro que recuperou para Pekoms e o Barão Tamago, junto com a caixa de domado, e diz a todos que ele falou com a Big Mom. Enquanto Netuno e o Ministro da Direita se preocupam com o destino dos Chapéus Straw, e Nami bate Luffy por dar o tesouro, Jimbei decide cortar a aliança com a Big Mom antes que as coisas fiquem feias. Caribou encontra Tamago e Pekoms com seu tesouro que ele roubou e ataca Pekoms com sua Gatling Gun. Pekoms revela ser um usuário de frutas do tipo Zoan. Caribou então tenta cortar a cabeça de Pekom, dizendo que ele era mais forte porque ele era um comedor de frutas do tipo logia, apenas para ser socado no estômago por Pekoms, deixando-o inconsciente novamente. Pekoms e Tamago então saem da ilha Fishman. Mais tarde é revelado que Smoker e Tashigi foram realocados para o G-5 Marine Branch, o ramo marinho mais cruel que nem recebe ordens do QG, e prendeu um bando de piratas emergindo da Ilha Fishman, que dizem Smoker que Luffy derrotou Hordy, com Smoker respondendo que ele já sabe e os chama de idiotas.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: Attack on a Celestial! Luffy's King Kong Gun of Anger!
en.synopsis:
As the people of Dressrosa cheer for Luffy's return, Doflamingo note that Luffy is at his limit, though Luffy states that he is as well, before being knock down by pillars of string. Doflamingo then attacks Rebecca, but she's teleported away by Law. As their battle resumes, Doflamingo relentlessly attacks Luffy with string and takes control of him. Luffy starts to remember that during his training with Rayleigh, he fought an opponent too big for the Kong Gun to work on, and Rayleigh told him that he needed to come up with something else. Luffy realizes that his Kong Gun isn't enough to beat Doflamingo. Doflamingo tells Luffy that they should have all just stayed in his cage and submitted to his manipulation, saying that humans should only live when a divine being like him manipulates them. He says that he would not have had to carry out this massacre if they had not cut their puppet strings, but Luffy has had enough with his talk. Luffy breaks free by activating Fourth Gear and flies into the air, where he declares his disgust to Doflamingo on how he manipulates everyone and makes it feel like he's suffocating, and the Warlord says that the people here were born as trash and are meant to be manipulated. Luffy tells him to be quiet as he retracts his forearm, and Doflamingo creates a web to protect himself. Luffy then blows air into his other arm, making the retracted arm even bigger, as he remembers sharing his idea for an improved Kong Gun with Rayleigh, as he prepares to deliver the final blow. Doflamingo creates sixteen string spears imbued with Armament Haki for a final attack of his own. Doflamingo uses his God Thread technique and Luffy unleashes his Gum-Gum King Kong Gun. The clash between Luffy and the strings is powerful enough to cause ripples in the water and be felt by the citizens below, and everyone on Dressrosa cheers Luffy on as he breaks through Doflamingo's attack and defense before hitting Doflamingo himself. The force of the punch sends Doflamingo flying into the ground, with the impact tearing apart the city, and Doflamingo falls down into the underground harbor. Law looks up at Luffy and remembers how Corazon once told him in some countries, there are people who call those with the name of "D.", the sworn enemy of the gods as Doflamingo's shattered glasses fall away and Luffy hovers in the air victorious.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Dressrosa saga: Dressrosa arc: (105/118)

pt-BR.title: Ataque a um Celestial! Luffy's King Kong Gun of Anger!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto as pessoas de Dressrosa torcem pelo retorno de Luffy, Doflamingo observa que Luffy está em seu limite, embora Luffy afirme que ele também está, antes de ser derrubado por pilares de corda. Doflamingo então ataca Rebecca, mas ela é teletransportada por lei. À medida que a batalha recomeça, Doflamingo implacavelmente ataca Luffy com cordas e assume o controle dele. Luffy começa a lembrar que durante seu treinamento com Rayleigh, ele lutou contra um oponente grande demais para o Kong Gun trabalhar, e Rayleigh disse a ele que precisava inventar outra coisa. Luffy percebe que sua arma Kong não é suficiente para vencer Doflamingo. Doflamingo diz ao Luffy que todos deveriam ter ficado em sua jaula e se submetido a sua manipulação, dizendo que os humanos só deveriam viver quando um ser divino como ele os manipula. Ele diz que não teria que levar a cabo este massacre se eles não tivessem cortado suas cordas de marionete, mas Luffy já teve o suficiente com sua conversa. Luffy se liberta ativando a Quarta Engrenagem e voa para o ar, onde ele declara seu desgosto para Doflamingo sobre como ele manipula todo mundo e faz parecer que ele está sufocando, e o Senhor da Guerra diz que as pessoas aqui nasceram como lixo e são destinadas a serem manipuladas. Luffy diz para ele ficar quieto enquanto retrai o antebraço, e Doflamingo cria uma teia para se proteger. Luffy então sopra ar em seu outro braço, tornando o braço retraído ainda maior, como ele se lembra de compartilhar sua ideia para uma arma Kong melhorada com Rayleigh, enquanto ele se prepara para entregar o golpe final. Doflamingo cria dezesseis lanças de cordas imbuídas de Armament Haki para um ataque final próprio. Doflamingo usa sua técnica God Thread e Luffy libera sua arma Gum-Gum King Kong. O choque entre Luffy e as cordas é poderoso o suficiente para causar ondulações na água e ser sentido pelos cidadãos abaixo, e todos em Dressrosa torcem Luffy enquanto ele rompe o ataque e a defesa de Doflamingo antes de bater no próprio Doflamingo. A força do soco envia Doflamingo voando para o chão, com o impacto destruindo a cidade, e Doflamingo cai no porto subterrâneo. Lei olha para Luffy e lembra como Corazon disse uma vez a ele em alguns países, há pessoas que chamam aqueles com o nome de "D", o inimigo jurado dos deuses como os óculos quebrados de Doflamingo caem e Luffy paira no ar vitorioso.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: To the Reverie! Rebecca and the Sakura Kingdom!
en.synopsis:
Despite Pedro's instance that they return to Zou to drop Carrot off, Carrot insists she will not get in the way. However, when Nami decides to cook in return for a large fee, Luffy decides to handle the cooking to avoid paying her, much to the horror of Brook and Chopper. Meanwhile other royal families set out for the Reverie, Dalton (with Kureha as his doctor) from the newly named Cherry Blossom Kingdom. Wapol, now king of the newly named Black Drum Kingdom, who reminisces on how after his defeat to Luffy ended up living on the streets where is Munch-Munch ability inadvertently allowed him to become a wealthy toy mogul and eventually regained his royal status, prepares for the Reverie (where he plans to get revenge against Dalton). The Dressrosa royal family also prepares with Rebecca accompanying them as a lady-in-waiting. Back on the Thousand Sunny, Brook gives Carrot a tour, while Pedro receives a new paper state the Revolutionary Army's headquarters has been devastated.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Enquanto isso, outras famílias reais partiram para a Reverie, Dalton (com Kureha como seu médico) do recém-nomeado Reino Cherry Blossom. Wapol, agora rei do recém-nomeado Black Drum Kingdom, que relembra como depois de sua derrota para Luffy acabou vivendo nas ruas onde a habilidade Munch-Munch inadvertidamente permitiu que ele se tornasse um rico magnata de brinquedos e, eventualmente, recuperou seu status real, se prepara para a Reverie (onde ele planeja se vingar contra Dalton). A família real Dressrosa também se prepara com Rebecca acompanhando-os como uma dama de companhia. De volta ao Thousand Sunny, o Brook dá uma visita a Carrot, enquanto Pedro recebe um novo jornal, o quartel-general do Exército Revolucionário foi devastado.

en.title: Z's Ambition! A Dark and Powerful Army!
en.synopsis:
Nami creates a plan for the Straw Hats to rescue Lily's father, Panz Fry. Chopper, Robin, Brook, and Luffy are the diversion group while Usopp, Sanji, Zoro, and Lily are in the submarine. Luffy goes on the submarine because he finds the diversion group boring. They rescue Panz Fry, but Momonga attacks Luffy, forcing Zoro to intercept him. Shuzo attacks the marines and Panz Fry. His pet alpaca Alpacacino shoots out a cannon at the Marine ships. Shuzo attacks Panz Fry directly but is intercepted by Luffy. Shuzo then kicks Luffy into the sea. Zoro jumps into the water to save his captain, and Shuzo and Sanji get into an argument. Shuzo tells Momomga his reason why he quit the marines, much to the dismay of the rest of his crew. Luffy and Zoro then resurface and Luffy threatens Shuzo. Luffy and Momonga prepare to fight Shuzo.

(Source: Wikipedia)

en.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Gin's Debt!
en.synopsis:
After a review of the last episode, the episode begins with Patty, a cook for Baratie, picking his nose in the bathroom while making a monologue about how serving the customers who have money is the number one concern for a restaurant. Upon leaving the bathroom, Patty becomes furious when he sees that Sanji is beating up Fullbody, who is a customer. Sanji replies that customer or not, Fullbody insulted a chef and his food. At this moment, the head chef and Luffy come crashing down from the ceiling because the head chef was kicking Luffy too hard while trying to convince him that he has to work at Baratie for a whole year to pay off his debt. The head chef then kicks Sanji to calm him down and also kicks Fullbody out of the restaurant. Fullbody's subordinate then comes running into the restaurant yelling that their prisoner, a member of Don Krieg's pirates, has escaped. The customers are terrified because Don Krieg is supposedly the strongest pirate in East Blue. The pirate shoots the marine from behind and comes in to order food. Patty recognizes the pirate as a customer and asks if the pirate has any money on him. The pirate points a gun at Patty and says "is a bullet okay?" Patty then beats the pirate up and doesn't recognize the pirate as a customer since he has no money. Sanji, on the other hand, heads to the kitchen and starts making a meal. Fullbody in the meantime, leaves the restaurant sneakily (along with the subordinate who got shot earlier, guess he is still alive). Sanji brings his meal to the pirate, who was thrown out by Patty. Sanji states that, for him, a customer is anybody who is hungry. He also states that he understands the feeling of starvation more than anybody else. The pirate then grabs the meal and gobbles it up, while crying and saying that this is the most delicious dish he has ever had in his entire life. Luffy, who was watching the whole thing, attempts to recruit Sanji as the cook for his crew. After refusing and some conversing, we find out that the head chef used to be a notorious pirate and the restaurant often comes into conflict with other pirates after his fame. Luffy, as always, is stubborn and insists that Sanji joins them. We also find out that the other pirate's name is Gin. Meanwhile, in the kitchen, we learn that Don Krieg is the captain of a fleet of 50 ships. Gin thanks Sanji for the meal and leaves. Sanji throws the dishes into the ocean to get rid of the evidence that Sanji is giving out food for free, which makes Gin even more grateful. Luffy is then sent back to work, where he ends up breaking even more dishes and makes a big commotion in the kitchen. The rest of the crew, Zoro, Nami, and Usopp, turn out to be eating a meal at the restaurant. Sanji, after seeing Nami, is captivated by her beauty. While flirting with Nami, the head chef tells Sanji that he's annoying and that he doesn't need him anymore. Meanwhile, Gin informs Don Krieg of the restaurant, where Don Krieg makes clear his intention to "visit" the restaurant.

(Source: Wikipedia)

East Blue saga: Baratie arc: (3/12)

pt-BR.title: Cliente indesejado! Sanji's Food and Gin's Debt!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Depois de uma revisão do último episódio, o episódio começa com Patty, um cozinheiro de Baratie, pegando o nariz no banheiro enquanto faz um monólogo sobre como servir os clientes que têm dinheiro é a preocupação número um para um restaurante. Ao sair do banheiro, Patty fica furioso quando vê que Sanji está batendo em Fullbody, que é um cliente. Sanji responde esse cliente ou não, Fullbody insultou um chef e sua comida. Neste momento, o chef-chefe e o Luffy caem do teto porque o chef-chefe estava chutando o Luffy com muita força ao tentar convencê-lo de que ele tem que trabalhar em Baratie por um ano inteiro para pagar sua dívida. O chef chefe então chuta Sanji para acalmá-lo e também chuta Fullbody para fora do restaurante. O subordinado de Fullbody então vem correndo para o restaurante gritando que seu prisioneiro, um membro dos piratas de Don Krieg, escapou. Os clientes estão aterrorizados porque Don Krieg é supostamente o pirata mais forte em East Blue. O pirata atira no fuzileiro por trás e vem pedir comida. Patty reconhece o pirata como um cliente e pergunta se o pirata tem algum dinheiro com ele. O pirata aponta uma arma para Patty e diz "é uma bala ok?" Patty então bate o pirata e não reconhece o pirata como um cliente já que ele não tem dinheiro. Sanji, por outro lado, vai para a cozinha e começa a fazer uma refeição. Fullbody, entretanto, deixa o restaurante sorrateiramente (junto com o subordinado que foi baleado mais cedo, acho que ele ainda está vivo). Sanji traz sua refeição para o pirata, que foi expulso por Patty. Sanji afirma que, para ele, um cliente é qualquer um que está com fome. Ele também afirma que entende a sensação de fome mais do que qualquer outra pessoa. O pirata então pega a refeição e a engole, enquanto chora e diz que este é o prato mais delicioso que ele já comeu em toda a sua vida. Luffy, que estava assistindo a coisa toda, tenta recrutar Sanji como o cozinheiro para sua tripulação. Depois de recusar e conversar, descobrimos que o chefe de cozinha costumava ser um pirata notório e o restaurante muitas vezes entra em conflito com outros piratas depois de sua fama. Luffy, como sempre, é teimoso e insiste que Sanji se junte a eles. Também descobrimos que o outro pirata se chama Gin. Enquanto isso, na cozinha, aprendemos que Don Krieg é o capitão de uma frota de 50 navios. Gin agradece Sanji pela refeição e sai. Sanji joga os pratos no oceano para se livrar da evidência de que Sanji está dando comida de graça, o que torna Gin ainda mais grato. Luffy é então enviado de volta ao trabalho, onde ele acaba quebrando ainda mais pratos e faz uma grande comoção na cozinha. O resto da tripulação, Zoro, Nami, e Usopp, acabam comendo uma refeição no restaurante. Sanji, depois de ver Nami, é cativada por sua beleza. Enquanto flerta com Nami, o chef chefe diz a Sanji que ele é irritante e que ele não precisa mais dele. Enquanto isso, Gin informa Don Krieg do restaurante, onde Don Krieg deixa claro sua intenção de "visitar" o restaurante.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.title: The Battle of the Monsters! The Three Stubborn Captains!
en.synopsis:
Kaido attacks Luffy, who barely dodges and is pleased, especially after seeing the shadows of those who were capable of fighting him behind Luffy. Big Mom attempts to attack Luffy with Prometheus but Zoro cuts it in half using Foxfire Style while Kaido attempts to attack a distracted Luffy. In the Pleasure Hall, Sanji is kept bound by Black Maria but is too charmed by the women to attempt to escape. Eventually, he decides to free himself by burning the webs with Diable Jambe flames, then uses the webs to fight off the ladies. However, he can't find himself to attack Black Maria, and Maria starts interrogating him about his crew's whereabouts, especially Robin. Law rescues Luffy . before he, Luffy and Kid begin bickering just as Prometheus shoots fireballs at them. Luffy suggests a contest where the last to dodge the fireball would win. Since they were focused on winning this contest, they all ended up being hit by the fireballs. Big Mom fires fireballs at the three captains who refused to dodge due to Luffy's game. Zoro reveals to Killer that he's aware the latter was Kamazo while Killer states his believe that he would have won their fight if he had his Punishers (a pair of gauntlets equipped with rotating sickle blades). The two combatants attack Kaido, to no effect, as Luffy, Law, and Kid get back up and prepare to attack. Luffy transforms into his Fourth Gear Bounceman, Kid gathers metallic objects to form Punk Rotten, a gigantic skull-faced demon-like golem made of scrap and Law creates a large Room and uses it to ride on rocks. They prepare for battle as Kaido excitedly calls them "monsters."

(Source: Wikipedia)

No Pleasure Hall, Sanji é mantida ligada por Maria Negra, mas é muito encantada pelas mulheres para tentar escapar. Eventualmente, ele decide libertar-se queimando as teias com chamas Diable Jambe, em seguida, usa as teias para lutar contra as senhoras. No entanto, ele não consegue atacar Maria Negra, e Maria começa a interrogá-lo sobre o paradeiro de sua tripulação, especialmente Robin. A lei salva Luffy... antes que ele, Luffy e Kid comecem a brigar, assim como Prometeu dispara bolas de fogo contra eles. Luffy sugere um concurso onde o último a esquivar-se da bola de fogo venceria. Já que estavam focados em vencer este concurso, todos acabaram sendo atingidos pelas bolas de fogo. Big Mom dispara bolas de fogo contra os três capitães que se recusaram a se esquivar devido ao jogo do Luffy. Zoro revela a Killer que ele está ciente de que o último era Kamazo enquanto Killer afirma que ele acredita que teria vencido sua luta se tivesse seus Punishers (um par de manoplas equipadas com lâminas de foice rotativas). Os dois combatentes atacam Kaido, sem efeito, como Luffy, Law, e Kid se levantam e se preparam para atacar. en.title: No Regrets! Luffy and Boss, a Master-Disciple Bond!
en.synopsis:
On the live floor of Skull Dome, Chopper works on the antidote but starts to run out of stamina. Still, he pushes through, using the last of his strength. Hyougoro also decides to use the last of his strength, battling the enemy Beast Pirates. However, he instructs his men to kill him once the transformation is complete. As he takes on the Mimawarigumi, he regrets not battling with Oden against Kaido while in his prime. However, he is pleased that the alliance now has a powerful asset, Luffy. On the rooftop, Kaido sends more slashes at his enemies in his Human-Beast Form and Big Mom makes Zeus unleash more lightning bolts. Luffy, having rested enough, is able to use Haki again and is ready to reenter the battle. Queen fires a laser beam from his mouth at Marco, but he avoids it before engaging both King and Queen managing to best both of them, sending King flying into a house and Queen into a wall. Although both survive and emerge from the rubble, this buys Chopper some extra time. However, Perospero, who enters from the stairs, spots him exhausted. Chopper manages to develop a cure for the virus. Before he administers the antidote to other people, he decides to test it on himself to guarantee its safety, noting the antidote creates a high fever meant to combat the virus. Hyougoro defeats both the Orochi Oniwabanshu and the Mimawarigumi, but he begins to transform into an Ice Oni. He orders his men to kill him so he would not endanger his allies. Leaving the battle to his subordinates, he states that he has no regrets.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (128/189)

pt-BR.title: Sem arrependimentos! Luffy e Boss, um Master-Discípulo Bond!
pt-BR.synopsis:
No chão ao vivo de Skull Dome, Chopper trabalha no antídoto, mas começa a ficar sem resistência. Ainda assim, ele avança, usando o último de sua força. Hyougoro também decide usar o último de sua força, lutando contra os inimigos Piratas da Besta. No entanto, ele instrui seus homens a matá-lo assim que a transformação estiver completa. Enquanto ele enfrenta o Mimawarigumi, ele se arrepende de não lutar com Oden contra Kaido enquanto está em seu auge. No entanto, ele está satisfeito que a aliança agora tem um ativo poderoso, Luffy. No telhado, Kaido envia mais cortes em seus inimigos em sua forma de besta humana e Big Mom faz Zeus soltar mais raios. Luffy, tendo descansado o suficiente, é capaz de usar Haki novamente e está pronto para reentrar na batalha. Rainha dispara um raio laser de sua boca em Marco, mas ele evita isso antes de envolver tanto Rei e Rainha conseguindo o melhor de ambos, enviando Rei voando em uma casa e Rainha em uma parede. Embora ambos sobrevivam e emergem dos escombros, isso compra Chopper algum tempo extra. No entanto, Perospero, que entra pelas escadas, o vê exausto. Chopper consegue desenvolver uma cura para o vírus. Antes de administrar o antídoto para outras pessoas, ele decide testá-lo em si mesmo para garantir sua segurança, observando que o antídoto cria uma febre alta destinada a combater o vírus. Hyougoro derrota os Orochi Oniwabanshu e os Mimawarigumi, mas ele começa a se transformar em um Oni de Gelo. Ele ordena que seus homens o matem para que não ponha em perigo seus aliados. Deixando a batalha para seus subordinados, ele afirma que não se arrepende.

en.title: Nami's Lethal Attack! O-Tama's Desperate Challenge!
en.synopsis:
The Heart Pirates find a sinking Luffy, bringing him to the surface on their submarine. They begin trying to treat him, forcing the water he's swallowed out of his stomach. Meanwhile, as Shinobu and Momonosuke fall from Onigashima, Shinobu uses a kite, and the pair glide to the Wano mainland. However, when they land, Momonosuke bursts into tears, worried over the Kin'emon and Kiku. Back on Onigashima, Ulti is terrorizing Tama when she is suddenly attacked by Nami. Zeus offers to send a lightning blast, but Nami argues that it would hurt Tama; however, Usopp is able to separate her, and Nami takes the opportunity to make a cloud, but Zeus becomes the cloud. Nami then launches a Lightning Blast at Ulti who tries to dodge the strike, but Zeus redirects himself to hit her, knocking the Tobi Roppo unconscious. Panicking, Bao Huang accidentally announces Ulti's and Page One's defeats over the Marys system, causing panic across the Beast Pirates. Taking advantage of her panicking, Usopp incapacitates Horseman and Bao Huang, informing Tama that the latter works as a transmitter. As the allies across the island are overwhelmed with numbers, Tama speaks into the transmitter, converting the Gifters tamed by her power into allies. Elsewhere, Yamato informs Kaido of her decision to cut their familiar ties. Kaido tries to persuade her otherwise, stating that he defeated both Luffy and Momonosuke, but Yamato refuses to change her mind. Yamato declares her intention to set out to sea, stating that she will force Kaido to leave Wano; however, Kaido refuses to allow her to be a pirate elsewhere, stating she must stay in Wano as he transforms into his Human-Beast Form. The two clash, with Yamato intending on forcing Kaido to remain on the rooftop until Luffy returns.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: O Ataque Letal do Nami! Desafio Desesperado de O-Tama!

Os Piratas do Coração encontram um Luffy afundando, trazendo-o à superfície em seu submarino. Eles começam a tentar tratá-lo, forçando a água que ele engoliu de seu estômago. Enquanto isso, quando Shinobu e Momonosuke caem de Onigashima, Shinobu usa uma pipa, e os dois deslizam para o continente Wano. No entanto, quando aterrissam, Momonosuke explode em lágrimas, preocupado com o Kin'emon e Kiku. De volta a Onigashima, Ulti está aterrorizando Tama quando de repente ela é atacada por Nami. Zeus se oferece para enviar uma explosão de raios, mas Nami argumenta que machucaria Tama; no entanto, Usopp é capaz de separá-la, e Nami aproveita a oportunidade para fazer uma nuvem, mas Zeus se torna a nuvem. Nami então lança uma Explosão de Relâmpago em Ulti que tenta se esquivar do ataque, mas Zeus se redireciona para acertá-la, derrubando o Tobi Roppo inconsciente. Em pânico, Bao Huang acidentalmente anuncia as derrotas de Ulti e Page One sobre o sistema Marys, causando pânico entre os Piratas da Fera. Aproveitando-se de seu pânico, Usopp incapacita Horseman e Bao Huang, informando Tama que este último funciona como transmissor. Como os aliados de toda a ilha estão sobrecarregados com números, Tama fala no transmissor, convertendo os Gifters domados por seu poder em aliados. Em outro lugar, Yamato informa Kaido de sua decisão de cortar seus laços familiares. Kaido tenta convencê-la do contrário, afirmando que derrotou Luffy e Momonosuke, mas Yamato se recusa a mudar de ideia. Yamato declara sua intenção de partir para o mar, afirmando que ela vai forçar Kaido a deixar Wano, no entanto, Kaido se recusa a permitir que ela seja um pirata em outro lugar, afirmando que ela deve ficar em Wano como ele se transforma em sua forma de besta humana. en.title: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky
en.synopsis:
Kaido and Yamato clash on the Onigashima rooftop, as Yamato attempts to cut ties with her father. However, Kaido refuses to accept it, instead trying to convince Yamato to become the Shogun of Wano under Kaido. Yamato states that she will continue to believe in Luffy, and that he will stall Kaido until he returns. He transforms into his Human-Beast Form, vowing to protect Wano. On the Performance Floor, Queen continues to attack Sanji, bragging about his powers as a cyborg, firing lasers from the mechanical claws on the end of his left arm, tail and braid. However, Sanji shows no real interest in them angering Queen. As Sanji continues to dodge the lasers, Zoro convinces Chopper and Miyagi to give him the miracle drug. Elsewhere, Gifters under Tama's influence begin assisting Franky, driving off the Beast Pirates who were surrounding him. As Franky and Sasaki fight, the two realize that they're both very durable, so Sasaki transforms into his Human-Beast Form. Back on the roof, Kaido continues trying to convince Yamato to stay by his side while expressing anger Yamato for eating her Devil Fruit. Yamato responds that she only ate it because she was starving and is also mad since she can no longer swim. Back in the Right Brain Tower, Sasaki draws his Trick Mechanism Screw Sword as Franky draws his sword. Franky instructs the surrounding Gifters to go help others, but Sasaki suddenly begins spinning his frill like a propeller, and begins to fly, charging forward and sending the Gifters flying. Franky is forced on the defensive, preparing the General Shield in anticipation of Sasaki's next charge. However, Sasaki accidentally spins his frills the wrong direction, throwing himself backwards instead. He follows up with a charge forward, successfully blowing one of the thrusters on the General Franky's shoulder. However, Franky managed to grab Sasaki, suplexing him into the ground. In the ocean, the Heart Pirates continue trying to wake up Luffy. He finally regains consciousness, and begins demanding meat.

(Source: Wikipedia)

No entanto, Kaido se recusa a aceitá-lo, em vez disso, tentando convencer Yamato a se tornar o Shogun de Wano sob Kaido. Yamato afirma que ela vai continuar a acreditar em Luffy, e que ele vai parar Kaido até que ele volte. Ele se transforma em sua forma de besta humana, prometendo proteger Wano. No Piso de Performance, Queen continua a atacar Sanji, gabando-se de seus poderes como um ciborgue, disparando lasers das garras mecânicas na extremidade de seu braço esquerdo, cauda e trança. No entanto, Sanji não mostra nenhum interesse neles irritando a Rainha. Enquanto Sanji continua a esquivar-se dos lasers, Zoro convence Chopper e Miyagi a dar-lhe a droga milagrosa. Em outro lugar, Gifters sob a influência de Tama começam a ajudar Franky, expulsando os Piratas da Besta que o cercavam. Enquanto Franky e Sasaki lutam, os dois percebem que ambos são muito duráveis, então Sasaki se transforma em sua forma de besta humana. De volta ao telhado, Kaido continua tentando convencer Yamato a ficar ao seu lado enquanto expressa raiva Yamato por comer sua Fruta do Diabo. Yamato responde que ela só comeu porque estava faminta e também está brava, já que não pode mais nadar. De volta à Torre do Cérebro Direito, Sasaki desenha sua Espada do Mecanismo de Truques enquanto Franky puxa sua espada. Franky instrui os Gifters ao redor para ir ajudar os outros, mas Sasaki de repente começa a girar sua frescura como uma hélice, e começa a voar, carregar para a frente e enviar os Gifters voando. Franky é forçado na defensiva, preparando o Escudo Geral em antecipação à próxima acusação de Sasaki. No entanto, Sasaki acidentalmente gira seus babados na direção errada, jogando-se para trás em vez disso. en.title: The Devil's Fist! A Show Down! Luffy vs. Grount!
en.synopsis:
Prodi fire at Brook and the Shark Submerge III before firing hake-infused shots from his bazooka at the group, while his men use rubber-coated shields to counter Nami's and Carrot's electrical attacks. However the Sanji Retrieval Team beats them using physical attacks. Bonham and Zappa prepare to join the fight but Grount, having lost his fighting spirit, refuses to come. After Bonham berates him Zappa tells Grount to remember what Aokiji taught them. As Luffy manages to defeat Prodi, Bonham and Zappa confront him. Grount remembers how in is youth, after eating a Zoan Devil Fruit, his left arm transformed into a large, hairy red arm resembling a gorilla's, but ended up destroying an island due to not being able to control it, before being subdued by Aokiji who trained him as a Marine. Years later, Aokiji tells Grount (who had is left arm contained in a metal attachment) no matter how strong he is, he may still lose to powerful opponents, but it's want he does afterwards that matters. Back in the present, Luffy defeats Bonham and Zeppa and prepares to leave From Island. However, he is confronted again by Grount, having regained his resolve, who shatters the attachment on his left arm to reveal its true form. Having trained all his life to control it, Grount wields its tremendous power against Luffy, but after a titanic struggle Luffy eventually manages to overpower and defeat him. As the Sanji Retrieval Team finally leaves Fron Island, Grount laughs and remarks that Luffy was a worthy opponent. On the Thousand Sunny, the Sanji Retrieval Team eats all the rations taken from the base in ten minutes.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: O Punho do Diabo! Um Show Down! Luffy vs. Grount!

No entanto, a Equipe de Recuperação Sanji os vence usando ataques físicos. Bonham e Zappa se preparam para se juntar à luta, mas Grount, tendo perdido seu espírito de luta, se recusa a vir. Depois que Bonham o repreende Zappa diz a Grount para lembrar o que Aokiji lhes ensinou. Enquanto Luffy consegue derrotar Prodi, Bonham e Zappa o confrontam. Grount se lembra de como é jovem, depois de comer uma fruta do Zoan Devil, seu braço esquerdo se transformou em um grande braço vermelho peludo semelhante ao de um gorila, mas acabou destruindo uma ilha devido a não ser capaz de controlá-la, antes de ser subjugado por Aokiji que o treinou como um fuzileiro naval. Anos mais tarde, Aokiji diz a Grount (que tinha o braço esquerdo contido em um acessório de metal) não importa o quão forte ele seja, ele ainda pode perder para oponentes poderosos, mas é o desejo que ele faça depois que isso importa. No presente, Luffy derrota Bonham e Zeppa e se prepara para sair da Ilha. No entanto, ele é confrontado novamente por Grount, tendo recuperado sua determinação, que quebra o apego em seu braço esquerdo para revelar sua verdadeira forma. Tendo treinado toda a sua vida para controlá-lo, Grount exerce seu tremendo poder contra Luffy, mas depois de uma luta titânica Luffy finalmente consegue dominar e derrotá-lo. Quando a Equipe Sanji Retrieval finalmente deixa Fron Island, Grount ri e observa que Luffy era um oponente digno. Desire is attacked as well, which shocks her, as Bill had rescued her crew after most of her crew was annihilated. The three are then sent plummeting further underground, where Desire explains he anger towards Bartolomeo is because when they were younger they had promised to aim for the top together, but she set off alone with her friends after Bartolomeo decided to help Luffy become Pirate King instead. The three then discover members of the Silver Pirate Alliance who are enslaved as miners due to not pleasing Bill. Bartolomeo manages to free his hands, and Avelon returns, unwittingly freeing Luffy from his silver ball with an attack. Luffy and Bartolomeo then work together to defeat Avelon, and upon hearing about this, Bill orders the underground mine to be buried.

The Lead Performers realize that Luffy's group was only a decoy for the real invading group. Ulti confronts Yamato for striking her down earlier. Yamato officially defects from the Beasts Pirates, swearing allegiance to the Kouzuki Family, saying she doesn't care if Kaido die as she attacks the enemy Beast Pirates and battles Ulti head-on. Elsewhere, Law travels through Kaido's castle, and Who's-Who stops chasing Yamato to resolve other business. Meanwhile, Big Mom spots and approaches Luffy. Shinobu sneaks onto the balcony in an attempt to rescue Momonosuke, while Robin and Jimbei prepare to strike when needed. In the hallway, Nami and Carrot fight back against the homies, striking them with electricity and killing them all. Nami then runs after Big Mom to retrieve Zeus. Luffy and Big Mom quickly enter battle, and punch each other, but Big Mom overpowers Luffy, knocking him back. Meanwhile, Nami finds Zeus. Terrified of her, Zeus rejoins Nami. The Akazaya Nine attempt to kill Kaido by stabbing him with their swords. Kin'emon recites the prophecy given by Toki twenty years prior. They nearly succeed in killing Kaido, but he unleashes a powerful attack knocking them all back. Back on the Performance Floor, Big Mom asks Luffy why he came here, being incredulous that he seriously intends to take on Kaido. To his allies' surprise, Luffy denies it, saying he is not just there for Kaido. Kaido deduces that the samurai have allied themselves with Luffy to take him down. Kaido attempts to deceive the samurai, claiming that Luffy would betray them whenever he saw fit. Kin'emon rebukes Kaido's words as slander and refuses to back down, saying that Luffy will one day stand at the pinnacle of the seas and no matter what happens, he will remain and achieve the promise of daybreak coming back to Wano. Luffy tells Big Mom that he came to defeat all of his enemies as he declares an all-out war.

en.title: Luffy's Past! Enter Red-Haired Shanks!
en.synopsis:
In a flashback, a seven-year-old Luffy sits in a bar filled with the pirate crew of the "Red-Haired" Shanks, begging him to take him out to sea. But the pirate captain refuses. A bandit named Higuma enters and orders several barrels of booze. Shanks offers him the last bottle but Higuma smashes it and humiliates Shanks. After the bandit leaves the bar, all of the pirates start to laugh. Luffy gets angry that Shanks did not fight back and in a huff eats a purple fruit lying on the bar. Shanks notices this and tries to make Luffy spit it out, but it was too late. Shanks tells Luffy that he just ate the Gum Gum Fruit, a Devil Fruit, and now he is a rubber man and won't be able to ever swim again. Later, Luffy gets attacked by Higuma and his bandits. He is about to be killed, when Shanks and his crew arrive and effortlessly defeat Higuma's men. Frightened, Higuma throws down a smoke bomb and makes his escape, taking Luffy with him. He flees out to sea in a boat. There he throws the non-swimmer into the water. As Higuma laughs at Luffy's plight, a Sea King appears behind him and devours him whole. The sea monster then goes for Luffy, but Shanks stops the sea monster as it takes a bite, and with one look, drives the beast away. Luffy clutches Shanks and starts crying, since Shanks' arm was bitten off by the creature. Shanks replies that it is fine, as long as Luffy is safe. As the pirates get ready to leave, Luffy decides he will become a pirate on his own, that he will gather a crew that will beat Shanks', and that he will become King of the Pirates. Shanks gives his straw hat to Luffy and tells him to return it some day, as a great pirate. Back in the present, Luffy slingshots into the sky to catch a bird. Instead he is caught himself. Zoro, now alone in their boat, tries to keep up, paddling. On his way he picks up three castaways from Buggy's crew. The bird, carrying Luffy flies over a town, where it is shot down by Buggy's men. Luffy falls down and lands right in front of Nami, who is running away from Buggy's crew for stealing their precious map to the Grand Line.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Um bandido chamado Higuma entra e pede vários barris de bebida. Shanks oferece a última garrafa, mas Higuma a esmaga e humilha Shanks. Depois que o bandido sai do bar, todos os piratas começam a rir. Luffy fica com raiva que Shanks não revidou e em um huff come uma fruta roxa deitada no bar. Shanks percebe isso e tenta fazer Luffy cuspir, mas era tarde demais. Shanks diz ao Luffy que ele acabou de comer a Gum Gum Fruit, uma Fruta do Diabo, e agora ele é um homem de borracha e não será capaz de nadar novamente. Mais tarde, Luffy é atacado por Higuma e seus bandidos. Ele está prestes a ser morto, quando Shanks e sua tripulação chegam e sem esforço derrotam os homens de Higuma. Assustado, Higuma joga uma bomba de fumaça e escapa, levando Luffy com ele. Ele foge para o mar em um barco. Lá ele joga o não-nadador na água. Enquanto Higuma ri da situação de Luffy, um Rei do Mar aparece atrás dele e o devora inteiro. O monstro marinho então vai para Luffy, mas Shanks para o monstro marinho enquanto ele morde, e com um olhar, afasta a besta. Luffy pega Shanks e começa a chorar, já que o braço de Shanks foi mordido pela criatura. Shanks responde que está tudo bem, desde que Luffy esteja seguro. Enquanto os piratas se preparam para partir, Luffy decide que se tornará um pirata por conta própria, que reunirá uma tripulação que derrotará Shanks, e que se tornará o Rei dos Piratas. Shanks dá seu chapéu de palha para Luffy e diz a ele para devolvê-lo algum dia, como um grande pirata. De volta ao presente, Luffy slingshots no céu para pegar um pássaro. Em vez disso, ele é pego sozinho. Zoro, agora sozinho em seu barco, tenta acompanhar, remar. A caminho, ele pega três náufragos da tripulação do Buggy. O pássaro, carregando Luffy voa sobre uma cidade, onde é abatido pelos homens de Buggy. Luffy cai e pousa bem na frente de Nami, que está fugindo da tripulação de Buggy por roubar seu precioso mapa para a Grand Line.

Inside the manor, though furious to find Nami, Usopp and Chopper in his lab after they were knocked in by the General Zombie Ryuma, Hogback sees no point in being upset as it is almost midnight. As midnight draws near, Absalom rallies the zombies together while the negativity-inducing ghosts converge into their master, a Gothic Lolita-style Ghost Princess named Perona. As the castle is slowly being engulfed by fire, many Beast Pirates quickly move towards the Performance Floor where Sanji, Zoro, King and Queen are fighting, Hyougoro and Kawamatsu preventing them from interfering with the fight. Meanwhile, after beating Sasaki, as Franky fends off some Beast Pirates, he runs out of energy so Bepo, Penguin, and Shachi step in. On the second floor of the castle, Nami, Usopp, and Tama are riding on Speed's back, with Zeus following close by. They are running away from Beast Pirates and while trying to escape Usopp to fall off Speed's back. On the same floor, Law and Kid are battling with Big Mom. Her Conqueror's Haki causes a large number of Beast Pirates to lose consciousness, which saves Usopp from their attacks. Usopp bluffs about causing the surge of Haki and urges the remaining conscious Beast Pirates to join him. On the third floor, Brook is carrying an unconscious Robin inside the burning floor while the fourth floor, Jimbei and Heat are also fighting Beast Pirates. Meanwhile, at the rooftop, Yamato barely manages to keep Kaido preoccupied while waiting for Luffy to return. In the Treasure Repository, Dogstorm and Jack are still engaged in battle, with Jack now in his centaur-like Human-Beast Form. Jack seems to have the upper hand since Dogstorm can't use his Sulong form indoors. However, using his convictions, he gets a surge of energy to toss Jack though a wall into a portion of the castle where the roof was blown off, (the room where Ashura sacrificed himself). Now with the moon visible, Dogstorm transforms into his Sulong form. Outside, as Shishilian and Bariete tend to Carrot and Wanda, Cat Viper faces Perospero, vowing to avenge Pedro's death, transforms into a Sulong as well. On the second floor, Fukurokuju mocks the Akazaya Nine fools for serving a child but Raizo angrily tells him that Momonosuke still has time to grow, with Wano serving to shape that. In Tokage Port, Caribou and the other Heart Pirates see a large pink dragon and are frightened as it resembles Kaido. Luffy approaches the dragon, knowing that it is actually Momonosuke. Shinobu reveals that she used her Ripe-Ripe abilities to age him to 28 years old, at the young shogun's request. Luffy then tells Momonosuke that it is time for them to take Wano back.

Enquanto isso, depois de derrotar Sasaki, enquanto Franky afasta alguns Piratas da Besta, ele fica sem energia, então Bepo, Penguin e Shachi entram. No segundo andar do castelo, Nami, Usopp, e Tama estão andando nas costas de Speed, com Zeus por perto. Eles estão fugindo dos Piratas das Feras e enquanto tentam escapar do Usopp para cair das costas de Speed. No mesmo andar, Law e Kid estão lutando com a Big Mom. Haki de seu Conquistador faz com que um grande número de Piratas da Fera percam a consciência, o que salva Usopp de seus ataques. Usopp blefa sobre causar a onda de Haki e pede que os restantes Piratas da Besta conscientes se juntem a ele. No terceiro andar, Brook está carregando um inconsciente Robin dentro do chão em chamas, enquanto o quarto andar, Jimbei e Heat também estão lutando contra os Piratas das Feras. Enquanto isso, no telhado, Yamato mal consegue manter Kaido preocupado enquanto espera Luffy voltar. No Repositório do Tesouro, Dogstorm e Jack ainda estão envolvidos em batalha, com Jack agora em sua forma de Centauro. Jack parece ter vantagem, já que Dogstorm não pode usar sua forma Sulong dentro de casa. No entanto, usando suas convicções, ele recebe uma onda de energia para jogar Jack através de uma parede em uma parte do castelo onde o telhado foi explodido, (a sala onde Ashura se sacrificou). His crew supported him, but Aladine's wife and Big Mom's daughter Charlotte Praline warned him that no one who tried to leave her mother's crew has emerged alive. In the present, Big Mom takes Jimbei to her castle, and seems fine with him leaving, but then says he will have to lose something in return. She then takes out a roulette wheel to determine what he will lose. As night falls, the Sanji Retrieval Team gets stuck in a sea of mizuame. While they try to free themselves, Pedro reveals that he once sailed with Pekoms as explorers looking for Poneglyphs. However, he met his defeat here, though is now returning because he knows how highly Duke Dogstorm and Master Cat Viper think of the Straw Hats. He now wants to help the Straw Hats get ahold of Big Mom's Road Poneglyph, and offers to sneak in and get it while the others rescue Sanji. en.title: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild!
en.synopsis:
Kin'emon and Kikunojo visit Raizo and Shinobu, in critical condition due to dehydration inflicted by Ryokugyu. As they talk it is mentioned that Kin'emon has reunited with Tsuru Carrot meets with the Minks privately; Dogstorm and Cat Viper have decided to remain in the Land of Wano to defend the shogun, so they entrust the Mokomo Dukedom to Carrot. Despite Carrot trying to refuse the role, the two reminded her travels with Luffy's crew gave her a broader view than most minks and that she possesses the same will that Pedro once had. Meanwhile, Sukiyaki then reveals his identity to Momonosuke, Hiyori, and the other Akazaya Nine, where he apologizes for going into hiding following Oden's death. Robin reports her findings regarding Pluton to the Straw Hat Pirates. Despite knowing the weapon is located in the country, Luffy decides not to attempt to uncover the weapon. Shinobu then arrives, having regained her youthful form following Ryokugyu's attack. She is accompanied by Tama, who has become her kunoichi apprentice. Tama asks Luffy if she can join his crew, and he accepts following she masters ninjutsu. Caribou, who was eavesdropping nearby, is shocked by the truth about Pluton, and must let a certain person know about it. A few days later, Momonosuke attempts to meet with them, but learns from Hiyori that the Straw Hat Pirates have all already left the castle. Kin'emon arrives and tells Momonosuke that they didn't know about their departure either and both become angry. The Straw Hat Pirates, Heart Pirates and Kid Pirates all prepare to depart the country via Tokage Port. After briefly arguing about their next direction, Kid presents a poster to Luffy. The poster reveals that Buggy now an Emperor has joined forces with Mihawk and Crocodile, though Luffy and Zoro highly doubt Buggy is actually in charge. The three have formed the Cross Guild, an organization which assigns bounties to Marines, now placing Marine soldiers under threat of civilian bounty hunters. As they prepare to depart, Law gives Kid a rubbing of Wano's Road Poneglyph, and the latter reveals his crew had managed to take one from Whole Cake Island some time ago. Killer states that in order to take part in the upcoming war over the One Piece, they need to find a "man with a burn mark". Momonosuke and Kin'emon meet with Yamato, who vows to live like Oden did.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Quando eles falam, é mencionado que Kin'emon se reuniu com Tsuru Carrot se reúne com os Minks em particular; Dogstorm e Cat Viper decidiram permanecer na Terra de Wano para defender o shogun, então eles confiam o Ducado Mokomo a Carrot. Apesar de Cenoura tentar recusar o papel, os dois lembraram que suas viagens com a tripulação de Luffy lhe deram uma visão mais ampla do que a maioria dos minks e que ela possui a mesma vontade que Pedro uma vez teve. Enquanto isso, Sukiyaki então revela sua identidade para Momonosuke, Hiyori, e os outros Akazaya Nine, onde ele se desculpa por se esconder após a morte de Oden. Robin relata suas descobertas sobre Pluton aos Piratas Straw Hat. Apesar de saber que a arma está localizada no país, Luffy decide não tentar descobrir a arma. Shinobu então chega, tendo recuperado sua forma jovem após o ataque de Ryokugyu. Ela é acompanhada por Tama, que se tornou sua aprendiz de kunoichi. Tama pede Luffy se ela pode se juntar a sua tripulação, e ele aceita seguir ela domina ninjutsu. Caribou, que estava escutando nas proximidades, está chocado com a verdade sobre Pluton, e deve deixar uma certa pessoa saber sobre isso. Alguns dias depois, Momonosuke tenta se encontrar com eles, mas aprende com Hiyori que os Piratas Straw Hat já deixaram o castelo. Kin'emon chega e diz a Momonosuke que eles não sabiam sobre sua partida também e ambos ficam com raiva. Os Piratas Straw Hat, Piratas do Coração e Piratas Kid todos se preparam para deixar o país através do Porto Tokage. Depois de discutir brevemente sobre sua próxima direção, Kid apresenta um pôster para Luffy. O cartaz revela que Buggy agora um imperador uniu forças com Mihawk e Crocodile, embora Luffy e Zoro duvidam muito que Buggy esteja no comando. Os três formaram a Cross Guild, uma organização que atribui recompensas aos fuzileiros navais, agora colocando soldados da Marinha sob ameaça de caçadores de recompensas civis. Enquanto se preparam para partir, Law dá a Kid um toque de Poneglyph da Estrada de Wano, e este último revela que sua tripulação conseguiu pegar um de Whole Cake Island há algum tempo. Assassino afirma que, para participar da próxima guerra sobre o One Piece, eles precisam encontrar um "homem com uma marca de queimadura". Momonosuke e Kin'emon se encontram com Yamato, que promete viver como Oden.

Whitebeard originally refused, but Oden agreed, determined to find the final island of the Grand Line. en.title: Moon Princess Echoes! The Final Phase of the Land of Wano!
en.synopsis:
Zunesha appears at Onigashima to aid the battle, but Momonosuke is unsure of whether to continue the battle. He explains to Yamato that it may not have been Oden's intention to liberate the Land of Wano if it endangered innocent lives. Onigashima begins to crumble as a result of the explosion, as well as the battle on the Skull Dome. Meanwhile, Franky saves Zoro from falling off the edge of the island, pulling him back onto the island with his extendable arm. Izo confronts the CP0 agents refusing to let them pass. After a short battle, Izo was quickly overpowered. However, as the agent, Maha, fatally strike Izo in the chest, Izo manages to shoot him down with his pistol, causing them to simultaneously take each other down. The lead agent briefly laments Maha's downfall. He then continues his search for Nico Robin, but he receives an imperial order from the Five Elders. Nami's group, accompanied Kid and Law's crew members, celebrate their victory against Big Mom and rest. The lead agent is ordered to interrupt Luffy's battle with Kaido and eliminate him immediately as a precaution as he's seen as an especially dangerous threat. The lead agent reluctantly obeys the order, but he is unaware that Drake has regain consciousness behind him. Komurasaki accompanies Orochi in his private chamber as he awaits Fukurokuju's return. Orochi becomes impatient and frustrated, but the ceiling suddenly collapses, crushing him under the rubble. Pressing her advantage, Komurasaki inserts a Seastone nail into Orochi's body, weakening him and preventing him from using his Devil Fruit powers. She plays Orochi's favorite song, "Moon Princess" on her shamisen and reveals that the song was also the favorite of her father, Oden and that she wears a mask so she could avoid smiling for him while playing it. In the Performance Hall, Kaid and Law acknowledge that their too exhausted to fight Kaido, leaving it all truly up to Luffy on the Skull Dome, Kaido notices that Big Mom had been defeated by Kid and Law, and begins to mourn her, reflecting on how they met while serving Rocks's crew. Luffy takes advantage of Kaido's emotional state and transforms into his Fourth Gear: Snakeman form, declaring it his final Fourth Gear. Luffy uses Gum-Gum Hydra to unleash a barrage of omni-directional punches at Kaido, declaring he won't stop attacking until he defeats him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (172/189)

pt-BR.title: Moon Princess Echoes! A Fase Final da Terra de Wano!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Zunesha aparece em Onigashima para ajudar na batalha, mas Momonosuke não tem certeza se continuará a batalha. Ele explica a Yamato que pode não ter sido a intenção de Oden libertar a Terra de Wano se ela põe em perigo vidas inocentes. Onigashima começa a desmoronar como resultado da explosão, assim como a batalha na Caveira. Enquanto isso, Franky salva Zoro de cair da borda da ilha, puxando-o de volta para a ilha com seu braço extensível. Izo confronta os agentes da CP0 se recusando a deixá-los passar. Depois de uma curta batalha, Izo foi rapidamente dominado. No entanto, como o agente, Maha, fatalmente golpeia Izo no peito, Izo consegue derrubá-lo com sua pistola, fazendo com que eles se derrubem simultaneamente. O agente principal lamenta brevemente a queda de Maha. Ele então continua sua busca por Nico Robin, mas ele recebe uma ordem imperial dos Cinco Anciãos. O grupo de Nami, acompanhado dos membros da equipe de Kid e Law, celebram sua vitória contra a Big Mom e descansam. O agente principal é ordenado a interromper a batalha de Luffy com Kaido e eliminá-lo imediatamente como precaução, pois ele é visto como uma ameaça especialmente perigosa. O agente principal relutantemente obedece a ordem, mas ele não sabe que Drake recuperou a consciência atrás dele. Komurasaki acompanha Orochi em seu quarto privado enquanto aguarda o retorno de Fukurokuju. Orochi fica impaciente e frustrado, mas o teto de repente cai, esmagando-o sob os escombros. Pressionando sua vantagem, Komurasaki insere um prego Seastone no corpo de Orochi, enfraquecendo-o e impedindo-o de usar seus poderes de Fruta do Diabo. Ela toca a música favorita de Orochi, "Moon Princess" em seu shamisen e revela que a música também era a favorita de seu pai, Oden e que ela usa uma máscara para que ela pudesse evitar sorrir para ele enquanto tocava. No Salão de Performance, Kaid e Law reconhecem que estão exaustos demais para lutar com Kaido, deixando tudo verdadeiramente até Luffy no Skull Dome, Kaido percebe que Big Mom foi derrotada por Kid e Law, e começa a chorar, refletindo sobre como eles se conheceram enquanto servia a tripulação de Rocks. Luffy aproveita o estado emocional de Kaido e se transforma em sua quarta engrenagem: Snakeman, declarando-a sua quarta engrenagem final. Luffy usa Gum-Gum Hydra para desencadear uma enxurrada de socos omnidirecionais em Kaido, declarando que ele não vai parar de atacar até que ele o derrote.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

Lastly, Hordy states that he will kill the Straw Hat Pirates, including Luffy, for crushing Arlong's ambitions. At the Sea Forest, Robin examines a poneglyph containing an apology to Joy Boy. Upon hearing Hordy's plans, Jimbei reveals to the Straw Hats that Shirahoshi is the real threat behind Hordy's plan. Luffy and Shirahoshi prepare to go face Hordy and the New Fishman Pirates, but Jimbei stops the two. en.title: A Celebration Banquet! The New Emperors of the Sea!
en.synopsis:
News of Big Mom and Kaido's defeat spread internationally, but the Five Elders attempt to censor Luffy's wanted poster depicting him as Nika and remove the "D." from his name. Despite their efforts, they are unable to contact the printing companies and the uncensored image is shown to the public. The new bounties of Luffy, Law and Kid are announced, each being given a bounty of 3 billion berries. The Straw Hat Pirates visit the Flower Capital to join the extended Fire Festival and banquet, where they participate in its activities. Meanwhile, Robin locates the country's Poneglyph, where she is met by Tenguyama. Tenguyama reveals himself to be Kouzuki Sukiyaki, Oden's father. Sukiyaki was imprisoned by the Kurozumi Family. Sukiyaki escaped many years later after Oden's death, but upon seeing the way Orochi transformed the country, he went into hiding. In the present day, Robin reveals that she learned from the Poneglyph in Alabasta that the ancient weapon Pluton was indeed located within Wano which Sukiyaki confirms. In the former Udon Prisoner Mine, defeated Beasts Pirates, including King and Queen, bandage their wounds, but are visited by Ryokugyu. After instigating a battle, King and Queen are both defeated by Ryokugyu's Devil Fruit ability, allowing him to manipulate vines which pierce and dehydrate his targets. Ryokugyu orders their arrest and a battleship to come to Wano before heading to the Flower Capital to pursue Luffy. As the banquet continues, Momonosuke remembers Luffy's instructions to him, telling him not to reveal his involvement in the raid. Upon receiving these news, Kid interrupts Luffy at the festival and attempts to kill him but Luffy quickly grabs him, and everyone starts partying. After a bit, though, Kid breaks free of Luffy's grip as he tells him he cares nothing for the party and simply came to kill him, though he does tell him that the Four Emperors now consists of "Blackbeard" Teach, "Red-Haired" Shanks, Buggy "the Genius Jester" and "Straw Hat" Luffy himself. Meanwhile, Ryokugyu approaches the Flower Capital, planing to kill Luffy.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (184/189)

pt-BR.title: Um banquete de celebração! Os Novos Imperadores do Mar!
pt-BR.synopsis:
As notícias da derrota de Big Mom e Kaido se espalharam internacionalmente, mas os Cinco Anciãos tentam censurar o cartaz procurado de Luffy, retratando-o como Nika e removendo o "D." de seu nome. Apesar de seus esforços, eles são incapazes de entrar em contato com as empresas de impressão e a imagem sem censura é mostrada ao público. As novas recompensas de Luffy, Law e Kid são anunciadas, cada uma recebendo uma recompensa de 3 bilhões de bagas. Os Piratas Straw Hat visitam a Capital das Flores para se juntar ao Festival do Fogo e ao banquete, onde participam de suas atividades. Enquanto isso, Robin localiza o Poneglyph do país, onde ela é encontrada por Tenguyama. Tenguyama revela ser Kouzuki Sukiyaki, o pai de Oden. Sukiyaki foi preso pela família Kurozumi. Sukiyaki escapou muitos anos depois da morte de Oden, mas ao ver como Orochi transformou o país, ele se escondeu. Nos dias de hoje, Robin revela que ela aprendeu com o Poneglyph em Alabasta que a antiga arma Pluton estava realmente localizada dentro de Wano que Sukiyaki confirma. Na antiga Mina de Prisioneiros Udon, derrotaram os Piratas das Bestas, incluindo o Rei e a Rainha, curando suas feridas, mas são visitados por Ryokugyu. Depois de instigar uma batalha, King e Queen são derrotados pela habilidade de Ryokongyu, permitindo que ele manipule videiras que perfuram e desidratam seus alvos. Ryokugyu ordena sua prisão e um navio de guerra para vir a Wano antes de ir para a Capital das Flores para perseguir Luffy. Enquanto o banquete continua, Momonosuke se lembra das instruções de Luffy para ele, dizendo-lhe para não revelar seu envolvimento no ataque. Ao receber essas notícias, Kid interrompe Luffy no festival e tenta matá-lo, mas Luffy rapidamente o pega, e todos começam a festejar. Depois de um pouco, porém, Kid se liberta do aperto de Luffy enquanto diz que não se importa nada com a festa e simplesmente veio matá-lo, embora ele diga que os Quatro Imperadores agora consistem em "Blackbeard" Teach, "Red-Haired" Shanks, Buggy "o Genius Jester" e "Straw Hat" Luffy ele mesmo. Enquanto isso, Ryokugyu se aproxima da Capital das Flores, planejando matar Luffy.

en.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
en.synopsis:
Zoro, Nami, and the Usopp Pirates still waiting around for Luffy and Usopp. The Usopp Pirates mention how Usopp always goes to the coast. They then spot Usopp running up to them, but he does not respond to any of their questions and runs right past them. Usopp is unable to convince the villagers that pirates are coming and that they have to abandon their homes. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others find Luffy. At Kaya's mansion, Merry shows Kaya the glasses that she got him to buy for Klahadore's third year of being a caretaker. Usopp is unable to convince Kaya of Kuro's assassination attempt and leaves, but gets shot by Merry in the process. Kuro announces his plans to attack the village at dawn. At sunset, Usopp remembers the stories he would tell Kaya, when Luffy and the Usopp Pirates arrive. Usopp tells about Kuro's plan, but then says that he was joking about it. The Usopp pirates abandon him. Nami asks Usopp why he said he made everything up. Usopp replies that it is because he is a liar. He says how he loves the village and wants to protect it, so he will stand against the pirates. Luffy, Zoro, and Nami decide to join him, and so Usopp stands up, declaring that even though he is scared, he will fight.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Eles então detectam Usopp correndo até eles, mas ele não responde a nenhuma de suas perguntas e passa direto por eles. Luffy and his crew are now referred to as the senior captain and senior officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. Chopper and Franky are both angry, the former because his bounty hardly increased and the latter because the Thousand Sunny is shown on his poster instead of his face. Nami and Usopp are both horrified that their bounties are so high. Brook is happy about his new bounty while Robin is uninterested. Sanji is initially proud that his bounty is now over a billion but becomes jealous upon learning that Jimbei and Zoro's bounties are higher than his, with Jimbei being glad to be recognized as a member of the Straw Hat Pirates and Zoro (having the second highest bounty of the crew) rubbing it in Sanji's face. Meanwhile, on Emptee Bluffs Island, Mihawk and Crocodile confront Buggy for being portrayed as the clown's subordinates, with none of Buggy's administration members helping him. en.title: Ticking Down to the Great Battle! The Straw Hats Go into Combat Mode!
en.synopsis:
Hiyori parts ways with Zoro and Kawamatsu, and the two later inform Momonosuke and the Akazaya Nine with him of her survival. Hitetsu presents Ame No Hebakiri and Enma to the group, with Momonosuke asking Hitetsu to hold on to Ame No Hebakiri, as he's hesitant to wield his father's blade. Zoro receives Enma and tries out his new sword on a tree, but the sword ends up drawing more Haki than necessary, creating an overly-powerful slash cutting off a piece of a nearby cliff as his crewmates quickly become worried as the sword draws significant quantities of Armament Haki from his arm causing it to shrivel. However, Zoro manages to bring the Haki back into his arm. Hitetsu explains that the Enma is considered impossible to wield because it always uses excessive amounts of the wielder's Haki. Still, Zoro to keep the blade. Luffy continues training his Armament Haki and Zoro trains with his new sword. Momonosuke tells Zoro while they are training that he was told not to say the word "Sunacchi", and Zoro tells him that he picked it up after hearing the old man in his home village using it, while admitting to never using the phrase himself. Meanwhile, the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance adds more numbers to their cause and finish up with their preparations. On the day before the Fire Festival, Momonosuke and his group of retainers march to the rendezvous point to meet up with their allies. The Straw Hats stay behind by Yasuie and Pedro's graves. Hitetsu seems amazed that Zoro is managing to tame the Enma. He reveals that he was the one who crafted Sandai Kitetsu and that the reason Zoro can use Oden's sword is because the Wado Ichimonji and Enma were created by the same person, Shimotsuki Kouzaburou. Zoro states that he will turn Enma into a Black Blade. Back at Udon, Babanuki calls Orochi and lies to him, stating that there was no trouble at Udon and the situation is under control. However, Orochi somehow reveals that he has the new information about the rendezvous point change and that Hiyori was alive. Luffy finally masters Ryuo, demonstrating his new skills by blasting a tree as the curtains close on the Land of Wano Arc's second act.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.synopsis:
Hiyori se separa com Zoro e Kawamatsu, e os dois mais tarde informam Momonosuke e os Akazaya Nine sobre sua sobrevivência. Hitetsu apresenta Ame No Hebakiri e Enma para o grupo, com Momonosuke pedindo Hitetsu para segurar Ame No Hebakiri, como ele está hesitante em empunhar a lâmina de seu pai. Zoro recebe Enma e experimenta sua nova espada em uma árvore, mas a espada acaba tirando mais Haki do que o necessário, criando um corte excessivamente poderoso cortando um pedaço de um penhasco próximo enquanto seus companheiros de tripulação rapidamente ficam preocupados quando a espada tira quantidades significativas de Armament Haki de seu braço, fazendo com que ele esmiuce. No entanto, Zoro consegue trazer o Haki de volta para seu braço. Hitetsu explica que a Enma é considerada impossível de usar porque sempre usa quantidades excessivas de Haki do portador. Ainda assim, Zoro para manter a lâmina. Luffy continua treinando seus trens Armament Haki e Zoro com sua nova espada. Momonosuke diz a Zoro enquanto eles estão treinando que ele foi dito para não dizer a palavra "Sunacchi", e Zoro diz a ele que ele pegou depois de ouvir o velho em sua aldeia natal usando, embora admitindo nunca usar a frase ele mesmo. Enquanto isso, a Aliança Ninja-Pirata-Mink-Samurai adiciona mais números à sua causa e termina com seus preparativos. No dia anterior ao Festival do Fogo, Momonosuke e seu grupo de retentores marcham até o ponto de encontro para se encontrar com seus aliados. Os Straw Hats ficam atrás dos túmulos de Yasuie e Pedro. Hitetsu parece surpreso que Zoro está conseguindo domar a Enma. Ele revela que foi ele quem criou o Sandai Kitetsu e que a razão pela qual Zoro pode usar a espada de Oden é porque o Wado Ichimonji e Enma foram criados pela mesma pessoa, Shimotsuki Kouzaburou. Zoro afirma que ele transformará Enma em uma Lâmina Negra. De volta a Udon, Babanuki chama Orochi e mente para ele, afirmando que não houve problemas em Udon e a situação está sob controle. No entanto, Orochi de alguma forma revela que ele tem a nova informação sobre a mudança de ponto de encontro e que Hiyori estava vivo. Luffy finalmente domina Ryuo, demonstrando suas novas habilidades explodindo uma árvore enquanto as cortinas se fecham no segundo ato do Arco da Terra de Wano.

Kaido and Big Mom decide to use a joint attack to try and wipe them out and they launch Conquest of the Sea, unleashing an extremely powerful shockwave. However, the success rate of these fruits is ten percent, meaning only ten percent of SMILE fruit eaters successfully gain an ability. The other ninety percent would permanently lose their ability to swim as well as express any emotion other than joy. Fighters of the Beast Pirates are divided into three categories; The Waiters, who have not eaten a SMILE fruit, the Gifters, who are those who gained SMILE fruit powers, and the Pleasures, are those who have eaten SMILE fruits but failed to gain powers and suffered the negative side-effects. Ebisu Town's dark history is then revealed. It was a poverty-stricken town that received its food from the capital. Orochi, for the sake of his own cruelty, took some failed SMILE fruits that have already been bitten and gave them to the town. Given no other source of food, the people of Ebisu Town ate the defective fruits and suffered its negative side effects. Toko enters the execution site, hoping to revive her father. Seeing Toko, Orochi attempts to kill her as well, blaming her for Komurasaki's death. But Zoro and Sanji step in and save her.

In a flashback, it is revealed that 20 years ago, a pirate named "Gold Lion" Shiki cut off his legs and escaped from Impel Down. A few days before the start of the movie, Gold Lion Shiki contacts the Amigo Pirates, a crew of pirates led by a man named Largo, offering to make them the 51st crew under his command if they fulfill a certain request. Yoko's father was a Marine who died defending them five years ago, and she first met Boss three years after his death. They show the four Straw Hats their village, which strongly resembles East Blue to the point of having replicas of several prominent buildings. Most of them see Big Mom's shadow from the window and dive into the water, but she opens the window finds Chopper riding the tank.The Big Mom Pirates, led by Perospero, finally make it back up the waterfall. However, they see another flying figure, thinking it is King, only to discover it is Marco in his Human-Beast Form, who arrived to the Land of Wano to aid Luffy. Although they attack Marco, he kicks the ship back down the waterfall. Cat Viper and Izou, who have also arrived to aid the rebellion, ride up the waterfall and watch the ship falling down. Orochi meets with Kaido and discusses the samurai's plan, with Black Maria staying to attend the banquet them instead of searching for Yamato. Orochi expresses his believes that the allies have died at sea. He comments on how trusting the samurai were of Kanjuro prior to his betrayal, since he nearly died along with them in the boiling pot twenty years ago. However, Kaidou laments that Oden never told them the location of Laugh Tale. The Beast Pirates outside, unaware that Kanjuro was on their side, act hostile towards him, but they are defeated and Kanjuro enters Orochi's throne room. He brings with him an unconscious, beaten Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Page One carries Ulti down the hallway. Off the coast of Onigashima, as he Polar Tang encounters a particularly strong current, Cat Viper contacts Dogstorm to inform him that he has just finished climbing the waterfall with his subordinates, but Cat Viper hangs up before discussing how his group will reach the island. In the mansion, Zoro cuts down a wall to get to Kaido, only to find several Beast Pirates on the other side. He and Luffy fight the enemies off, but are separated. Orochi se encontra com Kaido e discute o plano do samurai, com Maria Negra ficando para assistir ao banquete deles em vez de procurar por Yamato. Orochi expressa sua crença de que os aliados morreram no mar. Ele comenta sobre como confiava no samurai de Kanjuro antes de sua traição, já que ele quase morreu junto com eles na panela fervente há vinte anos. No entanto, Kaidou lamenta que Oden nunca tenha contado a localização de Laugh Tale. en.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
en.synopsis:
Usopp, Luffy, Zoro, and Nami formulate a plan on the slope for when the pirates come. Meanwhile, Kuro breaks the glasses Kaya gave him and injures Merry with his clawed glove. Kuro then steps into Kaya's room, and he holds his blood-stained claw over Kaya's head, remembering the deed he has to commit the following day. By the coast, the Black Cat Pirates' ship approaches Syrup Village. Jango reiterates the plan to his men. Meanwhile, Luffy, Usopp, Zoro, and Nami stand on the slope leading to the village, and have poured a barrel of oil on it to make it slippery. The plan is that when the Black Cat Pirates slip on the oil, the four will spring out and attack them. Dawn breaks, and so the Black Cat Pirates land on the coast, spotting Luffy's boat. At that moment, Luffy and the others are waiting for the pirates as the sun has now risen, and Nami hears the pirates coming from the north. Usopp notes that there is an identical slope at the north end of the village, and they realize they are at the wrong coast. Panicking, Nami then realizes that their ship is located at the north coast, and their treasure will be robbed by the pirates. Luffy and Usopp take off running for the coast. Zoro and Nami start to leave, but Nami slips on the oil and drags Zoro down the slope, stepping on him to climb back up. Zoro is unable to get up the slippery slope, and he slides to the bottom, but eventually uses his swords to pull his way up. At the north coast, Usopp arrives, surprised that Luffy hasn't come yet, who is now lost. The Black Cat Pirates arrive, and Usopp stands up to them, but realizes he can't beat them by himself. He sees the pirates taking the treasure from the Straw Hats' ship, and he says that the treasure belongs to him, and he'll give it to them if they leave. Jango decides to hypnotize Usopp instead, but Nami arrives in the nick of time and whacks Usopp in the head, knocking him over, refusing to give up her treasure. Usopp then reports that Luffy has not arrived yet, and is probably lost. The Black Cat Pirates then charge, and Usopp stands up to them, but they knock him down swiftly. Usopp struggles to fight them, but there are far too many. He is shocked when they are all sent flying back, and sees that Luffy and Zoro have arrived. Zoro yells at Nami about leaving him there, and Luffy yells at Usopp for not telling him which was north. However, united, the four face off against the invading Black Cat Pirates.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Usopp, Luffy, Zoro, e Nami formular um plano na encosta para quando os piratas vêm. Enquanto isso, Kuro quebra os óculos que Kaya lhe deu e fere Merry com sua luva com garras. Kuro então entra no quarto de Kaya, e ele segura sua garra manchada de sangue sobre a cabeça de Kaya, lembrando a ação que ele tem que cometer no dia seguinte. Na costa, a nave dos Piratas Black Cat se aproxima de Syrup Village. Jango reitera o plano aos seus homens. Enquanto isso, Luffy, Usopp, Zoro e Nami estão na encosta que leva à aldeia, e derramaram um barril de óleo sobre ele para torná-lo escorregadio. O plano é que quando os Piratas Black Cat escorregarem sobre o óleo, os quatro irão surgir e atacá-los. Amanhecer quebra, e então os Piratas Black Cat pousam na costa, avistando o barco de Luffy. Nesse momento, Luffy e os outros estão esperando pelos piratas enquanto o sol nasce, e Nami ouve os piratas vindos do norte. Usopp observa que há uma inclinação idêntica no extremo norte da aldeia, e eles percebem que estão na costa errada. Panicking, Nami então percebe que sua nave está localizada na costa norte, e seu tesouro será roubado pelos piratas. Luffy e Usopp saem correndo para a costa. Zoro e Nami começam a sair, mas Nami desliza sobre o óleo e arrasta Zoro para baixo da encosta, pisando nele para subir de volta. Zoro é incapaz de subir a encosta escorregadia, e ele desliza para o fundo, mas eventualmente usa suas espadas para puxar seu caminho para cima.
