en.title: His Dream Broken?! The Trap That Lures Sanji!
en.synopsis:
Kid confronts Apoo about his betrayal, but Apoo fights back as Queen, shocked that Kid has also escaped from the prisoner mine, gives his men permission to kill the intruders. Then one of the Numbers, Haccha comes to interfere, with Kid noting that the Number is bigger than a giant. Kid's crewmates Heat and Wire handles Haccha while Luffy, Zoro, Kid and Killer escape the area but are again confronted by Apoo. Killer tells the others to cover their ears as he figured out that Apoo's attacks only works if the target can hear the sound waves he creates. Big Mom's crew prepare make their way up the falls, unaware of the port behind it. Chopper's group with the tank joins Kin'emon's forces up the east mountain path. Kin'emon decides to modify the plan. The group will split into another two groups; one group will enter through the side of the Skull Dome and the other through the back. This will allow them to attack Orochi and Kaidou from two angles. Meanwhile, Denjiro leads the southern forces, the rest of the Akazaya Nine are under the sea, and Robin, Jimbei, Franky and Brook infiltrate the castle in disguise. Although Kin'emon's group encounters enemy Beast Pirates, Nami and Carrot use their good looks to charm their way through. Unfortunately, Kin'emon's group finds that the island blueprints were out of date, and the castle has been expanded since it was made. The forces encounter a pond on the eastern mountain path as Sanji finds a pleasure hall owned by Black Maria, but is distracted and finds it empty since Kaidou's subordinates have left in search of the intruders. Nami, Carrot and Shinobu decide to break away from the group to search for Momonosuke. In the live floor Apoo explains what happened to Killer. When Killer was imprisoned, Orochi offered him a chance to save his captain if he ate a SMILE fruit. Killer ate the fruit but it was defective, giving him the side effects but no ability and making him a Pleasure. Angered that his partner is being mocked, Kid almost starts another fight, but is stopped by Luffy and the others. Who's-Who decides not to intervene in the battle, instead working on tracking down Yamato before Sasaki does. He also thinks about how Queen said he would kill one of the Tobi Roppo with Who's-Who mentioning there is certain Tobi Roppo he wants to kill.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Então um dos Números, Haccha vem interferir, com Kid observando que o Número é maior que um gigante. Os companheiros de tripulação do garoto, Heat e Wire, lidam com Haccha enquanto Luffy, Zoro, Kid e Killer escapam da área, mas são novamente confrontados por Apoo. Killer diz aos outros para cobrirem os ouvidos, pois descobriu que os ataques de Apoo só funcionam se o alvo puder ouvir as ondas sonoras que ele cria. A tripulação da Big Mom se prepara para subir as quedas, sem saber do porto por trás. O grupo de Chopper com o tanque se junta às forças de Kin'emon no caminho da montanha leste. Kin'emon decide modificar o plano. O grupo se dividirá em outros dois grupos; um grupo entrará pelo lado da Caveira e o outro pelas costas. Isso permitirá que eles ataquem Orochi e Kaidou de dois ângulos. Enquanto isso, Denjiro lidera as forças do sul, o resto dos Akazaya Nine estão sob o mar, e Robin, Jimbei, Franky e Brook se infiltram no castelo disfarçado. Embora o grupo de Kin'emon encontre piratas inimigos, Nami e Cenoura usam sua boa aparência para encantar seu caminho. Infelizmente, o grupo de Kin'emon descobre que as plantas da ilha estavam desatualizadas, e o castelo foi expandido desde que foi feito. As forças encontram uma lagoa no caminho da montanha oriental enquanto Sanji encontra um salão de prazer de propriedade de Maria Negra, mas está distraído e encontra vazio desde que os subordinados de Kaidou partiram em busca dos intrusos. Nami, Cenoura e Shinobu decidem se separar do grupo para procurar Momonosuke. No chão ao vivo, Apoo explica o que aconteceu com Killer. Quando Killer foi preso, Orochi lhe ofereceu a chance de salvar seu capitão se ele comesse uma fruta SMILE. O assassino comeu a fruta, mas estava com defeito, dando-lhe os efeitos colaterais, mas sem habilidade e fazendo dele um prazer. Irritado que seu parceiro está sendo ridicularizado, Kid quase começa outra luta, mas é parado por Luffy e os outros. Quem decide não intervir na batalha, em vez disso, trabalhando em rastrear Yamato antes de Sasaki. Ele também pensa em como Queen disse que mataria um dos Tobi Roppo com quem ele mencionou que há certos Tobi Roppo que ele quer matar.

en.title: To the New World! Heading for the Ultimate Sea!
en.synopsis:
The Straw Hats are heading to the New World. Nami is taking a bath in the Thousand Sunny and Chopper comes in. Nami asks Chopper if he wants to join her in the bath and he says no claiming that he took one two days ago and the cloud reminds him of cotton candy. Sanji and Brook walk by and saw Nami taking a bath so they stare at her. Nami asked Chopper to move aside away from the cloud she made and the cloud electrified Sanji and Brook. Chopper claims he is scared and he won't eat the cloud. Meanwhile Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, Franky and Robin are hanging out. Luffy tells Usopp to hurry up with the fish hook because he wants to catch and eat a big fish. Robin says that Luffy and Usopp are having fun. Franky says he wants Cola with a big fish. Zoro says he wants to have a drink to celebrate entering the New World. Luffy, Zoro, and Usopp sees three big fish. Zoro wants to eat a fried fish with salt. Usopp wants a fish sliced up and grilled. Luffy wants a fish with mayonnaise. Usopp says which fish Luffy wants and claims that it is not edible. Luffy punches the fish with Gear Second and Usopp uses the fish hook to grab hold of it. The fish that they caught suddenly got ate by a bigger fish and Zoro uses 360 pound cannon killing it. Nami is still in the bath and she claims that the rest of the crew are making too much of a ruckus and that she shouldn't have trusted them in watching the ship for her. They suddenly got caught in a White Storm and Luffy claims it is the wormhole of his dreams and Usopp slaps him for saying that. Nami claims the crew to be stupid for getting into too much trouble while she was taking a bath. They get caught in the White Storm and they try to hang out to something so they won't fly out of the ship. They finally crash into a whale without noticing at first. Brook then claims that the whale is Laboon but they finally see a whole bunch of whales and the others claim that Laboon is not here but in the first half of the grand line. Sanji then says that they need to get out of there and asks Nami about what they should do. Nami says they don't need to do anything and Sanji listened. The Straw Hats asked one of the whales to give them a ride to the surface of the New World. Brook sang a song for the whales so they can bring them to the surface. Before they got to the surface the Straw Hats remembered the times during their training to become stronger so they can regroup and head towards the New World. They finally surfaced and Thousand Sunny hopped off the whales and landed onto the ocean. The Straw Hats say goodbye to the whales and they see some ships claiming they are pirate ships but then they saw that the ships belong to the Marines.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Luffy diz a Usopp para se apressar com o gancho de peixe porque ele quer pegar e comer um peixe grande. Robin diz que Luffy e Usopp estão se divertindo. Franky diz que quer Cola com um peixe grande. Luffy quer um peixe com maionese. Usopp diz qual peixe Luffy quer e afirma que não é comestível. Luffy perfura o peixe com Gear Second e Usopp usa o anzol para agarrá-lo. O peixe que eles pegaram de repente foi comido por um peixe maior e Zoro usa canhão de 360 libras matando-o. Nami ainda está no banho e ela afirma que o resto da tripulação está fazendo muito barulho e que ela não deveria ter confiado neles em vigiar a nave por ela. De repente, eles foram pegos em uma tempestade branca e Luffy afirma que é o buraco de minhoca de seus sonhos e Usopp bate nele por dizer isso. Nami diz que a equipe é estúpida por ter problemas demais enquanto tomava banho. Eles são pegos na Tempestade Branca e eles tentam sair com algo para que eles não vão voar para fora da nave. Brook então afirma que a baleia é Laboon, mas eles finalmente vêem um monte de baleias e os outros afirmam que Laboon não está aqui, mas na primeira metade da grande linha. en.title: War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
en.synopsis:
As Marco departs the Red Hair Pirates ship taking him to Whitebeard's homeland Sphinx, he remembers leaving the land of Wano. It is revealed that Yamato's real reason for staying in Wano was to protect it after Ryokugyu's attack made her realize that more powerful people will try to invade the country. As Marco said his goodbyes, Luffy thanks him for protecting him in Marineford. Marco accepts his thanks and says that Ace would be proud of how far he had come before saying that the times belong to him and the other youngsters of his generation. Back to the present on Amazon Lily, Gloriosa laments at how the island was invaded by men with part of its mountain cut down and its town heavily damaged. A bandaged Boa Hancock tells her that so long as she stays on the island, the Marines will return, especially with the Warlord system abolished. A few weeks prior the Marines invade Amazon Lily to arrest Hancock with the aid of a pair their new Seraphim Pacifista. The Seraphim bore great resemblance to Hancock and Mihawk as children while also possessing Lunarian-like traits. However, the Blackbeard Pirates also invade Amazon Lily, where Blackbeard, along with Vasco Shot and Catarina Devon, plans to steal Hancock Devil Fruit power. Blackbeard fights the Seraphim who resembles a younger Mihawk, who slices the island's mountain in two. Meanwhile, Hancock engages the Marines and turns all of them (save for Koby) to stone, as well as Blackbeard's crew. The Seraphim try to attack Hancock, despite Koby's orders for them to stand down as their attacks would shatter the petrified Marines. Hancock attempts to strike Koby but she is intercepted by Blackbeard, who grabs her by the throat and nullifies her abilities with his Dark-Dark Fruit powers. Blackbeard, whose bounty is now 3.996 billion berries, expresses his desire to obtain her Devil Fruit, but she told him that her powers were nothing without her beauty. She added that if he killed her, his people would remain petrified, and the next user would be unable to undo the petrification.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Guerra na Ilha das Mulheres! Um caso envolvendo Koby, o Herói
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto Marco parte da nave Red Hair Pirates, levando-o para a terra natal de Whitebeard, Esfinge, ele se lembra de deixar a terra de Wano. É revelado que a verdadeira razão de Yamato ficar em Wano era protegê-lo depois que o ataque de Ryokugyu a fez perceber que pessoas mais poderosas tentarão invadir o país. Como Marco disse, Luffy agradece por protegê-lo em Marineford. Marco aceita seus agradecimentos e diz que Ace ficaria orgulhoso de quão longe ele tinha chegado antes de dizer que os tempos pertencem a ele e aos outros jovens de sua geração. De volta ao presente na Amazon Lily, Gloriosa lamenta como a ilha foi invadida por homens com parte de sua montanha cortada e sua cidade fortemente danificada. Boa Hancock diz a ela que enquanto ela ficar na ilha, os fuzileiros voltarão, especialmente com o sistema Warlord abolido. Algumas semanas antes, os Fuzileiros Navais invadem Amazon Lily para prender Hancock com a ajuda de um par seu novo Seraphim Pacifista. Os Serafins tinham grande semelhança com Hancock e Mihawk quando crianças, enquanto também possuíam traços lunares. No entanto, os Piratas Blackbeard também invadem Amazon Lily, onde Blackbeard, junto com Vasco Shot e Catarina Devon, planejam roubar o poder da Fruta do Diabo Hancock. Blackbeard luta contra os Serafins que se assemelham a um Mihawk mais jovem, que corta a montanha da ilha em dois. Enquanto isso, Hancock envolve os Fuzileiros Navais e transforma todos eles (exceto Koby) em pedra, assim como a tripulação de Blackbeard. Os Serafins tentam atacar Hancock, apesar das ordens de Koby para que eles se retraiam, pois seus ataques destruiriam os fuzileiros petrificados. Hancock tenta atacar Koby, mas ela é interceptada por Blackbeard, que a agarra pela garganta e anula suas habilidades com seus poderes de frutas escuras. Blackbeard, cuja recompensa é agora 3.996 bilhões de bagas, expressa seu desejo de obter sua Fruta do Diabo, mas ela disse a ele que seus poderes não eram nada sem sua beleza. Ela acrescentou que se ele a matasse, seu povo permaneceria petrificado, e o próximo usuário seria incapaz de desfazer a petrificação.

en.title: Explosive?! The Handcuffs that Shackle Yamato's Freedom!
en.synopsis:
Yamato tells Luffy how Ace came to Wano for Kaido's head and mentioned Luffy a lot. Yamato also admits to have wanted to join Ace's crew but couldn't. On the top of the castle, Law and his crew break away from the group to achieve their own goals. However, the remaining samurai are attacked by headless samurai on horseback, deducing they are drawings made by Kanjuro. Kanjuro comes out of the castle door with some Beast Pirates and confronts them, revealing what happened to Momonosuke. Momonosuke attempted to escape by cutting his ropes using a knife. Although he managed to cut Kanjuro's hand, he was brutally beaten unconscious and taken to Orochi. Kanjuro finishes by announcing Momonosuke's public execution at the party. Outraged and feeling betrayed, the samurai wage a battle against Kanjuro's forces. Cat Viper has replaced his severed hand with a double-barrel gun and Dogstorm replaced his leg with a sword, so they battle fiercely against their enemies. However, Kikunojo still attempts to sympathize with Kanjuro, believing that there was still some good in him. After Kanjuro denounces the samurai for the last time, she enters the battle. Nami's group is chased by Prometheus down the halls, and are further attacked by the homies. Nami and Carrot are captured, but upon Nami's insistence, Shinobu flees to rescue Momonosuke. Zeus also attempts to intervene, but is grabbed by Big Mom's obscured hand. Back in the attic, Yamato explains that she wishes to join Luffy's crew and be free like Oden, but Kaido fitted her with shackles that would explode if she left the island, and while Yamato admits she is unsure if Kaido would kill her, she is afraid to test it. Luffy offers to remove her handcuffs for her, but they are interrupted by Kaido's speech from the Performance Floor. Kaido announces to the crowd his official alliance with the Big Mom Pirates to gather the Ancient Weapons to use against the World Government. In the hallway, Big Mom attacks Zeus before personally crashing into the party hall.

(Source: Wikipedia)

No entanto, os samurais restantes são atacados por samurais sem cabeça a cavalo, deduzindo que são desenhos feitos por Kanjuro. Kanjuro sai da porta do castelo com alguns Piratas da Fera e os confronta, revelando o que aconteceu com Momonosuke. Momonosuke tentou escapar cortando suas cordas usando uma faca. Embora tenha conseguido cortar a mão de Kanjuro, ele foi brutalmente espancado inconsciente e levado para Orochi. Kanjuro termina anunciando a execução pública de Momonosuke na festa. Indignados e se sentindo traídos, os samurais travam uma batalha contra as forças de Kanjuro. Cat Viper substituiu sua mão cortada por uma arma de cano duplo e Dogstorm substituiu sua perna por uma espada, então eles lutam ferozmente contra seus inimigos. No entanto, Kikunojo ainda tenta simpatizar com Kanjuro, acreditando que ainda havia algo de bom nele. Depois que Kanjuro denuncia o samurai pela última vez, ela entra na batalha. O grupo de Nami é perseguido por Prometeu pelos corredores, e são ainda atacados pelos homies. Nami e Cenoura são capturados, mas por insistência de Nami, Shinobu foge para resgatar Momonosuke. Zeus também tenta intervir, mas é agarrado pela mão obscurecida da Big Mom. De volta ao sótão, Yamato explica que ela deseja se juntar à tripulação de Luffy e ser livre como Oden, mas Kaido a equiparia com algemas que explodiriam se ela deixasse a ilha, e enquanto Yamato admite que não tem certeza se Kaido a mataria, ela tem medo de testá-la. On Luffy's instruction, Law teleports himself and Zoro to a lower level and brings Zeus as well to keep him from reuniting with Big Mom. Meanwhile, Momonosuke's group hides in the castle ceiling. They get in touch with Kin'emon, informing him that Momonosuke is safe, giving him their location so they can reunite as Yamato gathers some sewing supplies for their next move. Elsewhere, Usopp, Nami, and Tama are still being chased by Page One, who rides on Komachiyo's back, with Usopp upset that Tama's power doesn't work on non-SMILE Zoans. Tama plans to give an order on the Performance Floor in order make all the Gifters that ate a Kibi Dongo switch sides. Usopp manages to use his Pop Greens to knock Page One off Komachiyo's back, but he still fiercely pursues them. However, Big Mom appears, and is initially hostile to Nami and Usopp. However, due to her soft spot for children under the age of ten, she enters "Mother Mode" when she sees Tama. She remembers that when she lost her memory, the people of Okobore Town took care of her, fed her and fixed her hair. However, Tama tells her since food was stolen from Bakura Town, Kaidou's subordinates, led by Holedem, set fire to the town. Several people were harmed in the fire, including Tsuru. Page One, in his spinosaurus form, continues to pursue Tama's group, and Tama reminds Big Mom that he is one of Kaido's subordinates. Angry over Okobore Town's destruction, Big Mom strikes Page One with a Conqueror's Haki-imbued punch, alerting Kid and Zeus to her location. Usopp consegue usar seus Pop Greens para derrubar a página 1 das costas de Komachiyo, mas ele ainda os persegue ferozmente. en.title: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!
en.synopsis:
Luffy fights with Bellamy, with Luffy still refusing to strike back. At the fourth level, Pica then asks Kyros and Rebecca what exactly King Riku is to them. Kyros explains that he is family as well as his savior when he was a monster and that the country is hoping for the day King Riku takes up his throne again. With this new information, Pica disappears. Pica then descends to the lower level and begins attacking the injured fighters, much to Zoro's fury, before remerging with his giant stone body and advances toward the King's Plateau to kill King Riku, causing mass destruction with each step. Zoro is force to come up with a plan to stop him. His first plan is a long-distance slash, but Zoro notes that it would travel too far and thus be too weak. His second plan is jumping on top of Pica, but Zoro quickly realizes that it would be impossible to jump so high. His third plan is to warn Usopp and the others, but Zoro notes that they would not hear him from this distance. His fourth plan is to call Usopp on the Transponder Snail and tell him to run, but Zoro finds that he does not have it with him after reaching into his jacket. As Pica continues moving toward the plateau, Zoro notes that there is not enough time for Usopp and the others to flee anyway. Zoro meets up with Sai, Chinjou, Baby 5, Orlumbus and Elizabello. Getting an idea, Zoro asks Elizabello for two minutes and decides to go with his fifth plan: flying into the sky and cutting up Pica.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Atravessando o chão! A Manobra Surpresa da Estátua Gigante Pica!

Luffy luta com Bellamy, com Luffy ainda se recusando a revidar. No quarto nível, Pica então pergunta a Kyros e Rebecca o que exatamente o Rei Riku é para eles. Kyros explica que ele é família, bem como seu salvador quando ele era um monstro e que o país está esperando para o dia Rei Riku assume seu trono novamente. Com essa nova informação, Pica desaparece. Pica então desce para o nível mais baixo e começa a atacar os combatentes feridos, para a fúria de Zoro, antes de voltar com seu corpo de pedra gigante e avança em direção ao Planalto do Rei para matar o Rei Riku, causando destruição em massa a cada passo. Zoro é a força para chegar a um plano para detê-lo. Seu primeiro plano é um corte de longa distância, mas Zoro observa que ele viajaria muito longe e, portanto, seria muito fraco. Seu segundo plano é saltar em cima de Pica, mas Zoro rapidamente percebe que seria impossível saltar tão alto. Seu terceiro plano é avisar Usopp e os outros, mas Zoro observa que eles não iriam ouvi-lo a essa distância. Seu quarto plano é ligar para o Usopp no Transponder Snail e dizer a ele para correr, mas Zoro acha que ele não tem isso com ele depois de pegar sua jaqueta. Enquanto Pica continua se movendo em direção ao planalto, Zoro observa que não há tempo suficiente para Usopp e os outros fugirem de qualquer maneira. Zoro se encontra com Sai, Chinjou, Baby 5, Orlumbus e Elizabello. Obtendo uma ideia, Zoro pede a Elizabello por dois minutos e decide seguir seu quinto plano: voar para o céu e cortar Pica.

en.synopsis:

However, Oden knows that he will not survive the execution, so he tells his retainers to open up the country in his name, saying one day an important figure will appear. Oden manages to survive for over an hour, which enrages Orochi. The latter tells his men to shoot and kill Oden, breaking the promise. As ten minutes remains with Orochi becoming increasingly frustrated that Oden had not yet died. Through pure willpower, Oden pushes through the final ten minutes and completes the challenge. Despite this, Orochi decides to break his promises, and the firing squad point their guns on Oden anyway. After telling his retainers to open up the country for him, he throws the plank away from the execution area, allowing his retainers to flee to Kuri. They remembered their happy times with Oden as they tearfully ran away. Kaido mentions to Oden that he killed Higurashi for interfering with their fight, but then takes out his pistol and shots Oden in the head. Oden's final words, "Oden wouldn't be oden," is cut off, but the townspeople complete his sentence with, "if it wasn't boiled." as he dies with a smile.

en.title: He Returns! The Shogun of the Land of Wano, Kozuki Momonosuke
en.synopsis:
In the Flower Capital, Kyoshiro, revealing himself to be Denjiro, announces the return of the Akazya Nine, as the citizens begin to broadcast the news to the other regions of the country. In the Skull Dome, as Chopper continues to tend to the wounded combatants, Yamato introduces herself to the Straw Hat Pirates as Kaido's son, and asks to join the crew. Despite generally being in favor of admitting him, they choose not to act without Luffy's permission. When some Beast Pirates try to sneak away, they're stop by Yamato and a pair of Gifters. When Usopp asks what'll happen to the Gifters Tama reveals that her powers only last for a month, though some animals stay tamed. Speed confirms this saying she wants to remain by Tama's side, which she happily accepts, though she asks rather than be her servant her to become adoptive mother, to which she agrees. In his human form, Momonosuke announces his victory in Onigashima and the defeat of the Kaido and Orochi. Momonosuke declares his intentions to abolish slavery and end the mass poverty and pollution caused by Orochi's reign. As he speaks, Tama remembers her childhood. Following her parents' tragic deaths, Tama was left an orphan with Komachiyo. She was forced to sell hats to survive, often without success and going hungry. She was adopted by Tenguyama, who told her about the prophecy of the Kouzuki Family's return. The townspeople celebrate the return of the Kouzuki Family, and Momonosuke vows to follow his father's footsteps.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Apesar de geralmente serem a favor de admiti-lo, eles escolhem não agir sem a permissão de Luffy. Quando alguns Piratas da Besta tentam fugir, eles passam por Yamato e um par de Gifters. Quando Usopp pergunta o que acontecerá com os Gifters, Tama revela que seus poderes duram apenas um mês, embora alguns animais permaneçam domesticados. Velocidade confirma isso dizendo que ela quer ficar ao lado de Tama, que ela aceita alegremente, embora ela peça em vez de ser sua serva para se tornar mãe adotiva, ao que ela concorda. Em sua forma humana, Momonosuke anuncia sua vitória em Onigashima e a derrota dos Kaido e Orochi. Momonosuke declara suas intenções de abolir a escravidão e acabar com a pobreza em massa e a poluição causada pelo reinado de Orochi. Enquanto ele fala, Tama se lembra de sua infância. en.title: Fight Against the Dark Night: The Commander-in-Chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off
en.synopsis:
As Luffy sinks into the ocean, Chopper continues to battle Queen, but is demotivated from his captain's defeat. Across Onigashima, various samurai and allies react to Bao Huang's announcement, with some reacting like Chopper and some refusing to believe it. Meanwhile, Onigashima approaches the Land of Wano, finally reaching the mainland. As the samurai begin to give up in their fight, the Nine Red Scabbards continue to fight, stating they won't stop until they defeat Kaidou. Izo points out how they can't confirm Luffy's death, and Kawamatsu remarks that even the possibility destroyed morale. However, Sanji refuses to even consider that Luffy lost, getting angry at the samurai for thinking that they might have lost. Back on the Performance Floor, Queen now has the upper hand against Chopper, as Perospero continues to bombard the samurai with arrows. They encourage everybody to give up fighting, as Queen is about to bite Chopper wit retractable needle-like fangs; however, he's stopped by Sanji whose kick is hard enough to send Queen's head spinning, causing him to intercept all of Perospero's arrows as well as send Perospero himself flying. He congratulates Chopper for holding off Queen enough for him to arrive, and tells him to continue trusting in Luffy, before handing him Zoro and telling to take care of the injured swordsman. Sanji resolves to fight Queen, and the samurai look on in awe, noting how he doesn't give up despite his captain having been defeated. Meanwhile, above the first floor, Kaido easily defeats Kin'emon. Despite his injuries, Kin'emon continues to stand up and stab Kaido with his broken sword, allowing Shinobu and Momonosuke time to run. As he struggles, Kin'emon thinks back to when they were sent to the present day. He thinks back to when he and Momonosuke pretended to be father and son, and encourages him to continue living. However, he is stabbed by Kaido, collapsing to the floor. As Momonosuke runs with Shinobu, he also thinks back to his time with Kin'emon. He resolves himself to tell the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance members that Luffy isn't dead, and speaks into one of the Marys, announcing it across the island. He declares that Luffy is speaking to him, and encourages the allies to continue fighting until Luffy returns to the island.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Luta contra a Noite Escura: O Comandante-em-Chefe da Terra de Wano Soa Fora
pt-BR.synopsis:
Enquanto Luffy afunda no oceano, Chopper continua a batalha Queen, mas é desmotivado da derrota de seu capitão. Em Onigashima, vários samurais e aliados reagem ao anúncio de Bao Huang, com alguns reagindo como Chopper e alguns se recusando a acreditar. Enquanto isso, Onigashima se aproxima da Terra de Wano, finalmente chegando ao continente. Como os samurais começam a desistir em sua luta, os Nove Red Scabbards continuam a lutar, afirmando que não vão parar até derrotar Kaidou. Izo aponta como eles não podem confirmar a morte de Luffy, e Kawamatsu observa que até mesmo a possibilidade destruiu o moral. No entanto, Sanji se recusa a considerar que Luffy perdeu, ficando com raiva do samurai por pensar que eles poderiam ter perdido. De volta ao Performance Floor, Queen agora tem a vantagem contra Chopper, enquanto Perospero continua bombardeando o samurai com flechas. Eles incentivam todo mundo a desistir de lutar, como Queen está prestes a morder Chopper agulha retrátil como presas, no entanto, ele é parado por Sanji cujo chute é difícil o suficiente para enviar a cabeça da rainha girando, fazendo com que ele intercepte todas as setas de Perospero, bem como enviar o próprio Perospero voando. Ele parabeniza Chopper por segurar Queen o suficiente para ele chegar, e diz a ele para continuar confiando em Luffy, antes de entregá-lo Zoro e dizendo para cuidar do espadachim ferido. Sanji resolve lutar contra a Rainha, e os samurais olham com admiração, observando como ele não desiste apesar de seu capitão ter sido derrotado. Enquanto isso, acima do primeiro andar, Kaido facilmente derrota Kin'emon. Apesar de seus ferimentos, Kin'emon continua a se levantar e esfaquear Kaido com sua espada quebrada, permitindo que Shinobu e Momonosuke tenham tempo de correr. Enquanto ele luta, Kin'emon pensa em quando eles foram enviados para os dias atuais. Ele pensa quando ele e Momonosuke fingiram ser pai e filho, e o encoraja a continuar vivendo. No entanto, ele é esfaqueado por Kaido, caindo no chão. Enquanto Momonosuke corre com Shinobu, ele também pensa em seu tempo com Kin'emon. Ele se resolve a dizer aos membros da Aliança Ninja-Pirata-Mink-Samurai que Luffy não está morto, e fala em uma das Marys, anunciando-a em toda a ilha. Ele declara que Luffy está falando com ele, e encoraja os aliados a continuar lutando até que Luffy retorne à ilha.

en.title: Bringing Down the Emperor of the Sea! A Secret Raid Operation Begins!
en.synopsis:
When Kin'emon's group despaired over what has happened to their home, their hope was restored when they met those still loyal to the Koukuki Clan, who explained that those who bare a reversed crescent moon tattoo on their left ankle are allies waiting for the moment to avenge Oden. Afterwards, Kiku remained in Wano to gather information while Kin'emon, Kanjuro, Raizo and Momonosuke left the country to gather allies against Kaido, which eventually lead to them meeting the Straw Hats in Punk Hazard. Kin'emon explains their plan to gather at least five thousand allies, were in two weeks, they'll raid an island which looks like a horned skull near the Land of Wano that serves as the Beast Pirate's base, Onigashima, during the annual Fire Festival, were a banquet will be held with Kaido and Orochi in attendance. It is then revealed that Otsuru is Kin'emon's wife. Kin'emon then explains the preparation they have done till now, Zoro and Usopp being task to find allies by handing out encrypted flyers, Franky is working as a carpenter to find the blueprints for Kaido's mansion while Robin, disguised as a geisha, gathers information in Orochi's palace and assigns new tasks to the group after giving them disguises with his Garb-Garb Fruit ability. Brook is disguised as a Ghost to gather food from the capital, Sanji will use his culinary skills to aid in finding allies, Chopper and Carrot will aid Dogstorm, while Nami will be under the guise of a ninja with the aid of kunoichi ally, Shinobu. Kin'emon then advises them to be on the lookout of three other members of the Akazaya Nine, Kawamatsu, Ashura Doji and Denjiro.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Depois, Kiku permaneceu em Wano para coletar informações enquanto Kin'emon, Kanjuro, Raizo e Momonosuke deixaram o país para reunir aliados contra Kaido, o que acabou levando-os a conhecer os Chapéus Straw em Punk Hazard. Kin'emon explica seu plano de reunir pelo menos cinco mil aliados, foram em duas semanas, eles vão invadir uma ilha que parece um crânio com chifres perto da Terra de Wano que serve como base do Pirata da Fera, Onigashima, durante o Festival anual de Fogo, foram um banquete será realizada com Kaido e Orochi na assistência. É então revelado que Otsuru é a esposa de Kin'emon. Kin'emon então explica a preparação que eles têm feito até agora, Zoro e Usopp sendo a tarefa de encontrar aliados, distribuindo panfletos criptografados, Franky está trabalhando como carpinteiro para encontrar os planos para a mansão de Kaido enquanto Robin, disfarçado como uma gueixa, reúne informações no palácio de Orochi e atribui novas tarefas ao grupo depois de dar-lhes disfarces com sua habilidade Garb-Garb Fruit. Brook está disfarçado de Fantasma para coletar comida da capital, Sanji usará suas habilidades culinárias para ajudar a encontrar aliados, Chopper e Cenoura ajudarão Dogstorm, enquanto Nami estará sob o disfarce de um ninja com a ajuda do aliado kunoichi, Shinobu. en.title: The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!
en.synopsis:
The Red Hair Pirates approach the borders of the Land of Wano. Meanwhile, as Ryokugyu approaches the Flower Capital, the Akazaya Nine (save for Kin'emon and Kiku) and Shinobu detect his presence and confront him, deciding not to tell the Straw Hats as they're still recovering. Declaring his beliefs that the Celestial Dragons are true god, Ryokugyu uses his Logia-type Woods-Woods Fruit powers to transform into a wooden golem, repelling all the samurai's attacks. He then states that since the Land of Wano isn't affiliated with the World Government he can slaughter as many of its citizens as he wants until he gets Luffy, claiming "discrimination creates solace" before Yamato arrives to aid the samurai. Back with the Red Hair Pirates, everyone except Yasopp, who is afraid to face Usopp, wants to see Luffy again after so long. Shanks remembers his experiences with Luffy, having stolen the Gum-Gum Fruit from a CP9 ship only for it to be eaten by Luffy. Shanks decides not to meet Luffy in the Land of Wano, instead deciding to deal with Bartolomeo, who burned a Red Hair Pirates jolly roger on Shanks' territory and replaced it with that of the Straw Hat Pirates. In Marine Headquarters, Sakazuki holds a meeting with Kizaru and Criminal Investigative Service director Kurouma regarding the Revolutionary Army's invasion of Mariejois, which led to Sabo apparently assassinating of Nefertari Cobra, the disappearance of Vivi, and the freeing of Bartholomew Kuma from slavery. Saint Charlos was also victim of a failed assassination attempt from an unknown assailant, whose escape was aided by Mjosgard, whose actions are currently deliberating by the World Nobles. With the successful attack on the World Government, Sabo gained worldwide support among rebels for his rebellion efforts, now dubbed the "Flame Emperor". Kizaru also pointed out that Luffy's new status an emperor has greatly increased the influence of his brother Sabo. Back in Wano, Momonosuke in his dragon form arrives to his retainer's aid. He tries but fails to breath fire before being overwhelmed by the Admiral and ensnared in his wooden vines. Yamato tries to help but Momonosuke demands she stay out of the fight. At the end of the meeting, Sakazuki laments about the era in which he lived in, but vows to destroy all opposition to the World Government. Meanwhile, Shanks decides to go after the One Piece.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (185/189)

pt-BR.title: O mundo vai queimar! O ataque de um Almirante da Marinha!
pt-BR.synopsis:
Os Piratas do Cabelo Vermelho se aproximam das fronteiras da Terra de Wano. Enquanto isso, enquanto Ryokongyu se aproxima da Capital das Flores, os Akazaya Nine (exceto Kin'emon e Kiku) e Shinobu detectam sua presença e o confrontam, decidindo não contar aos Chapéus Straw enquanto eles ainda estão se recuperando. Declarando suas crenças de que os Dragões Celestiais são o verdadeiro deus, Ryokungyu usa seus poderes de Fruta Woods-Woods para se transformar em um golem de madeira, repelindo todos os ataques dos samurais. Ele então afirma que como a Terra de Wano não é afiliada ao Governo Mundial, ele pode matar tantos de seus cidadãos quanto quiser até que ele obtenha Luffy, alegando que "a discriminação cria consolo" antes de Yamato chegar para ajudar o samurai. De volta com os Piratas do Cabelo Vermelho, todos menos Yasopp, que tem medo de enfrentar Usopp, quer ver Luffy novamente depois de tanto tempo. Shanks se lembra de suas experiências com Luffy, tendo roubado a Gum-Gum Fruit de uma nave CP9 só para que ela seja comida por Luffy. Shanks decide não se encontrar com Luffy na Terra de Wano, em vez disso, decide lidar com Bartolomeo, que queimou um Red Hair Pirates alegremente no território de Shanks e o substituiu com o dos Straw Hat Pirates. Na Sede da Marinha, Sakazuki realiza uma reunião com Kizaru e o diretor do Serviço de Investigação Criminal Kurouma sobre a invasão do Exército Revolucionário de Mariejois, que levou Sabo aparentemente a assassinar Nefertari Cobra, o desaparecimento de Vivi, e a libertação de Bartholomew Kuma da escravidão. Saint Charlos também foi vítima de uma tentativa de assassinato fracassada de um agressor desconhecido, cuja fuga foi auxiliada por Mjosgard, cujas ações estão atualmente deliberando pelos Nobres Mundiais. Com o ataque bem sucedido ao Governo Mundial, Sabo ganhou apoio mundial entre os rebeldes por seus esforços de rebelião, agora apelidado de "Imperador da Chama". Kizaru também apontou que o novo status de Luffy um imperador aumentou muito a influência de seu irmão Sabo. De volta a Wano, Momonosuke em sua forma de dragão chega em ajuda de seu retentor. Ele tenta, mas não consegue respirar fogo antes de ser esmagado pelo Almirante e enredado em suas videiras de madeira. Yamato tenta ajudar, mas Momonosuke exige que ela fique fora da luta. No final da reunião, Sakazuki lamenta sobre a época em que ele viveu, mas promete destruir toda a oposição ao Governo Mundial. Enquanto isso, Shanks decide ir atrás do One Piece.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

Kokoro explains that mermaids like her are able to walk on land after thirty years' time before everyone is happy to see Robin. The joyous reunion does not last long as Zoro, Usop, and Franky see the inferno that was Enies Lobby. Zoro notes that they should remain in case the navy focuses on them while waiting for Luffy. But as Sanji joins the group, one of the ships announces that the Straw Hats' accomplices has been wiped out along with the main gate. This breaks Franky's heart to hear his gang have been slaughtered as he yells for Luffy that he better not get himself killed. As the fleet turns its attention toward the Bridge of Hesitation, having managed to wound Lucci in the legs, Luffy decides to finish the fight in Second Gear form.

Kokoro explica que sereias como ela são capazes de andar em terra depois de trinta anos antes que todos estejam felizes em ver Robin. A alegre reunião não dura enquanto Zoro, Usop e Franky vêem o inferno que era Enies Lobby. Zoro observa que eles devem permanecer no caso de a Marinha se concentrar neles enquanto espera por Luffy. Mas quando Sanji se junta ao grupo, um dos navios anuncia que os cúmplices dos Straw Hats foram exterminados junto com o portão principal. Isso quebra o coração de Franky para ouvir sua gangue ter sido morta enquanto ele grita por Luffy que é melhor ele não se matar. Inside the castle, Luffy and Zoro meet up on the platform, intending to go to the rooftop to face Kaido. They attempt to launch through the hole in the ceiling, but they are caught by Queen's dinosaur mouth and King also appears. They are flung off the balcony, where they are faced by Jaki on the ground below. However, Franky combines the Black Rhino FR-U IV and the Brachio Tank V to form General Franky. Operating the robot, Franky shoots down Jaki with his cannon. Unharmed by King's attack, Sanji emerges from the rubble and removes his raid suit. Although he is attacked by enemy units, Luffy and Zoro fight at his aid. The Straw Hats battle against the enemy Beast Pirates, remembering their past adventures as a crew. Despite being far stronger than most of the Beast Pirates, the Straw Hats are still greatly outnumbered. Still, they gather and prepare to battle against the Lead Performers and the Tobi Roppo.

en.title: A Barrage of Powerful Techniques! The Fierce Attacks of the Worst Generation!
en.synopsis:
Kaido prepares a counterattack, but Luffy strikes Kaido's stomach with Kong Gun, Kid crushes him with his fists using Punk Vise, and Law pummels him with rocks using Tact. Still, they continue to bicker over whose attack was stronger. He turns back into his dragon form and Big Mom joins him, revealing they intend to take everything from the Worst Generation declaring the winner of the battle will be one step closer to becoming King of the Pirates. Kaido attacks with Demolition Gust (the same move that severed Kikunojo's arm) but everyone dodges it with Luffy, Kid, and Law counterattacking and injuring him. Killer then unleashes a barrage of sonic slashes on Kaido but is struck down by a lightning bolt by Big Mom. Kaido admits the Worst Generation is vexing, but before he can chomp on Killer, Luffy strikes him with dropkick Kaido in the face. Kaido prepares to breath fire, but Zoro tells Law to move him into the air, which he does reluctantly. Zoro cuts through the fire to protect Luffy while having Law move him higher to prepare for a powerful attack. Big Mom warns Kaido to dodge because the sword Zoro was using is no ordinary sword. Unfortunately, Zoro's attack misses only grazing Kaido's cheek and ends up cutting off one of the horns of the Skull Dome. While Kaido wonders why he senses Oden's presence in the sword, Big Mom unleashes a plethora of sentient, direction-changing lightning onto the young pirate but is surprised when doesn't affect Luffy, who exclaims that he's rubber. Kaido fires another Blast Breath at him, but to Kaido's equal surprise, Luffy came out unscathed as well, claiming that it was his guts that protected him before hitting Kaido with a Kong Gatling.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (123/189)

pt-BR.title: Uma Barragem de Técnicas Poderosas! Os ferozes ataques da pior geração!

Kaido prepara um contra-ataque, mas Luffy ataca o estômago de Kaido com Kong Gun, Kid o esmaga com os punhos usando Punk Vise, e Law o esmaga com pedras usando Tact. Ainda assim, eles continuam discutindo sobre cujo ataque foi mais forte. Ele volta para sua forma de dragão e Big Mom se junta a ele, revelando que eles pretendem levar tudo da pior geração declarando que o vencedor da batalha estará um passo mais perto de se tornar o Rei dos Piratas. Kaido ataca com Gust Demolição (o mesmo movimento que cortou o braço de Kikunojo), mas todo mundo se esquiva com Luffy, Kid, e Law contra-atacando e ferindo ele. Assassino então desencadeia uma enxurrada de cortes sônicos em Kaido, mas é derrubado por um raio por Big Mom. Kaido admite que a Pior Geração é irritante, mas antes que ele possa bater em Killer, Luffy o golpeia com o ajudante Kaido na cara. Kaido se prepara para respirar fogo, mas Zoro diz a Law para movê-lo para o ar, o que ele faz relutantemente. Zoro corta o fogo para proteger Luffy enquanto Law o move mais alto para se preparar para um ataque poderoso. Big Mom avisa Kaido para se esquivar porque a espada Zoro estava usando não é uma espada comum. Infelizmente, o ataque de Zoro perde apenas a bochecha de Kaido e acaba cortando um dos chifres da Caveira. Enquanto Kaido se pergunta por que ele sente a presença de Oden na espada, Big Mom libera uma infinidade de raios sencientes que mudam de direção para o jovem pirata, mas fica surpreso quando não afeta Luffy, que exclama que ele é borracha. Kaido dispara outro sopro nele, mas para igual surpresa de Kaido, Luffy saiu ileso também, alegando que foram suas entranhas que o protegeram antes de bater Kaido com um Kong Gatling.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.synopsis:
Yamato and Kaido continue to duel on the rooftop, with Yamato officially refusing Kaido's offer to become Shogun. Meanwhile, Franky points out Sasaki's stomach cut despite his toughness, attempting to slash his stomach again. However, Sasaki avoids it, and the two begin a sword fight, leading to the Franken being shattered and half of General Fanky's left shoulder being sliced off. Franky is eventually forced to run, but upon realizing that they're close to the Performance Floor, Franky makes his stand and fires the General Cannon at Sasaki. Sasaki endures the attack and dive-bombs Franky, critically damaging General Franky. But Franky is ejected from the robot and defeats the Tobi Roppo by firing a Franky Radical Beam at the Sasaki's stomach. Back on the rooftop, Kaido laments Yamato having eaten the Dog-Dog Fruit, Mythical Type Model: Okuchi no Makami, as the Okuchi No Makami is considered as the "Guardian Deity of the Land of Wano" and asks once again for Yamato to become Shogun under him. Yamato refuses once again, and begins shooting ice at Kaido, though the latter counters the ice shots with a blast of fire. Inside Onigashima, Brook and Robin walk through fog, with Nico Olvia suddenly appearing before them. Saul and Clover quickly follow suit, gesturing towards Robin. She reminisces her time with the three of them, remembering their deaths. However, she realizes soon enough that they're simply mere illusions, knocking away Black Maria's minions, including Numbers member, Kunyun, who were embodying these illusions. Remembering the words of both her mother and Luffy, Robin declares that she has friend and has decided to live.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Enquanto isso, Franky aponta que o estômago de Sasaki cortou apesar de sua dureza, tentando cortar o estômago novamente. No entanto, Sasaki evita isso, e os dois começam uma luta de espadas, levando os Franken a serem quebrados e metade do ombro esquerdo do General Fanky sendo cortado. Franky é eventualmente forçado a correr, mas ao perceber que eles estão perto do Piso de Performance, Franky faz sua posição e dispara o Canhão Geral em Sasaki. Sasaki suporta o ataque e mergulha bombas Franky, prejudicando criticamente o General Franky. Mas Franky é expulso do robô e derrota o Tobi Roppo disparando um Raio Radical Franky no estômago do Sasaki. De volta ao telhado, Kaido lamenta Yamato ter comido a Fruta Cão-Cão, Tipo Mítico Modelo: Okuchi no Makami, como o Okuchi No Makami é considerado como a "Deidade Guardião da Terra de Wano" e pede mais uma vez para Yamato se tornar Shogun sob ele. Yamato se recusa mais uma vez, e começa a atirar gelo em Kaido, embora este último contrarie os tiros de gelo com uma explosão de fogo. Dentro de Onigashima, Brook e Robin andam através da névoa, com Nico Olvia de repente aparecendo diante deles. Saul e Clover rapidamente seguem o exemplo, gesticulando em direção a Robin. Ela relembra seu tempo com os três, lembrando da morte deles. No entanto, ela percebe logo que são meras ilusões, derrubando os asseclas de Maria Negra, incluindo o membro do Numbers, Kunyun, que estavam incorporando essas ilusões. Lembrando as palavras de sua mãe e Luffy, Robin declara que tem amigo e decidiu viver.

In the present, he's touched by everyone fighting for him and realizes that he wants to live. Buggy comes to after recovering from being frozen, and notices that Mr. 3 is gone. Whitebeard doubles over in pain while fighting Akainu, enabling Akainu to severely injure him and distracting Marco and Jozu long enough for them to be injured by Kizaru and Aokiji. Luffy asks for Ivankov to give him Tension Hormones to enable him to fight again and save Ace. Ivankov refuses, saying that it will likely kill him, but Luffy responds by saying that he would rather die than fail to save Ace, causing Ivankov to agree, restoring Luffy's energy. en.title: The Strike of an Ifrit! Sanji vs. Queen
en.synopsis:
Sanji continues his battle against Queen. After Sanji destroys his Raid Suit, Queen decides to continue on with the battle. This time, he demonstrates his scientific enhancements and uses techniques from Sanji's brothers to overpower him. He reveals that he had a rivalry with Judge and his goal is to outperform Germa 66. Before he could slam Sanji into the ground, however, Sanji uses a Diable Jambe-infused kick to destroy Queen's mechanical arm. Some, the woman who Sanji accidentally attacked earlier, has her wounds bandaged and healed. However, the room where she and the other geishas were hiding are destroyed during the battle. The geishas decide to evacuate, but Some's pet mouse, Chuji, is missing, so Some stays behind to look for it. In fury, Queen uses Sanji's Stealth Black ability to become invisible to catch him off guard. However, Sanji uses moves at high speed, allowing him to become effectively invisible to Queen but physically taxing him. Queen plans to wait for him to exhaust himself, then strike him unexpectedly. Sanji perches on a wall looking for his next approach. Some follows Chuji dangerously into the battlefield, unaware of Queen's presence. Queen recognizes her; when he was searching for Sanji, he saw her and realized that her uses of sickness as an excuse to repeatedly turned him down were lies. Infuriated, he stuck her in anger while invisible when she encountered Sanji. Queen prepares to attack Some again, giving his position away to Sanji. Combining his exoskeleton with Armament Haki, Sanji coats his legs with hotter, blue flames, dubbing it as Ifrit Jambe. With added agility and greater kicking power along with the realization that Queen was the one who hurt Some he strikes Queen and follows up with a barrage of flaming kick, knocking him into the ground. Queen gets up, preparing his retaliation. Remembering his past and accepting the scientific advancements given to him by Germa 66, Sanji uses Boeuf Burst against Queen, sending a powerful flaming kick into Queen's stomach and defeating him. Queen's unconscious body is sent flying out of the Skull Dome and off Onigashima, falling into the mainland below. Emerging victorious from his battle, Sanji returns Chuji to Some then collapses from his injuries.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Wano Country saga: Land of Wano arc: (165/189)

pt-BR.title: A Greve de um Ifrit! Sanji vs. Rainha.
pt-BR.synopsis:
Sanji continua sua batalha contra a Rainha. Depois que Sanji destrói seu traje de ataque, Queen decide continuar com a batalha. Desta vez, ele demonstra seus avanços científicos e usa técnicas dos irmãos de Sanji para dominá-lo. Ele revela que teve uma rivalidade com Judge e seu objetivo é superar Germa 66. Antes que ele pudesse bater Sanji no chão, no entanto, Sanji usa um chute com infusão de Diable Jambe para destruir o braço mecânico da Rainha. Alguns, a mulher que Sanji acidentalmente atacou mais cedo, tem suas feridas enfaixadas e curadas. No entanto, a sala onde ela e as outras gueixas estavam se escondendo são destruídas durante a batalha. As gueixas decidem evacuar, mas o rato de estimação de alguns, Chuji, está desaparecido, então alguns ficam para trás para procurá-lo. Em fúria, Queen usa a habilidade de Sanji para se tornar invisível para pegá-lo desprevenido. No entanto, Sanji usa movimentos em alta velocidade, permitindo que ele se torne efetivamente invisível para Queen, mas fisicamente o taxando. A Rainha planeja esperar que ele se esgote, e o golpeie inesperadamente. Sanji poleiros em uma parede procurando sua próxima abordagem. Alguns seguem Chuji perigosamente para o campo de batalha, sem saber da presença da Rainha. Rainha a reconhece, quando ele estava procurando por Sanji, ele a viu e percebeu que seu uso da doença como uma desculpa para repetidamente recusá-lo eram mentiras. Enfurecido, ele a enfiou em raiva enquanto invisível quando ela encontrou Sanji. Rainha se prepara para atacar alguns de novo, dando sua posição para Sanji. Combinando seu exoesqueleto com Armamento Haki, Sanji cobre suas pernas com chamas azuis mais quentes, chamando-o de Ifrit Jambe. Com mais agilidade e maior poder de chute junto com a percepção de que o Queen foi o único que machucou o Queen e seguiu com uma barragem de chutes flamejantes, derrubando-o no chão. Rainha se levanta, preparando sua retaliação. Lembrando seu passado e aceitando os avanços científicos dados a ele por Germa 66, Sanji usa Boeuf Burst contra Queen, enviando um poderoso chute flamejante no estômago de Queen e derrotando-o. O corpo inconsciente da Rainha é enviado voando para fora da Caveira e para fora de Onigashima, caindo no continente abaixo. Emergindo vitorioso de sua batalha, Sanji devolve Chuji a alguns e depois cai de seus ferimentos.

(Fonte: Wikipedia)

en.synopsis:
At the Courthouse Plaza, the marines defeat Oimo and Kashii and capture the Straw Hats' allies in the courthouse. As Robin attempts to reason with him of what will happen to Enies Lobby once the Buster Call is invoked, Spandam makes another mistake by informing the whole island of the coming threat while admitting that he does not care if the 10,000 navy soldiers under him are obliterated in process. This causes the navy soldiers to leave their prisoners and flee to the coast. With the Buster Call underway, the CP9 operatives decide to end their respective matches quickly while Luffy begins his fight against Lucci.

en.title: Romance Dawn
en.synopsis:
An adaptation of the second Romance Dawn one-shot manga, a predecessor to One Piece. The pirate Luffy is sailing in a search of "Piece-mains", pirates that focus on adventure and attack the "Morganeer" pirates who plunder lawlessly, when a Ruku ("monster bird") named Balloon lands in his ship. Luffy hands Balloon over to the nearby sorcerer pirate Speil, but gets imprisoned on Spiel's ship after insulting him. Luffy is trapped with Anne, a close friend of Balloon who explains that Spiel is after his magic blood and has kidnapped her as bait. Luffy in turn mentions that he was inspired by his pirate grandfather, and as a child unknowingly ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit belonging to him. Luffy uses his rubber powers to break them both out but is uninteresting in saving Balloon. Spiel shoots Anne after discovering her unlocking Balloon's cage and attacks Luffy when insulted again. Losing the fight and having obtained the Ruku he was after, Spiel destroys his ship with his former crew still aboard and uses Balloon to escape. After Anne saves him from drowning, Luffy successfully fights Spiel and rescues Balloon.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: Amanhecer Romance
pt-BR.synopsis:
Uma adaptação do segundo mangá one-shot de Romance Dawn, um antecessor de One Piece. O pirata Luffy está navegando em uma busca de "Piece-mains", piratas que se concentram na aventura e atacam os piratas "Morganeer" que saqueiam sem lei, quando um Ruku ("pássaro monstro") chamado Balloon pousa em seu navio. Luffy entrega Balão para o pirata feiticeiro próximo Speil, mas fica preso na nave de Spiel depois de insultá-lo. Luffy está preso com Anne, uma amiga próxima de Balloon que explica que Spiel está atrás de seu sangue mágico e a sequestrou como isca. Luffy, por sua vez, menciona que ele foi inspirado por seu avô pirata, e quando criança, sem saber, comeu a Gum-Gum Devil Fruit pertencente a ele. Luffy usa seus poderes de borracha para quebrar os dois, mas é desinteressante em salvar Balão. Spiel atira em Anne depois de descobrir que ela desbloqueou a gaiola de Balão e ataca Luffy quando insultado novamente. Perdendo a luta e tendo obtido o Ruku que ele estava atrás, Spiel destrói sua nave com sua antiga tripulação ainda a bordo e usa Balão para escapar. Depois que Anne o salva do afogamento, Luffy luta com sucesso contra Spiel e resgata Balão.

Orochi and his men heads to Onigashima after departing from Tabu Port on the day of the Fire Festival. Meanwhile, Kin'emon and the other samurai wait for their allies at Tokage Port, who have not arrived due to an incident orchestrated by Orochi the day before. Two days ago, as everyone prepares it's noted that a full moon that would be present during the final battle, meaning the minks could use Sulong. Meanwhile, Luffy wonders why Jimbei hasn't arrived yet despite Big Mom being in Wano, though Zoro assures him the fishman will appear. In Okobore Town, the citizens were confronted by Holedem, as the Paradise Farm was still being stolen from despite him burning down the Mt. Atama Thieves' hideout. Tsuru, having deduced of her husband's and his allies return, offers to show Holdem where the food is to distract them. However, the other citizens stopped her by claiming aloud that they had eaten the stolen food, shocking her and angering Holedem. Back in the present, the Akazaya lose hope that their allies will come and decides to head to Onigashima alone, despite Momonosuke's and Shinobu's pleas and protests.

en.title: Caesar Goes Missing! The Pirate Alliance Makes a Sortie!

en.title: I Trust Momo: Luffy's Final Powerful Technique!
en.synopsis:
Momonosuke struggles and fails to produce Flame Clouds to sustain Onigashima. He begins to doubt himself, but he remembers his final interaction with his mother, he regains his resolve. However an explosion cause Onigashima to fall faster. On the Skull Dome's rooftop, Luffy continues his final battle against Kaido, where he utilizes the clouds and lightning, manipulating and merging with the lightning bolts to strike Kaido. Despite several powerful attacks being levied against him, Kaido unleashes a series of powerful counterattacks, with Kaido claiming that no matter the Devil Fruit ability Haki trumps all, as neither Roger nor Oden ate a Devil Fruit as strikes Luffy with Destroyer of Death Thunder Bagua, sending Luffy into the sky. As the Fire Festival concludes in the Flower Capital below, Luffy grabs on to Kaido, who changes into his dragon form and sends a barrage of wind blades towards Luffy, before blasting him with fire. Meanwhile, after a tremor removes his Seastone nail, Orochi is now able to transform into his Yamata no Orochi form, though he only has one head remaining. He threatens to kill Hiyori for her to take her down with him. Inside the Skull Dome below, the remaining allied forces realize that if Luffy wins the battle, Onigashima would still crash, killing them. Willing to sacrifice their lives to remove Kaido from power, the allies cheer on Luffy and hope for his victory against Kaido. Hearing the cheering from the Skull Dome and the wishes of Wano's citizens, Luffy prepares a final powerful attack against Kaido, inflating his fist to a size as large as Onigashima itself. Preparing to fulfill his promise of liberating the Land of Wano, Luffy tells Momonosuke to move Onigashima out of the way, stating he trusts him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

No entanto, uma explosão faz com que Onigashima caia mais rápido. No telhado do Skull Dome, Luffy continua sua batalha final contra Kaido, onde ele utiliza as nuvens e relâmpagos, manipulando e fundindo-se com os raios para atingir Kaido. Apesar de vários ataques poderosos sendo cobrados contra ele, Kaido desencadeia uma série de contra-ataques poderosos, com Kaido alegando que não importa a habilidade da Fruta do Diabo Haki supera tudo, como nem Roger nem Oden comeu uma Fruta do Diabo como ataca Luffy com Destroyer of Death Thunder Bagua, enviando Luffy para o céu. Como o Festival do Fogo termina na Capital da Flor abaixo, Luffy se agarra a Kaido, que se transforma em sua forma de dragão e envia uma barragem de pás de vento em direção a Luffy, antes de explodi-lo com fogo. Ele ameaça matar Hiyori para ela levá-la com ele. Dentro do Skull Dome abaixo, as forças aliadas restantes percebem que se Luffy vencer a batalha, Onigashima ainda cairia, matando-os. When asked by Luffy what he is doing with his ally, Doflamingo responds that Law was originally his subordinate and that it was his responsibility to "educate" him. Zoro and Kin'emon attempt to save Law but, before the Marines make a move to stop them, Admiral Fujitora appears, blocks Zoro's sword and sends him underground, using his ability. Luffy tries to help, but is blocked by the Colosseum's bars, which are made of Sea Prism Stone. The rest of the crew, who were listening to the events, are shocked to learn that Doflamingo has an admiral on his side. Fujitora and Doflamingo pick up Law and head for the palace, in order to finish their conversation. Zoro tells Luffy to find a way out, as they try to outrun the Marines. At that point, Sanji's group is attacked by what appears to be a singing ship, which belongs to Big Mom. On the ship are Tamago and Pekoms, who reveal that their goal is Caesar Clown. Caesar believes they want to kill him because he stole research funds from Big Mom. The Straw Hats realize they have to keep their new enemies away from Dressrosa if they want to destroy the factory. Luffy gives the order for the Sunny to head to Zou, Sanji asks permission to return fire to the Emperor's ship with Luffy granting it as he already picked a fight with her, and Franky leads the way for the factory destruction team. Finally, Luffy states in anger that they will head to the palace to save Law and defeat Doflamingo. Meanwhile, a mysterious figure enters the Colosseum.

Quando perguntado por Luffy o que ele está fazendo com seu aliado, Doflamingo responde que Law era originalmente seu subordinado e que era sua responsabilidade "educar" ele. Zoro e Kin'emon tentam salvar Law mas, antes que os fuzileiros façam um movimento para detê-los, o almirante Fujitora aparece, bloqueia a espada de Zoro e o envia para o subsolo, usando sua habilidade. Nesse ponto, o grupo de Sanji é atacado pelo que parece ser um navio de canto, que pertence à Big Mom. No navio estão Tamago e Pekoms, que revelam que seu objetivo é o Palhaço César. César acredita que querem matá-lo porque roubou fundos de pesquisa da Big Mom. Os Straw Hats percebem que precisam manter seus novos inimigos longe de Dressrosa se quiserem destruir a fábrica. en.synopsis:
Luffy rides on Momonusuke's back and they start flying towards Kaido. However, being afraid of heights and having realized that they have been flying, Momonosuke comes crashing down. Meanwhile, as he continues his fight with Kaido Yamato remembers the first time she saw Oden and how the latter's sacrifice to save his retainers touched him as a young child. This caused the young Yamato to rampage around the castle. Yamato was subdued after knocking out several Beast Pirates with Conqueror's Haki. When Yamato declared her love for Oden and declared himself to be Oden, Kaido chained her and locked her up inside the Sacred Cave with three damiyos who rebelled against Kaido, telling them that they would be locked up for a month, but would be let out earlier if they changed their mind and joined his army. Yamato feared the samurai would kill her for being Kaido's child, but instead they showed her nothing but kindness. They gave her the little food they were given, released her from her chains, and trained her. When Yamato saw that the samurai did not intend to harm her, she asked them to help her read Oden's journal which she had found at the foot of Oden Castle. The four read the journal together, learning of the era Oden predicted. After 10 days, the samurai resolved to escape from the cave after seeing that Kaido had no plans on releasing his own son. en.title: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!
en.synopsis:
Corazon talks to Law about the name "D" and states that they are considered troublesome by most and this who fear those who bear the name "D" refer to them as "the sworn enemies of the gods". He also tells Law about his ulterior motives without exposing his relation to the marines, as well as the fact he ate the Calm-Calm Fruit which allows him to nullify sounds. Law threatens Corazon stating that he will tell Doflamingo about his motives and that he could talk. However, Law then changes his mind for Corazon not telling Doflamingo about the stabbing two years ago. As a result, Rosinante takes Law to multiple hospitals in an attempt to save him from the White Lead disease but all the attempts fail. Six months later, Law's disease has worsened and they camp out near the ocean. Corazon stands over Law, who he thinks is asleep, and expresses his regret that Law has to relive the pain he felt in Flevance. Corazon begins crying and states that the pain felt when Law stabbed him was nothing compared to the pain Law must be feeling before walking off. Law, however, was awake and heard everything, and begins crying as well. The next morning, Law wakes Corazon up for breakfast, calling him "Cora-san" to his astonishment. Back in the present, Law presses on his attack on Doflamingo as he swears to himself never to forget the tears Corazon had that night. Inside the palace, Luffy continues dodging Bellamy's strikes when he realizes the Doflamingo clone is behind him. The Doflamingo clone flies toward Luffy as he screams out.

Ele também conta a Law sobre seus motivos ulteriores sem expor sua relação com os fuzileiros, bem como o fato de que ele comeu a fruta Calm-Calm que lhe permite anular sons. Lei ameaça Corazon afirmando que ele vai contar a Doflamingo sobre seus motivos e que ele poderia falar. No entanto, Law então muda de ideia para Corazon não contar a Doflamingo sobre o esfaqueamento há dois anos. Como resultado, Rosinante leva Law a vários hospitais na tentativa de salvá-lo da doença de White Lead, mas todas as tentativas falham. Seis meses depois, a doença de Law piorou e eles acampam perto do oceano. Corazon está acima de Law, que ele acha que está dormindo, e expressa seu pesar que Law tem que reviver a dor que sentiu em Flevance. Corazon começa a chorar e afirma que a dor sentida quando Law o esfaqueou não foi nada comparada à dor que Law deve estar sentindo antes de sair. A lei, no entanto, estava acordada e ouviu tudo, e começa a chorar também. Na manhã seguinte, Law acorda Corazon para o café da manhã, chamando-o de "Cora-san" para seu espanto. No presente, Law pressiona sobre seu ataque a Doflamingo enquanto ele jura para si mesmo nunca esquecer as lágrimas que Corazon teve naquela noite. en.title: The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play
en.synopsis:
With their final battle now resumed, Kaido states that he was sure Luffy had died, to which the latter agrees. Kaido correctly deduces that Luffy had awakened his Paramecia Power as he can transform his surroundings into rubber, but is confused as his transformation is more akin to a Zoan. In his dragon form, he attempts to swallow Luffy whole, but Luffy beats him from his insides, inflates himself inside his belly, and forcefully launches himself out of his mouth by stretching his hands through his eyes. Luffy then grows himself to the size of a giant and starts to use Kaido as a jump rope. Kaido then attempts to strike Luffy with a Blast Breath, sending him off the island, but Luffy is completely unaffected by the attack. Luffy uses cartoon physics to run on air back to Onigashima. At this point, Yamato and Momonosuke travel to the rooftop to investigate the strange battle, discovering Luffy's awakened form. Kaido, transforms into his Human-Beast Form and strikes Luffy with his kanabou, smashing his head into the rooftop and causing the alliance on the Live Floor below to witness Luffy's awakened form, as Nami, Tama, Chopper, even Law and Kid were shocked seeing the giant head, with Marco surprisingly curious about Luffy's appearance. As Luffy returns to normal size, he and Kaido briefly collapse, both too tired to continue to battle. Kaido assures him that he can die, and someone will share the story of his fight, but Luffy refuses, stating that all that is left after dying is bones. As he prepares to reactivate Fifth Gear, Luffy reminds himself of several people he has made promises to or is indebted to, such as Momonosuke, Tama, Kin'emon, and Pedro. As the battle continues, Kaido becomes more confused by Luffy's powers. Luffy punches Kaidou which stretches though Kaido's head, launching him into a rock wall. As he gets back up Kaido asks who he is and Luffy proclaims that his name is Monkey D. Luffy and declares himself is the man who will surpass him and become the King of the Pirates.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.synopsis:
Com a batalha final agora retomada, Kaido afirma que tinha certeza que Luffy tinha morrido, o que este último concorda. Kaido corretamente deduz que Luffy tinha despertado seu Poder Paramecia como ele pode transformar seus arredores em borracha, mas está confuso como sua transformação é mais semelhante a um Zoan. Em sua forma de dragão, ele tenta engolir Luffy inteiro, mas Luffy bate-lo de seu interior, infla-se dentro de sua barriga, e vigorosamente lança-se para fora de sua boca, esticando as mãos através de seus olhos. Luffy então cresce até o tamanho de um gigante e começa a usar Kaido como uma corda de salto. Kaido então tenta atacar Luffy com um sopro, enviando-o para fora da ilha, mas Luffy não é afetado pelo ataque. Luffy usa física de desenhos animados para correr no ar de volta para Onigashima. Neste ponto, Yamato e Momonosuke viajam para o telhado para investigar a estranha batalha, descobrindo a forma desperta de Luffy. Kaido, transforma-se em sua forma de besta humana e atinge Luffy com seu kanabou, quebrando a cabeça no telhado e fazendo com que a aliança no chão ao vivo abaixo testemunhe a forma desperta de Luffy, como Nami, Tama, Chopper, até mesmo Law e Kid ficaram chocados vendo a cabeça gigante, com Marco surpreendentemente curioso sobre a aparência de Luffy. Quando Luffy retorna ao tamanho normal, ele e Kaido colapsam brevemente, ambos cansados demais para continuar a batalha. Kaido garante que ele pode morrer, e alguém vai compartilhar a história de sua luta, mas Luffy se recusa, afirmando que tudo o que resta depois de morrer é ossos. Enquanto se prepara para reativar o Fifth Gear, Luffy se lembra de várias pessoas com quem fez promessas ou está em dívida, como Momonosuke, Tama, Kin'emon e Pedro. À medida que a batalha continua, Kaido fica mais confuso com os poderes de Luffy. Luffy soca Kaidou que se estende pela cabeça de Kaido, lançando-o em uma parede de pedra. Quando ele volta Kaido pergunta quem ele é e Luffy proclama que seu nome é Monkey D. Luffy e declara-se é o homem que vai superá-lo e se tornar o Rei dos Piratas.

On the Neo Marines' ship, Ain calls Shuzo and asks why he was not there. Shuzo tells Ain that he will make a better second-in-command and that he is going after Lily's father. The Straw Hats see Marine ships coming their way who have Lily's father captive. They are heading towards Impel Down, so Luffy declares battle against the Marines.

en.title: The Birth of the Legend! The Adventures of the Revolutionary Warrior Sabo!
en.synopsis:
The Straw Hats along with Law, Bellamy, Kin'emon and Kanjuro retreat to Kyros's house to rest and recover. Sabo arrives soon after to see Luffy and everyone except Robin are shocked to know he is Luffy's brother. Sabo reveals CP-0 is searching for the revolutionaries and they have to leave soon, advising the Straw Hats to also leave soon. Sabo then tells the crew of his past with Luffy and Ace and also what happened to him after he was presumed dead. He recalls the time he first met Dragon, and how he felt trapped by the nobility system on Goa Kingdom, and his disgust towards them for when they burned down Grey Terminal. Feeling trapped, Sabo decided to set out to sea, but encountered a ship much larger than his small vessel. The large ship contained the World Noble Jalmack, who shot Sabo's ship with a bazooka due to it crossing his path. He was rescued by Dragon, who brought him to his ship for medical treatment. When Sabo awoke he'd lost all of his memories, only knowing his name due to it being on his possessions. When the revolutionaries suggest taking him back to his family, Sabo refuses, having a bad feeling about his family despite not remembering them. Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army, and though he couldn't remember his past Sabo had a lot of fighting experience which his body still remembered and eventually raised up the ranks. The Dressrosa palace has begun repair works and the Corrida Colosseum fighters are resting there. Bartolomeo then locks up Cavendish in a chain, telling everyone they will see a monster if they don't lock him up. After telling the crew his story, Franky asks how he get back his memories to which Sabo replies Ace's death awakened his memory.

(Source: Wikipedia)

pt-BR.title: O Nascimento da Lenda! As Aventuras do Guerreiro Revolucionário Sabo!
pt-BR.synopsis:

Sabo chega logo depois para ver Luffy e todos, exceto Robin, ficam chocados ao saber que ele é irmão de Luffy. Sabo revela que CP-0 está procurando os revolucionários e eles têm que sair em breve, aconselhando os Straw Hats também para sair em breve. Sabo então conta a tripulação de seu passado com Luffy e Ace e também o que aconteceu com ele depois que ele foi dado como morto. Ele se lembra da primeira vez que conheceu Dragon, e como ele se sentiu preso pelo sistema de nobreza no Reino de Goa, e sua repugnância com eles por quando queimaram o Terminal Cinzento. Sentindo-se preso, Sabo decidiu partir para o mar, mas encontrou um navio muito maior que seu pequeno navio. O grande navio continha o Nobre Mundo Jalmack, que atirou no navio de Sabo com uma bazuca devido a ele cruzar seu caminho. Ele foi resgatado pelo Dragão, que o trouxe para sua nave para tratamento médico. Quando Sabo acordou ele tinha perdido todas as suas memórias, só sabendo seu nome por estar em suas posses. Quando os revolucionários sugerem levá-lo de volta para sua família, Sabo se recusa, tendo um mau pressentimento sobre sua família, apesar de não se lembrar deles. Sabo se juntou ao Exército Revolucionário, e embora ele não pudesse se lembrar de seu passado Sabo tinha muita experiência de luta que seu corpo ainda lembrava e, eventualmente, levantou as fileiras. O palácio de Dressrosa começou a reparar obras e os combatentes do Coliseu de Corrida estão descansando lá. Bartolomeo então tranca Cavendish em uma corrente, dizendo a todos que verão um monstro se não o trancarem. Depois de contar a história à tripulação, Franky pergunta como ele recupera suas memórias, e Sabo responde que a morte de Ace despertou sua memória.

The battle between Robin's group and the nutcracker army comes to a stop as the toys revert into their human selves due to Sugar being knocked unconscious again. At the palace, Doflamingo questions Luffy's decision to help a former enemy like Bellamy, but Luffy tells him that past is behind him. Doflamingo then berates Bellamy calling him a lowlife. Angered, Luffy tries to kick Doflamingo but hits Bellamy instead when the Warlord uses him like a shield. Law admonishes Luffy to not get angry since Doflamingo likes to provoke his enemies. Doflamingo then tells the duo that he is sick of them ruining his plans and that they remind him of the anger he experienced 13 years ago. Law says if it weren't for that time, he wouldn't be standing here, but Doflamingo retorts that if he didn't do it, Law would have been the "third Corazon" and then attacks Law with a string clone. All the while, Luffy fights a controlled Bellamy. Mad at the Warlord for sitting through the fight, Luffy tells Law that he's gonna take down Doflamingo and readies an attack on Law. Law then creates a ROOM and switches with Doflamingo, causing him to be struck by Luffy's Red Hawk. Trébol is shocked by this surprise, before being incapacitated by Law's Radio Knife. Law tells Luffy that he's the worst but Luffy remarks that he is also part of the same generation.

Akainu won the title and Aokiji left since he didn't want to work for Akainu. He also explains the two changes that happened in the new world after two years which is Akainu becoming fleet admiral and Marshall D. Teach taking all of Whitebeard's territories and claiming the title of "Emperor" among Shanks, Charlotte Linlin and Kaido. Jimbei also claims that Blackbeard is searching for the strongest Devil Fruits so he can extract their abilities and claim them for his own use, with Chopper fearing that he'll be targeted next and Usopp saying that Blackbeard wouldn't want his Human-Human fruit ability. Luffy doesn't listen to Jimbei's blabbing and Luffy sees Keimi and asks where Shirahoshi is and she says that she is in her room. Luffy senses a "big animal" in the palace so he calls Zoro and Sanji to come with him and they find Caribou using his Logia powers to capture Shirahoshi. Luffy kicks him out and Minister of the Right thanks him once again. Minister of the Right wonders why the tower has been cut into pieces and Pappug says that Zoro did it and Zoro gets mad. After hearing Minister of the Right say that Caribou had stolen all the treasure from the vault and that Neptune would give it all to them, Nami reprimands Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji for not tying Caribou up and angrily kicks them out to find him and get the treasure back. Meanwhile in Hordy's cell, Hordy and his crew appear to be aged by the energy steroids that they used, which was later revealed to be aging pills, and still sought vengeance against the royal family, the Straw Hats, and humans. As everyone leaves Hordy's cell, Hordy yells at Fukaboshi for "betraying his kind." Fukaboshi answers by saying that he won't hold vengeance on Hordy for killing his mother and orders him to shut up so the children won't here him and be tainted by his evil. Soon, the Minister of the Left gets news that Baron Tamago and Pekoms, crew members of the Big Mom Pirates, are in Fishman Island going to receive the monthly payment of sweets. Akainu ganhou o título e Aokiji saiu já que não queria trabalhar para Akainu. Ele também explica as duas mudanças que aconteceram no novo mundo depois de dois anos, que é Akainu se tornando almirante da frota e Marshall D. Ensine a tomar todos os territórios do Whitebeard e reivindicar o título de "Imperador" entre Shanks, Charlotte Linlin e Kaido. Jimbei também afirma que Blackbeard está procurando os mais fortes Devil Fruits para que ele possa extrair suas habilidades e reivindicá-los para seu próprio uso, com Chopper temendo que ele será o próximo alvo e Usopp dizendo que Blackbeard não iria querer sua capacidade de fruto humano-humano. Luffy não ouve a tagarelice de Jimbei e Luffy vê Keimi e pergunta onde Shirahoshi está e ela diz que está em seu quarto.
